Anime or manga drawn in a style that was popular in the 2000s. This includes both works originally made in the 2000s in this style, and modern works drawn in a [[faux retro artstyle]]. This tag should not be used for images created in the 2000s that do not fall into this specific art style.

Common characteristics include:

* Bold, black [[lineart]]
* Cel-style "[[anime coloring]]" rendering
* Soft, pillowy shading with no defined form
* Freeform-shaped, "glossy" hair highlights with a low opacity 
* "Moe" proportions (large eyes, small [[dot nose]]s, low-placed mouths)
* Eyes without a defined pupil, instead being blurred with a darker shade or having a loose freeform shaped shadow
* Solid, round eye catchlights
* Common geometric eye shapes like [[jitome]] or [[tsurime]]
* Sharp, [[thick eyelashes|thick]], upturned eyelashes
* Stereotypical anime expressions ([[>_<]], [[:3]], [[blush stickers]] and lines, exaggerated [[sweatdrop]]s)
* Hair drawn with sharp shapes

Shoujo art in this style is typically [[traditional media]], particularly [[colored pencil (medium)|]] or [[watercolor (medium)|]]. Eyes are more rounded and detailed. [[Sparkle]]s are frequently used.

Western artists with a fondness for this style tend to tag their artwork as "animecore":https://aesthetics.fandom.com/wiki/Animecore, a term coined in Tumblr aesthetic communities in the late 2010s to refer to the imagery and culture surrounding anime in the 2000s. It is also sometimes known as "[[moe (phrase)|]] style".

h4. Examples

* !post #1276096: Typical shoujo manga style
* !post #117911: Typical anime and visual novel style
* !post #7939968: [[Faux retro artstyle]] [br] ([[Frutiger Aero]])
* !post #7767789: [[Faux retro artstyle]]
* !post #4703891: [[1980s (style)|]] vs [[1990s (style)|]] vs [[2000s (style)|]]

h4. Related tags

h4. See also

The main protagonist of [[NieR:Automata]].

[i]YoRHa No.2 Type B[/i] or 2B is a female-model YoRHa android created to battle the machine lifeforms that have invaded the planet on behalf of the surviving humans. 2B is calm and composed, she does not encourage idle chatter on frivolous subjects and is generally reticent towards others. She also has high respect for the chain of command and rarely questions her orders. However, 2B occasionally expresses a notably sardonic wit in the face of certain situations and can even be hot-headed at times.

Her canonical attire includes a [[two-sided dress|two-sided]] [[black dress]] with [[cleavage cutout|cleavage]] and [[back cutout]]s and [[long sleeves|long]], [[juliet sleeves|juliet]] [[feather-trimmed sleeves]] under which is worn [[white leotard]] which shows off her [[huge ass|ass]]. On her legs she wears [[thighhighs]] [[thighhighs under boots|under]] a pair of [[high heel boots|high heel]] [[thigh boots]]. On her head typically rests a [[black hairband|black]] [[hairband]] on short [[white hair]]. Over her eyes is a black [[blindfold]]. Occasionally throughout the events of the game her blindfold is removed and is thus sometimes [[no blindfold|not included]] by artists. Her eye color is [[blue eyes|blue]], and has a [[mole under mouth|mole under her mouth]].

She has an [[alternate color]]ed appearance in [[Soulcalibur VI]] and [[Final Fantasy XIV]] known as [[2P (nier:automata)|]]. In this appearance she has [[dark skin]], [[black hair]], and white clothes. 2B has made appearances in several other games, including [[Star Ocean: Anamnesis]], [[SINoALICE]], [[Phantasy Star Online 2]], among others.

h4. Appearance

* !post #2242944: Profile

The 🤟 hand gesture. The thumb, index, and pinkie fingers are held out, while the middle and ring fingers touch the palm of the hand.

Not to be confused with [[\n/]] (🤘), where the thumb is held down instead of extended out.

In anime, it is well known for being part of the [[Sailor Moon]]'s famous [[Tsuki ni kawatte oshioki yo]] ("I'll punish you") pose, for [[Ranka Lee]]'s dance move in [[Macross Frontier]] while singing the song [[Seikan Hikou]], and for the association with [[Yazawa Nico]]'s catchphrase, [[nico nico nii]].

In American sign language it's known as the "I Love You" sign, after a combination of the ASL signs for the letters I, L, and Y. 

May also be called the "Rumic Sign" after [[Takahashi Rumiko]]'s older comics ([[Ranma 1/2]], [[Inuyasha]]) using the sign as a form of comedy.

The 🤘 hand gesture. The index and pinkie fingers are raised, while the middle and ring fingers are held down by the thumb.

Known in the West as "the sign of the horns", "the devil's horns", or "throwing the horns". Often associated with [[heavy metal]] music, which was made popular by [[Ronnie James Dio]]. Originated as an apotropaic gesture to ward off the "evil eye," a curse cast by [[glaring]] at someone with hostility.

Not to be confused with [[\m/]] (🤟) (when the thumb is held out) or with [[fox shadow puppet]] (when the fingers are extended forward to make a fox muzzle).

An [[iDOLMASTER Cinderella Girls|iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls]] character in the Cute (Pink Flower) category, Nana is a hardworking and determined individual. Her appearances show that she likes to dress in maid outfits, something that reflects her attitude. She is also optimistic and believes that she can become a top idol. She is also caring for the Producer, as she sees him as a partner and confidant. Her hobby is communicating with her 'home planet' Usamin. Some of her speeches involves uttering "Pipi", signifying her communicating from there. She is a fan of anime, and one of her dreams is to become a seiyuu.

Some of her Affection UP and MAX comments reveal that she is not a real alien, and is a normal girl, but hopes that the Producer doesn't expose that fact and that they'll continue to work together. She claims to be "eternally 17", but it is hinted on her CD interview that that this is not true and she is actually at least in her early 20's, after her mother calls her to remind her to vote.

Due to her popularity, she was selected for the fourth CINDERELLA MASTER CD series, alongside [[Akagi Miria]], [[Koshimizu Sachiko]], [[Hino Akane (Idolmaster)|Hino Akane]], and [[Nitta Minami]]. She is voiced by [[Miyake Marie]] [三宅 麻理恵].

payload.body:
[b]Abyssal ships[/b] (深海棲艦, [i]shinkaisei-kan[/i]) are monstrous enemy ships in the [[Kantai Collection]] universe.

Abyssals are characterized by their [[pale skin]], black armor plates, [[glowing eyes|glowing]] [[aqua eyes]], and many [[teeth|toothy]] mouths. Alternate [[glowing|glows]] include [[red eyes|red]], [[yellow eyes|yellow]], and [[blue eyes|blue]].

The weaker versions tend towards being all black armor plates with fish-like forms, while the more powerful, "evolved" forms tend towards being humans with large black metal guns attached. In-between ships tend to have a human part (like just the torso or just the head) leading into metal-skull-crab parts.

Just as player shipgirls take inspiration from real WWII Axis warships, many abyssal boss or event-type characters seem inspired by real-life bases or ships from the Axis or Allied sides. Earlier bosses notably were more Allied (including Port Darwin as [[Seaport Princess]] or [[Isolated Island Oni]] as Wake Island) while more recent bosses are clearly meant to reflect [[dark_persona|dark versions]] of Japanese ships ([[Aircraft Carrier Water Oni]] as "dark [[Shoukaku (kancolle)|]]" or [[Destroyer Princess]] as "dark [[Harusame (kancolle)|]]").

Abyssal ships were designed and illustrated by [[Oguchi]] (regular enemies) and [[Akira (Kadokawa)]] (boss characters & submarines). Most of their model numbers are based on the "Iroha order":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iroha].

payload.body:
[[Toaru Majutsu no Index]] character.

Accelerator is the 1st-ranked [[Level 5 (ToAru)|]], the strongest esper currently residing in [[Academy City]]. He is nicknamed after his ability, which allows him to manipulate vectors.

He is the second protagonist of the Science Side in [[Toaru Majutsu no Index]]. First appearing chronologically as an antagonist, he later becomes the primary male protagonist of the Science Side after being defeated by [[Kamijou Touma]]. His journey to a more "heroic" role in the story progresses after meeting and saving [[Last Order (toaru Majutsu No Index)|]], and is forced into an ironic twist of fate where his life now depends on the [[misaka imouto|Sisters]], clones he previously killed by the thousands. He is also a major antagonistic character in [[Toaru Kagaku no Railgun]] and the protagonist of [[Toaru Kagaku no Accelerator]].

In his role as a protagonist, he is forced to deal with the cruel Dark Side of Academy City and the secret conspiracies surrounding it. As the most powerful esper of Academy City, his existence and powers are tied to the plans of [[Aleister Crowley (toaru Majutsu No Index)|]], the founder of Academy City, alongside Touma.

Having short, [[white hair]] and [[choker]] grants him a little resemblance to [[Riku (kingdom hearts)|]] of [[Kingdom Hearts]].

Voiced by [[Okamoto Nobuhiko]].

h4. See also

* [[Suzushina Yuriko]]

A grown up version of the series's main character, [[Neptune (neptunia)|]]. Unlike the original Neptune, this version is a normal human. She first appears offscreen (voice only) in the true ending of [[Kami Jigen Game Neptune V|Victory/Re;Birth 3]], with her first proper appearance in [[Shin Jigen Game Neptune VII|Megadimension Neptunia VII]].

[spoiler]This Neptune is from the Ultradimension, but never became a CPU. In the true ending of Victory/Re;Birth 3, she encounters and captures [[Croire]]. She later appears in Megadimension Neptunia VII, having used Croire's dimension travel ability to travel to the Zero Dimension.[/spoiler]

She looks like an [[aged up]] version of Neptune, with [[alternate color|a black]] hoodie and [[long hair|longer]] [[official alternate hair length|hair]]. She [[dual wielding|dual wields]] two [[sword]]s, sometimes replacing one of the swords with a [[handgun]].

Voice actors: [[Tanaka Rie]] (Japanese), [[Melissa Fahn]] (English)

She has [[long hair|long]] [[brown hair]] worn in a [[rope braid|rope]] [[braided ponytail]] (often mistaken or simplified as a regular braid) with [[parted bangs]] and [[wavy hair|wavy]] [[sidelocks]], fastened with a [[pink ribbon|pink]] [[hair ribbon]] and sometimes a visible green [[materia]], [[green eyes]], [[medium breasts]], sometimes [[pale skin]], a [[cropped jacket|cropped]] [[red jacket]] with [[short sleeves]] ([[puffy short sleeves]] in the original [[Final Fantasy VII|FFVII]]) over a [[long dress|long]] [[pink dress|pink]] [[sleeveless dress]] with [[brown boots]], a [[flower choker]] (simple [[ribbon choker]] prior to [[Final Fantasy VII Remake|FF7R]]) and [[bangle]]s on each wrist. Often carries a [[yellow flower]] and [[flower basket]] and wields a [[staff]].

She was first voiced in English by Mandy Moore in Kingdom Hearts, she was later voiced by Mena Suvari in Kingdom Hearts II and Advent Children, then by Andrea Bowen in Crisis Core and Kingdom Hearts III.  Her voice in the remake and Crisis Core Reunion is performed by Briana White.  Her voice in all Japanese media is performed by [[Sakamoto Maaya]].

Her default outfit is the class' uniform: a white [[serafuku]] that exposes her [[midriff]] with a red [[pleated skirt]], [[blue necktie]], [[white gloves]], [[belt]], [[grey footwear|grey]] [[rudder footwear]], and has [[uneven legwear]] where the left leg has a [[single thighhigh]] stocking on a [[garter_straps|garter strap]].

Her [[rigging]] consists of her real-life bridge, [[smokestack]], and mast worn in a backpack-like arrangement, her three 15.2 cm twin gun mounts controlled by [[joystick]]s, an 8 cm twin [[anti-aircraft gun]] mount on her right ankle, and a [[flight deck]] on her left leg.

[[Umamusume]] character.

Digital (referred to in game as Digi-tan) is a diehard [[otaku]] fan of [[horse girl]]s, analogous to an [[idol]] otaku in real life. She is often seen fangirling over her fellow schoolmates/colleagues or cheering them on with [[glowstick]]s. This trait is exaggerated in fanart, where she will often react violently (i.e. heart attack, massive nosebleed, [[so moe I'm gonna die!]]) to whatever wholesome or adorable event she deems "precious".

Her portrayal as an otaku is due to the real life horse's nickname of "Deviant Horse" or "Hentai Horse", referring to the horse's success as a Jack-of-all-trades (and not to any particular sexual attraction to other horses). In the game, she thrives on all terrains as well as Mile and Medium distances and is relatively well balanced on stats.

An [[iDOLMASTER Cinderella Girls|iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls]] character in the Passion (Yellow Sun) category.

Yumi is a home gardener who seeks to become a flower themed idol. Her idol costumes always have a flower theme, with newer cards are getting more elaborate with it. She always has flower in her hair when doing stage work. Every single card she has, with exception to the New Year cards, has her smiling in them.

In the tie in Cinderella Girls Theater skits, Yumi is a friendly girl who loves flowers and plant life. She seems to be a friend of [[Abe Nana]], although she has come dangerously close to finding out about Nana’s true age. She successfully creates a chocolate carving of a rose, and gets [[Miyamoto Frederica]]’s “Frederica” song stuck in her head when they continue baking. On Halloween, she dresses as a vampire and threatens the Producer to give her some candy or she’d bite him. He decides to allow her to bite him, but she is entirely too embarrassed to do so. In the end, the Producer gives her a bag of sweets.

Due to her popularity, she was selected for the 9th set of CINDERELLA MASTER CD series, alongside [[Ninomiya Asuka]], [[Ohtsuki Yui]], [[Nakano Yuka]], and [[Igarashi Kyoko]]. She is voiced by [[Kimura Juri]] [木村 珠莉].

[[Umamusume]] character. Voiced by [[Aoki Ruriko]]. 

Vice President of the Tracen Academy Student Council. Frequently the victim of [[Symboli Rudolf (umamusume)|]]'s [i]horrible[/i] puns.

Air Groove's official character profile originally had a line mentioning that "she hates men because of a certain traumatic incident in a race". This was a reference to the 1997 Japan Cup incident where another horse, [[Pilsudski (Racehorse)|]], won the race in front of Air Groove in spite of said horse flashing at the paddock in front of the crowd (and other horses including Air Groove), which is normally seen as a sign of distraction by Japanese horse racing fans. This line was subsequently removed, but the incident is still referenced in Air Groove's relationship with [[Fine Motion (Umamusume)|]], as the real-life Fine Motion is the half-sister of [[Pilsudski (Racehorse)|]]. Later, Fine Motion's career mode would give Fine an unseen older sister hopelessly enamored with Air Groove, as a more overt reference to Pilsudski and the incident.

Airfield Princess is an enemy [[abyssal ship]] in [[Kantai Collection]]. She was the boss of the fourth event map during the Fall 2013 event.

She has [[very_long_hair|very long]] [[white_hair|white]] hair, [[orange eyes]], and small [[horns]]. She wears a white [[leotard]] and has two rows of two spikes each along her lower back. She also wears white [[ankle boots]] with two spikes underneath them. Her right arm seems to be either a [[single mechanical arm]] or wearing a [[gauntlets|gauntlet]] with claws.

She is nicknamed "Henderson-chan" or just "Henderson" as a reference to "Henderson Field":http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Henderson_Field_%28Guadalcanal%29, which is what she is based on. [[Lycoris Princess]] also represents Henderson Field but in 1943 instead of 1942 in the case of Airfield Princess.

She is also nicknamed "Lycoris Henderson" as in the Fall 2013 Event (The Iron Bottom Sound Event) the E4 boss node were named as Lycoris Air Base.

The [b]AK-47[/b] (Russian: [b]А[/b]втомат [b]К[/b]алашникова образца 19[b]47[/b] года) is a 7.62×39mm [[assault rifle]] of [[Soviet]] origin, developed between 1944–1946 by [[Mikhail Kalashnikov]]. The AK platform has a reputation for its ruggedness, reliability, simple mechanism and ease of manufacture. It can perform well with steel-cased or low quality [[ammunition]] and under harsh conditions.

The original AK-47 is distinguishable from other [[Kalashnikov rifle]]s by its fixed buttstock with slanted profile, a milled receiver with a large rectangular indentation as the [[magazine (weapon)|]] guide and a smooth dust cover.

Do not simply tag any [[Kalashnikov rifle]] as AK-47 without looking thoroughly at its details.

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese aircraft carrier [i]Akagi[/i]. Character design by [[Shibafu_(glock23)|]], voiced by [[Fujita Saki]]. 

She has [[long hair|long,]] [[straight hair|straight]] [[brown hair]] and [[brown eyes]]. She is typically seen wearing a [[muneate]] over white and red [[japanese clothes]] in a [[nontraditional miko]] style with a red [[tasuki]]. She also wears an apron based on the stern end of her flight deck, with the kana "ア" inscribed on it. She wears white [[thighhighs]].

Her [[rigging]] includes notably less armor or machinery than most shipgirls. She holds a traditional [[Kyuudou]] [[bow_(weapon)|bow]] and has [[arrow (projectile)|]]s in a [[quiver]] slung over her shoulder by a strap which also has a replica of her ship's [[mast]]. On her right arm, she has her flight deck worn like a shield. She wears [[geta]]-like sandals that have carrier-like decks on them.

She is nicknamed the "Bauxite Queen" and portrayed as a [[glutton]]ous eater thanks to her reputation for eating up all the Bauxite reserves in your inventory.

payload.body:
An [[Idolmaster Cinderella Girls]] character in the Passion (Yellow Sun) category.

A young girl who really loves to talk. Possessing boundless energy, a sunny and positive outlook, and enthusiasm for everything she does, Miria became an idol because doing all the cute things seemed fun. She can be pretty mature at times, calling the Producer "cute" and asking him to spend time with her on their days off. But when it comes down to it, she's just a curious little girl who dreams of being an idol. Since she's 11, she's still pretty childish and naive, but she does her best at everything idol-related.

Her curiosity is quickly used as one of her charm points.
Due to her popularity, she was selected for the fourth CINDERELLA MASTER CD series, alongside [[Abe Nana]], [[Koshimizu Sachiko]], [[Hino Akane (Idolmaster)|Hino Akane]], and [[Nitta Minami]]. She is voiced by [[Kurosawa Tomoyo]].

She is in the unit [[Decoration (idolmaster)|]] with [[Jougasaki Rika]] and [[Moroboshi Kirari]] and their unit costumes are [[Pikapikapop (idolmaster)|]] in the anime.

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese repair ship [i]Akashi[/i]. Character designed by [[Fujikawa]], voiced by [[Taneda Risa]]. 

She has [[long_hair|long]] [[pink hair]] with [[blunt tresses|freshly cut strands]] held by [[tress_ribbon|red tress ribbons]], as well as [[green eyes]].

The playable and NPC versions of Akashi have slightly different outfits. Both versions wear a [[serafuku]] (identical to [[Ooyodo (kancolle)|]]'s) on top of a [[long_sleeves|long-sleeved]] zippered shirt, along with a [[blue_skirt|blue]] [[pleated skirt]] with hakama-like [[hip_vent|hip vents]] and [[thighhighs]]. The NPC version has white stripes along the bottom edge of her skirt while the playable version has a wider red stripe along the edge.

The playable version wears pieces of [[armor]], propeller platform shoes and she has several cranes attached to her ship parts. Once remodeled, she wears a white [[bandana]] and actual weapons (mostly anti-air guns) are attached to her.

As an NPC, she runs the premium shop and the Large Ship Construction system. 

As a playable character, she is used to slowly repair minor damage to other ships if she is the flagship of a fleet. When set as secretary ship (first fleet flagship), she is able to improve equipment in her armory arsenal.

Naturally, she is usually paired with fellow NPC [[Ooyodo (kancolle)|]]. She is also occasionally paired with [[Yuubari (kancolle)|]], usually featuring their mutual love of tinkering with and improving equipment.

[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese destroyer [i]Akatsuki[/i]. Character design by [[Yadokari (Migihashi)|]], voiced by [[Suzaki Aya]].

She has [[purple eyes]] and [[long_hair|long]] [[purple hair]] that can be fairly [[messy_hair|messy]], and usually has a tuft of [[hair_between_eyes|hair between her eyes]]. Her default outfit is the Special-Type's [[serafuku]] ([[white shirt]], [[black sailor collar]], [[red neckerchief]], [[black skirt|black]] [[pleated skirt]]), but with [[black pantyhose]], a [[flat cap]], and the "III" badge on the left side of her collar.

She does her best to act like a true lady and thus doesn't like to be [[age_conscious|treated as a child]], especially in regards to [[headpat]]ting. Her protests that she is a "full-fledged lady" or "first-class lady" have become something of a catchphrase: [[ichininmae no lady]]. This has the side effect of making her look even more childish. Many characters enjoy teasing her by doing things that play upon her being childish, such as giving her [[okosama_lunch|children's meals]].

payload.body:
Sometimes nicknamed [I][[akkari~n|Akarin]][/I], Akari is supposedly the main protagonist of [[YuruYuri]]. However, as she is an ordinary person and often pales in comparison to the other characters, she is often bantered with her small presence and pushed into the background. Her friends often peg her character as having the ability to turn invisible and fire her '[[double bun|hair buns]]' like missiles. 

[[Toshinou Kyouko]] and [[Funami Yui]] are her childhood friends, while [[Yoshikawa Chinatsu]], [[Oomuro Sakurako]] and [[Furutani Himawari]] are some of her classmates.

Akari has an older sister named [[Akaza Akane]].

payload.body: [[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese destroyer [i]Akebono[/i]. Character design by [[Drew (drew213g)|]], voiced by [[Hayasaka Kozue]]. She has [[purple eyes]] and [[very long hair|very long]] [[purple hair]] in a [[side ponytail]], plus a [[hair flower]] and [[hair bell]]. Her default outfit is shared with the other Special Types, consisting of a [[short_sleeves|short-sleeved]] shirt and [[blue_skirt|blue]] [[pleated_skirt]]. She also typically wears [[black socks|black]] [[kneehighs]] and [[loafers]] outside of her combat gear. Her [[rigging]] consists of her funnel-mast set worn like a backpack, a handheld 12.7 cm twin gun mount, and carried over a shoulder strap. Her shoes are armored, and she wears dual torpedo turrets on her thighs, like many in the [i]Fubuki-class[/i]. She refers to the [[Admiral (kancolle)|]] as a "[[Shitty Admiral_(phrase)|]]" and is seemingly always angry about something, stemming from her ill experiences during the war. In some fanworks, calling the admiral "shitty" is so ingrained in her, she even calls the admiral "shitty admiral" when she's in love, like other girls might say "darling". She's typically portrayed as a [[tsundere]] with almost no dere, at least not verbally, or a "bitter-tongued tsukkomi. Oftentimes, she's seen playing a big sister role to [[Ushio (kancolle)|]], who is often portrayed as the most childish and clumsy of the 7th Des Div. Along with the rest of the 7th DesDiv, Akebono has been one of the most frequent targets of limited-time special event artwork. h4. payload.body:
A character from [[Mahou Shoujo Madoka Magica]]. A mysterious and aloof girl who transfers to Mitakihara Middle School, encountering [[Kaname Madoka]] in the process, with intentions yet to be known to anyone. [spoiler]It is later discovered that Homura's actions are due to her contract with [[Kyubey]] following the death of Madoka in a previous timeline. This has led her to create numerous timelines in order to avert Madoka's doom.[/spoiler]

She has [[long hair|long]] [[black hair]], [[purple eyes]], and wears a [[hairband]]. She can also be seen with [[twin braids]] held by dark purple ribbons and [[red-framed eyewear]], [spoiler]particularly in the past timelines.[/spoiler], the latter appearance often being nicknamed "Moemura" by the English speaking fandom. She is often seen in the [[Mitakihara school uniform]] with [[black pantyhose]] or [[black socks|black]] [[kneehighs]].

When transformed into her [[magical girl|magical]] form, she wears a [[capelet]], a [[pleated skirt]], [[high heels|high heeled]] [[boots]] with [[argyle footwear|argyle]] patterns that cover the entire legs, and sometimes also has a [[shield]] on her lower left arm. She primarily uses mundane weapons such as guns and bombs. 

[spoiler]Her shield acts like a seemingly infinite portable storage space for her weapons, and also allows her to manipulate and travel through time.[/spoiler]

She is voiced by [[Saitou Chiwa]] (Japanese) and [[Cristina Valenzuela|Cristina Vee]] (English).

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese destroyer [i]Akigumo[/i]. Character design by [[Fujikawa]], voiced by [[Taketatsu Ayana]]. 

She has [[long hair|long]] [[brown hair]] tied to a long [[ponytail]], [[green eyes]], and a [[mole_under_eye|mole under her right eye]]. Due to historical confusion on what class she was in, she wears the standard [i]Yuugumo[/i]-class uniform: a purple [[halterneck]] [[pleated dress]] over a [[white shirt]] with [[long sleeves]], [[blue bowtie]], and [[grey pantyhose]] with a pair of [[lace-up boots]]. 

Her [[rigging]] is a hybrid of the styles seen in the [i]Kagerou[/i]- and [i]Yuugumo[/i]-class: her bridge and foremast to her back with a 25 mm [[anti-aircraft gun]], a 12.7 cm twin [[handgun]] mount, and two 61 cm quad [[torpedo tubes]] on [[thigh strap]]s. 

Due to her lines (and the fact that her crew illustrated the sinking [[Hornet (kancolle)|]] in the battle of the Santa Cruz Islands), she is often portrayed as a manga artist and is sometimes shown "being involved in doujinshi":/pools/9514. 

The historical [i]Akigumo[/i] was initially grouped with the [i]Yuugumo[/i]-class by historians. This was due to her following the [i]-gumo[/i] naming scheme and because the [i]Kagerou[/i] and [i]Yuugumo[/i]-classes were quite similar in design. Researchers later found documents in 1994 indicating that she was actually meant to be the last of the [i]Kagerou[/i]-class.

payload.body:
Akita Neru is a [[Vocaloid]] character, originally fanmade, now recognized as an official derivative of [[Hatsune Miku]] by Crypton. Her design was created by [[Smith Hioka]] in 2007. 

She started out as a meme on [[2channel]], when a troll user started spamming all Vocaloid related threads. Some user commented that he wouldn't get angry only if the troll was a cute girl. Thus Akita Neru, a [[tsundere]] non-Vocaloid net-chara was born. Her name came from the trolls' comments "I'm tired" (飽きた, Akita) and "going to sleep" (寝る, Neru).

Her image color is orange-ish yellow and her character item is a [[cellphone]]. Neru is written by some as a Miku wannabe, by others as the anti-hero of the Vocaloid personage. She has been officially recognized as a [[Hatsune Miku|Miku]] derivative by Crypton since 2008, and most vocal representations of Neru uses Miku's voicebank, such as those by Ohshio Kuimu (though some producers use [[Kagamine Rin|Rin]]'s voicebank, ala NanameueP, and some fans use the phone noises from Triple Baka).

In the West, she's largely remembered for her appearance in [[Triple Baka (Vocaloid)|]]. She would once more return to prominence in 2024 as a result of a meme relating to [[Mesmerizer (Vocaloid)|]], due to a reply to a tweet reminiscing about Triple Baka, where Neru was called ""the yellow one that doesn't appear in Mesmerizer":[https://twitter.com/FailedDumbFuck/status/1800938120416010623]". The wave of Neru fanart that followed would culminate in [[SWAGAMICCHI]]'s fan design for what Neru "could've looked like ":[/posts/7736166] in Mesmerizer. She would have her first major song in years in 2025, with [[Zako (Vocaloid)|]].

She respects Miho from the bottom of her heart.

[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese destroyer [i]Akizuki[/i]. Character design by [[Shizuma Yoshinori]], voiced by [[Ozawa Ari]]. 

She has [[medium hair|medium-length]] [[black hair]] with a [[hachimaki]] and tied to a [[ponytail]], and [[blue eyes]]. Her default outfit, the class uniform, is composed of a [[white shirt]] with a [[black sailor collar]], [[yellow neckerchief]], [[grey corset]] patterned off her real-life bow, two-tone [[white gloves|white]]-[[black gloves]], [[white skirt|white]] [[pleated skirt|pleated]] [[miniskirt]], [[white socks]], and knee-length [[rudder footwear]].

Her [[rigging]] consists of her real-life fire control director as a ponytail tie, 61 cm quad [[torpedo tubes]] to her back, and two hull pieces with sentient 10 cm [[anti-aircraft gun|dual-purpose]] guns named [[Chou-10cm-hou-chan (akizuki's)|]]. She also carries four spare 10cm barrels in a [[thigh strap]] holster on her right leg, referencing the 10cm Type 98 gun's short barrel life requiring frequent barrel replacement.

She is nicknamed "ducky" due to the alternate Kunrei-shiki (official) Japanese romanization rendering her name as [i]Akiduki[/i] instead of the Hepburn form (which Danbooru uses). Together, Akizuki and her sisters [[Teruzuki (kancolle)|]] and [[Hatsuzuki (kancolle)|]] are sometimes referred to as "the duckies".

Her hourly lines reflect how, due to being a late-war destroyer, her crew had to suffer through a shortage of rations, where meat was rarely served. As a result, there are often jokes of her being in awe of even ordinary food and having her mind blown by something luxurious (pool #10990).

He is also the only [i]boy[/i], let alone a [[crossdressing]] one, to make appearances in [[Idolmaster Cinderella Girls]].

The main character of [[Alice's Adventures in Wonderland]]. A curious little girl who ends up on an unplanned adventure when she falls down a rabbit hole. Throughout the story she is in search of the [[White Rabbit (alice In Wonderland)|]].

Alice is popularly depicted wearing a pale blue knee-length dress with a white [[apron|pinafore]] overtop. Her hair is held back with a wide ribbon.

Since many early illustrations were black and white, her colors would vary from artist to artist; it was [[Disney]] who made blue the most popular color for her dress [[blue eyes|her eyes]] and [[blonde hair|blonde]] for her hair. Completing the signature appearance are white [[pantyhose]], [[bloomers]] and a black [[hairband]].

Disney's depiction of Alice is so popular that in subsequent media, it is common for a character named "Alice" to share the aforementioned traits from Disney's Alice (especially her costumes as well as her hair and eye color), even if that said character has nothing to do with Alice in Wonderland itself.

[[Touhou]] character. Stage 3 and Extra Stage boss of [[Mystic Square]] and later a recurring playable character. One of the few [[touhou (pc-98)|PC-98 era]] characters (along with [[Hakurei Reimu|Reimu]] and [[Kirisame Marisa|Marisa]]) to reappear in the Windows-era games. She first appeared in her current design as the Stage 3 boss of [[Perfect Cherry Blossom]]. She is often accompanied by her dolls, [[Shanghai Doll]], [[Hourai Doll]], or [[Goliath Doll]].

A human-turned-youkai [[witch]] who specializes in manipulating [[doll]]s and using them to attack her enemies. Unlike [[Kirisame Marisa|Marisa]], her neighbor in the [[Forest of Magic]], Alice is not only rather aloof, but also somewhat cowardly at heart, refusing to use her full power for any reason because she would not know how to deal with losing. This nature leads to [[doujinshi]] portraying her as having some tendencies of being [[tsundere]] towards her [[human village (touhou)|human neighbor]]. Speculated to be the daughter of [[Shinki (touhou)|]]. Bearer of the [[Grimoire of Alice]].

She has [[short hair|short]] [[blonde hair]] with a [[frilled hairband|frilled]] [[red hairband]] and [[blue eyes]]. Her outfit is a [[pink neckerchief|pink]] or [[red neckerchief]], a [[white capelet]] over a (possibly) [[sleeveless dress|sleeveless]] [[blue dress]] and a [[long sleeves|long-sleeved]] [[white shirt]], a [[pink sash|pink]] or [[red sash]], and [[brown boots]].

The [[Touhou (PC-98)|Touhou PC-98]] version of [[Alice Margatroid]] as she appeared in [[Mystic Square]]. This version of Alice is considerably [[aged down]] and wears a [[white_dress|pink/white dress]] with a [[blue apron]], a [[blue_hairband|matching headband]] with a ribbon on the side, as well as [[white socks]]. She has [[blonde hair]] and [[yellow_eyes|gold eyes]] like in all of her later appearances (except [[Perfect Cherry Blossom]]). She has carried her signature [[grimoire]] since the Extra Stage.

Her connection with [[Shinki (touhou)|]] is typically assumed by fans to be a [[mother and daughter|mother-daughter]] relationship.

A popular nickname for Young Alice is Lolice, as in "Loli Alice."

For the sake of exclusionary searching, do not use the [[aged down]] tag if it's simply featuring the PC-98 Alice (as she appeared in Mystic Square) in a PC-98 context. Examples of when it is fine to use the tag:

* PC-98 Alice appears alongside the Windows/current version of Alice
* PC-98 Alice appears as a flashback in a comic set in the Windows era
* The Alice looks younger (e.g. she's a baby or a toddler) than she appeared in Mystic Square
* Anything involving Windows Touhou is featured in the artwork

payload.body:
The personification of the battlecruiser [[amagi_(battlecruiser)|Amagi]] in [[Azur Lane]], introduced as part of the [i]Crimson Echoes[/i] event. Character design by [[Liduke]], voiced by [[Sawashiro Miyuki]].

She is a [[kyuubi]] [[fox girl]] like her younger sister [[Akagi_(azur_lane)|]], with [[long_hair|long]] [[brown hair]] and [[purple eyes]] with red pupils. Her outfit consists of a [[red haori]] over a [[crane print]] dark [[purple kimono]] with [[bodystocking]] underneath, and an [[oil-paper umbrella]] in her hand in addition to her [[rigging]].

A natural strategist, Amagi is much more level-headed than Akagi, always behaving in a professional manner and being respectful towards the [[Commander (azur lane)|]]. However, she suffers from coughing fits, a reference to how her keel snapped during her conversion to a carrier in an earthquake, and is highly conscious of her own frail health, which is manifested in the story as a [[Wisdom Cube (azur lane)|]] with a crack on it.

The historical [i]Amagi[/i] was supposed to be the first in a four-ship class of battlecruisers, developed as part of the Imperial Japanese Navy's Eight-Eight Fleet Program. However, construction was halted as a result of the Washington Naval Treaty, before she and [i]Akagi[/i] underwent conversion into aircraft carriers. [i]Amagi[/i]'s conversion, however, was cut short when her keel snapped during the Great Kanto Earthquake, forcing her to be scrapped like her other two sister ships two years later. 

[[Amagi (cv) (azur lane)|Amagi (CV)]], an ultra-rare reimagining of her, was introduced in the 7th anniversary [i]Ode of Everblooming Crimson[/i] event in September 2024. In the event story, Amagi completed her fateful conversion to an [i]Amagi[/i]-class aircraft carrier, restoring her to full health in the process.

At base form, she wears a [[floral print|floral pattern]] [[green kimono]] with a [[green sash|green]] [[obi]] bearing her real-life [[flight deck]] camouflage pattern, and carries her banner-rod wrapped on her back. Her [[rigging]] consists of two hull pieces painted in green, bearing her real-life bridge and [[anti-aircraft gun]]s. When she is damaged, she slumps sideways, a reference to how she was sunk in real-life.

She has a high-strung, yet still "mature woman" personality, with a lack of confidence in her abilities and constant worry about air attacks. The ⚨ symbol.

A mix of the [[mars symbol|mars]] (♂) and [[venus symbol|venus]] (♀) symbols.

It can be used to refer to characters that have an [[androgynous]] appearance, characters that are intersex/hermaphrodite/[[futanari]], or characters with a non-binary gender identity.

It can be shown pointing in any direction, and the direction is sometimes used to distinguish androgyne and intersex.

Closely related to and commonly interchanged with with the [[male-female symbol]] (⚥). Distinctly separate and not to be confused with the [[transgender symbol]] (⚧).

Pronounced "An-hell" (as per the Spanish pronunciation of the word, therefore properly written as Ángel), a [[The King of Fighters|King of Fighters]] character who is well known for her striptease and killer physique, notably her [[large breasts|big breasts]] - tied with [[Shermie (kof)|]] for the biggest bust in all of KOF at 92 cm.

In [[The King of Fighters 2001]], Angel is introduced as an agent of the secret organization known as NESTS. A NESTS experiment herself, she is genetically augmented to have superhuman physical capabilities, including strength, agility, endurance and reflexes. She is assigned to keep an eye on the experiment [[K9999]], whose purpose is to hunt down traitorous experiments that had left NESTS. During the final moments of the tournament, it is revealed that both Angel and K9999 are actually on a mission to kill [[Kula Diamond]] and her guardians, but ultimately fail to do so. When NESTS ultimately falls, Angel escapes on her own and disappears.

In [[The King of Fighters XIV]], it is revealed that Angel abandoned NESTS entirely in its final moments and is now living for herself in her native [[Mexico]], though she is harrassed by NESTS agents for her betrayal. She still doesn't get along with Kula or the rest of Team K'. She forms a part of the new Team Mexico alongside [[Ramon (kof)|]] and the [[King of Dinosaurs|]].

In [[The King of Fighters XV]], Angel reunites with K9999 - now a fellow NESTS renegade under his new name [[Krohnen]] and with a slightly less volatile temperament - and teams up with him and a rebellious Kula to stick it to Team K'. After the tournament, Angel returns Kula to her guardians without a fuss and decides to travel with Krohnen for a while.

Angel's fighting style is self-described as "perfunctory," meaning she has no real training and makes up her style and strategy on the fly as she goes. This manifests as a combination of unorthodox speedy attacks and a small assortment of professional [[wrestling]] moves, particularly those inspired by [[the rock (dwayne johnson)|Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson]].

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese heavy cruiser [i]Aoba[/i].

She has [[messy_hair|messy]] [[pink hair]] or [[purple hair]] tied into a [[ponytail]] and held by a [[scrunchie]], and [[blue eyes]]. Her default outfit is a [[white shirt|white]] [[sailor shirt]] with a [[blue sailor collar|blue collar]] and a yellow [[neckerchief]], and blue [[shorts]].  She also wears [[black_thighhighs|black]] [[thighhighs]].  

Her [[rigging]] consists of a pair of 203 mm twin gun mounts carried on a strap like a purse on her right, with a [[flight deck]] on her left.  On her back, she carries a mockup of the real ship's bridge like a backpack.  

In the "supplementary material for the 2016 anime film":[https://twitter.com/tayotayo1224/status/1518217102226001920], Aoba is revealed to have a second remodel/kai ni, but remains unimplemented in-game due to her original artist [[Hatsuko]] no longer in touch with C2 Kikan since 2015. Her kai ni transforms her back rig to her real-life bridge superstructure with a mast, a crane on the left/portside, and a catapult on the right/starboard. Her two 20.3 cm twin mounts are also remounted to a new portable rig similar to [[Kinugasa Kai Ni (Kancolle)|]]. In addition, she also gains a third 20.3 cm twin mount attached to the left side of her shorts. 

The historical Aoba famously had a war correspondent onboard, and as such, Aoba has been made out into being the "reporter shipgirl":[/pools/8444]. At best, this makes her optimistic and enthusiastic, but at worst, she's portrayed as a stalker or paparazzi (whether she's portrayed as one or the other is largely artist- and/or story-dependent).  (In fact, due to the heavy overlap of artists between [[Touhou]] and Kantai Collection, she's oftentimes just drawn by former Touhou artists as [[Shameimaru Aya]] with the serial numbers filed off, due to the shared reporter stereotypes.) 

Historically, [i]IJN Aoba[/i] was the flagship of Cruiser Division 6, which consisted of her sister ship, [i][[Kinugasa (kancolle)|Kinugasa]][/i], as well as [i][[Furutaka (kancolle)|Furutaka]][/i] and [i][[Kako (kancolle)|Kako]][/i]. She served in numerous naval battles like Coral Sea and Leyte Gulf before being sunk in an air raid in Kure in July 1945.

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese destroyer [i]Arashi[/i]. Character design by [[Konishi (koconatu)|]], voiced by [[Kayano Ai]].

She has [[medium hair|medium-length]] [[messy_hair|messy]] [[red hair]] with an [[ahoge]], [[yellow eyes]], and [[small breasts]]. Her default outfit is the Konishi-designed [i]Kagerou[/i]-class standard uniform: a [[white shirt|white]] [[dress shirt]] with a [[black vest]], and a [[red neckerchief]]. She also wears a [[black skirt|black]] [[pleated skirt]], [[white gloves]], [[black thighhighs]], and [[loafers]]. 

Her [[rigging]] consists of her bridge on a backpack rig with a 12.7 cm twin mount on the right side and 61 cm quad [[torpedo tubes]] on the left, an additional 12.7 cm twin mount as a [[handgun]], a [[depth charge]] rack on her left leg [[thigh strap]], and a searchlight plus 25 mm [[anti-aircraft gun]] mounts on her belt. 

The historical IJN [i]Arashi[/i] bears the dubious distinction of contributing to the crushing Japanese defeat at the [[Battle of Midway]] by inadvertently leading American planes to the Japanese fleet. She was sunk in a night action in August 1943.

payload.body:
The main heroine of the visual novel [[Tsukihime]], who also makes an appearance in both [[Kagetsu Tooya]] and the fighting game [[Melty Blood]] by [[Type-Moon]]. She is voiced by [[Nabatame Hitomi]] in the original Tsukihime anime, by [[Yuzuki Ryouka]] in Melty Blood, and [[Hasegawa Ikumi]] in Type Lumina, the remake, and as [[Archetype_EARTH|Archetype: EARTH]] in [[Fate/Grand Order]].

She's the White Princess of the True Ancestors, a species of [[vampire|vampiric]] creatures.

Her birthday is December 25 (Self-styled). Her height is 167, weighs 52 kg with her blood type being unknown. Her three sizes are B88/W55/H85. She has the appearance of a female teenager around 16-17. Her real age is about 800-900, but her true age is much older, and unknown.

She has [[short hair|short]] [[blonde hair]] styled in [[hair intakes]], [[medium breasts|medium]] to [[large breasts]], as well as [[red eyes]]. Her clothing consists of a white [[turtleneck sweater]], a [[long skirt|long]] [[purple skirt]] and [[black pantyhose]]. In the remake, she wears a [[blue skirt|blue]] [[pleated skirt|pleated]] [[miniskirt]] instead along with a silver [[necklace]].

According to multiple sources, [[Nasu Kinoko|Nasu]] based her design on magazine model Amanda Dyer.

payload.body:
Originally called Archetype Saber, he is the version of [[Saber (fate)|]] that was to be used in the original [[Fate/stay night]] novel that was penned and left uncompleted. He would later make an official debut in [[Fate/Prototype]] as a Saber from an entirely different time tree, complete with his own characterization and contextual differences compared to the Saber from Fate/stay night.

Arthur's parameters differ from Artoria's as well; he sacrifices Mana and Luck for greater Strength and Endurance. This is similarly reflected in their fighting styles; whereas Artoria fights very elegantly and supplements her swordplay with her Servant Skills, Arthur fights very functionally, almost coldly, and funnels his skills into his martial prowess.

Arthur plays a prominent background role in [[Fate/Grand Order]] as well: [spoiler]he is chasing Beast VI across time and space, with the intent to slay it for good after unsuccessfully attempting such in 1991 and 1999 of his own time tree.[/spoiler]

A [[blonde hair]]ed man with [[green eyes]], his [[armor]] set includes a [[breastplate]], [[pauldrons]], [[gauntlets]], [[faulds]], [[greaves]] and a [[hood]]; slight differences in design compared to Saber. His weapon is another version of [[Excalibur (Fate/Prototype)|Excalibur]]. His casual outfit consists of a red [[t-shirt]] with [[black pants]] and a long [[black jacket]]. He is often seen with [[Sajou Ayaka (Fate/Prototype)|]].

[b]Character Design:[/b] [[Takeuchi Takashi]], [[Nakahara (mu tation)|Nakahara]]
[b]Voice Actor:[/b] [[Sakurai Takahiro]]

Common errors include:

* [[extra digits|too many fingers]]
* [[extra hands|too many hands]]
* [[extra legs|too many legs]]
* [[wrong foot|wrong feet]]
* [[wrong hand]]s
* [[bad reflection]]s
* [[bad multiple views]]

This also includes mistakenly drawing a character with the wrong appearance, such as drawing the wrong eye color.

Do not confuse [[artistic error]] with [[bad anatomy]], [[bad proportions]], [[bad hands]], or [[bad feet]], which are for elements that are merely poorly drawn, not outright mistakes. The tag [[QUALITY]] can be applied instead if the artist intentionally recreates the disfigured art for comedic effect.

Generally you should comment on the post describing what the error is.

She is a [[genderswap (mtf)|]]ped version of [[King Arthur (mythology)|]] from the old English mythology, manifested as a "Servant", powerful manifestation of historical/mythological figures in the Fate universe.

She first appeared in [[Fate/Stay Night]] as [[Saber (fate)|]], but later went on to appear in many other forms throughout the [[Fate (series)|]] series. This tag is an umbrella tag that collects all versions of Artoria Pendragon under one tag.

She and her variants, with the exception of Arthur Pendragon, are voiced by [[Kawasumi Ayako]].

A version of [[Saber (fate)|]] summoned as a Lancer-class servant in [[Fate/Grand Order]]. She wields [[Rhongomyniad (fate)|Rhongomyniad]] instead of [[Excalibur (fate/stay night)|Excalibur]].

This version of Artoria is taller, possesses [[large breasts|larger breasts]], longer bangs ([[swept bangs|swept]] or [[hair between eyes|falling between her eyes]]), and longer [[sidelocks]]. Due to her larger breasts, she's often called 乳王 (Milk/Breast King) among the fanbase.

The reason for her more endowed appearance is because [spoilers]she's not affected by Excalibur's side effects that prevent its user from aging further.[/spoilers]

Her horse is named [[Dun Stallion (fate)|]]. And her breastplate is most likely modeled after a tournament (jousting) helmet called a "[i]Frog-mouth helm[/i]":https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frog-mouth_helm, "[i]Stechhelm[/i]":https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stechhelm or "[i]Krötenkopfhelm[/i]":https://mittelalter.fandom.com/de/wiki/Krötenkopfhelm.

payload.body:
Asakaze (lit. "Morning Wind") is the second of nine [[kamikaze (kancolle)|Kamikaze]]-class destroyers as personified in [[Kantai Collection]].

h4. Appearance

Similar to [[kamikaze (kancolle)|Kamikaze]], Asakaze wears a [[Meiji schoolgirl uniform]] with a white [[furisode]] top, including a gradient to blue in the loose sleeves, along with a cobalt blue [[hakama skirt]] tied with a sash bearing an [[anchor]] on the end, and [[knee_boots|knee-high]] [[lace-up boots]]. She has [[blue eyes]] and [[long_hair|long]], [[wavy_hair|wavy]] [[light brown hair]] with [[parted_bangs|her bangs parted in the middle]] providing long [[sidelocks]] and exposing her [[forehead]]. She also wears two large blue [[hair_ribbon|hair ribbons]] on either side of her head.

Her [[rigging]] includes a [[smokestack|funnel]] attached to her back with an adjoining mast and twin-tube [[torpedo]] launcher. To her sides, at thigh-level, are cutoff-ship-deck-like platforms that bear a single-[[cannon]] [[ship turret|turret]]. She also carries a single-cannon turret in her left hand like a pistol, which is modeled like a ship's bow bearing the number "5". 

h4. Personality

Asakaze has an energetic personality, proud of her accomplishments but also highly sensitive to criticism. Her in-game lines include several instances of indignation over perceptions of anyone "making fun of her" even when none existed. Possibly because of the meaning her name, she also seems to love mornings, getting up at 4 AM to see the sunrise. Inversely, she becomes notably more nervous at night, likely due to the circumstances of her sinking.

h4. History

Originally commissioned merely as "Destroyer No. 3" as part of the "8-8 Fleet Program,":https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eight-eight_fleet the name [i]Asakaze[/i] was only assigned in 1928, five years after launch. At the time of the Attack on Pearl Harbor, [i]Asakaze[/i] was part of Destroyer Division 5, alongside sister-ships [i][[harukaze (kancolle)|Harukaze]][/i], [i]Matsukaze[/i], and [i]Hatakaze[/i].

Already aging by the start of the war, Asakaze mostly escorted landing craft in campaigns like "the Philippines":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philippines_Campaign_(1941%E2%80%9342)], "Java":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_Java], and "Andaman Islands":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Invasion_and_occupation_of_the_Andaman_Islands_during_World_War_II]. At the "Battle of Sunda Straight":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_Sunda_Strait], [i]Asakaze[/i] launched torpedoes that assisted in the sinking of HMAS [i]Perth[/i] and USS [i]Houston[/i].

Throughout most of the rest of the war, she was a convoy escort ship. [i]Asakaze[/i] was torpedoed by the submarine USS [i]Haddo[/i] at 22:35 on August 23rd near Luzon while on escort duty. During the night, efforts to save her proved unsuccessful, and in the pre-dawn hours of August 24th, she capsized and sank. 

h4. Trivia

Although she was the second of the nine Kamikaze-class destroyers, due to IJN numbering at the time she was listed as "Destroyer No. 3" at launch due to sharing a number scheme with the "Wakatake-class destroyers":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wakatake-class_destroyer].

Her seiyuu is [[Itou Shizuka]].

h4. [i]Kamikaze[/i]-class Destroyers

Asashio wears a [[black dress|black]] [[pinafore dress]] over a [[long sleeves|long-sleeved]] [[white shirt]], [[belt]] and [[black thighhighs]]. Lead character in the [[pokemon|Pokémon]] [[pokemon (anime)|anime]] from 1997 to 2023, based on [[Red (pokemon)|]], the player character in the [[pokemon red/green/blue/yellow|first Pokémon games]].

Ash is a Pokémon Trainer who, over the course of 1,200+ weekly episodes, took on the challenge of each region that was depicted in the most recent main games at the time, as well as thwarting the evil schemes of the [[Team Rocket]] trio.  He has had a number of travel partners and recurring rivals.

He wears a blue, sleeveless [[vest]] over a [[white shirt]] with a red stripe on the front, as well as [[two-tone shorts]] (blue on the front, dark blue on the back). His new [[baseball cap]] is mostly red, with a white brim and a black [[pokedex|Pokédex]] symbol on the front. He also sometimes carries a green [[backpack]].

His signature Pokémon is [[Pikachu]], which he chooses not to evolve into [[Raichu]] due to it not wanting to.

As a running gag throughout the series, he sometimes [[crossdressing|crossdresses]] under the name [[Ashley (pokemon)|]].

His name in Japanese is a reference to the Pokémon creator, Tajiri Satoshi.

payload.body:
Character from [[Boku no Hero Academia]].

A student in Class 1-A. Her quirk is having the [[frog girl|abilities of a frog]]. She has circular black eyes with three prominent eyelashes at the bottom of each one and long black hair [[low-tied long hair|tied at the bottom]], creating [[hair rings]]. Her hero costume consists of goggles ([[goggles on head|worn on her head]] most of the time), brown gloves, and a primary green and black bodysuit with webbed feet and a belt. She has a [[long tongue]] akin to a frog.

She is very straight-forward and blunt whenever she has something to say and occasionally every now and then in her dialogue lets out ribbits ([i]kero[/i] in Japanese). She is very adamant about being called by her first name, Tsuyu, and immediately corrects anybody who calls her by her last name, Asui. A majority of the time she has a "[[:>]]" expression on her face no matter what mood she is in, only going away when she opens her mouth.

She is the older sister of [[Asui Samidare]] and [[Asui Satsuki|Satsuki]].

Like most [[Boku no Hero Academia]] characters her name is a play on her quirk: 蛙 ([i]frog[/i]), 梅雨 ([i]rainy season[/i]).

She is often tagged on Pixiv with ”"Keroine":[http://www.pixiv.net/search.php?s_mode=s_tag_full&word=%E3%82%B1%E3%83%AD%E3%82%A4%E3%83%B3]”, a pun on "heroine" and "kero".

payload.body:
[[Senran Kagura]] main character. A second-year Shinobi student and leader at the Hanzou Academy.

Asuka has [[black hair]], usually tied into a medium length [[ponytail]] with a [[white ribbon]]. When she transforms into a shinobi, she wears a yellow [[vest]] over a [[white shirt]] and [[green necktie]]. With it she wears a [[green dress|green]] [[plaid dress]] and a [[red scarf]]. She wears red arm guards over [[bandages]], and [[thighhighs]] with [[brown footwear|brown]] [[shoes]]. She is usually seen with her twin [[sword]]s.

Asuka's favorite food is futomaki rolls. She fights for justice and wants to follow in the footsteps of her grandfather Hanzou, a legendary shinobi of his time. Sheer willpower and determination is what drives her to master the way of the shinobi. Firm believer that the Sword and Shield's true power comes from using both. Her guardian animal is the toad. 

When her clothes are ripped off, she is revealed to be wearing a simple [[striped bikini]].

Her seiyuu is [[Harada Hitomi]].

h4. External links

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of USS [i]Atlanta[/i] (CL-51) of the United States Navy. Character design by [[Shizuma Yoshinori]].

She is tall with [[large breasts]], and has [[long_hair|long]] [[brown hair]] in a [[two side up]] hairstyle and [[grey eyes]]. She wears a [[black headwear|black]] [[garrison cap]] with the number 51 written on it, silver [[star earrings]], an [[anchor hair ornament]], a [[long_sleeves|long-sleeved]] [[white shirt|white]] [[dress shirt]] that reaches her thighs, a [[high-waist_skirt|high-waisted]] [[black skirt|black]] [[suspender skirt]] over it that also reaches her upper thighs. [[Garter straps]] are visible below her skirt, attached to two [[thigh strap]]s. She also wears [[black footwear|black]] [[rudder_footwear|rudder]] [[boots]], and [[white gloves|white]] [[partially fingerless gloves]] which expose only her thumb and index finger and cover the other fingers in a mitten-style. Her [[rigging]] includes four [[ship turret|turret]]s and a [[crane_(machine)|]].

She is cool, laid back, and even somewhat aloof and/or easily irritated, in contrast to many of the American shipgirls who came before her. She has a particular aversion to night battles and Japanese destroyers, [[Akatsuki (kancolle)|]] and [[Yuudachi (kancolle)|]] in particular, in reference to her historical fate. She is often compared to [[Ryuujou (kancolle)|]], who also has brown hair and a similar haircut but a flat chest.

The historical [i]Atlanta[/i] was heavily damaged after sinking Japanese destroyer [[akatsuki (kancolle)|Akatsuki]] during the Naval Battle of Guadalcanal. She was sunk on her captain's orders later on the same day.

payload.body:
A connector commonly used for audio equipment. Sometimes called a headphone jack, jack plug, phone jack, or phone connector.

Almost all [[headphones]], [[microphone]]s and most consumer [[speaker]]s have one of these connectors. Consumer equipment usually has the small 3.5 mm plug and professional equipment has the large 6.35 mm plug. Electric guitars and effects units always use the 6.35 mm plug.

Plugs have a single prong with separately connected tip, sleeve, and usually one ring, sometimes more. Mono audio has no ring, often found on microphones; stereo audio has one ring and headsets with integrated microphones or control buttons have two or more rings.

h4. Examples

* !post #3788806: 6.35 mm variant with tip, ring and sleeve for stereo audio
* !post #2684511: 3.5 mm variant with tip, ring and sleeve
* !post #2331144: 3.5 mm variant with tip, two rings and sleeve

h4. See also

* [[RCA connector]]

[[Azur Lane]]'s personification of the Japanese destroyer [i]Ayanami[/i]. Character design by [[Ootsuki Momiji]], voiced by [[Taichi You]]. 

She is a Japanese/Korean/Taiwan server-only starter ship, being replaced by [[Z23 (azur lane)|]] in the English and Mainland Chinese servers. She is claimable after obtaining the other three starters.

She has light gray/[[blonde hair]], [[orange eyes|orange]] or [[red eyes]], and initially wears a modified [[serafuku|schoolgirl uniform]] and [[rudder footwear|rudder boots]], before her remodel switches her to an outfit with miko sleeves, a [[miniskirt]], loafer-type rudder footwear, and [[zettai ryouiki]]. Her clothes are short enough to expose her [[midriff]], and, in her retrofit, a fair amount of [[underboob]] as well.

Her [[rigging]] consists of a single 12.7 cm twin gun mount Type B to her left, a funnel-mast backpack on her back, a [[searchlight]] strapped to her belt on the left, and two 61 cm triple [[torpedo tubes]]. Upon retrofit, her searchlight and gun mount are remounted to the funnel backpack.

payload.body:
Character from [[Guilty Gear]] fighting game series.

A female [[samurai]] born in Japan amidst the "Crusades" during which millions of native Japanese people were killed by the Gears, leading to them being declared as an endangered species. During one of these attacks Baiken's parents were killed, she also lost her right arm (which she has since replaced with a [[claw_(weapon)|claw]]) and left eye to the Gears responsible for the death of her parents. From that day forward Baiken swore revenge on the creator of the Gears, known only as "That Man". 

Baiken has [[big_hair|voluminous]] [[pink hair]] worn in a [[ponytail]], a [[scar]] over her missing [[one-eyed|left eye]] and a [[facial tattoo]]. She wears a loose [[white kimono|white]] and [[black kimono|black]] kimono with the sleeves tucked in the sides of a [[kataginu]], showing off her [[large breasts]]. She also wears [[sash]], [[greaves]], [[sandals]], a [[eyepatch]] and a clawed grappling hook for her [[amputee|right arm]]. She has [[red eyes]] and is typically depicted wielding a [[katana]]. In [[Guilty Gear Xrd]], her kimono is almost unchanged, though she now has a [[black jacket]] that she [[jacket on shoulders|wears on her shoulders]] like a cape.

h4. External links

* "Guilty Gear Wiki: Baiken":http://guilty-gear.wikia.com/wiki/Baiken

One of the main protagonists of [[Tiger & Bunny]], and [[Kaburagi T. Kotetsu]]'s partner.

Barnaby is a stoic, handsome rookie hero forced to partner with Kotetsu to form the world's first hero team. Motivated by discovering the truth behind his parent's murderer, Barnaby took up his father's name and chose not to adopt a secret identity. He is given the nickname "Bunny" by his new partner, something he does not appreciate.

Barnaby's NEXT power is also [b]Hundred Power[/b], which increases his physical attributes one-hundredfold. However, it only lasts for five minutes, and has a cooldown time of approximately one hour.

While [[Wild Tiger]]'s forte is [[punching]], Barnaby uses [[kicking|kicks]].

The personification of the Royal Navy light cruiser HMS [i]Belfast[/i] in [[Azur Lane]]. Character design by [[Kisetsu]], voiced by [[Horie Yui]].

As the current head [[maid]] of the Royal Maid Corps, she is extremely responsible and professional, taking pride in her dedication to perfectionist service, caring for and constantly addressing the [[Commander (Azur Lane)|]] as "Master", while being gentle and friendly towards most people. She has [[long hair|long]] [[white hair]], [[blue eyes]], and [[large breasts]], and her signature [[maid]] outfit features a [[chain]] [[choker]] and a [[low neckline]] that exposes a generous amount of [[cleavage]].

She is [[yuri|shipped]] with [[Enterprise (azur lane)|]] in the official out of canon anime. While in story, she succeeds her [i]Town[/i]-class elder sister [[Newcastle (Azur Lane)|]] as the head maid of the Royal Maid Corps.

The real life [i]Belfast[/i] was saved from scrapping by private venture and became a tourist attraction afterwards. She is currently part of the Imperial War Museum, permanently moored on the Thames river, near the Tower Bridge, London, since 1971.

A [[forehead mark]] that consists of a colored dot (or sticker) worn on the center of the forehead. It is worn by [[hinduism|Hindus]], Jains and [[buddhism|Buddhists]] from the [[India]]n subcontinent. The mark is always applied close to the eyebrows or in the middle of the forehead.

Note that China historically had a mark similar to the bindi, called the cinnabar mole (朱砂痣, zhushazhi) or the dot cinnabar (点丹 diandan). The cinnabar it was made from gave it the red pigment, but was highly toxic. It was used as a status symbol, with links to [[taoism]].

Use [[forehead mark]] or [[circle facial mark]] instead if the image has no correlation with [[Hinduism]], [[Buddhism]] or [[Jainism]].

[[Azur Lane]]'s personification of the German battleship [i]Bismarck[/i]. Character design by [[Hao (patinnko)|]], voiced by [[Fukuhara Ayaka]]. 

She has [[blue eyes]] and [[long_hair|long]] [[blonde hair]]. Her normal outfit consists of a black [[military uniform]] with [[German flag print]] on her skirt, while her [[peaked cap]] is accented with symbols of the German Empire. She also wears a [[fur-trimmed cape]] and a pair of [[black boots|black]] [[fur-trimmed boots|fur-trimmed]] [[thigh boots]]. Her [[Bismarck (coat of arms)|coat-of-arms]] is displayed on her left shoulder, and like her sister [[Tirpitz (Azur Lane)|]], she carries a [[flag|pennant]].

She was present in the game since its beginning, serving as the boss for the tutorial. In May 2019, as part of Azur Lane's second anniversary, she was formally introduced as a playable character in the [i]Scherzo of Iron and Blood[/i] event. payload.body:
Blake Belladonna is one of the main characters of [[RWBY]], a 3DCG series produced by Rooster Teeth. 

Blake is the "B" in RWBY, and is associated with the color black. Her character design is inspired by both of the eponymous characters in the fairy tale [[Beauty and the Beast (fairy tale)|]].
Blake is somewhat aloof, enjoys reading, and seems to have a checkered past. 

h4. Abilities 
She wields a [[katana]]/[[cleaver]]/[[handgun]]/[[kama_(weapon)|kama]] hybrid weapon named [[Gambol Shroud]] (officially classified as a "Variant Ballistic Chain Scythe"). Using the [[ribbon]] around her arm as a chain, it resembles a [[kusarigama]]. Her symbol is a belladonna (aka deadly nightshade) [[flower]]. Her semblance (special ability) produces shadow clones. 

h4. Physical characteristics 
Blake has [[yellow eyes]] and [[long hair|long]] [[black hair]]. 

[spoiler]Her bow hides a pair of [[cat ears]].[/spoiler]

She stands 5' 6" tall (including high heels).

h4. Attire 
Blake tends to wear black and white clothing. She usually has a [[black bow|black]] [[hair bow]] on top of her head. Her default outfit includes a small [[black scarf]] around her neck, a black [[vest]] with long [[coattails]] on top of a white [[sleeveless shirt|sleeveless]] [[crop top]] that leaves her [[bare shoulders|shoulders]] and [[midriff]] bare, a black [[single_detached_sleeve|detached sleeve]] on her left arm, black [[arm ribbon]]s wrapped around both forearms, [[white_shorts|white]] [[shorts]] (sometimes depicted with [[garter straps]]) [[pantyhose under shorts|over]] [[black pantyhose]] (with her belladonna symbol printed on), and [[black footwear|black]] [[high heels]]. 

Her Beacon [[school uniform]] consists of a [[white shirt|white]] [[blouse]] with [[neck ribbon]], brown [[blazer]], and [[plaid skirt]]. She retains her black hair bow. 

h4. External links

* "RWBY Wikia: Blake Belladonna":https://rwby.wikia.com/wiki/Blake_Belladonna
other_names: ブレイク・ベラドンナ

payload.body:
One of four goddesses of Gamindustri, Blanc presides over the Land of White Serenity, Lowee. While she may initially comes off as a shy and quiet girl, Blanc is actually very quick to fly into an outrage and has the mouth of a sailor. She loves [[reading]] [[book]]s, and has once stated that she wants to buy more books, but couldn't because she already has so many and does not want to give up any of the books she already has.

Blanc's usual appearance consists of a large [[white headwear|white]] [[hat|cap]], a short [[white dress]] with brown trim and [[spaghetti strap]]s, and an opened [[white jacket]] with [[fur trim]] which she mainly wears in public. Her eyes are a dark [[blue_eyes|blue]] and her [[short_hair|short]], orderly hair is a sandy [[brown_hair|brown]].  Of the four goddesses her breasts are by far the smallest, ranging from [[small breasts]] to [[flat chest]] depending on the artist. As a result fanart frequently portrays her as having substantial [[breast envy]], especially when appearing alongside Vert.

Blanc represents the [[Nintendo]] [[Wii]], which is somewhat ironic since she has a rather short temper and tends to swear when provoked.

Voiced by: [[Asumi Kana]] (Japanese), [[Wendee Lee]] (English)

h4. See also

* [[White Heart (neptunia)|]], Blanc's HDD (Hard Drive Divinity) form
* [[Next White]], Blanc's Next Form

payload.body:
A small bag full of [[blood]], which has been collected from the patient or from a blood donor in order to replace that patient's blood should there be a lot of blood loss during surgery, or from exsanguination due to a critical [[injury]].

Different patients/donors' blood is collected, analyzed and grouped according to blood type, of which there are four: "A, B, AB, and O":http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Human_blood_group_systems, depending upon inherited antigens. There is also the + and - status to indicate if the "Rh factor":http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rh_blood_group_system (or Rhesus factor) is present.

Blood bags are often seen hanging from [[iv stand|intravenous stands]] in hospitals near the patient's bed.

[[One Piece]] character. She is the captain of the Kuja Pirates and the current empress of Amazon Lily. Also known as the "Snake Princess" and "Pirate Empress" due to her beauty, and one of the [[Shichibukai]].

She has two younger sisters, [[Boa Sandersonia|Sandersonia]] and [[Boa Marigold|Marigold]], and is often seen alongside her pet snake [[Salome (one piece)|]]. She would later on develop a crush on [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] during the Amazon Lily Arc.

Having consumed the Mero Mero no Mi [[Devil Fruit]], she can fire heart beams, bullets and arrows that turn anyone who is caught by her charm into stone.

She is a [[tall female]] that has [[very long hair|very long]] [[black hair]] with [[blunt sidelocks]], [[blue eyes]], [[large breasts]], and wears [[snake earrings]]. She typically wears a [[crop top|cropped]] [[red shirt|red]] [[long sleeves|long sleeved]] [[cropped shirt|shirt]] with a [[cleavage cutout]], a [[white cape]], a [[floral print skirt]] with a [[pink sash]], and black [[high heels]].

[spoiler]Hancock along with her sisters were kidnapped and sold as slaves to a member of the [[Celestial Dragons (one piece)|]] during their childhood. Because of this, she suffered much abuse while enslaved and developed a hatred for males. Hancock's hatred later softened after she developed a crush on Luffy, who was the first man who acknowledged her suffering.[/spoiler]

payload.body:
A character from the [[Guilty Gear]] fighting game series. First appearing in [[Guilty Gear XX]], born as one of two male twins in an [[united kingdom|English]] village where the birth of same-sex twins was considered bad luck, they were raised as a girl, prompting their [[trap]] appearance. 

Throughout [i]Guilty Gear XX[/i], they would reject the stigma of their upbringing and work towards proving their masculinity as a bounty hunter. Years later, as of [i][[Guilty Gear Strive]][/i], Bridget had since succeeded, dispelling the superstition of their village. In absence of that purpose, they experience unresolved doubts, ultimately determining to be true to herself, embracing her identity as a girl across the conclusions of her story.

[i]Current policy is to tag Bridget as male unless physical evidence in the image proves otherwise, including the presence of the [[transgender flag]]. Non-bodily evidence (e.g. [[transgender flag]]) is only relevant to {{Rating:General}} posts.[/i]

In [i]XX[/i], Bridget wears an unconventional [[nun]] habit (for ease of movement, not because they are a nun) featuring a [[two-sided veil|two-sided]] [[white trim|white-trimmed]] [[blue veil]] with a yellow [[latin cross|latin]] [[cross print]] on the back and a [[mars symbol]] on the head, [[white wrist cuffs]] also with cross prints, [[black gloves|black]] [[fingerless gloves]], a [[guimpe]], a [[yellow ribbon|yellow]] [[neck ribbon]], a top is similar to an [[open vest|open]] [[blue vest]] over of a [[sleeveless shirt|sleeveless]] [[white shirt]] but it was designed in such way that the vest inexplicably "merges" with the shirt around the waist area (asset #38438314), an [[object belt]] (a single [[oversized object|oversized]] [[single handcuff|handcuff]]), [[black shorts|black]] [[bike shorts]], [[white socks]] and [[blue boots|blue]] [[ankle boots]]. In battle, they wield a large [[yo-yo]] as weapon and is joined by their pet [[teddy bear]] [[Roger (Guilty Gear)|]]. Besides blue, [[player 2]] colors include pink, black, red, yellow and white (post #50283).

In [i]Strive[/i], the nun habit is replaced with a similar [[hooded jacket]], with the [[mars symbol]], pointed to the upper-right, changed to an [[androgyne symbol]], pointed to the upper-left, matching the orientations of these elements as in the [[transgender symbol|⚧ symbol]]. The official hairstyle is also slightly different with a single left [[swept bangs|swept bang]].

Her original [[voice actor|voice actress]] [[Tsuru Hiromi]] passed away in November 2017, and was replaced by [[Hisakawa Aya]].

She is known to change outfits and hairstyles throughout the series, leading to many [[official alternate costume]]s and [[official alternate hairstyle]]s.

payload.body:
Bunny Day is a [[date pun]] that occurs on August 2nd or 21st.

"バニー" (banii) looks similar to the numerals 八二一, which respectively mean 8, 2, and 1. The same pun can also result from goroawase: 8 (ba) + 2 (ni) and 8 (ba) + 2 (ni) + 1 (i).

Some also designate August 23rd as Bunny Day or "Banii-san no Hi" using goroawase: 8 (ba) + 2 (ni) + 1 (i) + 3 (san).

In Greek mythology, Caenis was a woman who was raped by Poseidon. Afterwards, Poseidon granted her a wish; Caenis wished to become an invulnerable warrior. Poseidon granted her wish, turning Caenis into the male Caeneus.

The version appearing in Fate/Grand Order has her original female body, but is often referred to with male pronouns by others in the game. She uses the masculine personal pronoun [b]Ore[/b].

payload.body:
[i][[Granblue Fantasy]][/i] character.

She has [[long hair|long]] [[blonde hair]] and [[purple eyes]]. She wears [[black thighhighs]], [[black boots]], a [[red skirt]] with [[vial]]s along the side of it, a [[tiara]]-like [[hairband]], and a [[cape]]. She is always holding a book.

She is actually over 1,000 years old, and is widely known in the Granblue universe as the person who basically invented alchemy. Her original male body was always of ill health and would've died in adolescence; to avoid such a fate, she learned how to use alchemy to create new bodies and transfer herself into them, thereby living indefinitely. This is how she wound up in her current female body, which she views as her "ideal" form.

Her nickname on the internet is "Uncle Cali" (カリおっさん, Cali-[i]ossan[/i]).

Note that, because her male form was never even seen in-series, Cagliostro's presence only warrants the [[genderswap_(mtf)]] tag if the image references it somehow. See topic #11614 for details.

[[splatoon_(series)|Splatoon]] character. Named [b]Aori[/b] in the Japanese version. She is an [[inkling]].

She is part of an [[idol]] group known as Squid Sisters (Sea O'Colors in the Japanese version) with the other member being her [[cousins|cousin]], [[Marie (splatoon)|]]. She and Marie are also both news program hostesses that announce in-game news.

She wears a purple and black-themed outfit matching Marie's and [[sushi]] [[food on head|on her head]]. Other features of this default costume & appearance include [[bow-shaped hair]] and a [[detached collar|detached]] [[white collar]]. In general she is usually depicted with a [[mole under eye|mole under her eye]], [[thick eyebrows]] and [[star-shaped pupils]].

Her canonical [[list of weapons in splatoon|weapon]] class of choice are Rollers. [[Splatoon 3: Side Order]] reveals she mainly uses the [[Splat Roller (splatoon)|]] via her Palette.

Her Japanese name comes from the Japanese word for the "bigfin reef squid":http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bigfin_reef_squid (障泥烏賊/アオリイカ [i]Aori-ika[/i]) and their band's name in Japanese is a portmanteau of "shiokara" (a Japanese food made out of various marine animals, commonly squid) and "colors". Callie and Marie's names in English are a play on the word calamari.

[b]Camilla[/b] is a playable character in [[Fire Emblem Fates]].

The eldest princess of the Nohrian royal family, Camilla carries herself with maturity and elegance on the onset but treats her family with unrivalled care and affection. She is ruthless on the battlefield, destroying her enemies with wild abandon. Along with the other royal siblings, she was subject to the family's "concubine wars" at a young age. She bathes the longest out of anyone in the army, and her birthday is on November 30th. She is the younger [[half-siblings|half-sister]] of [[Xander (Fire Emblem)|]] and the older half-sister of [[Leo (fire Emblem Fates)|]] and [[Elise (Fire Emblem)|]]. 

Camilla has [[very long hair|very]] [[long hair|long]], [[wavy hair|wavy]] [[purple hair]] with [[hair over one eye|one bang covering her left eye]], [[purple eyes]], full [[lips]], [[large breasts]], and well-shaped [[thighs]]. She dons [[black armor|black]] [[armor]] shaped like a [[bodice]] that exposes her [[cleavage]] and [[groin]], also showing off her [[black panties|black]] [[panties]] and leaving her [[ass]] visible. She also wears [[armored boots|armored]] [[black boots|black]] [[thigh boots|thigh-length]] [[high heel boots|high-heel]] [[boots]] and a [[tiara]]. Camilla is often portrayed riding her [[undead]] [[wyvern]] and wielding a [[battle axe]].

She is voiced by [[Sawashiro Miyuki]] in Japanese. [[Paula Tiso]] voices her in English [[Fire Emblem Fates|Fates]], and "Misty Lee":http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Misty_Lee voices her in English [[Fire Emblem Heroes]] and [[Fire Emblem Warriors]].

[b]Starting Class[/b]: Revenant Knight (Malig Knight)

payload.body:
A character in the [[Street Fighter]] series. Her codename is [b]Killer Bee[/b] (christened in [[Street Fighter Zero (series)|Street Fighter Zero 3]] and kept for herself afterwards). She first appeared in the fighting game [[Street Fighter II (series)|Super Street Fighter II]] (1993) as one of the titular "New Challengers," the four new characters introduced in that title.

Cammy is a female clone of [[M. Bison]], originally serving within his organization [[Shadaloo]] as both Bison's potential replacement body should his original body fail, and, until then, the leader of the [[Shadaloo Dolls]] - Bison's personal unit of brainwashed bodyguards and underlings. She later went rogue after her encounter with [[Dhalsim]] nullified Bison's Psycho Powered mind control. As of [[Street Fighter II (series)|]] onward to the present in [[Street Fighter 6]], she serves as a member of Delta Red, a British special forces unit with connections to MI6. She has made it her personal mission to locate, rescue, and rehabilitate the Dolls. She collaborates closely with most of the other World Warriors on her assignments, notably [[Chun-Li]].

Trained extensively in close-quarters combat, Cammy likes to strike with quick, sharp attacks like a stinging bee (hence her codename) and use takedowns to immobilize and cripple her foes. Her signature techniques include the [i]Spiral Arrow[/i] and [i]Cannon Spike/Strike[/i] - both flying kick attacks that send Cammy lunging feet first at sharp angles, whether straight forward, up into the sky, or down from the air - as well as the [i]Hooligan Combination[/i], where she hurls herself into close quarters to either grapple the opponent to the ground or strike from odd angles.

She has two well known appearances depending on the Street Fighter timeline, although both have her wearing some manner of [[highleg leotard]] and red gauntlet-like gloves, sporting long [[blonde hair|blonde]] [[twin braids]], and showing off a long [[scar]] on her left cheek.

Her original "Delta Red" appearance, worn in every instance outside her Alpha/Zero appearances prior to Street Fighter 6, has her in a green [[highleg leotard]] with a small triangle badge above her right breast and a red [[beret]]. [[Street Fighter V]] adds a [[chest harness]] and a [[thigh holster]] on her right leg, but loses the green patches of [[bodypaint]] originally seen on her legs. The bodypaint does make a return in Street Fighter 6 as part of her Street Fighter V form/"younger self" alternate skin. Her appearance in [[Fortnite]] as a Gaming Legends outfit skin adds [[pantyhose]] with a [[camouflage]] pattern to her Street Fighter V outfit.

In her Alpha/Zero "Killer Bee" appearance, which takes place during the time she was a member of M. Bison's Dolls, she instead wears a light blue long-sleeved [[ribbed leotard|ribbed]] [[highleg leotard]] with a matching color [[garrison cap]] and a small yellow necktie with a black armband on her left arm. Like in her original form, she has bodypaint patches on her legs, except they are blue to match her leotard and somewhat [[lightning bolt symbol|lightning bolt]]-shaped.

In [[Street Fighter 6]], Cammy has [[short hair|cut her hair short]], and she now sports a [[blue jacket|blue]] [[cropped jacket|bolero]] with [[Union Jack]] print, [[black sports bra]] and black [[yoga pants]].

European garments made with mail are leggings ([[chausses]]), mail hoods ([[coif]]) and mail mittens (mitons). A mail collar hanging from a helmet is camail or [[aventail]].
