Japanese chainmail is called [i]kusari[/i] (鎖, lit. "chain") and was used extensively alongside the more distinctive and better known [[lamellar armor]]s.

payload.body:
The main antagonist of [[Mobile Suit Gundam]] and the eponymous [[Char's Counterattack]], a supporting character in [[zeta gundam|Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam]] and eternal rival and foe of [[Amuro Ray]]. Also appears in [[Gundam GQuuuuuux]].

[b]Char Aznable[/b], also known as [b]The Red Comet[/b] by the [[Earth Federation Space Forces]], is originally a [[blonde hair|blonde-haired]] [[Zeon]] ace pilot of the [[Zaku II S Char Custom|MS-06S Zaku II Commander Type]], [[z'gok char custom|Z'Gok]], [[gelgoog s char custom|Gelgoog]], [[Zeong|MSN-02 Zeong]], [[AEUG]] [[Rick Dias]], [[Gundam Mk II]], [[Zero Shiki (gundam)|]], [[Hyaku Shiki|MSN-00100 Hyaku Shiki]] and the [[Neo Zeon]] [[Char's Dijeh]], [[Dijeh Traversia]], [[Geara Doga Psycommu Test Type]] and the [[Prototype Sazabi]]/[[Sazabi|MSN-04 Sazabi]]/[[nightingale (gundam)|MSN-04II Nightingale]]. 

He has several names, secret identities, and clones throughout the Gundam series. He is usually depicted with some sort of eyewear or headwear (usually [[sunglasses]] or his trademark [[helmet]]), concealing his eyes.

His birth name is [[Casval Rem Deikun]] and he has [[blue eyes]]. He stole the identity of the [[char aznable (real)|real Char Aznable]] (who is mostly identical to him except his brown eyes) to avoid being killed by [[Kycilia Zabi]] as a part of her plan to purge the Deikun family, and as such he chose to conceal his eyes to hide his real identity. He is the actual brother of [[Sayla Mass]]/[[Artesia Som Deikun]] and the true heir to Zeon. Char later becomes a very important member of the AEUG/Karaba alliance, eventually becoming its leader after the death of [[Blex Forer]], but is reported M.I.A. during the Battle of [[Gryps]]. Years after The Gryps War he becomes the supreme leader of Neo Zeon. 

Char's name was inspired by the [[real life]] Franco-Armenian singer and actor "Charles Aznavour":http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charles_Aznavour.

He is voiced by [[Ikeda Shuuichi]].

A [[spoilers|spoiler]] character of [[Undertale]].

[spoiler]The default name of the Fallen Child. It is eventually revealed at the True Pacifist route that Chara is the first human to fall into the Underground and that they are not the player character. Chara also takes control of the player character throughout the [[Genocide route (undertale)|]] and appears in person at the end of the route. Chara will also possess the player character at the end of the True Pacifist route endings if the player has ever finished a Genocide route run beforehand.

Chara is similar to [[Frisk (undertale)|Frisk]] in appearance as they both have [[short hair|short]] [[brown hair]] with [[hair behind ear|locks behind their ear]], but instead, they have [[brown eyes]], [[pale skin|paler skin]], [[blush stickers|rosy cheeks]], a [[long sleeves|long-sleeved]] [[two-tone shirt|two-tone]] [[striped shirt|striped]] [[green shirt|green]] and [[yellow shirt|yellow]]  scheme as opposed to purple and blue with a [[single horizontal stripe|single stripe]] on their shirt instead of [[double horizontal stripe|two]]. They wear[[brown shorts]] or [[brown pants]], and [[brown shoes]]. They are [[androgynous]] in appearance as well.

They are also seen with [[hollow eyes]] with [[liquid from eyes|liquid coming out]] and a wide [[open mouth|open]] [[smile]] that's [[black mouth|black]].

Although they canonically have brown eyes, most fanart depict them with [[red eyes]] instead. They are sometimes depicted with [[black pantyhose]], [[black socks|black]] [[ankle socks]]/[[kneehighs]], [[brown boots|brown]] [[ankle boots]], [[two-tone sweater|two-tone]] [[striped sweater|striped]] [[green sweater|green]] and [[yellow sweater]], a [[gold necklace|gold]] [[heart necklace|heart]] [[locket]], and seen [[holding knife|holding a knife]] in fanart instead. They are also sometimes depicted with [[chocolate]] as they are implied to like chocolate.

If they are depicted as male or female instead, use [[genderswap (otm)]] or [[genderswap (otf)]] respectively.

Their [[adoptive siblings|adoptive]] brother is [[Asriel Dreemurr]].[/spoiler]

payload.body:
[[Strike Witches]] character. A witch of the [[501st Joint Fighter Wing]]. She originates from [[Liberion]].

Magnanimous in character, tall and buxom in appearance, Charlotte ("Shirley" to her friends) is a thrill-seeker who is fascinated by speed. Concerned with cleanliness, Charlotte had her personal bath transported all the way to the [[Strike Witches]]' Britannia base when she was transferred from the Liberion Army 363rd Fighter Wing. She is strong, confident and sociable. She is good friends with [[Francesca Lucchini]]. She has an orange plane named Glamorous Shirley.

She is based on [[Chuck Yeager]], and shares many characteristics with her archetype: Yeager was the first pilot to travel faster than sound in 1947, and would later break further speed and altitude records in his life; he was a mechanic, similar to Shirley's tinkering, and flew a plane he named the Glamorous Glennis. 

Possibly in reference to model and photographer Bunny Yeager, Charlotte's [[familiar]] is the [[rabbit]]. She wields the [[M1918 BAR]], [[Thompson submachine gun]], and Colt [[M1911]] pistol.

The "Black Cat of Bad Omens". Stage 2 midboss and boss, as well as Extra Stage midboss of [[Touhou]]'s [[Perfect Cherry Blossom]].

She is the [[cat girl|nekomata]] shikigami of [[Yakumo Ran]] (who is herself the shikigami of [[Yakumo Yukari]]). Despite her knowledge of black magic, Chen is rather weak by herself, only gaining a massive increase in power in the presence of her master. She is also weakened by water. Like Ran, Chen is actually the shikigami spirit possessing the nekomata, although she appears to have only a partial hold on her host and doesn't suppress the host's personality, resulting in Chen as a character being a symbiosis between the two.

Fanworks frequently portray her as a daughter figure to Ran, often exuding a level of cuteness that often gives her [[excessive nosebleed|epic nosebleeds]]. She is also considered an honorary member of [[Team 9 (touhou)|]] in some fanwork circles. She appears to have befriended [[Kaenbyou Rin]] in [[Foul Detective Satori]], who has passed on her habit of finding and retrieving dead bodies.

payload.body:
A holiday celebrating the [[New Year]], also called "Spring Festival" (春节), in the traditional Chinese calendar, a lunisolar calendar, falling sometime between January 21 and February 20. It is mainly celebrated in China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macao, in countries with significant Chinese populations, and in Chinatowns elsewhere. It is broadly called "Lunar New Year" because several other "new year" holidays such as Seollal (Korean New Year) and Tết (Vietnamese New Year) are also celebrated around the same time.

Before 1873, the Japanese had celebrated New Year's festivities around the same time as Chinese New Year. Since 1873, however, when Japan adopted the widely used Gregorian calendar, New Year's festivities are being held instead on January 1.

Many of the New year traditions are said to have originated from the legend of [[Nian (mythology)|]].

Throughout the series though she sticks to predominately using the name "Kuro" (クロ), and is referred to as such by herself and the rest of the cast.

Chloe is also a servant under the Archer designation in [[Fate/Grand Order]], wielding Kanshou and Bakuya with great skill, and later gains a Summer version [[Chloe von Einzbern (Swimsuit Avenger)|under the Avenger designation]].

payload.body:
[b]Chris Redfield[/b] is a Special Operations Agent (SOA) of the Bioterrorism Security Assessment Alliance (BSAA), of which he is a founding member. Formerly, he served in the US Air Force; before moving on to law enforcement as a member of the RPD's Special Tactics And Rescue Service's (S.T.A.R.S.) Alpha Team. After S.T.A.R.S. were disbanded following the Raccoon City Incident, he and his partner, [[Jill Valentine]], became members of a Private Regional Biohazard Containment Unit (BCU), and took part in the fall of Umbrella in 2003. 

Chris is the older brother of [[Claire Redfield]] and one of few survivors of the mansion incident, during the Arklay Mountains outbreak in 1998. In addition to his qualification to pilot fixed-wing aircraft, Chris has been trained strictly in several fighting techniques like [[close-quarters combat]], is an expert in knife and firearm combat, and is also gifted with great accuracy.

Also notorious for punching a boulder in the climax of [[Resident Evil 5]].

h4.Appearance
Chris is a [[muscular male|muscular man]] with [[black hair]] and [[blue eyes]]. His appearance varies throughout the series.

* [[Resident Evil 1]]: Chris wears a [[police uniform]] with [[white shirt]], [[black pants]], [[bulletproof vest]], [[fingerless gloves]], and black boots.
* [[Resident Evil 5]]: Chris has a [[green shirt]], [[gloves]], [[grey pants]] and a [[green footwear|green shoes]]. His appearance changes noticeably, looking much more muscular compared to Resident Evil 1 .
* [[Resident Evil 6]]: Chris wears a similar outfit to the ones he wore in Resident Evil 5, albeit he sports a [[grey pants]], [[green shirt]], [[bulletproof vest]] and [[gloves]].
* [[Resident Evil 7: Biohazard]]: In Resident Evil 7: biohazard, Chris design changed to a less muscular body and a [[brown hair]], he sports a [[black jacket]], [[gloves]], [[black pants]], [[bulletproof vest]], [[black shoes]] and [[knee pads]]. 
* [[Resident Evil Village]]: Chris has a much more matured appearance in Resident Evil Village, he sports a [[black coat]] along with [[black shirt]], [[black pants]], [[gloves]] and black shoes.

payload.body:
[b]Chun-Li[/b] is a character in the [[Street Fighter]] series by [[Capcom]].

Introduced in [[Street Fighter II (series)|]], Chun-Li was the youngest member of the roster and only female character in the game, the self-proclaimed "strongest woman in the world". Her most famous attack is the [[Hyakuretsukyaku]] ("Hundred Crack Legs", alternately known as "Lightning Legs"), where she repeatedly kicks her opponent from a tilted standing position with incredible speed.

An Interpol investigator from [[China]] investigating the recent death of her father, she found a lead indicating who may be responsible—the mysterious crime syndicate [[Shadaloo]] and its tyrannical leader [[M. Bison]]. After M. Bison confirmed he killed her father, she made it her life's mission to destroy Shadaloo and bring M. Bison to justice. She collaborated closely with [[Guile]], [[Cammy White]], [[Ryu (Street Fighter)|]], and the other World Warriors throughout the journey.

After M. Bison's supposedly final death during [[Street Fighter V]], her mission complete, Chun-Li retired from Interpol and opened an orphanage to live a quieter life. The most famous of her young wards - practically her adopted daughter - is [[Li-Fen]].

She has [[brown eyes]] and [[long hair|long]] [[brown hair|brown]] or [[black hair]] almost always done up in a [[double bun]]. Her standard costume consists of a [[blue dress|blue]] [[china dress]] with [[puffy short sleeves]] and a white [[sash]], two high [[side slit]]s forming a [[pelvic curtain]], [[brown pantyhose]], [[white boots|white]] [[lace-up boots]], [[spiked bracelet]]s, and [[hair pulled back]] in [[double bun|buns]] under white [[bun cover]]s. She usually wears [[earrings]].

In [[Street Fighter Zero (series)|]], she wears a blue, sleeveless [[unitard]] and vest with sneakers and studded bracelets. [[Street Fighter IV (series)|]] & [[Street Fighter V]] introduced skimpier [[official alternate costume]]s, such as her [[backless dress]]; while [[Street Fighter 6]] gave her a white/blue [[multicolored dress|multicolored]] [[china dress]] and [[blue leggings]]. Her appearance in [[Street Fighter: Duel]] is an [[adapted costume|adapted]] version of her Zero attire. It consists of a [[crop top|cropped]] [[blue sports bra]], a [[black jacket]], [[lowleg pants|lowleg]] [[asymmetrical legwear|asymmetrical pants]] with a [[single thighhigh]], [[highleg panties]], and [[sneakers]].

Her first design was based on another character from Capcom called [[Tong Pooh]].

Japanese stereotypical depiction of a delusional person who attempts to stand out by believing that they have special powers (especially sealed powers), a dark past, or such like. Chuunibyou can manifest as overly dramatic [[hand over eye|hand gestures]], expressions, and spoken lines; and clothing such as [[eyepatch]]es and [[scarf|scarves]]. If the symptoms are severe enough, even [i]actually[/i] having special powers and/or a dark past may not be enough to beat chuunibyou allegations.

payload.body:
"The Small Ice Fairy"

Debuted as the Stage 2 boss of [[Touhou]]'s [[Embodiment of Scarlet Devil]] and later a recurring playable character. She has [[short hair|short]] [[blue hair]], [[blue eyes]], [[ice wings]], and wears a [[blue dress]] with [[puffy short sleeves]]. She appears in [[Hidden Star in Four Seasons]] as a playable character, "[[Tanned Cirno]]."

An ice fairy living in the [[Misty Lake]], near the [[Scarlet Devil Mansion]]. A relatively weak fighter, but nevertheless claims to be the strongest of all (somewhat justified, as fairies are low-tier generic enemies in the series). One of her hobbies is [[frozen|freezing]] [[frog|frogs]] and watching them thaw (a third of which ends up shattering), leading doujins to portray her at odds with the frog-themed goddess [[Moriya Suwako]].

Her large ego and childish incompetence earned her the nickname "[[circled 9|⑨]]" (pronounced "maru kyuu"/"nine-ball"), based on an "elements of play" screenshot from the game manual of [[Phantasmagoria of Flower View]] in which she was labelled 「9.バカ」 ("baka"/"idiot"). Another contributing factor to her portrayal as an idiot is her [[Icicle Fall]] spell card from Embodiment of Scarlet Devil, which (on Easy difficulty only) fails to hit a "safe zone" directly beneath/in front of her. Doujins also portray her as de facto leader of [[Team 9 (touhou)|]], a posse of childish low-tier Touhou characters.

In Russian she is known as [i]Сырно[/i] (Sɨrno), which literally translates as "cheesy" (in adverb form). In Finnish she is known as [i]Sirkku[/i] (post #673220).

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the US Navy battleship USS [i]Colorado[/i] (BB-45). 
Character design by [[Parsley-F]].

h4. Appearance

Like [[iowa (kancolle)|Iowa]] before her, she is given traits, based upon some old WWII-era US Navy pin-ups such as: [[short hair|short]] [[blonde hair]] with [[side braids]], [[blue eyes]], and a [[large breasts|well endowed]] yet petite body. She wears a [[grey hat|grey]] [[garrison cap]], yardarm [[headgear]] that is already typical for the Big 7, a two-part [[grey dress|gray]] [[pleated dress]] with blue accents and a [[sleeveless]] [[white shirt]] that [[sideboob|exposes one side of each breast]], a [[blue necktie]] with the number 45 on it, [[black gloves|black]] and grey [[elbow gloves]], [[black pantyhose]], a grey [[capelet]] with blue underside, and red [[high heels|high-heeled shoes]].

Her machinery includes her famed 16-inch guns (four at each side in twin [[ship turret|turrets]]), a [[smokestack]] and a [[lattice mast]] with a large clock face among others. She is given a remodel which trades the clock face for a radar antenna atop the mast, paints her wooden deck grey and modernizes her secondary and anti-aircraft guns.

h4. History

The historical USS [i]Colorado[/i] saw a long and active career that took her into both Atlantic and Pacific oceans. She participated in a number of fleet exercises in the inter-war years, and also briefly served in various tasks such as becoming a training ship, and even assisting in the search for Amelia Earhart. During WWII, [i]Colorado[/i] saw extensive action throughout the Pacific against the Japanese, being a constant presence in pre-invasion shelling and fire support actions from Tarawa all the way to Okinawa. For her service, the battleship was awarded seven battle stars. After the war, she participated in "Operation Magic Carpet" to bring US troops back home. She was decommissioned in 1947 and sold for scrap in 1959.

h4. Trivia

She is named after the state of Colorado, the second such ship in the US Navy but the third to carry the name (the first USS [i]Colorado[/i], a steam screw frigate, was named after the Colorado River).

She is the first foreign shipgirl as well as the first personified battleship for her artist [[Parsley-f]]. She is also the fourth (second foreign) member of the so-called Big 7 (the seven battleships with 16-inch guns built before WWII) in the game, joining [[nagato (kancolle)|Nagato]], [[mutsu (kancolle)|Mutsu]], and [[nelson (kancolle)|Nelson]].

In comparison to the other Big 7 in the game, she is given a petite body and a more youthful appearance, reflecting the fact the Colorado-class battleships were the shortest of the Big 7 at 624 feet 3 inches (190.27 m) each, compared to the Nagato-class at 708 feet (215.8 m; later lengthened to 738 feet/224.94 m) each and the Nelson-class at 710 feet (216.4 m) each. In spite of this shorter length, their displacement was equal to that of her counterparts, at 32,600 long tons unloaded (compare the Nagato-class at 32,200 long tons and the Nelson-class at 33,300 long tons), which is reflected by her curvaceous figure and ample bosom.

h4. [i]Colorado[/i]-class battleships
* [b]Colorado[/b] (BB-45)
* [[Maryland (Kancolle)]] (BB-46)

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the French seaplane tender [i]Commandant Teste[/i]. Character design by [[Akira_(kadokawa)|]], voiced by [[Tanibe Yumi]].

She wears a large, white floppy [[beret]] with a red [[pom pom_(clothes)|]] on top, a blue-white-and-red tartan [[scarf]], white [[double-breasted]] [[jacket]] and [[belt]] over a navy blue [[dress]], [[black socks|black]] [[kneehighs]], and white-and-red [[platform shoes|platform]] [[loafers]].  When damaged, it can be seen she that wears [[white_panties|white]] [[lace panties]]. Her [[long_hair|long]] slightly [[wavy_hair|wavy]] [[blonde hair]] is [[streaked_hair|streaked]] with blue, white, and red, and is pulled into a [[ponytail]]. She has [[swept bangs]] held in place with a small [[anchor hair ornament]].

Her [[rigging]] is suspended off her back, consisting of a deck-like platform carrying a mast and several [[crane (machine)|]]s. Two ship-hull like platforms come along either side of her bearing two [[aircraft catapult]]s apiece. Small [[ship turret|turret]]s dangle from chains off of her jacket.

Similar to [[Warspite (kancolle)|]], Commandant Teste can pronounce French fairly well, but she also speaks Japanese with an unusual accent, overly enunciating or pausing on certain words. With little history with other implemented ships or any implemented fellow French ships, her in-game lines focus upon her wanting to train with other seaplane carriers, especially [[Mizuho (kancolle)|]] and [[Hyuuga (kancolle)|]].

Historically, [i]Commandant Teste[/i] was built as a 10,000-ton seaplane tender as a way to sneak the most powerful ship possible in under the Washington Naval Treaty without counting as a fleet carrier. She participated in the [[Spanish Civil War]] by escorting neutral shipping, but did little during World War II. After ferrying aircraft to Africa, and being damaged in a British raid on "Mers-El-Kebir,":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mers_El_K%C3%A9bir], the Vichy French scuttled [i]Commandant Teste[/i] in 1942 to prevent her from being captured by the Germans. The Italians managed to bring her back up in 1943, and passed her to the Germans, but [i]Commandant Teste[/i] was sunk again by aerial bombing nearly a year after that. Although raised one last time after the war, there was no use seen for her, and she was sold for scrap in 1950.

Her [[abyssal ship|abyssal]] form is assumed to be the [[Seaplane Tender Water Princess]].

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Italian battleship [i]Conte di Cavour[/i]. Designed by [[Jiji (aardvark)|]], voiced by [[Iida Hikaru]].

She has [[brown eyes]] and [[long_hair|long]] light [[grey hair]] tied in a [[two side up]] hairstyle. She wears a [[long_sleeves|long-sleeved]] white and grey [[frilled dress]] that has [[cleavage cutout|cleavage]] and [[armpit cutout]]s. She bears visibly oversized [[rigging]] mainly composed of [[cannon]]s, [[ship turret|turret]]s, and [[smokestack]]s, including her three triple- and two-twin 305-mm guns.

The short length of the historical battleship translates to a petite childlike appearance that is belied only by her [[large breasts]] and mature voice, to the point she is oftentimes mistaken for being an [[oppai loli]]. Because she is the oldest and shortest battleship in the game, her lines have her being [[height conscious]], having back pain due to her [[rigging]], and complaining about the other Italian shipgirls already in the base, particularly [[Pola (kancolle)|]] and several of the [[Maestrale (kancolle)|]]-class girls for their behavior and [[Roma (kancolle)|]] for calling her nosy and old. She does go along well with [[Gangut (Kancolle)|]] as long as she is not served vodka all the time.

The historical [i]Conte di Cavour[/i] was the nameship of the three [i]Conte di Cavour[/i]-class dreadnought battleships of the [[Regia Marina]]. She served in both world wars, although she saw no action in World War I. She was badly damaged by British torpedo bombers in November 1940 and deliberately run aground. Repairs were never completed by the time of the Italian armistice in 1943. She was captured by the Germans, but they made no efforts to complete her repairs. She was damaged in an Allied air raid in early 1945 and capsized a week later. She was eventually scrapped in 1946.

payload.body:
A dense, towering vertical [[cloud]].

Well-developed cumulonimbus clouds are characterized by a flat, anvil-like top (anvil dome), caused by wind shear or inversion near the boundary between the troposphere and the stratosphere.  These clouds are capable of producing lightning, heavy rain, high winds, and/or other dangerous severe weather, such as [[tornado|tornadoes]] and [[hail|hailstones]].

h4. Types

* Cumulonimbus calvus: Latin for "bald", features a puffy top
* Cumulonimbus capillatus: Latin for "long hair", features ice crystal clouds that streak out at its top edge giving it a fibrous appearance
* Cumulonimbus capillatus incus: Also known as an "anvil cloud" (incus being Latin for anvil), features a flat, anvil-top shape

h4. Examples

* !post #4594627

Daiyousei's name is fangiven, meaning literally "great fairy." [[Touhou]] midboss of [[Cirno]]'s stage in [[Embodiment of Scarlet Devil]]. 

Thought to be friends with her, portrayed as more mature and coolheaded than other fairies. In Oriental Sacred Place, she was portrayed as incredibly shy, hiding from anyone that wasn't Cirno. The Fandom might draw her with larger breasts than any other fairy, thanks to her fan name.

She has [[green hair]] in a [[high side ponytail]] tied with a [[yellow bow|yellow]] [[hair bow]] and her eyes are usually either [[blue eyes|blue]] or [[green eyes|green]]. She wears a [[collared shirt|collared]] [[white shirt]] with [[puffy short sleeves]], a [[yellow ascot]], and either a [[skirt set|paired]] [[blue vest]] and [[blue skirt]] or a [[blue dress|blue]] [[pinafore dress]]. Out of all the Touhou fairies, she is most frequently depicted with [[white wings|white]] [[fairy wings]]. 

In [[Whispered Oracle of Hakurei Shrine]], her ability has been revealed as "to swim through mist". Whether this means she can move through the mist with incredible ease, as if she's teleporting through them, or her "swim through mist" is more akin to "thrive in the mist" and become stronger in the mist is up to interpretation.

payload.body:
[b]The Legendary Devil Hunter, Dante[/b]

[b]Dante[/b] is the main protagonist in the [[Devil May Cry (series)|]] series. He is the son of [[Sparda]] and [[Eva (devil may cry)|]], the twin brother of [[Vergil (devil may cry)|]], and the paternal uncle of [[Nero (devil may cry)|]]. As such, he is a half-demon.

A demon hunter by trade, he owns the eponymous shop named after the series. Wielding his sword [[Rebellion (sword)|]] and twin pistols [[Ebony & Ivory]], he became a devil killer to avenge the death of his mother and protect humankind.

Unlike Vergil, he also displays a spunky, cocky attitude. Voiced by Reuben Langdon in North America, and [[Morikawa Toshiyuki]] in Japan.

[[Limbus Company]] character. 

Sinner No.03 of [[Limbus Company]]. Based on and named after [[alonso quixano|the main protagonist]] of the 17th century Spanish novel [[Don Quixote (novel)|]] written by "Miguel de Cervantes":https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Miguel_de_Cervantes. 

She has [[short hair|short]] [[blonde hair]] kept in a [[bob cut]], [[yellow eyes]] that frequently [[+_+|sparkle]], and always wears a pair of worn [[brown footwear|brown]] [[boots]] with the name "Rocinante":https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rocinante across all of her identities. She wears the uniform of all [[Limbus Company]] sinners, consisting of a [[white shirt|white]] [[collared shirt]], [[red necktie]], [[black pants]], [[black coat]], but excludes the [[black vest]] and additionally adorns her uniform with various pins of famous fixers (Most notably [[iori (project moon)|The Purple Tear]]). 

She wields a towering [[polearm|joust]] in her base identity with the Spanish words 'SUEÑO IMPOSIBLE' ('IMPOSSIBLE DREAM' in English) written on it, the name of main theme song of [[Man of La Mancha]], the first official musical adaptation of Don Quixote.

[spoiler]She is revealed to be a second-generation Bloodfiend in Intervallo IV-2 after losing her shoes in a confrontation with [[Cassetti (project moon)|]]. Canto VII further reveals that she was formerly named [[Sancho (project moon)|]], having purposely wiped her memories by drinking from the River of Oblivion, suppressed her nature as a Bloodfiend with Rocinante, and adopted the name of the [[La Manchaland's Don Quixote (project moon)|First Kindred]] that sired her.[/spoiler]

payload.body:
E.G.O equipment (Extermination of Geometrical Origin) is a recurring theme in [[Project Moon]] media. They can be used by characters in order to enhance their fighting prowess. They can take the form of weapons, clothing, and items.

E.G.O may manifest in two manners:

* Extracted from abnormalities (taking a similar appearance from them)
* Manifested through intense feelings and determination

Notable E.G.O equipment includes [[Gebura (project moon)|]]'s Mimicry (E.G.O extracted from the abnormality [[Nothing There]]) and armor (her own manifested E.G.O).

Prolonged usage of extracted E.G.O one is not fully qualified to use or with low levels of sanity can result in E.G.O corrosion. This results in the user transforming into a form similar to the abnormality the E.G.O was originally extracted from.

payload.body:
Easter, also called Pascha (Greek/Latin) or Resurrection Sunday, is a festival and holiday celebrating the resurrection of [[Jesus]] from the dead. In [[christianity|Christian]] faith, Jesus died [[crucifixion|on the cross]] on Good Friday and was buried. On Easter Sunday, He revived and returned to Heaven to be with the Almighty Father.

Informally, Easter is celebrated with imagery of the [[Easter Bunny]], who is purported to leave decorated baskets of candy and chocolates for children. [[Easter egg]]s are painted and hidden throughout a location for children to find as a festive activity. Since Easter frequently occurs in either March or April, it also uses images and colors related to the season of spring.

h4.See also

* [[Happy Easter]]
* [[Tag Group:Holidays and Celebrations]]

Avenger-class Servant seen in [[Fate/Grand Order]]. Notable for being the first Avenger introduced in the game.

Edmond Dantes is the protagonist of [[Alexandre Dumas (fate)|]]' [i]"The Count of Monte Cristo":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Count_of_Monte_Cristo][/i]. Good-natured and innocent in the beginning, he is framed as a supporter of the exiled Napoleon Bonaparte and imprisoned.  In prison he befriends another political prisoner, a priest named Faria, who educates him. Dantes later escapes, and hardened by his experiences, he goes on to create a new identity for himself as the Count of Monte Cristo, and uses his new position to exact revenge on all those who wronged him in the past. He is also known as [b]The King of the Cavern[/b] in the Japanese version as a reference to the Japanese title of the novel.

In [[Fate/Grand Order]] he does not consider himself as Dantes at all, rather as the vengeful King of the Cavern.

Eila Ilmatar Juutilainen (エイラ・イルマタル・ユーティライネン, Eira Irumataru Yūtirainen?) is a witch of the [[501st Joint Fighter Wing]], originating from [[Suomus]] and affiliated with the Suomus Air Force. She is referred to as "Illu" by her friends, and is sometimes named Diamond Ace. Her familiar is the black [[fox]].

Eila's magic ability Foresight (未来予知, Mirai Yochi) grants her a limited ability to predict the future. Her hobby is fortune-telling with tarot cards, although the accuracy of her predictions is questionable at best. Similar to stereotypes of her familiar (a black fox), she has a reputation for mischief, being fond of pranks amongst her colleagues and is somewhat mischievous.

Eila is often partnered with 501st Night Witch [[Sanya V. Litvyak]], and perhaps as a result the two have become very close; Eila is often portrayed as fiercely protective of her younger squadmate and takes on a sometimes awkwardly nurturing role during down-time. Whether this interest is romantic or plain, big-sisterly fondness is up for interpretation. 

Eila is based on the #1-ranked Finnish flying ace (and #1-ranked non-German flying ace) "Eino Ilmari Juutilainen":http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eino_Juutilainen. Like Eila, he bore the nickname "Illu" amongst his friends. Her magic ability, Foresight, is a reference to Eino having never been hit by enemy fire.

She has an older sister, [[Aurora E. Juutilainen]].

h4. Appearance

* !post #3658878

h4. Equipment

* [[MG42]]
* [[Suomi KP/-31|Suomi M1931]]

payload.body:
[[Elsword]] character. [[elsword (character)|Elsword]]'s older sister, and a strong and calculating warrior who travels the world to improve her swordsmanship. Her disappearance is what motivates Elsword to go on his own journey. Her seiyuu is [[Inoue Marina]].

She used to be known by the name Elsa.

Elesis is heavily based on [[Elesis Sieghart]] from [[Grand Chase]], but [b]they are not the same character[/b] due to them having different backstories and living in different universes. However, because Grand Chase lists Elsword as her brother too, their lineage is considered identical across both games, and some fans see both incarnations of Elesis as one and the same. However, they are all to be treated as separate characters on Danbooru.

[[Free Knight (elsword)|]] > [[Saber Knight (elsword)|]] > [[Grand Master (elsword)|]] > [[Empire Sword (elsword)|]]

A character introduced in [[Guilty Gear Xrd]], later becoming playable. Claims to be [[Ramlethal Valentine]]'s sister.

Elphelt Valentine is a big fan of nature and absolutely adores all kinds of animals. She is also a sweetheart and empathetic, and cannot stand to see others feeling lonely. Elphelt is also optimistic to a fault and firmly believes that anything can be overcome if one simply takes action.

She is passionate about appearing as feminine as possible as well as willing herself to become the woman she wants to be, but her efforts often end up in vain. Elphelt is a hopeless romantic whose fantasies often cloud her judgment, evident by her tendency to ask anyone who is friendly with her to "marry" her. Her weapons of choice are rifles, shotguns, and other various firearms and explosives.

In Xrd, she wears a [[bride]]-like getup donned with clovers and spikes that exposes her [[large breasts]]. In Strive, she wears a punk rock-like getup.

payload.body:
A small icon embedded in text used to express various emotions or concepts.

The word "Emoji" comes from the Japanese word "絵" ([i]e[/i], "picture") + "文字" ([i]moji[/i], "character"). Its resemblance to the word "[[emoticon]]" is purely coincidental.

Emoji as we know them originated as a proprietary system by a Japanese mobile phone operator [[NTT DoCoMo]] using a Unicode private-use block to encode their emoticons. While other mobile providers used many other systems for emoji, this system was the most compact implementation used at the time (and the closest to the current one).

The very first Emoji were actually Unicode Dingbats, of which, quite a few are now official Emoji. Emoji became a standardized system with its implementation in Unicode 6.0 in 2010 but it's only around 2014-2015 that their use exploded and became commonplace to the point that they became a cultural phenomenon with real world merchandise and even a movie about them.

See [[emoticon]] for text-based emoticons like [code]:)[/code] or [code]^_^[/code]. See [[kaomoji]] for Japanese text-based emoticons like [code](´・ω・`)[/code].

Emperor, like the other Penguins, wears a black and white hoodie after their species' plumage with the sleeves ending as mittens, emulating the flippers. In her case, the hood has a yellow hood. She also wears it open, revealing her white leotard (or swimsuit) with a wide collar fading up to yellow as well as [[large_breasts|her physique]]. She also wears thighhighs, accentuating the impact of her greater height compared to the others. She has long black hair with [[hair_over_one_eye|a long bang covering up her left eye]]. She has [[very long hair|very long]], [[grey hair|grey]], [[aqua hair|aqua]], or [[white hair]], [[grey eyes|silver]] to dull [[blue eyes]], and is [[large breasts|well-endowed]]. She wears a white [[peaked cap]], a [[sleeveless]], [[white shirt|white]] [[collared shirt]] and [[necktie]], a [[black skirt|black]], [[pleated skirt|pleated]] [[miniskirt]] with [[gold trim]], [[black thighhighs]], and [[black footwear|black]] [[knee boots]]. She has an open long [[black coat]] with red inner lining that reaches her feet and hangs loosely on her shoulders. Her [[rigging]] is composed of a [[flight deck]] with yellow markings, including the letters "EN," and bow with island superstructure.

She is frequently depicted with her companion bald eagle, though officially unnamed, has been nicknamed "[[Grim (azur lane)|]]."

[[Strike Witches]] character. A witch of the [[501st Joint Fighter Wing]], originating from [[Karlsland]]. Her familiar is the [[Dachshund]]. 

Erica is Karlsland's sixteen year old "ultra ace" of the Luftwaffe JG 52 with more than 300 confirmed victories and the rank of Flying Officer. She one of the best-seven witches in terms of shot down count. While extremely efficient and strategic in battle, Erica is rather sloppy on the ground, and her room (which she has never cleaned) is extremely messy. She is the sort of person who is only serious when the situation calls for it.

She uses an [[MG42]] and an [[MP40]].

Her ace archetype is [[Erich Hartmann]]. Her [[bob cut]] hairstyle (German: "Bubischnitt") is based on Erich's nickname "Bubi".

Estelle is an 18 year old noblewoman who has spent all of her life growing up in Zaphias Castle. Due to her restrictive upbringing, she has gained most of her worldly knowledge through books. payload.body:
[b]The Butterfly Fairy who Approaches God[/b]

Stage 1 boss of the [i][[Touhou]][/i] game [i][[Hidden Star in Four Seasons]][/i]. In the demo, her name was misspelled as [b]Etarnity Larva[/b].

She has [[aqua_hair|aqua hair]] with [[brown_eyes|brown eyes]]. She has a forked [[antennae|antenna]] (actually an "osmeterium":https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Osmeterium) atop her head accompanied with some [[leaf_on_head|leaves around her head]]. She wears a [[green_dress|green]], larva-shaped dress and is [[barefoot|barefooted]]. She has a pair of [[butterfly_wings|butterfly wings]] on her back. She is depicted with her [[outstretched_arms|arms stretched out]] in her character portrait. Her dress has [[short_sleeves|short sleeves]].

She is a butterfly fairy embodying the life cycle of a butterfly. Her abilities let her scatter scales. She is normally very gentle, but the incident has empowered her to be a bit more aggressive than usual.

[spoiler] In [[Cirno|Cirno's]] Extra route, [[Matara_Okina|Okina]] speculates that Eternity may not be a mere fairy, but is in fact a Tokoyo Kami (or God of the Everlasting World) and one of her enemies. [/spoiler]

h4. External links

* Touhou Wiki: https://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Eternity_Larva

[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese escort ship [i]Etorofu[/i]. Character design by [[Akasaka Yuzu]], voiced by [[Shuto Yukina]]. 

She has [[short hair|short]] [[red hair]] with [[orange hair|orange]] [[gradient_hair|gradient tips]], [[thick eyebrows]], and [[purple eyes]]. A [[mecha]] in [[Neon Genesis Evangelion]], piloted by [[Ikari Shinji]]. 

Arguably the most famous [[evangelion_(mecha)|Evangelion unit]], [b]EVA-01[/b] has a predominantly purple body with neon green highlights, yellowish eyes and a characteristic [[single horn]] that distinguishes it from the other EVAs. 

It has the hidden ability to go berserk, in which case its eyes glow red and a large mouth opens itself from the Evangelion's faceplate. In [[Evangelion: 2.0 You Can (Not) Advance]], the unit undergoes a process called "Pseudo-Evolution" after devouring [[Zeruel (evangelion)|]], where its green highlights become red and a shining [[halo]] materializes around the horn. In this form, the unit's left arm may or may not be a glowing construct.

In the original series, it is revealed that [spoiler][[Ikari Yui]]'s essence fused with the mecha during a pilot test, turning it into [[Ikari Shinji|Shinji]]'s actual mother.[/spoiler]

Character designed by [[Yamashita Ikuto]].

payload.body:
A post centered around evolutionary lines of [[Pokemon|Pokémon]] and similar franchises ([[Digimon]], etc).

Also applies to [[Fakemon]] or [[original]] [[creature]]s/[[monster]]s, so long as it's clear that they're part of the same evolutionary family.

A few notes:
* For this tag to apply, the picture should reasonably be about evolutionary lines. That is, the theme connecting characters in the picture should be the fact that they're part of the same family, not that they're part of the same franchise.
** For example, post #4134648 technically contains a lot of evolutionary lines, but realistically nobody searching for this tag wants the majority of posts for unpopular Pokémon to be [[everyone]]-style posts.
* For an evolutionary line with 3 or more creatures, not every single one needs to be present. This tag is fine to use if there is focus on, for example, the first stage and third stage of an evolutionary line with the second stage creature not being present.
* For [[Pokemon (creature)|Pokémon]], Paradox Pokémon ([[Scream Tail]], [[Iron Valiant]], etc.) and convergent Pokémon ([[Toedscool]], [[Wiglett]], etc.) are not considered to be part of the same evolutionary line as the Pokémon they are referencing.

payload.body:
A [i][[Kemono Friends]][/i] character. She is one of many "Friends" in Japari Park, being part of the Snowy Mountain Region in the anime.

As her name suggests, she is an [[Ezo Red Fox]] ([i]Vulpes vulpes schrencki[/i]), a red fox subspecies native to Hokkaido and Sakhalin.

Her outfit consists of what appears to be an orange blazer uniform with fur lined sleeves and a white pleated skirt, beige pantyhose fading to white at the feet, black gloves as well as a scarf tied into a bow. She has long blonde hair with black-tipped bangs along with the requisite fox ears and tail. She can be distinguished from a simple palette swap of Silver Fox with her lack of sidelocks. Her eyes are also a lighter amber color than her fellow fox.

More often than not, she is depicted as a slacker who likes to play video games.

She is often seen with [[Silver Fox (kemono friends)|]], a fellow fox Friend. Compare as well with [[Red Fox (kemono friends)|]], their nominate species Friend.

h4. Appearance

* !post #5991289

For her eighteenth birthday, [[Stark (sousou no frieren)|]] gave her an ornate mirrored lotus [[bracelet]] as a present, which she frequently wears on her left wrist.

After the events at [[granat (sousou no frieren)|Graf Granat's]] Domain, Graf Granat gave Fern a [[black dress|black]], [[long sleeves|long-sleeved]] [[dress]] that she wears with a thick, [[white coat|white]] [[winter coat]] and [[purple scarf|purple]] [[braided scarf]] in colder settings.

* [[Flintlock]]: A hammer holding flint strikes a piece of steel to produce sparks that ignite a pan of gunpowder.
* [[Caplock]]: A hammer strikes a percussion cap that ignites the gunpowder in the barrel.

If the weapon's firing mechanism is easily identifiable, use one of the more specific tags under this tag. The younger, mentally unstable sister of [[Remilia Scarlet]], sealed in the basement of the [[Scarlet Devil Mansion]] for 495 years because of her ability to cause wanton destruction. payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of USS [i]Fletcher[/i] (hull number DD-445), nameship of the US Navy's 175 Fletcher-class destroyers. Designed by [[Zeco]].

She has [[long hair|long]] [[blonde hair]] with triangular [[double bun]]s, [[purple eyes]], and [[large breasts]]. Her outfit is similar to [[Johnston (Kancolle)|]]'s, but with the black features being given lighter colors: a stylized [[serafuku]] which consists of an [[off-shoulder shirt|off-shoulder]] [[blue shirt]] with a [[white sailor collar]] that exposes her [[cleavage]], a [[yellow neckerchief]], and a short [[white skirt|white]] [[pleated skirt]], along with [[white thighhighs]] that are shielded by what seem to be metallic thigh and [[shin guards]] and red [[rudder footwear|rudder shoes]]. She also wears [[white gloves]] and a metallic [[hairband]].

Her [[rigging]] consists of two [[smokestack]]s and two 5-inch [[cannon]] [[ship turret]]s with one set on each side of her rigging. Her hull number is emblazoned on each side of her lower rigs. She also carries a [[cargo net]], a reference to her rescuing many survivors of the USS [[Northampton (kancolle)|]] during the "Battle of Tassafaronga":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_Tassafaronga] by using cork-floated cargo nets.

In her [[Fletcher Kai (kancolle)|Kai]] form, she gains a silver [[star hair ornament]] on each side of her hairband, and her rigging gains an additional radar set atop the director and loses its blue camouflage in favor of standard grey color.

In her [[Fletcher Mk II (kancolle)|Mk II]] form she has two reversible modes. In both of them, she loses the cargo net and gains a pair of [[headphones]]. One of the modes gives her a quintuple torpedo launcher to carry, while the other completely redoes her rigging, giving her experimental ASW equipment to carry, making her headband more angular (mimicking the changed shape of her bridge), and changing the color of her skirt and thighhighs from white to black.

Historically, the Fletcher class was the most numerous of the destroyers that participated in [[World War II]], built completely free from any treaty restrictions with a larger size, larger fuel capacity and range, and better armaments. In Kantai Collection, this translates to Fletcher and Johnston being tall and having ample bustlines; among the other non-Japanese destroyers before them, only [[Tashkent (kancolle)|]] is comparable in those areas while the others are implied to have flat chests.

Her namesake (and namesake of the class) is Navy Admiral "Frank Friday Fletcher":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frank_Friday_Fletcher], who served in the 19th and 20th centuries, most notably as commander of naval forces at the "Battle of Veracruz":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_occupation_of_Veracruz] in Mexico.

Berserker-class Servant in [[Fate/Grand Order]] featured in the [[E Pluribus Unum (fate/grand order)|]] singularity. The eponymous "Angel of Crimea", a British nurse from the Victorian era best known for her contribution to the modern medical study and effort to improve the conditions in hospitals.

She has [[red eyes]] and [[long hair|long]] light [[pink hair]] worn in a [[braided ponytail]]. She wears a red [[military uniform]] with a [[black skirt]]. In her third Ascension level, she has a [[bandage over one eye]] and a [[black coat]] worn [[coat on shoulders|over her shoulders]].

Nightingale usually behaves in a cold and stoic manner. Due to the side effect of Madness Enchantment from her classification, she has an obsession with keeping anything clean or sanitized, and also causing her will to treat someone to go overboard, to the point that she will do anything to treat her patient, such as killing anyone who interrupts her treatment process.

She uses a [[pepperbox revolver]] in combat in addition to other unconventional weapons, such as throwing [[bed]]s.

[b]Character Design:[/b] [[Takahashi Keitarou]]
[b]Voice Actress:[/b] [[Sawashiro Miyuki]]

Joining the 501st from the Duchy of Romagna, Francesca is the youngest soldier of the unit at a mere twelve years. Her rank is that of a Pilot Officer and her unit affiliation was with Romagna's Sovrana Aeronautica Romagniana 4th Air Unit. Francesca is often childish and self-indulgent, shirking training and other duties in order to have fun around the base or nap. However, in battle she displays a true talent and passion for flying. She is good friends with the similarly casual [[Charlotte E. Yeager]] and has the tendency to occasionally speak in a sing-song tone.

Francesca is based off the Italian flying ace Franco Lucchini.

Several years later, she took on another journey with Warrior [[Stark (sousou no frieren)|]] and her new disciple Mage [[Fern (sousou no frieren)|]], eventually reunited with her now elderly former party members. She is often known as "Frieren the Undertaker" (the title of the series) or "Frieren the Slayer".

She wears a [[striped shirt|striped]] [[black shirt|black]] and [[white shirt]], along with a [[white jacket]] with [[gold trim|gold embellishments]] tucked into a [[skirt set|matching]] [[white skirt]] with a [[black belt]]. Over her jacket, she wears a gold-trimmed [[white capelet]] with a [[red gem]] on her [[high collar]]. She also wears [[black pantyhose]] and [[brown boots]], and a pair of [[gold earrings|gold]] and red [[earrings]] on each ear. She also carries a [[mage staff]].

[[aged down|In the past]], she had her [[hair down]] and wore a simple [[white dress]].

payload.body: [[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese destroyer [i]Fubuki[/i]. Character design by [[Shibafu (glock23)|]], voiced by [[Uesaka Sumire]]. She has [[long hair|long]] [[black hair]] in a small [[ponytail]] and [[sidelocks]] in front, [[black eyes]], and [[small breasts]]. Her default outfit, the Special-Type uniform, is a [[serafuku]] comprising a [[white shirt]], [[blue sailor collar]], [[neckerchief]], [[blue skirt|blue]] [[pleated skirt]], [[black socks]], and [[grey footwear|grey]] [[rudder footwear]]. Her [[rigging]] consists of her funnel and foremast carried as a form of backpack, while carrying two 61 cm triple [[torpedo tubes]] on [[thigh strap|thigh straps]] and a 12.7 twin gun mount Type A as a [[handgun]]. She has an earnest and diligent personality, but lacks any notable quirks or notable personality traits, and is often considered very plain. She is the viewpoint character of the official 4koma [i]Fubuki-chan Gambarimasu![/i], as well as the leading role in the [[Kantai Collection (anime)|Kantai Collection anime]] adaptation. h4. A character from [[One-Punch Man]]. Her full hero name is [i]Jigoku no Fubuki[/i] (地獄のフブキ, lit. Blizzard of Hell, [i]Hellish Blizzard[/i] in the official translation), and she is the 1st place ranked B-class hero of the Heroes Association. She is [[Tatsumaki]]'s younger [[sisters|sister]] and a powerful [[telekinesis|telekinetic]]/[[psychic]].

She has [[green eyes]], [[large breasts|large]] to [[huge breasts]], and [[short hair|short]] [[green hair|dark green]]/[[black hair]] with [[blunt bangs]] & [[blunt ends]]. She wears a [[green dress|green]] [[taut dress|taut]] [[collared dress]], [[necklace]], and [[black thighhighs]].

payload.body:
[[Fubuki (Kancolle)|]]'s second remodel.

Her white [[serafuku]] is retained but she opts for a [[black sailor collar]] with red stripes, while she also wears a [[black skirt]] and [[black socks|black]] [[kneehighs]] with red stripes: the default Special Type Kai Ni uniform.

As for her [[rigging]], she replaces her original 12.7 cm twin gun mount Type A with a 10 cm twin DP gun mount and wears a type 94 anti-aircraft fire detector on her left wrist. She also gains a [[radar]] on her mast. Her use of this gear is hypothetical, however. She was sunk in the battle of Cape Esperance (October 1942) before she ever had a chance to be refit with AA weaponry. Unlike other hypothetical second remodels, she does not require a blueprint for the remodel.

She gained her second remodel with the January 9th 2015 update (timed with the premiere of the [[Kantai Collection (anime)|Kantai Collection anime]]) and thus became the first starter ship to have one.

payload.body:
The protagonist of [[Fate/Grand Order]] if selected as female.

She has [[orange hair]], [[orange eyes]], [[medium breasts]] and an [[ahoge]]. In her default attire which is [[Chaldea Master uniform]], she has a [[side ponytail]]/[[one side up]] tied by a yellow [[hair scrunchie]], and wears a [[black skirt]], [[black pantyhose]] and a pair of [[white boots]].

She has roughly the same characterization as the [[Fujimaru Ritsuka (Male)|male version]]. She does, however, have an alternate characterization from the "Learn with Manga!":/pools/10385 comics, where she is more depraved and quick to [[female pervert|perv]] on other female Servants, particularly [[Mash Kyrielight]].

The [[fujimaru ritsuka (male)|male protagonist]] is colloquially called Gudao. The name Gudako could come from an abbreviation of [b]Gu[/b]rando Oo[b]da[/b]a, or from "Gudaguda Order" (ぐだぐだオーダー), an official series of Grand Order comics ("English":[http://fate-go.us/gudao/], "Japanese":[https://www.fate-go.jp/gudao/]). Ko is a common ending for female names and can also mean girl.

Her appearance is based on [[Emiya Shirou]].

[b]Character Design:[/b] [[Takeuchi Takashi]]
[b]Voice Actress:[/b] [[Sekine Akira]]

payload.body:
The "Crimson Watchguard". Extra Stage boss of [[Touhou]]'s [i][[Imperishable Night]][/i].

An immortal human with powers of [[fire|pyromancy]]. Mokou bears a deep grudge against [[Houraisan Kaguya|Kaguya]] for spurning her father's hand in marriage when the former was still young (humiliating him in the process), which caused her to steal and drink the Hourai Elixir as revenge. Upon reaching Gensokyo, she learned that Kaguya, too, was an immortal exile, and both have since engaged in countless fatal duels for fun.

When not picking a fight with Kaguya, she rescues lost people or guides them through the Bamboo Forest to Eientei, home of her own nemesis, or the Human Village, where her friend [[Kamishirasawa Keine]] lives, and claims to run a yakitori stand (which would put her at odds with [[Mystia Lorelei]]).

Became playable in [[Urban Legend in Limbo]] and [[Antinomy of Common Flowers]].

A character introduced in [[Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc]], titled the Ultimate Writing Prodigy (超高校級の「文学少女」).

She has a gloomy and pessimistic personality, making it hard for her to get along with others, though she's obsessively in love with [[Togami Byakuya]]. [spoiler]Her alternate personality is the demented serial killer [[Genocider Sho]].[/spoiler]

Has [[long hair|long]] [[purple hair|purple]] or [[brown hair]], [[purple eyes]], and a [[mole under mouth|mole under her mouth]]. Wears [[round eyewear|round]] glasses and a [[black serafuku|black]] or [[purple serafuku]] consisting of a [[long sleeves|long-sleeved]] [[shirt]] with a [[white sailor collar]], a [[red neckerchief]], and a [[long skirt]]. In her debut appearance, she has [[twin braids]], [[white socks]], and [[purple shoes|purple]] [[loafers]].

She later returns as the deuteragonist of [[Danganronpa Another Episode: Ultra Despair Girls]], accompanying protagonist [[Naegi Komaru]]. Compared to her initial design, her appearance in this game is noticeably more disheveled. Her [[torn skirt|skirt]], [[torn neckerchief|neckerchief]], and left [[torn sleeve|sleeve]] are all [[torn]], and her hair (which is now [[hair down|worn down]]) is [[messy hair|messy]]. She also has an [[ahoge]], several [[hairclip]]s, [[purple thighhighs]], and [[mary janes|Mary Jane]] [[high heels|heels]].

Known for saying [[nipa~]], which has become a [[meme]].

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the [i]Casablanca[/i]-class escort carrier USS [i]Gambier Bay[/i] (CVE-73). Character design by [[Akira (Kadokawa)|]], voiced by [[Uchida Shuu]].

She has [[blue eyes]], [[blonde hair]] and [[large breasts]]. Her hair is worn in large fluffy [[twintails]] that reach down to her shoulders. She wears a [[hairband]] in Measure 32 camo with radar antennae to one side. Her clothing consists of a [[blue_shirt|blue]] [[collared shirt]] with [[breast pocket]]s, alongside a [[belt]] and [[shorts]] in Measure 32 camouflage. She also wears [[gloves]] with a white top and black underside, as well as [[white thighhighs]]. The one on her left leg bears her hull number, which is also found on her [[flight deck]].

She has a rather timid personality, generally sounding very meek and self-doubting due to her history, not helped by the common nickname for CVEs being "Combustible, Vulnerable, Expendable" due to their poor overall protection. Because of this, she often has a [[wavy mouth]] and looks as if she's on the verge of [[crying]]. She is also extremely fearful of her Japanese counterparts, especially capital ships, constantly worrying that they may fire upon her at any moment. She's often depicted as a [[lost child]] due to her [[Gambier Bay (Sasebo) (Kancolle)|Sasebo]] outfit; see "Lost Gambier Bay":[/pools/13799].

The historical [i]Gambier Bay[/i] was sunk in the Battle of Samar during the Battle of Leyte Gulf after taking gunfire from [i][[Chikuma (Kancolle)|]][/i], with [i][[Yamato (Kancolle)|]][/i] finishing her off. She was the only American aircraft carrier sunk by enemy surface gunfire during World War II, and also the [i]Yamato[/i]'s only confirmed kill.

Her abyssal form is assumed to be the [[Escort Water Princess]].

payload.body:
The Imperial Russia/Soviet Union battleship Gangut (Cyrillic: Гангут) in [[Kantai Collection]] and the first native Russian shipgirl in the game. (While [[Verniy (kancolle)|]] is the first shipgirl from the Soviet Fleet, her origin isn't Russian as she was seized as a war trophy by the Soviet Union from Japan after WWII). She is named for the "Battle of Gangut":https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_Gangut in 1714.

Her real life counterpart was launched in 1911 - one year before [[Kongou (kancolle)|]] launched. This made Gangut the oldest ship in the game upon her inclusion, later to be eclipsed by [[conte di cavour (kancolle)|Cavour]]. She was completed in 1915 and served with the Baltic Fleet during [[World War I]], though she saw only limited action. Her crew mutinied with the rest of the Baltic Fleet in the February Revolution of 1917.

Her appearance is somewhat similar to Hibiki (they share the same artist). Gangut has [[long hair|long]] [[grey hair]] and [[red eyes|red]]/[[orange eyes]]. In her basic form she wears a [[white jacket]] with [[belt]] over a [[red shirt]], [[black skirt]] and [[black pantyhose]]. She also wears [[black gloves]], [[black footwear|black]] [[boots]] and a [[peaked cap]] with [b]a white crown and black visor[/b]. In her [[gangut dva (kancolle)|dva]] (Cyrillic: два, meaning "two") form, she wears her [[jacket on shoulders|jacket on her shoulders]], revealing her [[short sleeves|short-sleeved]] red shirt and an [b] all black peaked cap[/b].

A noticeable trait shared with all her forms is a [[scar on cheek|scar under her left eye]] after being struck by a [[he 111|Heinkel He 111]] from Kampfgeschwader 4 (KG 4).

She is voiced by Seto Asami [瀬戸 麻沙美].

h4. See also

* [[Oktyabrskaya Revolyutsiya (Kancolle)|]]

She is also known to [[eating flower|eat flowers]], specifically the [[qingxin flower]], since it is her favorite food.

A franchise of anthropomorphic frogs found in merchandise marketed to children in the [[ToAru Majutsu no Index]] universe. [[Misaka Mikoto]] is a huge fan of the franchise, which - much to her consternation - gets her labeled as childish. Other Gekota fans (gekoers / ゲコラー) include [[Hokaze Junko]] and [[Iizumi Rita]].

h4. Characters

* [[Gekota (character)]]. He is colored in green, has a [[black facial hair|black]] [[mustache]] and wears a [[black suit]]. He is an old man type of character who is known to suffer from motion sickness easily. Because he has a habit of saying geko-geko (ゲコ, ゲコ), the name stuck and he's been referred to as such ever since.

Gertrud Barkhorn (ゲルトルート・バルクホルン, Gerutorūto Barukuhorun?) is a witch of the [[501st Joint Fighter Wing]], originating from [[Karlsland]]. Some call her by the pet name of Trude (トゥルーデ, Turūde). Her familiar is the German Shorthair Pointer.

A calm, cool and collected realist, Gertrud always tries to conduct herself in a rational manner. But since deep down she is a hot-blooded person, there are also times when her emotions get too worked up and she loses sight of her surroundings. She believes that a military member should abide by discipline and rules, but still doesn't seem to try to impose that much on anyone other than Flying Officer [[Erica Hartmann|Hartmann]].

Gertrud's inherent magic is called Superhuman Strength <Super Physical Strengthening> (怪力 <超身体強化>, Kairiki <Chō-shintai Kyōka>) Classified in telekinesis-lineage, it far exceeds the Body Strengthening (肉体強化, Nikutai Kyōka) - one of the basic abilities of a Witch - in capacity and sustainability.

She is based on "Gerhard Barkhorn":http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gerhard_Barkhorn; like Gertrud, he was the #2 ranked flying ace of World War II.

payload.body:
Solid body [[electric guitar]] manufactured by [[gibson_brands_inc|Gibson]] since 1952, designed with input by famed jazz guitarist Les Paul whose name ended up as the name of the [[guitar]] itself, work and prototypes commenced in 1950, with 1951 prototypes being strikingly similar to the final product until its introduction in 1952. The Les Paul eventually caught big success in a seemingly endless array of genres, pinning it as one of the most well known and popular guitars along with its contemporaries, the [[Fender Telecaster]] and [[Fender Stratocaster]]. It's similarly been used by musicians far and wide, including [[Slash (Musician)|Slash]], Joe Perry and James Dean Bradfield among others.

The Les Paul also holds a strong cult following in Japan. Within anime and manga, [[K-On!]]'s [[Hirasawa Yui]] is most associated with the Les Paul, using a Cherry Sunburst Les Paul Standard (now Traditional). Other prominent characters include [[iDOLMASTER Million Live!]]'s [[Julia (Idolmaster)|Julia]] using a TV Yellow Les Paul Special, [[Bang Dream!]]'s [[Mitake Ran]] with a red Les Paul copy, and [[Bocchi The Rock!]]'s [[Gotoh Hitori]] with a black Les Paul custom.

Original Les Pauls were released with goldtop finishes, P90 ("soapbar") pickups and either stopbars or tailpieces. Prominent Gibson versions of the Les Paul include:
* Standard, most famous example in anime being Hirasawa Yui's model.
* Junior/Special, lighter glossier model with soapbar pickups with the Junior only sporting a single pickup, most commonly seen being used by iDOLMASTER's Julia.
* DC/DC Lite, a double-cutaway version, famously used in Japan by [[B'z]] guitarist [[Matsumoto Takahiro (B'z)|Matsumoto Takahiro]]. (post #2361213)
* Custom, featuring gold hardware, most commonly seen in either black or white. (post #1867738)

payload.body:
[[Fate (series)|]] character who appears in [[Fate/zero]], [[Fate/stay night]], [[Fate/strange Fake]], and [[Fate/Grand Order]]. 

The heroic spirit of the legendary Sumerian king. Identifying as a demigod and the 'King of Heroes,' he possesses the appearance of a [[blonde hair|blonde]], [[red eyes|red-eyed]] man in [[gold armor|golden]] [[armor]]. Some appearances depict him without his armor, revealing his [[toned]] body.

He is originally summoned by [[Tohsaka Tokiomi]] during the Fuyuki Grail Wars in [[Fate/Zero]]. Following his death, he formed a contract with [[Kotomine Kirei]], who helped him take measures allowing him to survive into the Fifth Grail War in [[Fate/stay night]]. While the Fuyuki Grail summons him into the Archer class, his existence in [[Fate/extra CCC]] is unable to be constrained by class.

In [[Fate/hollow ataraxia]], he takes a magic potion to become a younger version of himself, known as [[Child Gilgamesh (fate)|]], while in [[Fate/strange Fake]], he is the "False" Archer-class Servant of [[Tine Chelc]].

In [[Fate/Grand Order]], he becomes an ally and playable Servant as the Wise King of Uruk under the [[Gilgamesh (Caster) (Fate)|]] designation. His Archer self also appears in some story chapters and is a summonable limited Servant as well.

Notable for his arrogant and narcissistic personality, with him calling almost any other non-Sumerians or gods as "mongrel" (雑種 - [i]zasshu[/i]). He is enamored by [[Saber (fate)|]] for her beauty and noble spirit, her continual refusal of him only compounding his obsessive desire.

[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Swedish seaplane cruiser HSwMS [i]Gotland[/i]. Designed by [[drew (drew213g)|Drew]].

She has [[long_hair|long]] grayish [[blue hair]] tied into a [[single hair bun]] and a [[mole under eye|mole under her left eye]]. She wears a [[military uniform]] consisting of an overcoat, a shirt with a [[blue sailor collar]] and [[black neckerchief]], and a [[blue skirt]] with yellow stripe (the colors of the [[Swedish flag]]). Completing the outfit are [[half gloves|short]] [[white gloves]], a [[dirk]] in a [[thigh strap]], mid-shin [[socks]] and [[rudder footwear]]. Her rigging includes a [[smokestack]], a single [[ship turret]] at her right side and a short landing pad for seaplanes at her left. 

Being the only Swedish shipgirl, she is often portrayed with distinctive Swedish things ([[surstromming|surströmming]] for example). She is also associated with [[sheep]]. This is probably due to her namesake island's coat of arms depicting a ram. Due to her unusually friendly and casual attitude with the [[Admiral (Kancolle)|]], she is often portrayed as "manipulating them and the shipgirls to think she was there since the beginning":[/pools/14729]. This personality trait likely stems from the fact that Swedes are generally very casual with others, even those of a higher rank or standing, in contrast to the more formal Japanese.

The historical [i]Gotland[/i] did not see any active combat during [[World War II]] due to Sweden's official stance of neutrality. She became known for spotting [[Bismarck (kancolle)|]] as the latter broke out of the Baltic Sea, leading to the "final battle of Bismarck":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Last_battle_of_the_battleship_Bismarck]. [i]Gotland[/i] survived the war and was scrapped in 1963.

[[Fate (series)|Fate series]] character. One of the main characters in [[Lord El-Melloi II Case Files]]. In [[Fate/Grand Order]], she is summonable as a Assassin-class Servant.

She is an assistant of [[Lord El-Melloi II]] at the Mage's Association's Clock Tower. She first met Lord El-Melloi II when he arrived in her hometown. She became his apprentice, and was admitted to the Clock Tower of London.

She has a striking resemblance to [[Saber (fate)|]], which Lord El-Melloi II believes is because she's a distant descendant of King Arthur. Her face brings unpleasant memories of the Fourth Holy Grail War for him, so he tells her to wear a hood to hide her face.

Gray has possession of the Noble Phantasm [[Rhongomyniad (fate)|]], the holy lance of King Arthur, that has been passed down through the generations by preserving its mystery through a similar manner to the Tradition Carrier trait held by the Fraga family.

Gray also possess a unique Mystic Code called [[Add (fate)|]].

She is about 15 years old in the events of Adra Castle Case. She is 18 during [[The Adventures Of Lord El-Melloi II]] but looks the same, as she stopped aging after Saber was summoned again in 2004. In [[Fate/strange fake]], she appears in her early twenties. In [[Fate/Grand Order]], she's introduced as an Assassin-class Servant in the [i]Case Files[/i] collaboration event.

Only his love for [[Casca (berserk)|]] keeps him from going completely insane and becoming a creature of rage and hatred.

Guts's primary weapon in his one-man war against the God Hand is a massive [[sword]] known as the [[Dragonslayer (sword)|]], though he's also been known to employ a repeating crossbow, a set of throwing knives, a set of bombs, and a powerful gunpowder cannon built into the prosthesis that replaces the left hand that he lost during the Eclipse. In the anime, his shirt has a smaller number of rivets in an x-cross shape.

His [[Stand (jojo)|]] is [[Ball Breaker (stand)|]].

payload.body:
A [[submachine gun]] first manufactured by German arms company [[Heckler & Koch]] in 1999. Its name, [i]Universale Maschinenpistole[/i], means "Universal Machine Pistol".

A slab-sided weapon, lighter but bulkier in comparison to the [[H&K MP5]] it was designed to supplant, the UMP is equipped with Picatinny accessory rails, a skeletonized folding buttstock, and is available in three calibers: 9mm (H&K UMP9, distinguishable by its curved box magazine), .40 S&W (H&K UMP40), and .45 ACP (H&K UMP45). Both the UMP and MP5 remain in production.

h4. See also

* [[Heckler & Koch]]

The "Wonderful Shrine Maiden of Paradise" and main character of the [[Touhou]] series.

An easygoing but dutiful [[nontraditional miko|miko]] and good friend to fellow protagonist [[Kirisame Marisa]]; her cool, detached facade belies a sympathetic personality which often wins her the friendship of her former enemies, such as [[Remilia Scarlet]]. Reimu takes care of the rundown [[Hakurei Shrine]], which lay near [[Gensokyo]]'s border with the outside world and acts as its main portal, and fights using her [[gohei]], [[ofuda]], and her family heirloom, [[yin yang orb]]s.

Famous for her laid-back disposition and exposed [[armpits]], as well as the first subject (together with Marisa) of a notorious [[2channel]] meme - "[[Yukkuri shiteitte ne|]]!!!".

Her hair color is usually [[brown hair|brown]] or [[black hair|black]] of nearly every length and her eye colors varies between [[red eyes|red]], [[black eyes|black]], or [[brown eyes|brown]]. Her signature accessories are her [[frilled bow|frilled]] [[red bow|red]] [[hair bow]], her [[frilled hair tubes]] on her [[sidelocks]], and her [[yellow ascot]]. Her outfit is a [[sleeveless shirt|sleeveless]] [[red shirt]] (that is sometimes depicted either as [[crop top|cropped]] or otherwise baring [[midriff]] or having a [[white shirt|white]] [[undershirt]]) with a [[frilled shirt collar|frilled collar]], [[detached sleeves|detached]] [[white sleeves]] with a [[ribbon-trimmed sleeves|ribbon trim]], a [[skirt set|matching]] [[frilled skirt|frilled]] [[red skirt]], [[white socks]], and either [[brown shoes|brown]] [[loafers]] or [[black shoes|black]] [[mary janes]].

payload.body:
The primary [[shrine]] of [[Gensokyo]] in [[Touhou]] and the personal residence of [[Hakurei Reimu]].

The Hakurei Shrine sits on the border between [[Gensokyo]] and the rest of Earth proper, existing on both sides as the anchor of the Great Hakurei Barrier and accessible from either side, though the Earth-side version is said to appear old and abandoned. Outside world items appear on the grounds from time to time, but no one knows how to consciously cross from one side to the other save for [[Yakumo Yukari]] and Reimu, the latter of whom will send outsiders home if asked.

[[Ibaraki Kasen]], [[Ibuki Suika]], [[Yakumo Yukari]], and Reimu's best friend [[Kirisame Marisa]] are frequent guests. The old turtle spirit [[Genjii (touhou)|]] and the Three Fairies of Light ([[Sunny Milk]], [[Luna Child]], and [[Star Sapphire]]) live in a spring and a tree behind the shrine, respectively. [[Mima (touhou)|]] once haunted the grounds, but has been absent from the games since the PC98 era and is only assumed to still be present. The inchling princess [[Sukuna Shinmyoumaru]] also lived at the shrine in a converted birdcage for a period of time. [[Clownpiece]] has taken up residence in the basement since the events of [[Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom]]. Since becoming animate, [[Komano Aunn]] has taken it upon herself to be the shrine's guard dog. And others ([[Hinanawi Tenshi]], [[Yorigami Shion]], etc) have also taken up temporary residence over the years. The patron god of Hakurei Shrine is unknown, even to Reimu, though theories include Yukari, Mima, and [[Dragon God (Touhou)| the Great Dragon]].

A character in the [[Street Fighter]] series, a brutal South Korean [[Taekwondo]] martial artist who derives pleasure from inflicting pain on others. She made her debut in [[street fighter iv (series)|Super Street Fighter IV]]. 

She is described as being an "evil, mean and nasty" member of S.I.N. who is a main character in the SFIV storyline. The character was created by request of many Korean fans who wished for [[Capcom]] to add a Korean character in Street Fighter, something already established by [[SNK]] and [[Namco]]. 

She is depicted as being overtly [[sadism|sadistic]] and often makes denigrating and [[sexually suggestive]] remarks toward her opponents. According to [[Menat]], this cruel demeanor is simply a facade to hide her emotional pain and suffering as a result of her traumatic experience after her parents were killed by [[M. Bison]], who blinded her left eye, along with her mistreatment after she was captured as a test subject by Shadaloo and S.I.N.

Her left eye was replaced with a "Feng Shui engine," a device capable of enhancing one's power with ki energy, which she typically covers with her [[eyepatch]] or [[diagonal bangs]]. Normally, she has [[purple eyes]], but they may appear as [[heterochromia|heterochromatic]] when she uses the Feng Shui engine in her left eye, causing it to become [[blue eyes|blue]].

In 4, her default attire consists of a purple [[dudou]], [[white pants|white]] [[baggy pants]], [[fingerless gloves]], [[foot wraps]] and she has [[pink nails]]. In [[Street Fighter v|V]], she is seen wearing a purple [[catsuit]] with fingerless gloves, and an [[eyepatch]]. In [[Street Fighter 6|6]], she wears an [[crop top|cropped]] [[white shirt|white]] [[open shirt|open]] [[cropped shirt|shirt]], [[black pants|black]] baggy pants with [[pink trim|pink]] and [[aqua trim|aqua trims]] that has a [[crotch cutout]] that reveals [[white leggings]] underneath. payload.body:
A traditional Japanese custom of sitting among newly bloomed [[cherry_blossoms|cherry]] or [[plum_blossoms|plum]] [[tree]]s in the early [[spring (season)|]] (ranging from late March through late April from the south to north of Japan's main islands, and in January in Okinawa). It is often accompanied by [[picnic|picnicking]], [[drinking]], and other activities. 

The appeal of viewing tree blossoms itself is found in the very brief period of flowering, which lasts seldom over a week before the petals have all fallen, and the leaves of their trees begin to sprout. This is considered a symbolic motif representing the beauty and impermanence of life. Owing to the cultural significance of the practice, Japan's national weather service keeps an annual forecast to inform the public as to when cherry trees are predicted to blossom. 

Viewing plum blossoms (ume) is an older practice which started in the Nara period, and was eclipsed during the [[Heian]] period by the popularity of viewing cherry blossoms. Many older Japanese today prefer ume viewing (sometimes known as 梅見, [i]umemi[/i]), as they find that sakura viewing parties may be too crowded and raucous.

She has [[long hair|long]] [[brown hair]] divided into [[low twintails]] by two [[red scrunchie|red]] [[hair scrunchie|hair scrunchies]]. payload.body:
The second remodel of [i][[Kantai Collection]][/i]'s [[Haruna (kancolle)|]]. 

She gains the distinctive radar wing [[headband]] that characterizes the class kai ni aesthetic, but otherwise retains her outfit. Unique to her Kai Ni, Haruna has [[anti-aircraft gun]]s attached to her boots and her main guns are painted with dazzle [[camouflage]] stripes, a reference to her real-life black-white striped camouflage when she was moored in Kure after the battle of Leyte Gulf.

After her second remodel was revealed, artists began to draw Haruna with panties striped like her dazzle camouflage. Interestingly enough, her canon panties does actually feature vertical [[striped panties|black-white stripes]]. In 2023, she gained her Kai Ni C forms which give her additional anti-air (or alternately, torpedoes).

Her default outfit, the class uniform, is composed of a [[white shirt]] with a [[black sailor collar]], [[yellow neckerchief]], [[grey corset]] patterned off her real-life bow, two-tone [[white gloves|white]]-[[black gloves]], [[black bodysuit]], [[black skirt|black]] [[pleated skirt|pleated]] [[miniskirt]], [[black pantyhose]], and knee-length [[rudder footwear]].

Her [[rigging]] consists of 61 cm quad [[torpedo tubes]] to her back, 25 mm [[anti-aircraft gun]]s on platforms, and two hull pieces with sentient 10 cm [[anti-aircraft gun|dual-purpose]] guns named [[Chou-10cm-hou-chan (hatsuzuki's)|]]. 

Hatsuzuki is a "bokukko", and refers to herself with the "typically young boy" pronoun of "boku". She has a stoic, serious, and taciturn personality, similar in some respects to [[Kaga (kancolle)|Kaga]], however she has a far more selfless and humble personality. This is likely due to all her service escorting, and her final mission in Leyte Gulf ending in a "last stand" sacrifice so the survivors of [i]Zuikaku[/i] could escape.

She speaks like a stereotypical Japanese regretful or vengeful ghost (particularly [[Yamamura Sadako|Sadako]] from [[The Ring]], whom she resembles) including lines that make her sound obsessive and creepy. She is portrayed as perpetually mournful of her real ship's fate, and her inability to change that fate. Because of her lines, particularly her secretary line "Just like this, I'm always watching. Watching... Always... Forever", she is stereotyped as an obsessive stalker.

Her name means "quick absorption", but read literally it can be interpreted as "fast sucking", a source of many [[sexually suggestive|suggestive]] jokes.

[[Touhou]] character.

Based on the Greek goddess [[Hecate (mythology)|]], Hecatia is a goddess who governs the Hells of the Earth, Moons and Otherworlds.  Like [[Junko (Touhou)|]], she also has a grudge against Chang'e, whose husband shot down Apollo and indirectly weakened Hell, as Hell wouldn't be able to exist without the sun. She's friends with Junko, and lent her [[Clownpiece]], her subordinate, to fulfill her plans.

She has [[red hair]], [[red eyes]] and wears a [[black shirt|black]] [[off-shoulder shirt|off-shoulder]] [[t-shirt]] (that is sometimes [[adapted costume|depicted]] as a [[crop top]]) along with a [[multicolored skirt|tri-colored]] [[plaid skirt]] of [[green skirt|green]], [[red skirt|red]], and [[blue skirt|blue]], and a [[black hat]]. She also carries ornaments of [[Moon (ornament)| the moon]], [[Earth (ornament)| the Earth]], and [[underworld (ornament)|the Spirit World]] with her, representing her ability to exist in 3 locations at once. Her hair and eye color change according to the ornament she wears in her hat: red when it's the Spirit World, [[blue hair|blue]] when it's [[Hecatia Lapislazuli (Earth)|Earth]], and [[blonde hair|blonde]] when it's the [[Hecatia Lapislazuli (Moon)|moon]], although it's not uncommon to see her with "other objects on her head.":/pools/10382

payload.body:
The "Memory of [[Gensokyo]]".

Resident historian of the [[Touhou]] series and ninth (and current) incarnation of the "Child of Miare", possessing a photographic memory as well as the ability to recall memories from her previous incarnations ([[hieda no aichi|Aichi]], [[hieda no ani|Ani]], [[hieda no ami|Ami]], [[hieda no ayo|Ayo]], [[hieda no ago|Ago]], [[hieda no amu|Amu]], [[hieda no anana|Anana]] and [[hieda no aya|Aya]]). In-universe author of [i]Perfect Memento in Strict Sense[/i] and [i]Symposium of Post-Mysticism[/i], encyclical works on the various faces, places, and dates in Gensokyo. Also writes mystery fiction under the pen name [[Agatha Chris Q outfit (touhou)|Agatha Chris Q]]. Her original, "zeroth" incarnation was the author [[Hieda no Are]], writer of the Kojiki.

After it was revealed that all Children of Miare generally live for around 30 years in [i]Strange Creators of Outer World[/i], some fans began to count the days until Akyuu's 30th birthday, which would be, according to [i]Perfect Memento[/i], around August/September 2024 (earliest August 7, latest September 6). However, ZUN has confirmed that Akyuu wouldn't die, and that the other characters wouldn't grow old, as the series runs on '[[Sazae-san]] time', a floating timeline (commonly called "Comic Book Time" in the west due to its heavy use in that media). This didn't stop fans from awaiting the day. Around August 7th, 2024, fans "across":[https://twitter.com/richard_effendi/status/1821886649661321351] the world began discussing the death of Hieda no Akyuu.

h4. Appearance

* !post #6906325

* "Touhou Wiki: Hieda no Akyuu":http://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Hieda_no_Akyuu

Her "{{pool:13812|Hiei Curry}}" featured in her hourlies, whether it is good or [[bad food|bad]] (usually the latter), is infamous for making the admiral run away for several hours.
