An enemy group from [[Genshin Impact]]. Hilichurls are a [[goblin]]-like family of [[monster]]s that are one of the first enemies encountered in-game. 

Regardless of their growth stage, all Hilichurls have a fluffy [[mane]] with two long ears and always wear a [[loincloth]] and a [[mask]] to hide their face. Hilichurls that are afflicted with an element will take on that element's color. As a Hilichurl grows and survives, they eventually turn into [[Mitachurl (genshin impact)|]]s. Mitachurls that continue to grow and absorb elemental energy will turn into [[Lawachurl (genshin impact)|]]s.

Most Hilichurls live in tribes which are usually led by [[Samachurl (genshin impact)|]]s, although many are also affilliated with the Abyss Order as they are easily manipulated by [[Abyss Mage (genshin impact)|]]s. Hilichurls are quite intelligent, as they can use tools and [[Slime (genshin impact)|]]s, raise livestock and even communicate through their own language, Hilichurlian.

payload.body:
The "Girl of the Highest Heaven". Final boss of [[Touhou]]'s [[Scarlet Weather Rhapsody]] and later a recurring playable character.

A spoiled formerly-human celestial with the ability to manipulate land and weather, motivated by boredom to cause chaos. Her official profile states that she was called Chiko (地子) at the time when she was human, and thus used to refer to her younger-self in fanworks.

She carries a weapon called the [[Sword of Hisou]], a tool which can be only used by celestials. She is frequently seen with her [[kaname-ishi]]s, a kind of [[floating rock]] with a [[shimenawa]] and [[shide]].

Her notable nickname is "Tenko" (てんこ; an alternate reading of her name). Many fans portray her as a [[masochism|masochist]], based on her dialogue in SWR demanding "punishment for her deeds" (though in canon this is due to her wanting a good fight), often landing her on the receiving end of other girls' wrath, especially the [[sadism|sadistic]] [[Kazami Yuuka]].

She has [[long hair|long]] [[blue hair]] and [[red eyes]] and usually [[flat chest|doesn't have a large chest]]. Her [[hat]] is [[black hat|black]] with a [[peach hat ornament|peach]] and a [[leaf hat ornament|leaf]] on it. She wears a [[buttons|buttoned]] [[collared shirt|collared]] [[white shirt]] with [[center frills]] and [[puffy short sleeves]] and a [[red bowtie]] with a [[frilled skirt|frilled]] [[blue skirt]]. Sometimes she is drawn with a [[frilled apron|frilled]] [[white apron|white]] [[waist apron]] decorated with a [[rainbow gradient]] rope, and [[brown footwear|brown]] [[cross-laced footwear|cross-laced]] [[boots]].

payload.body:
A [[Touken Ranbu]] character.

A [[wakizashi]] converted from a [[naginata]], and one of the many Toushirou brothers. Like [[Namazuo Toushirou]], he suffers from memory loss due to a fire (in Honebami's case, he was burned in the Great Fire of Meireki in 1657), but he has lost far more of his memories and is much more quiet and withdrawn than Namazuo is. He dislikes being touched and is not fond of interacting with any of the swords other than Namazuo, though he is fond of horses.

He has [[white hair]] (with the usual superposition with grey and silver) and he has [[purple eyes]] like Namazuo. He wears the same [[military uniform]] as most of the other Awataguchi swords, along with a black [[necktie]], [[sode]], and [[white gloves]]. His [[Honebami Toushirou (Kiwame)|Kiwame]] form gives him [[high heels]] and more elaborate armor, and his hair has grown slightly longer in the front.

[i]Honebami[/i] (骨喰) means "bone-eater", and he is sometimes depicted with [[bone|bones]] or a [[skeleton]] as his [[object namesake]]. His armor in his Kiwame form becomes somewhat skeletal in appearance to reflect this.

After his Kiwame remodel, [spoiler]he finally regains his memories. Honebami learns that he was not burned like Ichigo and Namazuo at Osaka, and it was the pain of being left behind (which ultimately saved him) when many of his brothers were burned, coupled with the fires of Meireiki burning him that caused his amnesia. After returning, he's still troubled about his memories, but he's more friendlier with the Saniwa (also revealing he doesn't dislike being touched).[/spoiler]

Voiced by Suzuki Yuuto. Artist is [[tndkworks]].

payload.body:
Stage 3 mid-boss and boss of [[Touhou]]'s [[Embodiment of Scarlet Devil]], and later a recurring playable character.

A humanoid youkai (presumably resembling a Han Chinese). She works as the gatekeeper of the [[Scarlet Devil Mansion]] and specializes in Chinese martial arts. Unusually for a Touhou character, it is unclear what kind of youkai Meiling is, but many fans associate her with [[dragon]]s due to the [[star hat ornament|star]] on her [[green hat|green]] [[beret]], which bears the Chinese character for "dragon" (龍, [i]Long[/i]). Hong is also the name of a specific dragon from Chinese mythology, implying Meiling has some relation or actually is Hong, leading to frequent depictions [[Hong Meiling (dragon)|as a dragon]]. There are also occasional images that depict her [[Hong Meiling (panda)|as a panda]].

Fandom also often depicts Meiling as being lazy and ineffective at her job, and often being berated and/or [[knifed|punished]] for this by [[Izayoi Sakuya]]. In canon, however, her relationship with Sakuya is actually something closer to amicable co-workers, if not outright friendship, and she is generally very good at her job of repelling intruders, with the notable exception of [[Kirisame Marisa]], who everyone else at the mansion admits is impossible to keep out when she wants access to [[Voile]].

Sometimes known by her nickname "China" (中国, [i]Chuugoku[/i]), which originated on [[2channel]] during a debate about the proper reading of her name's kanji (some believed it to be the Japanese reading "Kurenai Misuzu", and it wasn't until later that [[ZUN]] revealed that the Chinese reading "Hong Meiling" is correct). Fans came to an agreement that her defining characteristic is being Chinese, and thus called her "China".

She has [[long hair|long]] [[orange hair|orange]] or [[red hair]] with [[twin braids]] tied in [[green bow|green]] or [[black bow|black]] [[hair bow|bows]] and [[blue eyes]]. She wears a [[green hat|green]] [[beret]], a [[black ribbon|black]] [[neck ribbon]], a [[green vest]] over a [[collared shirt|collared]] [[white shirt]] with [[puffy short sleeves]], a [[skirt set|matching]] [[green skirt]] [[pants under skirt|over]] [[white pants]], and [[black shoes|black]] [[flats]]. Some fanart has her wearing something closer to a [[tangzhuang]] or [[china dress]].

A [i][[Touken Ranbu]][/i] character, the personification of the historical [[wakizashi]] [i]Horikawa Kunihiro[/i]. 
Character design by [[shiramine (srmn09)|Shiramine]], voiced by [[Enoki Jun'ya]]. 

Both he and [[Izumi-no-Kami Kanesada]] are personifications of swords that belonged to [[Hijikata Toshizou (real life)|]]. He as a character is named after his swordsmith, as the sword he was based on went unnamed. After the Japanese surrendered in WWII, he was one of the 200,000 swords confiscated and dumped at sea. Only about 5600 were recovered, but his whereabouts were unknown and it is unlikely he's still around to this day. 

He has short [[black hair]] and [[blue eyes]]. He wears a blue [[double-breasted]] jacket with a red [[ribbon]], [[white pants]], and red [[stud earrings]]. In his Kiwame form, he wears a [[white scarf]], a black coat and black [[knee boots]]. For Internal Affairs, he wears a red [[track suit]].

She has [[long hair|long]] [[blonde hair]], [[grey eyes]], and [[large breasts]]. She wears a [[white shirt|white]] [[dress shirt]] with a [[black necktie]] under a [[black jacket|black]] [[bomber jacket]], a [[black belt]], a black [[pencil skirt]], [[black pantyhose]], and [[rudder footwear]]. Her damaged CG reveals that her dress shirt [[sleeveless shirt|does not have sleeves]].

Like [[Saratoga (Kancolle)|]] and [[Intrepid (Kancolle)|]], she carries a firearm to launch her planes, in her case a modified [[M1903 Springfield]] with a pair of "Quad 1.1 inch":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1.1-inch/75-caliber_gun] [[anti-aircraft gun]]s in place of the rear sight.

Due to the history of the real [i]Hornet[/i], through the [[Battle of Midway]] and the [[Battle of Santa Cruz]], she has a relationship with [[Akigumo (kancolle)|]], [[Makigumo (kancolle)|]], and [[Shoukaku (kancolle)|]]. payload.title: hospital

payload.body:
A type of uniformed clothing provided by hospitals for patients, also know as a patient gown. There're mainly two variants. The loose detachable robe for patients undergoing operations or examinations. The [[pajamas]]-like buttoned top-and-bottom set for hospitalized patients, often [[vertical stripes|vertically striped]]. Their designs are not very standardized, versions often vary in details. The most common colors are blue and white, pink is also somewhat common.

Patients can often be seen with an [[iv stand]] and an [[intravenous drip]].

Not to be confused with [[medical scrubs]], a type of medical gown for medical workers during operations.

Not to be confused with [[bathrobe]].

payload.body:
One of [[Alice Margatroid]]'s [[spell card]]s in [[Perfect Cherry Blossom]] and [[Immaterial and missing Power]].

Other than sharing the same sprite with [[Shanghai Doll]], the doll has no official artwork.

Varying means of differentiating Hourai from Shanghai in fan works include depicting her wearing a [[bonnet]] instead of a [[hair bow]], wearing a [[red dress]] instead of a [[maid]] outfit, and depicting her hanged (cf. [[spell card]] name "Hanged Hourai Dolls"). Some stick to the sprite and hold it that Hourai looks completely identical to Shanghai.

Just as with Shanghai, it is a possible interpretation that Hourai is a type or class of magical dolls rather than an individual doll.

Hourai has become a relatively popular supporting character (or artifact) in Touhou fan works, even though in-game they are indistinguishable from ordinary Shanghai dolls.

[[Fujiwara no Mokou]]'s spellcard "Hourai Doll" is completely unrelated.

payload.body:
The "Eternal Lunar Princess". Final boss of [[Touhou]]'s [[Imperishable Night]], imbued with the power of immortality.

The former [[princess]] of the Lunarians, banished to Earth for drinking the [[Hourai Elixir]], which gave her immortality. She has since settled in [[Eientei]], a mansion deep within a [[bamboo forest]] in [[Gensokyo]], where she came to love the humans she once detested and her new, easygoing life. Because of this, she is comically depicted in fanon as a [[NEET]] who is always dependent on her bodyguard and creator of the Hourai Elixir, [[Yagokoro Eirin]]. She is also the master of lunar rabbit [[Reisen Udongein Inaba]].

She shares a bitter rivalry with [[Fujiwara no Mokou]], daughter of one of her many spurned suitors. Both have since been killing each other for centuries, despite knowing that neither can permanently die.

She is based on [[Kaguya Hime]] from the Japanese legend [[Taketori Monogatari]] ([i]The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter[/i]).

Many of her attacks scale based on how low her HP is. As a result, comic fanart tends to depict her as [[masochism|masochistic]], or at the very least disliking healers.

In Chinese and Japanese, the two kanji that spell Hu Tao's name have the meaning of "walnut", but Hu is her family name while Tao is her given name. She is the only Liyue character with her family name displayed on the in-game character menu. Japanese fans sometimes accidentally (or deliberately) misspell her name as [i]Kurumi[/i], the Japanese word for "walnut"; however, her name is pronounced Hu Tao even in the Japanese version of the game.

payload.body: A [i][[Kemono Friends]][/i] character. She is one of many "Friends" in Japari Park. Part of [[penguins_performance_project_(kemono_friends)|Penguins Performance Project]] as "Hululu". She is typically presented as an airhead with a bottomless stomach, and is usually seen munching on a [[Japari Bun]] when idle. Hululu wears a black and white jacket patterned after a Humboldt penguin's speckled plumage, with sleeves ending in mittens as to evoke flippers. The earpieces of her headphones bear a pattern evoking the eyes of the actual penguin. As the bottom of her coat covers her lower half, she [[no_pants|appears to wear no bottoms]], though she may wear something similar to [[emperor_penguin_(kemono_friends)|Emperor Penguin]]'s leotard underneath. She has short black hair with some bangs being tipped pink; her center bangs feature two white spots. As her design bears numerous similarities to that of her bandmate [[Gentoo Penguin (Kemono Friends)|]] (Gean), the two are sometimes mixed up by taggers. While one should be conscious of artistic liberties and stylistic differences, some reliable distinguishing details to check for include: * hair length (Hululu has shoulder-length hair, Gean's extends past her ribcage) * default outfit (Gean has a ruffled skirt; Hululu doesn't wear one, and her lower half is covered by her long jacket. Additionally, Gean's jacket has a black collar with pull-cords; Hululu has a white collar with no cords.) * default headphones (Hululu's headband is obscured by her hair at the top; Gean's is fully visible. Additionally, the design on Hululu's earpiece makes a "ç" shape, where Gean's makes a fully-closed ring.) * bangs (Gean has red streaks (sometimes depicted as a red-pink) on the sides of her center bang, usually depicted from the middle to the tip. Hululu has light pink patches on the bangs flanking the top of her center bang; her center bang just has two white dots.) In 2021, a [[virtual YouTuber]] based on Hululu debuted under the franchise's [[Kemono Friends V Project|KemoV Project]] label as one of its founding members, alongside [[African Penguin (Kemono Friends)|African Penguin]]. This Humboldt Penguin is a soft-spoken and easygoing girl, generally preferring to hold chatting streams and play relaxed games such as [[Minecraft]]. A nostalgia-lover, familiar with retro music and media. h4. Appearance * !post #5991478 h4. See also * [[Grape-kun]] * [[Humboldt penguin]] h4. payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese submarine [i]I-13[/i]. Nicknamed "Hitomi". Character design by [[Shizuma Yoshinori]], voiced by [[Imamura Ayaka]]. 

She has [[short_hair|short]] [[black hair]] with a [[asymmetrical_hair|single long strand on her left side]], and [[brown_eyes|brown]] [[tsurime]] eyes. Her default (and only) outfit is a [[school swimsuit]] shared with her sister I-14: hers has her name emblazoned over her hip. Over this, she wears a serafuku-style [[white shirt]] with a center [[breast cutouts]] and [[white sailor collar]], [[brown neckerchief]], and [[partially fingerless gloves|partially fingerless]] [[black gloves]]. 

Her [[rigging]] consists of [[headphones]] with a [[hat]] patterned off her real-life bow, her real-life conning tower/hangar on her right arm, and red [[rudder footwear]]. 

She has a cripplingly [[shy]] personality that lacks any self-confidence, with her in-game lines broken by pauses as she struggles to continue speaking up, likely due to her ship's very short history. Her in-game lines also connect her firmly to her sister-ship, [[I-14 (Kancolle)|]], with Hitomi, somewhat like [[Zara (Kancolle)|]], being unable to rein in her younger sister.

The historical IJN [i]I-13[/i] had a severely short history, being commissioned only on December 16, 1944, and sunk by USS [i]Anzio[/i] on July 16, 1945 while en route to an operation. Her [[abyssal ship|abyssal form]] [[Abyssal Twin Princess (white)|]] is also presumed killed by the player in her final form and it references the real life I-13's fate.

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese submarine I-401, nicknamed "Shioi". Character design by [[Shibafu (glock23)|]], voiced by [[Ise Mariya]]. 

She has [[medium hair|medium-length]] [[brown hair]] tied to a [[ponytail]], [[brown eyes]], [[tan]] skin, and is [[barefoot]]. Her default outfit consists of a [[blue one-piece swimsuit|blue]] [[school swimsuit]] with a [[name tag]], [[white shirt|white]] [[sleeveless shirt|sleeveless]] [[side-tie shirt]] with an [[orange sailor collar]], and a [[hairclip]] patterned off her real-life fins. Her [[rigging]] consists of her torpedoes slung to her left side and her real-life conning tower, hangar, and [[aircraft catapult]] slung to her right. 

Her model is the Sen Toku-class aircraft-carrying submarine of the same name. The Sen Toku-class were once the largest submarines ever constructed and were originally meant for an attack on the Panama Canal. However, they were never used in any meaningful way as the few completed were only commissioned near the end of the war. The I-401 was sunk as a target off Pearl Harbor on May 31st 1946.

payload.body:
"The One-Armed, Horned Sennin"

Introduced in the official comic [i]東方茨歌仙 ([[Touhou]] Ibarakasen) ～ [[Wild and Horned Hermit]][/i], serialized in Chara☆Mel Febri. An enigmatic [[pink hair|pink haired]], [[red eyes|red-eyed]] (or [[pink eyes|pink]]) "pilgrim" with her right [[bandaged arm|arm]] wrapped in [[bandages]] whose search for the "Kappa Arm" led her into the Hakurei Shrine. It is soon revealed that [[amputee|there is no arm inside her bandages]], which are instead filled with a mysterious magical smoke. She wears a [[tabard]] with a [[red rose]], a [[short sleeves|short-sleeved]] [[white shirt]] and a [[green skirt]]. Her appetite for [[steamed bun]]s also has her frequently depicted with [[large breasts]] and/or [[eating]].

Due to the [[shackles|shackle]] on her left arm, her suspicious [[double bun]]s with [[bun cover]]s, and her title implying the existence of horns, there is rampant speculation among fans that Kasen is an [[oni]], specifically [[Ibaraki Douji_(mythology)|]], one of the Big Four. Some of Kasen's actions, such as her avoidance of [[Ibuki Suika]], also contribute to the speculation.

She is often accompanied by her pets: [[Koutei (touhou)|]] the dragon, [[Kume (touhou)|]] the giant eagle, [[Kanda (touhou)|]] the young eagle, [[Mukou (touhou)|]] the raijuu, and [[Houso (touhou)|]] the tiger.

Since both characters are hermits, Kasen is often associated with [[Kaku Seiga]], though usually on an antagonistic basis since Seiga is a "wicked hermit". 

[spoiler]Wild and Horned Hermit 35 revealed she is one of the Sages of [[Gensokyo]] alongside Yukari.[/spoiler]
[spoiler]Wild and Horned Hermit 49 would not only introduce her severed arm given semi-physical form, [[Ibaraki Douji's Arm]], but Kasen herself would become one with her arm and fully become an oni once more, revealing herself to be one of the Big Four, [[Ibaraki Douji (Touhou)|Ibaraki Douji]]. Also associated with [[Miyako Yoshika]] as the real Miyako No Yoshika wrote poems that Douji supposedly liked. [/spoiler]

Playable in Touhou 14.5 ~ Urban Legend in Limbo.

payload.body:
[b]Ibuki[/b] ([b]いぶき / 息吹[/b], born December 6) is a character in the [[Street Fighter]] series. She first appeared in [[Street Fighter III (series)|]] and is voiced by Yuri Amano in all three games. She made her return in the prequel to that game, [[street fighter iv (series)|Super Street Fighter IV]].

Ibuki lives in a village composed entirely of [[Ninja]]. She has been trained from childhood, but resents her lot in life.

In Super Street Fighter IV, she sneaks away from her clan's summer training camp to compete in S.I.N's tournament, in order to meet cool and handsome guys. When the tournament is over, she realizes that she is late for camp and attempts to sneak back in as if nothing had happened. However, she is caught by one of the camp's instructors.

Later in 2nd Impact, Ibuki was sent by her clan to procure documents from [[Gill (street fighter)|]]'s organization. These documents concerned the "G-File" project, which was responsible for creating Necro and Twelve. Gill voluntarily gave Ibuki the documents, though the project was already under way by that point.

In [[street fighter iii (series)|3rd Strike]], Ibuki tracks down [[Oro (street fighter)|]] to fight him for her ninja graduation exam. She fights well enough to pass, and moves on to go to a university. While there, she joins a club which, to her dismay, turns out to be based on ninja training.

She is always found [[drunk]]en, carrying a bottomless [[gourd]] of [[sake]], and is an avid lover of parties. She has the power to control the density of any given object. She is explicitly based on the oni king Shuten-douji.

She is friends with [[Yakumo Yukari]], [[Hoshiguma Yuugi]] (both were once part of the "Four Devas of the Mountains") and [[Hakurei Reimu]], whose shrine also serves as her sometimes home. She and [[Ibaraki Kasen]] appear to have a slightly strained relationship, given Kasen's breaking rank with the other Gensokyo Sages, but the two remain mostly friendly to each other.

Her hair color varies between [[blonde hair|blonde]], [[brown hair|brown]], or [[orange hair|orange]] but is almost always [[very long hair|very long]] and [[low-tied long hair|tied near the bottom]] with [[sidelocks]]. Her eyes also [[yellow eyes|vary]] [[brown eyes|between]] [[orange eyes|those]] colors or [[red eyes|red]]. She wears a [[red bow]] in her [[hair bow|hair]] and a [[purple bow]] [[horn bow|on]] [[brown horns]]. Her outfit is a [[sleeveless shirt|sleeveless]] [[white shirt]], a [[red bowtie]], a [[ribbon-trimmed skirt|ribbon-trimmed]] [[purple skirt]], [[white socks]], and [[black footwear|black]] [[shoes]]. payload.body:
A [[Touken Ranbu]] character, designed by [[Kanameyura]]. The personification of the [[tachi (weapon)|tachi]] "[i]Ichigo Hitofuri[/i]":http://meitou.info/index.php/一期一振. He is the older brother of the Awataguchi school swords, due to the fact that he was the only tachi ever forged by Awataguchi.

Originally named "Okatana Yoshimitsu" (御刀吉光), Ichigo Hitofuri once belonged to Toyotomi Hideyoshi. He ordered the blade to be shortened to match his rather short height. Ichigo Hitofuri was damaged in the summer of 1615 during the Siege of Osaka at Osaka Castle and then re-tempered by Yasutsugu under the order of Tokugawa Ieyasu. However, Ieyasu didn’t had the chance to use this sword because he was advised by the Priest Tenkai to avoid sending Hideyoshi’s swords (including Ichigo Hitofuri) to Edo. It has been an Imperial treasure since that time, alongside [[Tsurumaru Kuninaga]], [[Uguisumaru]] and [[Hirano Toushirou]].

He has [[short hair|short]] [[aqua hair]] and [[yellow eyes]]. He wears [[white gloves]] and a [[military uniform]] with [[necktie]].

Ichigo has a polite and humble personality and is shown to be concerned with his brothers' well-being. However, it seems that he keeps things to himself, such as the fact that he's worried about losing his identity (since he was retempered in the past) and is secretly displeased about the Saniwa having so many swords. 

Fans enjoy portraying him as the big brother of the Awataguchi tantous, due to him being the biggest/tallest blade among Yoshimitsu's creations, not because he's the oldest among them. Either that, or he's presented as a foil to the prankster Tsurumaru.

Because of his in-game elder brother status, many of the swords tend to call him "Ichi-nii" (Big brother Ichi), which extends to his nickname outside the game as well.

An [[iDOLMASTER Cinderella Girls|iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls]] character in the Cute category.

Shiki is a curious 18 y.o. girl who can be described only as "a mad scientist". She loves experiments, and is motivated by finding new things to hold her attention; if it's not interesting, she's not interested. Rather than being scouted by Producer, she chose him as part of one of her experiments. She sniffed the Producer and his smell convinced her that he was the right one for the experiment. She became an idol for this reason.

It's implied she uses pheromones to attract fans, and even in idol form, her hair looks messy and uncombed.

In the 11th Magic Hour SP, she revealed that she went to an American university before being an idol, but she got bored of it and returned to Japan. She attends a Japanese high school and lives on her own. She likes tabasco sauce and her forte is chemistry, but she dislikes wasabi and waking up early.

In the tie in Cinderella Girls Theater skits, Shiki is introduced by [[Yanagi Kiyora]]. Her sniffing habits show up as early as her first line and her “Nyahaha” laugh appeared soon after. She seems to be friends with [[Sagisawa Fumika]] and [[Jougasaki Mika]], who both also know of her nose. Her smelling often causes her to fall asleep and she highly regards the Producer’s jacket as a source of soothing smells. Shiki got a job as a background character in a Wild West film.

Due to her popularity, she was selected for the 8th set of CINDERELLA MASTER CD series, alongside [[Tachibana Arisu]], [[Shiomi Syuko]], [[Katagiri Sanae]], and [[Sakurai Momoka]]. She is voiced by [[Aihara Kotomi]].

payload.body:
An [[Idolmaster Cinderella Girls]] character in the Cute category.

Kyoko is a gentle teen who makes a perfect housewife. Her notably nice attitude is often considered to be her most notable trait. Kyoko is sweet and gentle, with the perk of being good at housework. Her hair is usually tied with a ribbon into a [[side ponytail]].

It has been shown in her "The Seven Mysteries of Sacred Slipper Academy" S Rare+, that she can look more menacing than she usually does. Fans say that Kyoko has the possibility of crossing into yandere territory, however it is more likely that she is taking the role seriously.

In the tie in Cinderella Girls Theater skits, Kyoko is a sweet girl who has a joyful disposition. She loves to clean and enjoys remembering her journey as an idol. Kyoko admits that she likes the Producer enough to marry him, and hopes to share an umbrella with him when she’s caught in the rain. Her kindheartedness is displayed when she delivers Christmas presents with her fellow idols to [[Sajo Yukimi]] and how she takes care of the Producer on their day off at the beach. She seems to have trouble drawing cats, as they tend to look more like rabbits, and loves to cook.

Due to her popularity, she was selected for the 9th set of CINDERELLA MASTER CD series, alongside [[Ninomiya Asuka]], [[Ohtsuki Yui]], [[Nakano Yuka]], and [[Aiba Yumi]]. She is voiced by [[Tanezaki Atsumi]].

She's part of [[Pink Check School (idolmaster)|]] with her friends [[Shimamura Uzuki]] and [[Kohinata Miho]].

h4. Appearance

* !post #1068258

payload.body:
The main character from the manga/anime [[Shinryaku! Ikamusume]]. Her name literally means "[[squid]] girl" in English.

The self-proclaimed "guardian of the sea". Ikamusume emerges from the ocean to "invade" the humanity, only to be subdued by [[Aizawa Chizuru]] and was forced to work inside the Aizawa family's seaside restraurant.

Like a [[squid]], she has an ability to control her [[tentacles]]-shaped hair for various purposes and is also capable of spraying [[ink]].

She is voiced by [[Kanemoto Hisako]] in Japanese and [[Christine Marie Cabanos]] in English.

Known for ending her sentences with [i]"de geso"[/i] or [i]"ika"[/i].

[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese destroyer [i]Ikazuchi[/i]. Character design by [[Yadokari (Migihashi)|]], voiced by [[Suzaki Aya]].

She has [[short_hair|short]] [[brown hair]] with a [[hairclip]]s on her left, [[brown eyes]], and a [[fang]]. Her default outfit is the Special-Type's [[serafuku]] ([[white shirt]], [[black sailor collar]], [[red neckerchief]], [[black skirt|black]] [[pleated skirt]], [[black thighhighs]]), but with the addition of a "III" pin unique to the [i]Akatsuki[/i]-class. The "III" is on the right side of her collar.

An excitable girl, she is often shown with her sister ship [[Inazuma (kancolle)|]]. The two are extremely similar in appearance; having been laid down on the same day they are depicted as [[twins]]. She is also often depicted as very doting to the [[Admiral (Kancolle)|]], many a times spoiling them beyond help (her Pixiv nicknames "Loli-Okan" and "Useless Admiral Maker" refer to this side of her). Sometimes depicted as being clingy, to the point of being [[yandere]], leading to the nickname "Black Thunder" among the fandom.

payload.body:
A character introduced in [[Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc]], titled the Ultimate Soldier (超高校級の「軍人」).

She is the [[twins|twin]] [[sisters|sister]] of [[Enoshima Junko]]. She has [[short hair|short]] [[black hair]], [[grey eyes]], [[freckles]], and a [[hand tattoo|tattoo]] on her right hand.

She does not have a singular "default" costume, instead wearing multiple outfits over the course of the series. She is initially introduced [[enoshima junko (cosplay)|disguised as Junko]], wearing a [[long hair|long]] [[blonde hair|blonde]] [[wig]] in [[twintails]]. Her outfit is mostly the same as Junko's, though she has different hair accessories (a [[rabbit hair ornament]] and [[hair bow]] instead of [[bear hair ornament]]s) and a different [[necktie]] ([[white necktie|white]] with [[polka dot necktie|polka dots]] instead of [[two-tone necktie|two-tone]] with a [[no symbol]]).

Some CGs and promotional material depict her in a [[Hope's Peak Academy school uniform]]. This outfit consists of a [[long sleeves|long-sleeved]] [[brown jacket]] over a [[white shirt|white]] [[collared shirt]], a [[black ribbon|black]] [[neck ribbon]], a [[brown skirt]], [[blue socks|blue]] [[kneehighs]], and [[brown shoes]]. Her character art for Trigger Happy Havoc depicts her wearing a [[long sleeves|long-sleeved]] [[white shirt]] under a [[tactical clothes|tactical]] [[vest]], as well as [[brown gloves]], a [[black skirt]], [[black socks|black]] [[kneehighs]], and [[black shoes]], though she does not wear this outfit in the game itself.

In [[Danganronpa/Zero]], she wears a different school uniform, consisting of a [[white shirt|white]] [[collared shirt]] with [[short sleeves]] and a [[breast pocket]], a [[red ribbon|red]] [[neck ribbon]] (sometimes drawn as [[black ribbon|black]]), a [[black skirt|black]] or [[grey skirt]], [[black socks|black]] [[kneehighs]], and [[black shoes]]. She wears a similar outfit in [[Danganronpa 3 (anime)|]]'s Despair Arc; compared to her outfit in Zero, her sleeves are slightly longer, her [[brown skirt|skirt]] and [[brown shoes|shoes]] are both brown, and she wears [[brown gloves]].

h4. Appearance

A character from [[Fate/Stay Night]]. She is voiced by [[Kadowaki Mai]], and her nickname is Illya.

A young German aristocrat competing in the 5th Holy Grail War. Due to her white-blonde hair and red eyes, she is often considered an albino by fans. Her Servant is Berserker [[Heracles (fate)|]].

She appears in [[Fate/Grand Order]] as an Alter Ego Servant [[Sitonai (fate)|]], as a composite of Sitonai, Freyja, and Louhi.

Another version of her is a fifth-grade [[magical girl]] in the spinoff [[Fate/Kaleid Liner Prisma Illya]], who also appears in Fate/Grand Order as a Caster-class Servant.

payload.body:
Posts containing references to the real life Imperial Japanese Army, such as depictions of historical events, [[military vehicle]]s, or [[soldier]]s with clear evidence of the colors or uniforms of Imperial [[Japan]].

h4. History
The Imperial Japanese Army (IJA) was the army of the Empire of Japan from 1871 to 1945. It was involved in several wars throughout the late 19th and early 20th century, including Russo-Japanese war, both Sino-Japanese wars, and [[World War II]].

The IJA became infamous throughout the world during 30s and 40s due to their countless war crimes and atrocities commited during the [[Second Sino-Japanese War]] and other conflicts in Asia (including but not limited to: cannibalism, large-scale rape, mass-murder, use of chemical and biological weapons, "forced human experimentation on captured civilians":https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unit_731 , guerillas, and murder and torture of prisoners of war) committed during this time period (especially during the rule of [[toujou_hideki|Hideki Tojo]].) With some even suggest them to be even worse than the [[Nazi]] Germany regime itself.

Following the Japanese surrender, the IJA was dissolved and during 1950s its role as Japan's military's land warfare branch was taken over by the [[Japan Ground Self-Defense Force]] which was modeled after the US Army.

h1. External links
* "Wikipedia: Imperial Japanese Army":https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imperial_Japanese_Army

A device in the setting of [[Arknights]].

Infection monitors are medical devices which keep track of an individual's oripathy infection, along with their general health and well-being. They are worn by many personnel at Rhodes Island, typically those already suffering from oripathy, but also some uninfected individuals, particularly those at high risk.  A variant called a suppressor has additional functions to help the infected control [[originium arts (arknights)|]] outbursts caused by the disease.

Monitors are manufactured by a number of different companies, but the ones produced by Rhodes Island are the most common, resembling black, solid bands with inlaid, X-shaped blue lights. In general they take the form of a personal accessory or piece of jewelry. They are usually but not always worn close to external [[oripathy lesion (arknights)|]]s when those are present.

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the US Navy battleship USS [i]Iowa[/i] (BB-61). Character design by [[Shizuma Yoshinori]], voiced by [[Hashimoto Chinami (voice Actor)|]].

She has [[long hair|long]] [[blonde hair]], grayish [[blue eyes]], and [[large breasts]] with visible [[cleavage]]. Her default outfit consists of a [[grey corset]] with her real-life hull number printed on it, [[blue shirt]] tied to the front, [[American flag print]] [[thighhighs]] (red vertical stripes for the right, blue for the left), [[black gloves|black]] [[fingerless gloves]] with [[white gloves|white]] [[elbow gloves]], two-tone grey-blue [[miniskirt]], [[black belt]] with the US Navy emblem, and [[rudder footwear|rudder]] [[knee boots]]. 

Her [[rigging]] consists of two hull pieces containing her three historic three 406 mm/16-inch triple mounts Mk7, one to her left and two to her right. She also carries three of her ten 127 mm twin mounts: one beside the starboard main guns, two to the back of the portside main gun. Her funnel carries searchlights on either side and has two Bofors 40 mm [[anti-aircraft gun]]s below the searchlights. Another Bofors quad mount is atop her third main battery turret, while the second turret has three Oerlikon 20mm mounts on its top. 

Much like [[Kongou (kancolle)|]], Iowa is loud, friendly and energetic. Also like Kongou, she uses English mixed in with her Japanese speech, but her English is so broken and accented many find it incomprehensible.

Her historical counterpart is currently docked in the Port of Los Angeles complex as a museum ship, making her the first ship to appear in the game which wasn't sunk, scuttled, scrapped, or expended as a target. She is also the first Allied ship implemented in the game.

payload.body:
A [[Pokemon]] character.

In the games, Iris is a young, nature-loving girl and Unova's eighth Gym Leader in [[Pokemon Black and White|Pokémon White]]. Her specialty is Dragon-types, and she is [[Drayden (pokemon)|]]'s apprentice. Her main Pokémon is [[Haxorus]]. She returns in [[pokemon black 2 and white 2|Pokémon Black 2 and White 2]] as the new Champion of the Unova region.

In the [[pokemon (anime)|anime]], she is also one of [[Ash Ketchum|Ash]]'s former companions. She has a [[Axew]] that lives in her hair. Like [[Misty (pokemon)|]], Iris is frequently critical of Ash's actions as a trainer, calling him childish. She aims to be a master of Dragon-type Pokémon, and must evolve her [[Axew]] into it's final stage, [[Haxorus]] to be considered one. She is also known for being the first naturally dark-skinned main character in the Pokémon series. She returns in [[pokemon journeys|Pokémon Journeys]] in her capacity as Champion of Unova, and battles Ash as he climbs the ranks of the World Coronation Series. [spoiler]Eventually, she joins Ash in the Masters Eight.[/spoilers]

A character from the video game series [[Samurai Spirits]].

originally from Samurai Shodown/Spirits VI, which was a non-canon dream-match game and became a very popular character, to the point that she almost got a game of her own.

She was added in the second wave of DLC fighters for the 2019 reboot, finally adding her to the universe as a proper canon character.

She is a crane who takes the form of a human Japanese [[maid]], and is known to be very loyal to her master. She fights with her two iconic butterfly swords.

payload.body:
"Seaside Wind"

Isokaze is the 12th ship of the Kagerou-class destroyers in [i][[Kantai Collection]][/i].

She has [[long hair|long]] [[black hair]] with red [[tress ribbon|tress ribbons]] and [[red eyes]]. Some art makes light on how she essentially looks like a black-haired [[murakumo (kancolle)|Murakumo]] and a pixiv tag is dedicated to how she looks like a tiny [[nagato (kancolle)|Nagato]].

She wears a [[long sleeves|long-sleeved]] white and blue [[serafuku]] with a yellow scarf on top of the standard Kagerou-class [[pleated skirt]], [[white gloves]] & [[uneven legwear|socks of different lengths]]. She [[dual wielding|dual wields]] two pistols, one based from a standard 12.7cm twin gun and another is a collection of AA guns. On her back is her rigging. Unlike her sisters, it was made into a style similar to some larger ships' split bow. On her right is the part corresponding to her sisters' rigging with an additional 12.7 gun and a quadruple torpedo launcher attached to it and to her left is a depth charge launcher with another torpedo launcher attached to it.

In her remodel, her scarf has been changed to a rope, her thighhigh gains a stripe, the Standard 12.7cm guns have been replaced by their High-Angle equivalent, a radar has been propped behind her head and finally, camo-textures are added to her uniform.

For her B remodel (which is [i]not[/i] an actual second remodel), she is essentially the same as in her remodel except for her use of long 10cm guns. While she is now significantly more powerful stats-wise, the portrait serves as an art refresher.

h4. Personality
Like Nagato, she has a straightforward and professional personality with great pride in her fighting abilities. Perhaps because of this, she prefers a frontal and aggressive approach in battle rather than to engage in defensive measures.

It is implied in her hourlies that she is the only one in her division with poor culinary skills. At 0700, she said that [[hamakaze (kancolle)|Hamakaze]] told her how to make breakfast for the admiral but it ended in failure. At 1200, Tanikaze made the rice balls they ate at that time. At 1800, she ends up cooking with Urakaze. At 2000, it is revealed Urakaze made custard while Isokaze made grilled fish. The next hourlie implies that Urakaze's dish was better than Isokaze's. This has been exaggerated to the point that, if she and [[hiei (kancolle)|Hiei]] are allowed to cook together, they will produce something that is multiplicatively worse than if the two are allowed to cook separately.

Due to her blunt personality, Isokaze is often depicted by fans as either being oblivious to her poor performance or simply being a narcisstic. Because of this, she is frequently depicted in ecchi/NSFW works as being more seasoned in sexual matters or simply viewing it as another form of competition. Alternatively, others have also depicted her in the more ladylike demeanour.

She is voiced by [[Kawasumi Ayako]], who also voices [[ooyodo (kancolle)|Ooyodo]], [[unryuu (kancolle)|Unryuu]], [[kamikaze (kancolle)|Kamikaze]] and the [[Midway Princess]]. Isokaze, in particular, shares a voice identical to [[Saber (fate)|]], who incidentally has much in common with her.

Isolated Island Oni is an enemy [[abyssal ship]] found in [[Kantai Collection]]. She was the boss of the fifth event map during the Spring 2014 event.

She is depicted with [[very long hair|very long]] [[black hair|black]] hair, [[glowing eyes|glowing]] [[red eyes]], [[small breasts]], two [[horns]], a [[bonnet]], and a frilled [[gothic lolita]] dress with detached sleeves. She also wears [[bodystocking]] and has two spikes protruding from her upper back like [[Airfield Princess]].

She's often portrayed as a [[hikikomori]] in fanart ([i]Isolated[/i] Island Oni). Her nickname amongst fans is "Ritou" (りとう) which is taken from the first two kanji in her name. Also, before [[Northern Ocean Princess]] was introduced, she was the youngest looking [[abyssal ship]], looking more like a 14-15 year old in comparison to the rest of the abyssal fleet whom look 18 and older. In fact because of this she originally had the Pixiv tag "敵艦隊のチャイドル ([i]Teki kantai no chaidoru[/i], lit. "Enemy fleet's child idol") before it was nearly taken over by [[Northern Ocean Princess]].

She is based on "Wake Island":https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_Wake_Island and is voiced by [[Ogura Yui]].

payload.body:
A [i][[Touken Ranbu]][/i] character, the personification of the historical [[katana|uchigatana]] [i]Izumi-no-Kami Kanesada[/i]. 
Character designed by [[Shiramine (srmn09)|]], voiced by [[Kimura Ryouhei]]. 

He was formerly classified by the game as a tachi until July 2015. Both he and [[Horikawa Kunihiro]] are personifications of swords that belonged to [[Hijikata Toshizou (real life)|]] of the [[Shinsengumi]]. He was asked to be made after the Shinsengumi started to become well known, and Hijikata thus sought after a swordsmith from the Kanesada school, requesting that his new sword be similar to his [[wakizashi]] (Horikawa). This is likely the reason why Izumi-no-kami and Horikawa have the same hair and eye color. He is still around today, located in the Hijikata Toshizou Museum in his hometown of Hino, [[Tokyo (city)|]].

h4. Appearance
[tn]See post #1934098 for base form.[/tn]

He has [[long hair|long]] [[black hair]] with part of it done in a [[side braid]], and [[blue eyes]]. He typically wears [[earrings]], [[Japanese clothes]], black [[fingerless gloves]], and a [[cape]] with the Shinsengumi's distinctive blue and white pattern. For his [[Izumi-no-kami Kanesada (Kiwame)|Kiwame]] form, he puts his hair up in a [[ponytail]] and wears a white [[headband]], a Shinsengumi [[haori]] and black [[knee boots]]. 

Despite looking like an adult, he is technically the youngest character in the game, being the most recently forged sword as he was made in 1867. Because of this, he often comes across as reckless and a bit overconfident, which is why Horikawa often has to assist him or reign him in. Much of his personality is also inspired by the real-life Hijikata.

A [[Kemono Friends]] character. She is one of many "Friends" in [[Japari Park]].

The [[crested_ibis|Japanese Crested Ibis]] or Toki ([i]Nipponia nippon[/i]) is a large bird with a mostly white plumage, a bare head, showing red skin and a crest of white feathers on the nape. The Japanese name for this bird ("Toki") is also used to refer to the Ibis group as a whole.

She has [[yellow eyes]] and [[long hair|long]], swept back [[white hair]] (resembling the bird's crest) which turns red at her [[sidelocks]] and [[head wings]], with [[blunt bangs]]. She wears a [[white jacket]] with red [[feather-trimmed sleeves]], a red [[pleated skirt]], [[red pantyhose]], and [[red gloves]].

As her species were bought back from the brink of extinction (and were thought for some time as being extinct), she exhibits [[empty_eyes|the lack of shine on the eyes]] usually reserved to extinct species.

She is best described as a [[bad singing|bad singer]] who likes to sing nonetheless. In the anime, she typically sings about where are her friends (her infamous "WATASHI WA TOOOKIIII" song) with a shrill voice that can stun most Friends (as poor [[Serval (kemono_friends)|]] can attest). A serving of [[Alpaca Suri (kemono_friends)|]]'s tea improves her voice to a certain extent (she can't stun anyone by singing).

She is often associated with another [[Toki (hokuto_no_ken)|]] (whom is also at the brink of death).

One of the central protagonists in [[JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken]] Part 3: [[Stardust Crusaders]]. Also appears in Part 5:: [[Vento Aureo]] as a supporting character. His [[stand_(jojo)|stand]] is the [[Silver chariot]].

He became the origin of two Japanese well-known [[meme]]s. If you find these memes in the image, use [[Jean Pierre Polnareff]] tag and [[meme]] tag.

1) "あ…ありのまま 今 起こった事を話すぜ!" ("[i]A...arinomama Ima Okotta Koto wo Hanasuze![/i]", "L-let me tell you straight fact about what happened now!").
When a very unimaginably mysterious thing happened, this meme and his [[ASCII ART]] are used.

[quote]"Before we go after him, I have something to say!
I have barely experienced [[dio_brando|Dio]]'s stand. N-no, I have experienced it, but I don't understand what it is....
L-let me tell you straight fact about what happened now!
'[b]I was trying to climb the stairs to get him but somehow I ended up lower than where I started.[/b]'
[i]Y-you guys think I don't know what I'm talking about. I don't know what's going on at all...[/i] This is driving me crazy...
It's not something like hypnosis or super fast speed. What I experienced was just the tip of the iceberg...."
[/quote]

2) "現実は非情である" ("[i]Genjitsu wa Hijou de Aru[/i]", "Reality is Cruel")
[quote]This is a real problem. I'm injured. How can I get away?

There are three options.
One, the handsome Polnareff figures out a way to counter the attack.
Two, my friends will save me.
Or three, reality is cruel and I die here.
[/quote]

payload.body:
Tag for the dark version of Jeanne d'Arc from [[Fate/Grand Order]]. Also called [b]Jalter[/b] for short by fans.

Unlike the other [[alter servant]]s, Jeanne Alter is a separate entity of the original Jeanne d'Arc. She was created by [[Gilles de Rais (caster) (fate)|Gilles de Rais]], who was so obsessed with Jeanne that he used a corrupted [[Holy Grail_(fate)|]] to "revive" her. As a result, she is a polar opposite of Jeanne, as she wished to destroy France rather than protect it, as she blamed the very existence of France as a cause of her "original" death.

She is often depicted as being [[tsundere]] in official and fan works, and being somewhat annoyed (though secretly admiring) that the original Jeanne treats her as a sister.

For her original Ruler variant, see [[Jeanne d'Arc (Fate)]].

For her Santa variant, see [[Jeanne d'Arc Alter Santa Lily (Fate)]].

[b]Jill Valentine[/b] is a Special Operations Agent (SOA) of the Bioterrorism Security Assessment Alliance, of which she is a co-founder and one of the original eleven members, making her a respected and high ranking operative of the organization. Prior to this, she was a member of S.T.A.R.S. Alpha team, Position RS (Rear Security). Before joining S.T.A.R.S., she was in the U.S. Army's Delta Force training program, where she earned extremely high grades in bomb disposal. She was brought into S.T.A.R.S. for her already well-developed fighting skills.

They frequently fulfill the niche of female "geek" and "nerd" characters: model students, bookworms, and [[otaku]]. In Japanese high school settings, if they are outgoing enough, they are a popular choice for class rep and the student council.

[[Glasses]], [[messy hair|messy]] or [[unkempt]] hair, [[thick eyebrows]], [[twintails]] or [[twin braids|braids]], [[freckles]] and [[bags under eyes|baggy eyes]] can all often complete the look.

payload.body:
A fashion subculture for "landmine-type" girls that originated in Japan's "Kabukichō":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kabukich%C5%8D] district and first spread in popularity in early 2020.

Fashion consists of two sides: 量産型 (ryousangata, literally "mass production") - a more mainstream girly style, and サブカル (subculture) - the more alternative and dark variant. Do note that the latter term is also used for alternative fashion in general.

Ryousangata tends to use a lot of pink with some black accents, and often uses frilly [[blouse]]s, [[suspender skirt]]s, [[choker]]s, heart decorations, [[bow]]s, [[platform shoes]], and [[ankle socks]].

Subculture jirai, on the other hand, leans towards darker color palettes such as black, grey, red, and white. [[layered clothes|Layered clothing]] is common, as are [[chain]]s, striped patterns, fishnets, [[leg warmers]], [[track jacket]]s, and [[boots]].

Both sides of the fashion use makeup that accentuates the [[aegyo sal]] and gives the face a "sickly-cute" appearance.

It is comprised of an elastic waistband attached to a pouch (typically foam), with thigh bands to properly secure it in place.

While it has been mostly used as a utilitarian accessory, foamless or patterned variations have been made to emphasize its appeal as a fashionable and sexual garment. For this reason, both sports and fashion types are popular among gay males.

A counterpart to the jockstrap, known as a pelvic protector or a "jill", is similarly structured to cover female genitals.

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the USS [I]Johnston[/i] (hull number DD-557), 75th of the US Navy's 175 Fletcher-class destroyers.

Compared to [[Samuel B. Roberts (Kancolle)|]], Johnston is much taller and [[medium_breasts|slightly more well-endowed]] with [[long_hair|long]] pinkish [[brown hair]] tied into a [[two side up]] style and [[brown eyes]].

She wears a stylized [[serafuku]] which consists of an [[off shoulder|off-shoulder]] [[blue shirt]] with a black [[sailor collar]] that exposes her [[cleavage]] and short [[black skirt|black]] [[pleated skirt]], along with [[black thighhighs]] held by [[garter straps]] with what seem to be metallic thigh and [[shin guards]] and red [[rudder footwear|rudder shoes]]. Johnston's damaged CG has her stripped of some of her clothing, revealing a bit of her black underwear.

On her left hand she wears a [[single glove|single]] [[black gloves|black glove]], an oblique reference to the injuries to the left hand sustained by her captain, "Commander Ernest E. Evans":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ernest_E._Evans], including losing two fingers. Draped on her left upper arm is the [[United States Medal of Honor|Medal of Honor]], referencing the one posthumously awarded to Commander Evans for his actions in the "Battle off Samar":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_off_Samar].

Her [[rigging]] consists of two [[smokestack]]s and three of her Mark 12 5-inch/38 caliber [[cannon|gun]] [[ship turret|turret]]s, with one set on each side of her rigging and a third [[adapted turret|handheld turret]] in her right hand. Her hull number is emblazoned on each side of her lower rigs.

Her namesake is "Navy Lieutenant John V. Johnston":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_V._Johnston], who fought for the Union from 1862 to 1864 during the [[American Civil War]]. She is the game's first bona fide American destroyer, despite the fact that destroyer escort [[Samuel B. Roberts (Kancolle)|]] was already classified as a destroyer in the game.

She's voiced by Shiraki Nao and was designed by [[Zeco]].

A nameless female mob unit in [[Blue Archive]] who serves as a part of Trinity General School's [[Justice Task Force (blue archive)|]]. Despite her lack of distinctive characteristics she's managed to garner quite a following. For short she may be called 正実モブ ([i]Seiji Mobu[/i], "JTF Mob") or affectionately as モブちゃん ([i]Mob-chan[/i]).

The named members of the [[Justice Task Force (blue archive)|]] (with the exception of [[Koharu (blue archive)|]]) share many character design elements in common with Mob-chan: [[black serafuku]] with red trim, [[long hair|long]], [[straight hair|straight]] [[black hair]] and a [[red halo]]. The main feature that Mob-chan lacks is a pair of [[black wings]]. As a result, artists occasionally potray her to be a kind of "larval form" that the named members have "evolved" from, and that the growth of wings is an adolescent trait. As of Ichika's recent release, these mobs have [[red eyes]].

Carries either an [[EM-2]] or an [[L85]]-style [[assault rifle]].

The [b][i]kabuto[/i][/b] (兜, 冑) is the traditional, Japanese [[samurai]] helmet, composed of a solid metal skullcap ([i]hachi[/i] or [i]kabuto-bachi[/i]) and hanging, articulated plates ([[shikoro]]). Its main function was to stop blade strikes to the front of the head more efficiently. 

More ornate [i]kabuto[/i] may have crests and decorations known as [i]datemono[/i], and many were secured to mask-like facial armor known as [i]mengu[/i] rather than be strapped around the chin due to their heavy weight.

For the Pokémon of the same name, see [[kabuto_(pokemon)]].

payload.body:
A [b]kadomatsu[/b] (literally "gate pine") is a traditional Japanese decoration of the [[New Year]] placed in pairs in front of homes to welcome ancestral spirits or [i]kami[/i] of the harvest. They are placed after [[Christmas]] until January 7 (or January 15 during the Edo period) and are considered temporary housing ("[i]shintai[/i]":https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shintai) for [i]kami[/i]. Designs for [i]kadomatsu[/i] vary depending on region but are typically made of [[pine_tree|pine]], [[bamboo]], and sometimes ume tree sprigs which represent longevity, prosperity and steadfastness, respectively.

h4. See also

* [[nebikimatsu]]
* [[shimekazari]]

h4. External links

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese aircraft carrier [i]Kaga[/i]. Character design by [[shibafu_(glock23)|Shibafu]], voiced by [[Iguchi Yuka]]. 

She has [[long hair|long]] [[brown hair]] in a [[side ponytail]], [[tsurime]] [[brown eyes]], and [[large breasts]]. 

Her default outfit consists of a black [[muneate]] over a [[white kimono]] top and [[blue skirt|blue]] [[pleated skirt]], blue [[tasuki]], brown [[apron]] based on the stern end of her flight deck, with the kana "カ" inscribed on it, [[black thighhighs]], and [[platform footwear]]. Her [[rigging]] is very similar to [[akagi (kancolle)|Akagi's]] (and, by extension, all of Shibafu's carriers') own gear: a traditional [[yumi (bow)|yumi bow]], a [[quiver]] with a replica of the ship's mast, her full flight deck attached as a [[shield]] on her left arm and carrier-like [[geta]]. 

She has a stoic personality. In fan works, she is often paired with [[Akagi (kancolle)|]] or [[Zuikaku (Kancolle)|]]. She is sometimes portrayed as having high body temperature or being warm to the touch, due to the fact that the [i]Kaga[/i] was a converted battleship and was prone to overheating due to poor ventilation.

The historical [i]Kaga[/i] was originally designed as a battleship before being converted into a carrier. She was scuttled after being heavily damaged at the [[Battle of Midway]] in 1942.

[b]Kaguya Luna[/b] is a [[Virtual YouTuber]] who made her debut on December 9, 2017. She was managed by Vic inc. from the start, but between fall 2018 and fall 2019, she operated under her own autonomous agency, [[THE MOON STUDIO]]. In addition to her YouTube content, she produced music under the Sony Music label [[SACRA MUSIC]]. She was designed by [[Mika Pikazo]].

While neither she nor Vic Inc. have officially announced that she had graduated, her most recent YouTube video was published on August 29th, 2020, and the Kaguya Luna Official channel has been inactive ever since. Her voice was often compared to [[Hamtaro]], earning her the nickname "Strangled Hamtaro" (首を絞めたハム太郎).

[spoiler][[Pmaru-sama]], who has "admitted":[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ADVUKyyq3uA] she is the talent behind Kaguya Luna, remains very active with her own channel on YouTube.[/spoiler]

[[Girls' Frontline]] character. A logistics officer in the Griffin branch base, her main job is to coordinate resource movements for the [[Commander (girls' frontline)|]]. However, due to a lack of manpower in such a distant location, Kalina also carries out the duties of a secretary.

Her standard costume consists of a [[pleated skirt]], dress shirt, a tan [[jacket]], tactical [[gloves]] and [[high heel boots]]. Her [[thighhighs]] are [[mismatched legwear|mismatched]], with one being solid black and the other with black and white stripes.

She has [[blue eyes]] and [[orange hair]] made up into a [[side ponytail]].

Kalina has an obsession with money (or in the player's case, gems) and will encourage the player to spend at her in-game shop.

She is cheerful, passionate and casual by nature and is very friendly to the Commander. For the most part Kalina is diligent at her work, but in her private life she has a typical girlish side to her.

She returns in [[Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium]] [[aged up]] and wearing a black suit.

Voiced by [[Touyama Nao]].

payload.body:
Main character from [[Kimetsu no Yaiba]].
He is a Demon Slayer in the Demon Slayer Corps, who joined to find a remedy to turn his sister,  [[Kamado Nezuko]], back into a human and to hunt down and kill demons, and later swore to defeat [[Kibutsuji Muzan]], the King of Demons, in order to prevent others from suffering the same fate as him.

Before he became a Demon Slayer, Tanjiro was a coal burner before his entire family was slaughtered by Muzan while his younger sister, Nezuko, was turned into a demon.

He has ruffled, [[black hair]] with burgundy tips, combed back to expose his forehead, and wide, dark [[red eyes]] with [[white pupils]] that appear lighter around the lower section of his irises.

Tanjiro first appears wearing a checkered, black and sea foam green [[haori]] over a white robe and black pants. He occasionally sports a turquoise [[scarf]] and is seen with circular, [[white bands]] looped around his calves. He also wears a distinct pair of [[hanafuda earrings]], with the image of the rising sun over a mountain.

During the Final Selection, Tanjiro wears a blue, cloud-patterned samue-styled [[kimono]] and [[black pants]], nearly identical to Sakonji's outfit. He still wears his [[hanafuda earrings]], but his hair is cut extremely short and remains the same length since. Similar to the rest of the apprentices that were trained under Sakonji, Tanjiro wears a hand-carved [[fox mask]] crafted from his master on the left side of his head. The mask has red accents on the eyes, ears, and spots on each corner of its mouth. On the upper right corner of the mask, there is a sun-shaped design that likely symbolizes the scar on his forehead.

After becoming a Demon Slayer, Tanjiro wears the standard [[Demon Slayer uniform]], a dark-brown gakuran jacket, a white belt, baggy chocho zubon pants that extend into tabi socks, a pair of zōri with red straps, and bands of white cloth wrapped tightly around his calves resembling kyahan, all beneath his signature [[checkered haori]]. He carries a large [[wooden box]] on his back (which was a gift to him from [[Urokodaki Sakonji]]), where his sister sleeps as they travel during the day.

[spoiler]After being turned into a [[demon]] by [[Kibutsuji Muzan]], Tanjiro is able to heal the growth on his face as well as regenerate his lost arm and other smaller injuries. He obtains eyes with [[slit pupils]], fangs and flame-shaped marks over his left forehead and right jaw that are reminiscent of those of [[Kokushibou]], in addition to a third, smaller flame-shaped mark coming down from the right side of his head down to his eyebrow after he conquered the weakness to sunlight. His scar turns into a flame-pattern as if it were a permanent Demon Slayer Mark, has become longer and is the largest of the three, and all three marks vaguely point towards his nose, though only his scar-mark reaches it. He still dons his bloodstained corps uniform, one sleeve ripped off where his arm was severed, but loses his checkered haori and the Nichirin Sword at his hip.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]After returning to his human form, Tanjiro loses the ability to see from his right eye, the iris of which is now a dull pink-gray color and the pupil black rather than its original white. His left arm, which he regrew as a [[Demon]], now takes the appearance of that which an older person may have, becoming wrinkled and skeletal, and he loses all feeling in it below the elbow and thus the ability to move it from his forearm down.[/spoiler]

h4. External Links
* "Kimetsu no Yaiba Wiki: Tanjiro Kamado":https://kimetsu-no-yaiba.fandom.com/wiki/Tanjiro_Kamado

payload.body:
The main protagonist of the [[Toaru Majutsu no Index]] series and an important character in the [[Toaru Kagaku no Railgun]] series. 

As a Level 0 Academy City first-year high school student, his point-of-view allows the audience to become acquainted to the mysterious world of Toaru Majutsu no Index, and is mostly involved in the events of its Magic Side.

He possesses the mysterious [[Imagine Breaker]] in his right hand, which is capable of negating all forms of magic, esper powers, and other divine abilities. This, according to [[Index (toaru majutsu no index)|]], even includes his own good luck, as they are the blessings of God.

He has a very strong desire to aid all those who are in need even if it means putting his life on the line and will not hesitate to challenge an opponent who is several times more powerful than himself. Because of his willingness to help others unconditionally, he has attracted the affections of many characters in the series, which Himegami Aisa jokes about, stating that his life is like a dating simulation where he is bound to unlock more paths to more girls

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the [i]Kamikaze[/i], lead ship of the [i]Kamikaze[/i]-class destroyers. Character design by [[Parsley-F]], voiced by [[Kawasumi Ayako]].

She has [[purple eyes]] and [[long hair|long]], reddish-[[purple hair]] which [[gradient_hair| gradually fades]] to [[pink hair|pink]] at the ends, tied with a [[yellow ribbon]]. 

Kamikaze and her sisters wear traditional [[Japanese clothes]], namely a [[pink hakama]] over a [[red kimono]] paired with [[lace-up boots]] in the style of a [[Meiji schoolgirl uniform]], in reference to how she and her sisters were built during the [[Taishou]] era (when this style of dress was still common).

She doesn't want to be seen as old, despite being of the oldest destroyer class in the game and her old-fashioned looks. That being said, she has an excellent war record for her capabilities.

Kamikaze is related in some way to all four of the [i]Myoukou[/i]-class:

* She was part of Destroyer Division 1, which was part of the 5th fleet, led by [[nachi (kancolle)|Nachi]] during the battle of Attu.
* She was under the command of [[haguro (kancolle)|Haguro]] (and protected by her) during the Battle of Malacca Strait. Kamikaze saved some of Haguro's survivors after the battle.
* She was under [[Ashigara (kancolle)|Ashigara]]'s command until her sinking and also saved some of her survivors.
* She surrendered along with the crippled [[myoukou (kancolle)|Myoukou]] (and Takao) at Singapore.

Her [[abyssal ship|abyssal]] form is assumed to be the [[Ancient Destroyer Oni]].

She has no relation to the [[kamikaze pilot]]s who conducted suicide attacks on Allied ships later in World War II.

"The History Eater"

Stage 3 mid-boss and boss as well as Extra Stage mid-boss of [[Touhou]]'s [[Imperishable Night]].

A were-hakutaku and schoolteacher with the ability to consume the history of [[Gensokyo]]'s Human Village to protect it from malicious youkai. Normally she has bluish-white hair and matching blue dress, except during a full moon when her hair becomes greenish-white, her dress turns green, and she grows horns. In this form, she can create and alter history.

Doujin works portray her as a [[teacher]] for some of the "child" characters in the series by whom she is feared for her punishment - a headbutt. She is also seen tutoring to [[Team 9 (touhou)|]] with predictable results. In canon, however, while she is a schoolteacher, she refuses to teach youkai. She is also a good friend to [[Fujiwara no Mokou]]. Many fans often pair her with [[Morichika Rinnosuke]] either as a childhood friend or a colleague due to their similar status as half-youkai.

[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese seaplane tender [i]Kamoi[/i]. Character design by [[Akira (Kadokawa)|]], voiced by [[Seto Asami]]. 

She is portrayed with [[medium hair|medium-length]] [[multicolored hair]] ([[white_hair|white]] on the outside, [[blue_hair|blue]] on the inside and the eyebrows) and tied to a [[folded ponytail]] with a [i]matanpus[/i] [[headband]], [[blue eyes]], and [[large breasts]]. 

Each of her forms has her wear some variant of a blue [[cropped jacket]] over a long, [[sleeveless_dress|sleeveless]] [[white dress]] with [[thighhighs]]. In her base form her thighhighs are black bandages. In her [[Kamoi Kai (kancolle)|Kai]] form she wears [[thigh boots]]. In [[Kamoi Kai Bo (kancolle)|Kai Bo]] form her headband loses its pattern.

She was one of a few Japanese ships in-game to be built abroad (besides [[kongou (kancolle)|Kongou]]). In her case, at New York Shipbuilding Corporation, at the same time as [[saratoga (kancolle)|Saratoga]], before her conversion (for this reason, [i]she[/i] is the key for building Saratoga with LSC). However, she shows very little traces of her birthland and instead acts as the token minority of the fleet. Her design is heavily influenced by the [[Ainu]], featuring distinctive patterning as well as a [[ainu_clothes|few clothing items]] and objects. 

She is the only ship in the game to change ship class three times as well as the only ship who irreversibly (but nominally) return to their original ship class. As Kai Bo, she is the only other ship other than [[akitsushima (kancolle)|Akitsushima]] to field Flying Boats.

payload.body:
An [[UTAU]] character. She is a young girl with [[red eyes]] and [[red hair|red]] [[twin drills]]. She typically wears a dark blue/gray outfit with red trim. Her official profile lists her as a "chimera", so she is sometimes given characteristics like a [[forked tail]] or [[wings]]. Her character item is a [[baguette]]. 

She was created as an [[April Fools]] joke by the VIPPERs of [[2channel|2ch]], meant to trick [[NicoNico]] users into thinking she was the 3rd Vocaloid from Crypton. After the joke was over, instead of fading into obscurity Teto was picked up by [[UTAU]], a freeware knock-off of [[VOCALOID]]. She has maintained a level of popularity, and many have tried to replicate this effect with other joke and fanmade characters since.

After her 15th anniversary on April 2023, she received an [[kasane teto (sv)|updated voicebank]] under the [[Synthesizer V]] engine, which would boost her popularity even further.

Her voice provider is [[Oyamano Mayo]]. Oyamano initially used the name Oyama Nobuyo as a reference to famed singer and voice actress [[Ooyama Nobuyo]]. Since the latter is most known as the voice of [[Doraemon (character)|]], fans had Teto share similar traits. Teto's [[catchphrase]] 君は実に馬鹿だな ("You really are an idiot, aren't you?") also originated from a [[Doraemon]] comic.

Do not tag Kasane Teto as a [[VOCALOID]]. She is either an [[UTAU]], [[Synthesizer V|SynthV]] or [[VOICEPEAK]].

[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese escort carrier [i]Kasuga Maru[/i]. Upon remodeling, her name changes to [[Taiyou (kancolle)|]]. Character design by [[Shibafu (glock23)|]], voiced by [[Shuto Yukina]]. 

She has [[long_hair|long]] dark [[brown hair]] in a [[folded ponytail]] held in place with a [[blue_ribbon|blue]] [[hair ribbon]], and [[swept bangs]].  She has [[brown_eyes|brown]] [[tareme]]-style eyes. Similar to [[Akagi (kancolle)|]] and [[Kaga (kancolle)|]], [[Shibafu_(glock23)|]]'s other fleet carriers, she wears a white [[dougi]] top with a red [[hakama short skirt]], and [[black socks]]. On her left hand, she wears a thick falconry [[gloves|glove]].

Her [[rigging]] involves a [[flight deck]] strapped to her right arm, falconry-related steel pouches strapped to her torso, and steel [[platform boots]]. She is notably is modeled upon "classic Japanese falconry":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Takagari] unlike the majority of carriers in-game that are either archers, onmyoji, or marksmen. 

Historically, the [i]Kasuga Maru[/i] was originally built as a [i]Nitta Maru[/i] class passenger-cargo liner, but was requisitioned by the Imperial Japanese Navy and converted into the escort aircraft carrier [i]Taiyou[/i] without ever seeing service as an ocean liner. As [i]Taiyou[/i], she was initially used to transport aircraft and for training, but was later used to escort merchant convoys. She was sunk by a US submarine on August 18, 1944.

One of her lines references "an advertisement":[http://otakei.otakuma.net/wp/wp-content/uploads/2012/01/210.jpg] where she was anthropomorphized alongside her sister-ships even back in the 1940s. 

Her [[abyssal ship|abyssal]] form is assumed to be the [[Escort Princess]].

payload.body:
[b]Sakura Kasugano[/b] ([b]春日野 さくら[/b]) is a character in the [[Street Fighter]] series. She is introduced as a 16-year-old (as of [[Street Fighter Zero (series)|Street Fighter Zero 3]]) Japanese schoolgirl who has an intense fixation with [[ryu (street fighter)|Ryu]]. She has managed to copy and learn some of Ryu's techniques but really wants him to train her personally. In her most recent appearance in [[Street Fighter V]]'s new [i]Arcade Edition[/i], she has graduated high school and has taken a job at an arcade to make ends meet, but she still persists in fighting and training.

Sakura has typically fought in her school's uniform, a [[serafuku]] consisting of a slightly [[crop top|cropped]] [[white shirt|white]] [[cropped shirt|shirt]] with a [[popped collar|popped]] [[blue sailor collar]], a [[yellow neckerchief]], a [[pleated skirt|pleated]] [[blue skirt|blue]] [[miniskirt]] with [[red buruma]] underneath. She wears a [[red sports bra]] under her uniform, [[red gloves]], [[red shoes|red]] [[sneakers]], and a [[white headband]] (given to her by Ryu before Street Fighter Zero 2). She wore this outfit up until Street Fighter V, where she replaced it with the [[employee uniform]] of the arcade she works at. She has [[short hair|short]] [[brown hair]] and [[blue eyes]]. 

Chronologically, Sakura first appeared in [[Shiritsu Justice Gakuen|Shiritsu]] [[Justice Gakuen]], where she had started to participate in street fighting after watching Ryu win the first World Warrior tournament. Justice Gakuen saw Sakura involved in the adventure between her school and others in Ashura City. Fighting in it, she realized how much it meant to her to protect something she cared about.

She wishes to be seen by other idols as an older sister and be called Onee-sama, despite the fact that she is shorter than idols who are half her age. Sanae has a black belt in Aikido, Judo, and Karate. She also tends to get upset if others mention that she is single, and is very easily susceptible to drinking to drown her sorrows.

She leads training lessons for [[Aino Nagisa]], [[Akanishi Erika]], [[Yagami Makino]], and [[Ohnishi Yuriko]]. While she finds it extremely difficult, Sanae continues to do so because she wants to be considered reliable. She puts other’s wants before hers, and can sometimes wind up looking like a fool because of it. She is nervous when it comes to [[Aihara Yukino]]’s high class tea and ceramics.

Sanae has a habit of getting drunk, and often drags other idols into it as well. She has found drinking buddies in [[Takagaki Kaede]], [[Hiiragi Shino]], [[Shinohara Rei]], and [[Hyodo Rena]] and made friends with [[Yanagi Kiyora]]. Sanae earned a movie role of an evil mahjong player, and in turn became one of [[Munakata Atsumi]]’s ogling victims. Her sense of style seems to mostly include extremely short dresses that show a lot of cleavage. She is said to be stunning in a bathing suit, although she has put on a child’s swimsuit in order to gain attention.

Due to her popularity, she was selected for the 8th CINDERELLA MASTER CD series, alongside [[Tachibana Arisu]], [[Ichinose Shiki]], [[Shiomi Syuko]], and [[Sakurai Momoka]]. She is voiced by [[Waki Azumi]] [和氣 あず未].

She has a younger sister named [[Cassiopeia (league Of Legends)|Cassiopeia]], and her missing father is General Marcus du Couteau.

She has a rivalry with [[Garen (league Of Legends)|]]. This relationship has been hinted at being more than just a rivalry.

She has [[long hair|long]] [[red hair]], [[green eyes]], a [[scar on face]], a [[stomach tattoo]], and [[large breasts]]. By default, she wears a black [[crop top]], [[black gloves]], [[black pants]] held up by a [[brown belt]], [[grieves]], and [[black boots]].

A character from [[Neon Genesis Evangelion]] who is the chief operations officer at Nerv. She is the field commander for the [[Ayanami Rei|Eva pilots]] and guardian of [[Ikari Shinji]] and [[Souryuu Asuka Langley]] who stay at her home.

In the original series, it is revealed that [spoiler]Misato and her father were involved in the Second Impact as he was a top scientist who in the last moment put Misato in a escape capsule so she could survive the event. Afterwards Misato became [[crazy]] with survivor guilt and was admitted into a mental institution for most of her teenage years. After being released in her adult years she developed a very extroverted and cheerful personality to be able to cope with her past tragedies.[/spoiler]

Misato has a pet [[mutant]] [[penguin]] named [[PenPen]]; and she was the lover of [[Kaji Ryouji]].

She has [[long hair|long]] [[wavy hair|wavy]] [[purple hair]] with [[parted bangs]] (sometimes, it is tied in a [[ponytail]] with [[sidelocks]]), and dark [[brown eyes]]. She is usually seen wearing a [[black dress]], a [[cropped jacket|cropped]] [[red jacket]], and [[black shoes]] with [[green socks]], also sometimes wears a [[red hat|red]] [[beret]]. Her casual [[official alternate costume|attire]] consists of a [[shirt tucked in|tucked in]] [[yellow tank top]] (which is sometimes [[adapted costume|depicted]] as [[crop top|cropped]]), and [[denim shorts|denim]] [[short shorts]].

Foreigner-Class servant in [[Fate/Grand Order]]. A famous Japanese artist. Some of his more prominent works include the [[kanagawa okinami ura|Great Wave off Kanagawa]] (part of the Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji), and the first known portrayal of tentacle porn, [[The Dream of the Fisherman's Wife]], among others.

Similarly to [[Artemis (fate)|]] and [[Orion (Bear) (fate)|Orion]], the girl who is summoned is not actually Hokusai; the small black [[octopus]] following her named [[Toto-sama (fate)|]] is the true Hokusai, while she herself is his daughter "Katsushika Oei":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katsushika_%C5%8Ci], who served as her father's assistant and even produced some works under his name. He takes over her body upon reaching her third ascension, giving her an octopus-themed costume and a purple color scheme.

They have a [[katsushika hokusai (swimsuit saber) (fate)|Swimsuit Saber]] variant, introduced for the summer 2019 event.

payload.body:
A playable character from [[Genshin Impact]], he is a well-known architect from Sumeru behind the [[Palace of Alcazarzaray]] and is commonly depicted with his automated [[suitcase]] companion [[Mehrak (genshin impact)|]].

A genius architect and an honors graduate of Kshahrewar in the Sumeru Akademiya, Kaveh has a good reputation among Sumeru citizens and has earned the moniker "Light of Kshahrewar". He currently resides with [[Alhaitham (genshin impact)|]] after going into debt for taking a loan from [[Dori (genshin impact)|]] to continue construction of the palace. Due to the stark contrast in their personalities and ideologies, Kaveh gets easily flustered around Alhaitham and they often have heated arguments. He is also empathetic and thoughtful of others, quick to lend a hand to people in trouble.

Kaveh has [[long hair|long]] [[blonde hair]] with [[double-parted bangs]] hanging [[hair between eyes|between his eyes]], a [[single braid]] on the back of his head and [[tsurime|sharp]] [[red eyes]]. He wears a [[white shirt]] with [[long sleeves]], a [[cleavage cutout]] exposing his [[pectoral cleavage]] and a [[back cutout]], a [[red cape]] with [[tassel]]s, a [[blue sash]], [[black gloves|black]] [[partially fingerless gloves]], [[black pants]] and a pair of [[white shoes]]. He has a blue [[feather hair ornament]] and multiple red [[hairclip]]s, [[gold earrings]], a [[gold necklace]] and a [[gold thighlet]] on his left leg. He wears his [[vision (genshin impact)|]] on his left leg. Kaveh's [[vision (genshin impact)|]] element is Dendro and he wields a [[greatsword|claymore]] in combat.

Voiced by [[Ben Balmeceda]] (EN), [[Uchida Yuuma]] (JP) and Liu Sanmu (CN).

payload.body:
A character from the series [[Girls und Panzer]].

Gunner and loader of Team [[Turtle]] in a [[Panzer 38(t)]] ([tn]later upgraded to a [[Jagdpanzer 38(t)]][/tn]) on the "Ooarai Girls Academy":[#dtext-see-also] tankery team. Also the Public Relations Manager of the student council. Is made the overall commander for [i]Das Finale[/i].

Her name means [[peach]], and is fruit-based like the other members of the student council.

Voiced by [[Ueda Kana]] "[1]":[#dtext-external-links].

[expand=Official Character Bio]

h6. Original Anime

Runs public relations for the Ooarai Girls Academy student council. Supports the shenanigans of the president. Is a senior.

[tn]Source: post #1291295[/tn]

h6. Das Finale

Affiliated with the Ooarai Girls Academy tankery team. Is Team Turtle's loader, gunner, and radio operator. Despite her constant condescending attitude, she's actually weak in a pinch and will panic right away. Faithful to the President, during the crisis of the second school closing, she was viewed as conducting herself in an admirable way as a substitute for the President.  Although in charge of the gunnery, her aim is shockingly terrible.

[tn]Source: "[2]":[#dtext-external-links][/tn]

h6. Operation More Love Love

The (former) public affairs officer, she runs around freely and is commonly known as the "one-eyed strategist". She is also affectionately known as "Momo-chan-senpai". However, due to her nagging personality and the occasional clumsy behavior that she shows, her kouhai don't seem to listen to her that much.

[tn]Source: "[3]":[#dtext-external-links][/tn]

She often has her large [[backpack]], usually either [[blue bag|blue]] or [[green bag|green]]. A trend of drawing her with her jacket opened or removed to reveal a [[black tank top]] undershirt as an [[alternate costume]] has also become popular. h4.
