payload.body:
The "Flower Master of the Four Seasons".

Final Boss of [[Touhou]]'s [[Lotus Land Story]] and later a recurring playable character, as well as the fourth [[Kazami Yuuka (PC-98)|PC-98]] generation character after [[Hakurei Reimu]], [[Kirisame Marisa]] and [[Alice Margatroid]] to reappear in the Windows generation (specifically in [[Phantasmagoria of Flower View]]).

A highly dangerous youkai with the power to manipulate [[flower]]s, and reputed creator and original wielder of the [[Master Spark]] (which Marisa later "borrowed"). Hinted by [[Hieda no Akyuu]] to exhibit a rather polite facade, provided she or her flowers are not harmed. Once described by [[ZUN]] as "Youkai moe~", possibly meant as a pun given that the literal meaning of moe is "budding" and Yuuka controls flowers. Yuuka's place of residence is unknown in canon, but is generally assumed to be the [[Garden of the Sun]], where she tends a [[flower field|massive field]] of [[sunflower]]s, and it is known she used to occupy the Dream World mansion [[Mugenkan]] with her then-retainer [[Elly (touhou)|]]. Frequently portrayed in fan works as the [[sadism|Ultimate Sadistic Creature]] (USC), as a bloodthirsty psychopath, or as [[tsundere]]. Usually some combination of the first two (or of all three). Alternately, she is often depicted as lonely due to this reputation or as very friendly to [[Team 9 (touhou)|]] and other children.

She has [[short hair|short]] [[green hair]] with [[medium bangs|medium-length bangs]] and [[red eyes]], sometimes [[yellow eyes|yellow]]. Her outfit consists of an [[open vest|open]] [[plaid vest|plaid]] [[red vest]] over a [[long sleeves|long-sleeved]] [[collared shirt|collared]] [[white shirt|white]] [[dress shirt]] tied with a [[yellow ascot]]. To complete her [[skirt set]] is a matching [[plaid skirt|plaid]] [[red skirt]] with [[frilled skirt|frills]] or [[plaid pants|plaid]] [[red pants]]. Her footwear is usually [[white socks]] with [[red shoes|red]] [[mary janes]] or [[brown boots]]. She usually carries her [[pink umbrella|pink]] [[parasol]].

h4. Appearance

* !post #5248036
* !post #2981660: [[Kazami Yuuka (Pc-98)|PC-98]] 

h4. Fan-made Variations

* "Noukarin":[http://dic.pixiv.net/a/%E3%81%AE%E3%81%86%E3%81%8B%E3%82%8A%E3%82%93] (Farmer-Yuukarin): Originally a type of [[Yukkuri Shiteitte Ne]], unusually depicted with a full body instead of just as a head.  Now this word means Kazami Yuuka wearing a [[straw hat]].  Noukarin is frequently depicted with an acoustic [[guitar]] and/or with an almost impenetrable rural accent. 
* "Bakerin":[http://dic.pixiv.net/a/%E3%81%B9%E3%83%BC%E3%81%8B%E3%82%8A%E3%82%93] (Bakery-Yuukarin): A recent variant of Kazami Yuuka who makes [[bread]] in her own bakery named "[[Bakery]] Kazami".  "A certain tweet":http://twitter.com/matsurisyndrome/status/51104783376990208 caused this trend.

She's one of the six main protagonists of the [[Senki Zesshou Symphogear]] series.

She also wears white and blue stocking up to her thigh, and light blue boots with the left one reaching to her knee and the right reaching to her ankle.

She is also seen wearing the Lydian Music Academy uniform.

(For "a Japanese slang word with the same pronunciation":[http://dic.pixiv.net/a/%E8%8F%8A%E9%96%80], see [[anus]].)

菊花紋章 ([i]kikka monshou[/i]), 菊紋 ([i]kikumon[/i]), 菊花紋 ([i]kikka-mon[/i]) or 菊の御紋 ([i]kiku no gomon[/i]) 

A stylized depiction of a 16 petal [[chrysanthemum]] flower, used by the Emperor of Japan and the Imperial Family. It is most notably seen on the bows of warships of the [[Imperial Japanese Navy]] and on the covers of Japanese passports. Be careful not to confuse it with the 5 petal [[sakuramon]].

For clear examples, check the [[obi]]'s of Akiha (post #15614) and Megurine Luka (post #568974), and the bottom-right side of Yuyuko's kimono (post #570756).

payload.body:
One of the four main characters of [[Hunter x Hunter]].

Killua is a boy with a calm and laid back personality, however, his ruthlessness and aptitude in killing show the other side of him—deadly, violent, and bloodthirsty. He is a member of a famous family of assassins, the Zoldyck Family. He is the third son of [[Silva Zoldyck|Silva]] and [[kikyou_zoldyck|Kikyou]]. Killua is considered a promising member of the family but ends up running away from home and entering the Hunter Exam. Killua ends up meeting [[Kurapika]], [[leorio_paladiknight|Leorio]] and [[gon_freecss|Gon]], the other three main characters of the series. Gon later becomes his best friend. 

h4. Appearance

Killua is a young boy with [[white_hair|white]], [[messy_hair|messy]] [[spiked_hair|spiky hair]] and [[blue eyes]]. He typically wears a [[long_sleeves|long-sleeved]] [[blue_shirt|blue]]/[[black_shirt|black]] [[shirt]] with [[turtleneck]] under a [[white_shirt|white]] [[t-shirt]]. He also wears [[blue_shorts|blue]]/[[purple shorts]] and [[purple footwear|purple]] [[shoes]] (recolored [[brown footwear|brown]] in the 1999 adaptation). He wears a white [[tank top]] in the [i]Chimera Ants[/i] arc.

payload.body:
King Dedede is the self-proclaimed king of Dream Land, [[kirby|Kirby's]] #1 rival, and a recurring antagonist in the [i][[kirby_(series)|Kirby]][/i] games. Typically caring only for himself, he likes to mess with others because he thinks it's fun. He even once stole all of Dream Land's food. However, Dedede isn't all bad - he's just more of a bully who pulls pranks on others just for the fun of it. Sometimes, he does do good deeds, and will even team up with Kirby more often than he'd like to admit.

In the [[kirby: right back at ya!|anime]], Dedede also pulls pranks on others and especially tries to make other people's lives as miserable as he can because he thinks it's fun. He buys monsters called [[Demon Beast|Demon Beasts]] created by the Holy Nightmare Company, led by [[Nightmare_(Kirby)|Nightmare]], to help him with his desires, and has a snail sidekick called [[Escargon]].

Assassin-class Servant seen in [[Fate/Grand Order]]. The Old Man of the Mountain, and founder of the Hassan-i-Sabbah sect of assassins. His identity and existence are obscure even to his followers; the only proof he exists is when he executes a Hassan for straying from the intended path, along with any witnesses who see him.

Appears as a tall man in a jet black [[full armor]] with [[horns|horned]] [[skull mask]].

Named [b]First Hassan[/b] in the English version. Humorously, his voice actor is [[Nakata Jouji]], who also voices [[Kotomine Kirei]] (and once had a Hassan as his Servant).

He is usually depicted as a strict moral guardian who adheres by his own code of honor, and often cannot tolerate seeing any woman wearing [[revealing clothes]], though is generally very kind to those he deemed good or innocent, especially children.

payload.body:
Female protagonist of [[Kino no Tabi]].

Kino is a composed, stoic, and precocious teenager who travels with her talking motorrad, [[Hermes (kino no tabi)|]]; the two have a contract—Kino provides the balance, Hermes provides the speed, and together they can travel anywhere they wish.  Although Kino appears apathetic at first, she is a caring and understanding person. She travels through different countries to experience their customs and understand their histories, but she never stays longer than three days, as she is afraid of settling down, and would thus cease being a traveler.

Kino is portrayed with either [[short_hair|short]] [[green hair]] and [[green eyes]] or [[black hair]] and [[black eyes]]. She wears a [[black jacket]], [[brown coat]], [[white shirt]], [[goggles on headwear|goggled cap]] and wide [[belt]] with lots of [[pouch]]es — using special gear depending on the weather or season as necessary, she is typically armed with a [[Colt 1851 Navy]] [[revolver]].

Due to her [[androgynous]] appearance, her gender is often confused by both viewers and other characters in the series.

[spoiler]"Kino" is also the name of her predecessor.[/spoiler]

payload.body:
A former [[Virtual YouTuber|VTuber]] and member of [[hololive]]'s [[holoforce|4th generation]]. A [[dragon girl]] in human form. Designed by [[Yaman]].

She has [[very long hair|very long]] [[orange hair]] with a single [[blonde hair|yellow]] [[streaked hair|lock of hair]] near her forehead. Her regular hairstyle is [[straight hair]] with an [[ahoge]], [[hair intakes]] held with a [[black hairband]], [[fanged bangs|fanged]] [[blunt bangs]], [[sidelocks]] and a [[side braid]]. She also has a pair of [[dragon horns]] with a [[horn bow|bow]] on her right horn, [[pointy ears]], [[red eyes]] with [[white pupils|white]] [[slit pupils]], a long purple [[dragon tail]] (which she had a running gag of it being a [[butt plug]] [[anal tail|tail]]). She also has quite [[large breasts]], with her subsequent outfits making them [[huge breasts|noticeably larger]].

She is fluent in English, and quite eccentric (due to being a half-American). Hosted a morning "news show"-esque 20-minute program on weekdays named "AsaCoco" (Morning Coco), which usually ended up creating absurd memes - such as [[Himemori Luna]]'s English Corner, where the cute, childish princess constantly spews out obscenities, and most notably the drug "[[asacoco]]", a potent stimulant available to be delivered in a wide variety of forms ranging from needles to anal plugs.

Despite her wild antics, insane gags and frequent foul language (which often got her into trouble with YouTube), she is very eager to help her friends if need be and has a mature, big sister-like approach to troublesome situations (though usually laced with some of her personal brand of humor to break the seriousness if it's too much).

She was considered to have the second largest bust in hololive after [[Tsukumo Sana]], even toppling [[Shirogane Noel]]'s K-night cups. She was also significantly taller than the rest of the hololive girls (180 cm, compared with [[Omega Alpha]], who is the second tallest at 175 cm without counting the gigantic Sana), especially the rest of the 4th generation (Kanata, Towa and Watame are all about 150 cm tall, Luna is the shortest at 140 cm, boosted to 150 cm with her shoes and crown).

She was the real-life roommate of [[Amane Kanata]], and the apartment that they lived in together was called by other visiting hololive members as the "KanaCoco House". This means that they could (and had several times) make appearances on each other's streams.

She is in fact a big [[Ryuu ga Gotoku (series)|]] fangirl and has been known to play games of the series. In fact, her name and her title of "Chairwoman" ("会長" - [i]Kaichou[/i]) are direct references to [[Kiryu Kazuma]].

Kiryu Coco reached one million YouTube subscribers on February 17, 2021.

She announced her graduation from Hololive on June 8, 2021. Her final act was a live concert on July 1, 2021, which became one of the most viewed live streams in Hololive and VTuber history, reaching over 498,000 concurrent viewers.

On the upper part there are large, pointed shoulder pads. Junketsu's eyes appear on the shoulder pads, with the white-orange scleras changed to black.

In the series, Satsuki is usually seen wielding [[bakuzan]], a sword that resembles a [[katana]].

A supporting character from [[JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken]] Part 4. His [[Stand (jojo)|]] is [[Heaven's Door]]. Wears a distinctive jagged headband and earrings that look like fountain pen nibs.

A famous Mangaka, Rohan may be a fantastical [[artist self-insert]] of [[Araki Hirohiko]]. He shares Araki's love of traveling and has starred in multiple one-shot side stories titled [[Kishibe Rohan Wa Ugokanai]].

He became the origin of Japanese meme, "だが断る" ("[i][[Daga Kotowaru]][/i]", "[b]I REFUSE.[/b] What I like to do the most is say NO to people who consider themselves extremely good."). It is used to refuse "'an offer he can't refuse.'":https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Godfather#Cultural_influence_and_legacy

[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese light cruiser [i]Kitakami[/i]. Character design by [[Shibafu (glock23)|]], voiced by [[Ootsubo Yuka]].

She has [[long_hair|long]] [[black hair]] with the back in a long [[braid]], and [[purple eyes]]. Her personality goes all over the place. Sometimes, she's a genuinely nice girl; other times, "she trolls":/pools/7431 [[Abukuma (Kancolle)|]]. She often expresses her annoyance with the destroyers. She is likes to boast of her abilities, such as referring herself as "Super Kitakami-sama" after remodeling.

The nature of her relationship with [[Ooi (Kancolle)|]] varies but they are usually very close to each other. In some versions, Kitakami is straight while Ooi is a lesbian, and Kitakami has to repeatedly shred Ooi's delusions. In others, they're a romantic couple. payload.body:
Character from [[Umamusume]], voiced by [[Yano Hinaki]]. 

A cheerful and energetic girl who innocently takes up any challenges. She looks up to [[Tokai Teio (Umamusume)|]] and idolizes her. Her general motif is based on Japanese [[festival]]s. In the anime, she was a supporting character during Season 2. She would later become the protagonist of Season 3 and a member of Team Spica.

She is most infamous for her "SSR Support Speed card":[https://gametora.com/umamusume/supports/30028-kitasan-black] (see post #9671126). Given how early in the game's lifespan it was released, it was one of the best cards in the game and stayed that way for a very long time, thanks to her massive Specialty Priority rating at higher levels.

The original horse's name wasn't named because he had a black or brown coat (he was a simple bay), but rather after his sire, [[Black Tide (racehorse)|]], an older full brother to the much more successful [[Deep Impact (racehorse)|]].

payload.body:
The world's premier [[Virtual YouTuber|VTuber]]. She uploads a variety of videos to her YouTube channel, the A.I. Channel, in a similar format to other popular YouTubers. She's produced by activ8 under their [[Kizuna AI Inc.]] autonomous subsidiary.

Her character designer is [[Morikura En]], while her [[voice actor]] was kept a secret (until April 24, 2020 when it was revealed that [spoiler]Kasuga Nozomi[/spoiler] was her "voice model"). She made her debut with the video [i]"Creating A Twitter account!":[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EoPFGj3uuYo][/i] on November 29, 2016. Her 3D model is available for "download":[http://kizunaai.com/download-page/] from her official website. 

She describes herself as a 16 year-old super intelligent A.I. that is curious about humans. As the sole resident of an endless white void, she finds human life fascinating, and wishes to use her channel to learn more about them. In a "live stream":[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C3Fx-9s9Y68] celebrating a new subscriber milestone, Kizuna Ai gave her impression of her own three-sizes: 83-56-81.

On February 26, 2022, Kizuna Ai went on an indefinite hiatus following a final [i]hello, world[/i] virtual concert. At the final live, an [[kizuna no allele|anime project]] and a [[CeVIO]] voicebank ([[KZN (cevio)|]]) based on her were announced. Exactly 3 years later, on February 26, 2025, she announced "the resumption of her activities":https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j53m3DSqhKo.

Kizuna has had an immense amount of game collabs, including an appearance as a shipgirl in [[Azur Lane]], an unlockable [[Fall Guy]] skin in [[Fall Guys]], and an appearance as a playable pilot in [[Super Mecha Champions]]. activ8 has also ensured she had collaborations with crypto ventures, such as Otaku Coin and Japanese metaverse/NFT project METAANI, as well as previously having talked about Bitcoin, which is met with mild controversy among anti-crypto crowds.

payload.body:
Stage 4 midboss of [[Touhou]]'s [[Embodiment of Scarlet Devil]] who lives in the [[Scarlet Devil Mansion]], often seen in the [[Voile]] [[Library]]. Her name literally translates to "Little Demon", leading to some ambiguity whether or not it is her real name.

It is generally assumed by the majority of fans that Koakuma is [[Patchouli Knowledge|Patchouli]]'s summoned familiar and personal assistant, as she is rarely seen outside of the library unless accompanying the magician, and served as Patchouli's midboss in EoSD. She's also frequently depicted as a succubus in fanworks, despite [[ZUN]] calling her more of an imp and her exact species being unknown. Unused sprites in the EoSD game files include a possible "EX-Koakuma" with violet hair and a purple arcane aura, which might have been meant to appear alongside Patchouli during the Extra Stage midboss fight.

In [[Whispered Oracle of Hakurei Shrine]], her ability has been revealed as "capable of finding target book in an instant", which can be interpreted as she listens to the books' "whispers/sounds" and triangulates their location like some kind of bat sonar. In the same work, It is also states that she is like a magical creature similar to [[Patchouli Knowledge|Patchouli]] and the various fairies, which is in line with [[ZUN]]'s definition of "Devil":[https://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Devil], where he describes them as 'large species that can include vampires and magicians among other similar things'.

She has [[red eyes]], [[long hair|long]] [[red hair]], [[black wings|black]] [[demon wings]] on her [[head wings|head]] and back, and occasionally has a [[demon tail]] too. Her outfit is a [[collared shirt|collared]] [[white shirt]] with [[long sleeves]], a [[red necktie]], a [[skirt set|matching]] [[black vest]] and [[black skirt|skirt]], either [[white socks]] or [[black pantyhose]], and [[black shoes|black]] [[mary janes]].

payload.body:
The "Human of the Worshipped Wind". Stage 5 boss of [[Touhou]]'s [[Mountain of Faith]] and later a recurring playable character. Has the power to create miracles.

She is the miko of the [[Moriya Shrine]] under the patronage of [[Yasaka Kanako]] and also direct descendant of the shrine's original deity, [[Moriya Suwako]]. Sanae and her deities moved into [[Gensokyo]] due to waning faith of humans from the outside world, making her one of the only humans from the 21st century. Recent games in the main series as well as certain side works consider her a type of deity in her own right.

She has [[long hair|long]] [[green hair]], with a [[single sidelock]]. Her eyes are [[green eyes|green]] or [[blue eyes|blue]]. In her hair are [[snake hair ornament|snake]] and [[frog hair ornament]]s and a [[single hair tube]]. She is frequently depicted with [[large breasts]]. She wears a [[nontraditional miko]] outfit consisting of a [[sleeveless shirt|sleeveless]] [[collared shirt|collared]] [[white shirt]] (that is sometimes depicted as a [[crop top]]) with [[detached sleeves|detached]] [[wide sleeves|wide]] [[white sleeves]], a [[long skirt|long]] [[frilled skirt|frilled]] [[blue skirt]], [[white socks]], and [[brown shoes]], her signature [[gohei]] is different from the norm as it has straight paper decorations. As of [[Unfinished Dream of All Living Ghost]], she is additionally shown with [[wings]]. Doujins sometimes portray her wearing a modern [[school uniform]] as homage to her origins.

She is a generally good, if somewhat naive and clumsy, girl, but also an "overeager youkai hunter":/pool/show/4639 (leading to her portrayal of frequently bullying [[Tatara Kogasa]] after a scene in [[Undefined Fantastic Object]] where Sanae gave scathing words against the latter).

She is occasionally depicted as a [[retro games sanae (meme)|generation or so behind]] due to [[Mountain of Faith]] first releasing in 2007.

She is sometimes called "[[player 2|2P]] [[Hakurei Reimu|Reimu]]" or "[[Miko]] [[Luigi]]" due to Reimu's red outfit compared to Sanae's green outfit.

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese battleship [i]Kongou[/i]. Character design by [[Konishi (koconatu)|]], voiced by [[Touyama Nao]] (Japanese) and [[Alexis Tipton]] (English).

She has [[purple eyes]], [[long hair|long]] [[brown hair]] bunched into [[double bun|two braided buns]], and an [[ahoge]]. All of the Kongou-class wear a [[nontraditional miko|modified miko]] uniform with differently colored [[hakama short skirt|hakama skirts]] (hers is [[black skirt|black]]), [[thigh boots]], and wear the same signature winged [[hairband]]. 

Being historically constructed in England, she has peculiar speech habits which include using random English words. Her catchphrase (from her speech when firing) is "[[Burning_love_(phrase)|Burning Love!]]" This does not keep her English from being so grammatically incorrect and accented to nearly be incomprehensible.

Her excitable dere-dere nature and frequent demands for attention from the [[Admiral (Kancolle)|]] lead her to being portrayed as being "protago-sexual" in fan works, falling in love with anyone who is the protagonist of a series. Her openness and one of her lines, "Hey! Admiral! [[It's OK to touch]], but there's a time and place for everything," has earned its own tag.

She is an avid drinker of [[black tea]], sometimes to the point of being addicted to the stuff (see pool #7461).

payload.body:
The second and third remodels of [[Kantai Collection]]'s [[Kongou (kancolle)|]].

For her second remodeling, this new form revamps her costume and rig and modifies her hairband (the "wings" are now [[radar]]s, the band itself is now fully gold/brass instead of a gold/brass and black pattern). This is the most obvious change if she is not depicted with her rigging as her [[nontraditional miko]] outfit remains unchanged. 

More than 5 years later, she obtained her third remodel, termed Kai Ni C (or Hei). This form revamps her costume and rig further and takes advantage of Konishi's art style evolution as well as given cues from other Konishi ships. The most notable features are her boots (similar to the Shoukaku-class Kai Ni), her headband (more intricate), her jacket (now collared) and sleeves (back to being attached to her top) as well as her rig (more detailed for the HD/HTML5 era and features some [[torpedo tubes]]).

payload.body:
The "Half-Human Half-Phantom". Stage 5 boss of [[Touhou]]'s [[Perfect Cherry Blossom]] and later a recurring playable character.

Gardener of [[Hakugyokurou]], the netherworld pagoda, and bodyguard of its "princess", [[Saigyouji Yuyuko]]. She [[holding sword|wields]] a [[katana]], Roukanken, and a [[wakizashi]], Hakurouken. Youmu specializes in rapid swordplay taught by her predecessor [[Konpaku Youki|Youki]]. She is always followed by [[Konpaku Youmu (ghost)|her phantom half]], which floats beside her. Ironically, although she is half-phantom, she is terrified of ghosts.

She is nicknamed [[myon (phrase)|"Myon"]] in many fanworks, based on a nonsensical word she muttered back in "PCB Extra Story":[https://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Perfect_Cherry_Blossom/Story/Extra_Story]. 

She has [[short hair|short]] [[grey hair]] and either [[blue eyes|blue]], [[green eyes|green]], or [[red eyes]] inconsistently. Her outfit is a [[black hairband]] [[bow hairband|with]] a [[black bow]], a [[collared shirt|collared]] [[white shirt]] with [[puffy short sleeves]], a [[black bowtie]], a [[green vest]] and a [[skirt set|matching]] [[frilled skirt|frilly]] [[green skirt|skirt]], [[white socks]], and [[black shoes|black]] [[mary janes]].

A character from the series [[Girls und Panzer]].

Driver of Team [[Turtle]] in a [[Panzer 38(t)]] ([tn]later upgraded to a [[Jagdpanzer 38(t)]][/tn]) on the "Ooarai Girls Academy":[#dtext-see-also] tankery team. Also Vice President of the student council.

Her name is based on the citrus fruit [[yuzu (fruit)|yuzu]], and is fruit-based like the other members of the student council.

Voiced by [[Takahashi Mikako]] "[1]":[#dtext-external-links].

[expand=Official Character Bio]

h6. Original Anime

The gentle Vice President of the Student Council. It feels like she's being manipulated quite a bit by the President and Kawashima. Everyone admires her big boobs. Is a senior.

[tn]Source: post #1283992[/tn]

h6. Das Finale

Affiliated with the Ooarai Girls Academy tankery team. Team Turtle's driver. Former Student Council Vice President. A competent right-hand, she fills in on the management of the Student Council for Anzu who usually does nothing. With a surprising aptitude for maneuvering tanks, in the Pravda battle of the 63rd Tournament she outmaneuvered a large amount of T-34 tanks, helping to destroy their enemies with point-blank firings.

[tn]Source: "[2]":[#dtext-external-links][/tn]

h6. Operation More Love Love

The (former) Vice-president who supports Anzu. Has a gentle personality and is often bossed around by Anzu, who starts things on a whim, and Momo, who is like an instant water heater. Nevertheless, she is an indisputable member of the student council, dealing with intruders from other schools and handling various practical matters.

[tn]Source: "[3]":[#dtext-external-links][/tn]

payload.body:
Alter Ego-class Servant seen in [[Fate/Grand Order]]. She is originally introduced as Tamamo Vitch, one of the [[Tamamo Nine]]. [[Shi Huang Di (fate)|]] also calls her "Da Ji", a Chinese figure who ruined dynasties.

Koyanskaya actually has no True Name to speak of, and is entirely unrelated to either the Tamamo Nine or Da Ji. Koyanskaya is "the Tunguska event given form", the embodiment of the thoughts of animals persecuted by mankind, and chose to manifest in the Saint Graph of [[Tamamo no Mae (Fate)|]] due to their shared attribute of being a "beast that is supposed to live for revenge against humans." She likens herself to "the Tamamo no Mae from another world," considering Tamamo to be her original, but she's not actually Tamamo nor is she part of the Tamamo Nine.

She was given the name Yaskaya by the manifested Heroic Spirit [[dobrynya nikitich (fate)|Dobrynya Nikitich]], which she later mistakenly remembered as Koyanskaya. This is an allusion to the Shinto goddess [[Konohanasakuya-hime (mythology)|]], to which Koyanskaya has no relation whatsoever.

When she was defeated in her Beast form, she split into two distinct but similar fragments, Koyanskaya of Light and Koyanskaya of Darkness, in a contrast akin to [[yin yang|yin and yang]].

She has been released as an Assassin class Servant in Fate/Grand Order under the name "Koyanskaya of Light", and shortly afterwards as a Foreigner class Servant under the name "Koyanskaya of Darkness".

[b]Character Design:[/b] [[Wada Arco]]
[b]Voice Actress:[/b] [[Saitou Chiwa]]

[b]Kris[/b], known as [b]Crys[/b] (クリス) in Japan, is a character introduced in [i][[pokemon|Pokémon]] [[pokemon gold/silver/crystal|Crystal]][/i]. She is the first female playable character in the series.

[quote]
Utilizing her deep knowledge of Pokémon on her journey, she looks out for all Pokémon and treats them with love. She is known for her kind personality.
[/quote]

Her [[Pokemon Adventures]] counterpart is named [b]Crystal[/b] and is one of the main protagonists in the [i]GSC chapter[/i] and the [i]HGSS chapter[/i]. She is distinguished from her game counterpart by her [[star earrings]] and sometimes wearing a [[lab coat]]. [[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese light cruiser [i]Kuma[/i]. Character design by [[Ugume]], voiced by [[Sakura Ayane]]. 

She has [[long_hair|long]] [[brown hair]] with a [[huge ahoge|huge]] zizag [[ahoge]], and [[brown eyes]]. Her default outfit, shared with Tama and Kiso, is composed of a [[white shirt]] with light [[blue sailor collar]], [[red neckerchief]], [[white shorts]], and [[grey footwear|grey]] [[rudder footwear]]. 

Her [[rigging]] consists of her real-life bridge, foremast, and funnels to her back, 14 cm gun mounts on the rig, and two 61 cm twin [[torpedo tubes]] on her ankles.

As "Kuma" means "bear" and her catchphrase is "kuma", which she almost always appends to the end of her sentences, she is often depicted with [[bear]]-like qualities or dressed in a [[bear costume]]. She is most often paired with her younger sisters, especially [[Tama (Kancolle)|]]. Additionally, there's a joke about the "Kuma Fleet", which also includes [[Abukuma (kancolle)|]], [[Chikuma (kancolle)|]], [[Kumano (kancolle)|]], [[Mikuma (kancolle)|]] and occasionally [[Noshiro (kancolle)|]] (see post #1543570).

Kuma was last of her class to be given her [[Kuma Kai Ni (Kancolle)|Kai Ni]] second remodels. She is sometimes grouped with [[Tenryuu (Kancolle)|]] and [[Shiratsuyu (Kancolle)|]] who also received their second remodels before being remodeled themselves.

payload.body:
One of the main characters from [[Hunter x Hunter]].

A Blacklist Hunter and member of the Kurta Clan, being the only remaining member so far, Kurapika vows to avenge his fallen clan by destroying the Phantom Troupe after the latter massacred his clan for their "Scarlet Eyes", thus being his ultimate goal in becoming a Hunter.

He is usually calm, smart, and reticent, but becomes more wrathful and callous when threatened, attributing to his tragic past. This makes him impulsive sometimes, despite doing so for the sake of protecting his friends and avenging his clan.

Voiced by [[Hidaka Noriko]] (Pilot OVA), [[Kaida Yuki]] (1999), [[Sawashiro Miyuki]] (2011), and [[Erika Harlacher]] (2011; EN).

Kurapika has an [[androgynous]] appearance. He is a short [[blonde hair|blonde haired]] young man with [[brown eyes]] which turn [[red eyes|scarlet red]] in some occasions. His outfit is usually a [[tabard]] with reddish hem and a white [[white shirt|shirt]] and [[white pants|pants]]. His footwear is a blue-colored [[flats]].

[b]Major Kusanagi Motoko[/b] is the main character of the [[Ghost In The Shell]] [[cyberpunk]] series.

Major Kusanagi is the serious and very competent squad leader of [[police|Public Security Section 9's counter-terrorist and anti-crime unit]].

The Major is a full body [[cyborg]] with [[short hair with long locks]]. Her hair color changes from series to series; from [[blue hair|blue]] in the original manga (and [i]Arise[/i]), [[black hair|black]] in the movies, to [[purple hair|purple]] in [i]S.A.C.[/i] Her eye color also changes, being [[blue eyes|blue]] (movies), [[green eyes|green]] or [[red eyes|red]] depending on the show. She is often seen wearing a [[pink leotard]] with [[pink thighhighs]], [[black bodysuit|battle armor]], or a yellow [[police uniform]].

The Major is also an expert in systems hacking, infiltration, [[close-quarters combat]], [[martial arts]], and is extremely proficient with many types of ballistic weapons.

payload.body:
"I want you to make contracts with me and become Magical Girls!" - Kyubey, Madoka Magica episode 1

Also known by [i]QB[/i] or [spoiler]"Incubator"[/spoiler], Kyubey is one of the main characters [spoiler]and later revealed as the main antagonist[/spoiler] from [[Mahou Shoujo Madoka Magica]].

They are a "Messenger of Magic" (魔法の使者 mahou no shisha) who grants the wishes of young girls, but in exchange contracts their services as Puella Magi (魔法少女, mahou shoujo, lit. Magical Girls). Girls who form a contract with them are tasked to defeat [[Witch (madoka magica)|]]es -- bizarre entities that feed upon the hopes and dreams of normal people.

[spoiler]However, unbeknownst to the Magical Girls, Witches were actually a corrupted form of Magical Girls who were either killed in battle or eventually have their [[Soul Gem]] tainted over time and transforms into [[Grief Seed]] after consecutive encounters with Witches. Kyubey intentionally withheld this specific detail to create a millennia of cycle of war between Magical Girls and Witches in order to harvest the magical energy of these clashes for the benefit of their race. Their indifference to death and suffering upon the revelation of this fact upon [[Kaname Madoka]] has led to fans creating numerous hate arts subjecting them to various physical abuses.[/spoiler]

Kyubey is a four legged, white, fox-like [[alien]] with round [[red eyes]], and the unchanging facial expression [[:3|/人◕ ‿‿ ◕人\]]. Appearance and name share an affinity with [[kyuubi]].

Voiced by [[Katou Emiri]] (Japanese) and [[Cassandra Lee Morris]] (English).

payload.body:
An [[alien]] weapon in the [[Neon Genesis Evangelion]] series.

In the Gospel of John, an unnamed soldier, known traditionally as Longinus, pierced [[Jesus]]'s side with his spear to ensure he was dead. The account given in John purports that blood and water (cf. 1 John 5:6-8) came immediately (John 19:34). Relics purported to be the spear with which Longinus pierced Jesus have appeared since the sixth century.

The manga/anime series [[Neon Genesis Evangelion]] depicts the Spear of Longinus as a colossal [[bident]] and as the only object that can penetrate the [[at_field|A.T. Field]] of an [[angel_(evangelion)|Angel]]. [spoilers]It is revealed later in the series that the lance was built by the same advanced aliens who created the Angels as a way to control them.[/spoilers]

Born in a rural part north of Sumeru City, Layla is a student in the Akademiya's Rtawhaist Darshan, who specializes in theoretical astrology. She suffers from a chronic sleep condition that leaves her perpetually sleepy, but doesn't allow her to sleep well at night.

She has [[yellow eyes]], [[pointy ears]], and [[long hair|long]] [[blue hair]] with [[drill sidelocks]]. She wears a [[blue hood]] and [[white pantyhose]]. Her clothing is black and blue with [[gold trim]] accents.

Her [[Vision (genshin impact)|]] element is Cryo, and she wields a [[sword]] in battle.

payload.body:
One of the main characters of the [[Resident Evil]] series, debuting in [[Resident Evil 2]].

[b]Leon Scott Kennedy[/b] is a rookie cop assigned in Raccoon Police Department (R.P.D.). In 1998, Leon would later meet [[Claire Redfield]] and arrive together in Raccoon City. Realizing the chaos brought by the outbreak, the two became separated and arrive at the city's police station to seek shelter. The two arrived at the precinct for their own purposes as they find for possible ways to escape the city as the station was also swarmed by the undead.

After the events of Raccoon City, Leon departs and was apprehended by the US military, eventually becoming a STRATCOM agent alongside with a fellow agent, [[Jack Krauser]].

Leon is a tall man with [[blonde hair|blonde]] or [[brown hair|brown]] [[curtained hair]] and [[blue eyes]]. His clothing varies throughout the series, but he generally wears a [[police uniform]] with the "R.P.D." logo printed on his vest, or casual clothing with a dark jacket.

payload.body:
The "Leftover of Winter". Stage 1 boss of [[Touhou]]'s [[Perfect Cherry Blossom]].

A seasonal yuki onna in control of cold, leading to her doujin portrayal as friends with [[Cirno]]. She is only visible during winter, but her status on other times of the year is debatable (either she melts or hibernates somewhere). She is infamous, however, for her large [[hitbox]], which led to jokes about her being [[fat]] and her pictures with a [[curvy]] or [[plump]] figure and [[large breasts]]. The ornament often drawn on her chest is a [[lapel pin]], and closely resembles the alchemic symbol for silver.

h4. Appearance

[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Italian destroyer [i]Libeccio[/i]. Character design by [[Jiji (Aardvark)|]], voiced by [[Kitou Akari]].

She has [[long hair|long]] [[brown hair]] in [[twintails]], [[brown eyes]] and [[tan]]ned skin. Her default outfit is the class' uniform: a [[sleeveless]] [[white dress|white]] [[sailor dress]] with her real-life hull code, striped [[red neckerchief]] with an [[anchor]] clip, and [[rudder footwear]]. 

Her [[rigging]] consists of her real-life funnel and foremast to her back, connecting her two 53.3 cm triple [[torpedo tubes]] and 120 mm twin gun mounts, [[paravane]]s on [[thigh strap]]s, and her real-life fire control director as a [[mini hat]]. 

The historical [i]Libeccio[/i] was assigned in 1941 to escort a convoy bound for Libya when the convoy was attacked. She escaped damage and attempted to pick up survivors of the destroyed convoy but was torpedoed on her stern by a Royal Navy submarine, later sinking under tow. This explains her moderate damage voice lines and repair lines where she doesn't like being hit in the same area.

payload.body:
Single strands of hair that are drawn out of place, separated from the rest of the hair.

Sometimes, this is an element of [[messy hair]] or [[floating hair]] where a clean hairstyle is disrupted, but can also appear on the periphery of otherwise orderly hair, or in front of a character's face, as with many cases where a [[hair in own mouth|strand of hair is stuck to one's mouth]], or ahead of the bulk of the hair as a distinct loose stroke.

Note that this tag is only for single strands of hair, these will be usually drawn in a single stroke, either in black, white, or a shade of the color of the hair.  It is [b]not[/b] for bundles, spikes, wedges, or clumps of hair. It is [b]not [/b]for [[ahoge]], [[antenna hair]], [[cowlick]]s, [[sidelocks]], or the like. For those, be sure to include the appropriate tag. If a bit of hair has a distinct border of another color, or a significant width or taper, it is almost certainly not applicable for this tag.

Although they might be drawn similarly, this is also [b]not[/b] for [[stray pubic hair]], or [[body hair]].

Note that this phenomenon is often very hard or impossible to see in thumbnails, be cautious when gardening this tag.

h4. Examples

* !post #7020568
* !post #9178468

h4. See also

* [[lone nape hair]]
* [[tag group:hair]]

One of the two possible protagonists in [[Genshin Impact]], and the [[twins|twin]] [[brother and sister|sister]] of [[Aether (Genshin Impact)|]]. Voiced by [[Yuuki Aoi]] in Japanese. If chosen as the player character, she is referred to in-game by the name set by the player or as [b]Traveler[/b] by most people in Teyvat. If not chosen as the player character, she is instead the leader of the Abyss Order.

She has [[yellow eyes]] and [[short hair|short]] [[blonde hair]] with [[short hair with long locks|long locks]] and [[hair flower]]s. She wears a [[white dress|white]], [[high-low dress|high-low]] [[halter dress]] with a [[white overskirt|white]] [[overskirt]], a [[collared cape]], and [[white boots|white]] [[thigh boots]].

Her name is [b]Lumine[/b] in English, [b]Yíng[/b] (荧, meaning "luminous") in Chinese and [b]Hotaru[/b] (蛍, meaning "firefly") in Japanese. In Teyvat, her true name is only used by her brother. She is often paired with [[Firefly (honkai: star rail)|]] from [[Honkai: Star Rail]], whose name is also localized as "Hotaru" in Japanese.

payload.body:
A playable character from [[League of Legends]]. She is the younger sister of [[garen_(league_of_legends)|Garen Crownguard]].

[b]Luxanna Crownguard[/b] hails from Demacia, an insular realm where magical abilities are viewed with fear and suspicion. Able to bend light to her will, she grew up dreading discovery and exile, and was forced to keep her power secret in order to preserve her family's noble status. Nonetheless, Lux's optimism and resilience have led her to embrace her unique talents, and she now seeks to bring greater tolerance and understanding to her homeland.

In-game, Lux is a long-range mage who can lock down her enemies from a distance, shield her allies, or blast the opposition down with her spells.

Character in [[Fire Emblem: Three Houses]] and member of the [[Golden Deer (fire emblem)|]]. She makes an appearance in the spin-off game [[Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes]].

She has [[long_hair|long]] [[white hair]], [[pink eyes]], and is [[flat_chest|flat-chested]].

She is a hardworking girl with a no-nonsense attitude who has a desire to improve her abilities. Being the youngest student at 15-years-old, she dislikes being treated like a child and can be impatient with those who annoy her. Despite wanting to look independent and mature, she has an intense fear of ghosts and is an avid lover of sweets, especially cake.

In-game, Lysithea is a very potent mage with unparalleled offensive power, but she has terrible defenses. She is often considered a "Glass Cannon" character, able to annihilate all but the toughest of opponents.

Remarkably, she ended in the Top 2 of the 2020's edition of "Choose Your Legends":[https://vote4.campaigns.fire-emblem-heroes.com/en-US/results] (women's side), making her the first non-main character to get a Brave unit in [[Fire Emblem Heroes]].

payload.body:
An American-designed 5.56×45mm NATO [[assault rifle]], developed in 1957 by Eugene Stoner at ArmaLite and based on his previous [[AR-10]] design. The [[rifle]] had initial bad notoriety due to the original design's tendency to jam with dirt or in some weather conditions and different ammunition powder types. The M16 is still regarded effective thanks to its low weight, low recoil and high accuracy.

It has been the standard weapon of the US [[military]] since 1964, and has been partially replaced by the [[M4 Carbine]]. Visually distinguishable by its triangular front sight and integrated carrying handle containing rear sight, although newer variants sport removable units. 

This tag is for M16-type rifles used in military or police-related context. For the civilian-legal counterpart, see [[AR-15]].

payload.body:
[b]Makoto[/b] ([i][b]まこと[/b][/i]) is a character in the [[Street Fighter]] series. She first appeared in [[street_fighter_iii_(series)|Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike]] and is voiced by Makoto Tsumura. She is a playable character in the game [[street_fighter_iv_(series)|Super Street Fighter IV]].

Makoto is a young Japanese girl, trained in Rindoukan karate. Her karate style is very similar to that of Shotokan karate. Although having little fashion sense for a girl her age, she still hates it when she is mistaken for a boy. She develops something of a rivalry with kunoichi [[Ibuki (street fighter)|Ibuki]], as shown by their alternate opening when they fight each other.

Since her father's death, Makoto's dojo has been floundering and her older brother decided to become a businessman, leaving Makoto to elevate her dojo back to its former glory. Horrified to discover the decrepit state the dojo is in, she first enters S.I.N.'s tournament in Super Street Fighter IV in order to win money to renovate it. During the tournament, she encounters and fights [[Fei Long]] in the hopes that the publicity will enhance Rindo-kan's reputation. Apparently she is the overall tournament winner - as her win quote against [[seth (street fighter)|Seth]] is the only one that says the character has become the tournament champ, and in her ending she says that she "beats the pants off" of all her opponents - however she didn't win any money since the tournament sponsor, Seth, was killed and S.I.N. disbanded. She decides to rebuild her fathers dojo by hand, and make money the old-fashioned way.

Ultimately, she finds [[ryu (street fighter)|Ryu]] in 3rd Strike and challenges him to enhance her dojo's reputation. After her fight with Ryu, the publicity attracts a swarm of potential students to her dojo. Unfortunately, she enforces the rather counterproductive policy of rejecting aspiring students who are unable to defeat her first, and thus far none have.

Her default outfit consists of a [[pink shirt|pink]] [[collared shirt]], long [[blue skirt]], [[white apron|white]] [[kappougi]], [[white socks]], and [[grey sandals|grey]] [[rudder footwear]]. 

Her [[rigging]] is a hull piece to her back containing her funnel, foremast, bridge, and crane.

Notable in real life to be the [i]real[/i] idol of the Imperial Japanese Navy at the time, due to the ship's massive food and sweets production boosting the morale of many naval personnel. The US Navy at the time deemed her and [i][[akashi (kancolle)|Akashi]][/i] to be high priority targets, and as such she was frequently escorted by destroyers during the war.

Character in [[Fire Emblem: Three Houses]] and member of the [[Golden Deer (fire emblem)|]].

She has [[blue hair]] typically worn with a [[crown braid]], [[brown eyes]], and [[large breasts]]. She is commonly depicted with [[bags under eyes]] and a shadow over her face before the time skip. After the time skip when she is older, these go away.

She has low self-esteem and dislikes talking to people. However, [[hilda_valentine_goneril|Hilda]] is generally depicted as her only friend. She's also fond of animals, in particular horses.

[spoilers]Her low self-esteem is caused by her blood carrying the Crest of the Beast, belonging to a hero who was long lost to history, which promises contempt for those who bear it. It corresponds to the tarot of the Devil, who is also commonly known as "the Beast". She is acutely aware of this and keeps it a secret. As a result, she is deeply religious.[/spoiler]

Remarkably, she ended in the Top 1 of the 2021's edition of "Choose Your Legends":[https://vote5.campaigns.fire-emblem-heroes.com/en-us] (women's side), making her the first non-main character to win the event, alongside the [[Gatekeeper_(fire_emblem)|]].

payload.body:
A [[Touhou]] character (alt. spelling Maribel Han, or Maryberry Hearn; usually shortened to just Merry).

One of the main protagonists of ZUN's Music Collection. She is a psychology major living in the [[kyoto|outside world]] with the ability to see borders of any kind, including the one that separates our world from [[Gensokyo]]. She is the other member of the Hifuu Club and, together with her friend [[Usami Renko]], dedicates themselves to the secret purpose of finding a way into [[Gensokyo]].

Specializing in relative psychology, Maribel sees things more relatively and subjectively than her friend.

She usually dresses in [[purple dress|purple]] and wears a [[mob cap|white mob cap]]. Her eyes are most commonly depicted as either [[yellow eyes|yellow]] or [[purple eyes|purple]].

Due to Maribel and [[Yakumo Yukari]] both having boundary-related abilities, as well as a degree of visual resemblance, fan theories abound about a possible connection between them, with some even going so far as to suggest that they are somehow the same person - the most common theory being that Maribel somehow cast herself backwards in time and ultimately aged into Yukari as she returned to her original era "the long way". [[ZUN]]'s own comments on the pair pointed fans towards the writer [[Lafcadio Hearn]], who moved to Japan and was naturalized with the name Koizumi Yakumo.

payload.body:
[[splatoon_(series)|Splatoon]] character. Named [b]Hotaru[/b] in the Japanese version. She is an [[inkling]].

She is part of an [[idol]] group known as Squid Sisters (Sea O' Colors in the Japanese release) with the other member being her [[cousins|cousin]] [[Callie (splatoon)|]]. She and Callie are also both news program hostesses that announce in-game news.

She wears a green and black-themed outfit matching Callie's and wears a food cup on her head. Other features of this default costume & appearance include [[bow-shaped hair]] and a [[detached collar|detached]] [[white collar]]. In general she is usually depicted with a [[mole under eye|mole under her eye]], [[thick eyebrows]] and [[star-shaped pupils]].

Her canonical [[list of weapons in splatoon|weapon]] class of choice are Chargers. [[Splatoon 3: Side Order]] reveals she mainly uses the [[Splat Charger (splatoon)|]] via her Palette.


Often drawn with a more melancholic expression compared to her cousin. 

Her Japanese name comes from the Japanese word for the "firefly squid":http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Watasenia_scintillans (蛍烏賊/ホタルイカ [i]Hotaru-ika[/i]) and their band's name in Japanese is a portmanteau of "shiokara" (a Japanese food made out of various marine animals, commonly squid) and "colors". She and Callie's names in English are a play on the word calamari.

[b]Mario[/b] is the main protagonist of the [[Mario (series)|]] series, the mascot of [[Nintendo]], and basically the video game equivalent of [[Mickey Mouse]]. 

Mario is normally a [[plumber]], but in games, he uses his legendary [[jumping]] and combat abilities to defend the inhabitants of the usually peaceful Mushroom World from power-hungry villains such as [[Bowser]]. During most of his adventures, he often teams up with his brother [[Luigi]] and their partner [[Yoshi]] for extra support, as they are the only two characters he fully trusts to help him. When not adventuring, Mario participates in a variety of [[playing sports|sporting events]] and even works as one of his alter-egos, [[Dr. Mario]].

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese army submarine Maru-Yu. Character designed by [[Kuuro Kuro]], voiced by [[Noto Mamiko]]. 

She is portrayed with [[parted_bangs|parted]] [[short_hair|short]] [[black hair]] and [[brown eyes]]. Her default outfit consists of a [[white one-piece swimsuit]] with a red encircled "yu" printed on it, [[diving mask]], and a [[flotation belt]]. Carries a transport container in her left hand and an [[FP-45 Liberator]] [[handgun]]. 

Historically, the Maru-Yu submarines were of a highly unusual design, and initial tests failed to get the prototype Maru-Yus to actually submerge, causing many Maru-Yu jokes to involve her only managing to get her head underwater while her legs still flail above water.  [[kiso (kancolle)|Kiso]] was nearby in the test runs, and Kiso's crew made jokes about the Maru-Yu's strange shape, causing some artists to treat Kiso as some sort of senpai to Maru-Yu because of it.

[b]Mash Kyrielight[/b] (also romanized as Matthew or Mashu) is a female character from [[Fate/Grand Order]] of the Shielder class. She is a Demi-Servant, a human fused with a Heroic Spirit.

She works at the Chaldea Security Organization, and she is the first person the protagonist, [[Fujimaru Ritsuka]], sees when he/she wakes up in Chaldea.

She has [[short hair|short]], [[purple hair]] which [[hair over one eye|covers her right eye]], [[purple eyes]] and [[medium breasts|medium]]-to-[[large breasts]]. When not in her servant form, she wears a [[necktie]], [[black dress]], [[jacket]], [[black pantyhose]] and [[glasses]]. In her servant form, she wears an [[armored dress]] and carries an enormous [[shield]], Lord Chaldeas (named by [[Olga Marie Animusphere]]). Later in the story it is revealed that [spoiler]the shield is in fact [[Lord Camelot (fate)|]], [[Galahad (Fate)|]]'s Noble Phantasm.[/spoiler]

Her design is based on [[Tachie (fate)|]], an unused character concept originally developed for [[Fate/stay night]] that was later published in [[Fate/unpublished material]].

payload.body:
[b]The Ultimate, Absolute Secret God[/b]

[[Touhou]] character introduced as the stage 6 boss and extra stage boss in [[Hidden Star in Four Seasons]].

She has [[long hair|long]], [[blonde hair|blonde]] hair and [[yellow eyes]]. She wears a [[tabard]] with [[constellation print]] accompanied by a [[green skirt]] and [[boots]]. Her clothes feature [[long sleeves|long]] and [[wide sleeves|wide]] sleeves. Her Stage 6 portrait depicts her suspending a [[drum]] in [[floating object|midair]] while [[sitting]] on a [[chair]]; [[Touhou Sangetsusei]] subsequently depicts her sitting in a [[wheelchair]]. She is also depicted with a flaming [[aura]]. Her [[hat]] has three points.

Okina is a hidden god with a wide range of public faces, those being an Earth mother goddess, a god of noh, a god of stars, a god of silkworm breeding, a god of hindrances, a god of discriminated peoples, et cetera. As one of the Sages of Gensoukyou, she protects Gensoukyou from the Outside World. Her servants are [[Teireida Mai]] and [[Nishida Satono]]. She is based on Matarajin, a Japanese Buddhist deity of the Tendai school. Her abilities let her create doors on the back of anything, hence she is sometimes depicted in fanworks with [[door]]s.

She bears a striking resemblance to [[Junko (touhou)|]] from [[Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom]], and her abilities and position are similar to those of [[Yakumo Yukari]].

Matarajin is sometimes conflated with Hata no Kawakatsu (alluded to in-game via her comments on [[Eternity Larva]] and her status as a God of Noh), which has led some fanworks to depict Okina as being close to [[Toyosatomimi no Miko]] and [[Hata no Kokoro]].

payload.body:
Character from [[Umamusume]].

The fortune-telling [[horse girl]] with a really long name (read as [i]Machikane Fukukitaru[/i]), Matikanefukukitaru is obsessed with fortune and luck and collects a wild range of lucky charms. The other horse girls (and humans at times) often consult her with their luck as well. She often refers to a "Shiraoki-sama" as if they were a [[shinto]] deity (and indeed, a horse named Shiraoki is the real life horse's fifth generation mare line ancestor).

Her name, when read as a whole, roughly means "Good fortune comes to those who wait".

The real life horse's romanized name was originally intended to be "Machikane Fukukitaru", but it was shortened to "Matikanefukukitaru" (the [[Kunreishiki]] version) because the international rules for racehorse names specify a maximum of 18 characters when the name is written in Latin script. Here, Machikane/Matikane is a [i]kanmei[/i] and many of the owner's horses have limit-filling names like these (See [[Matikanetannhauser (umamusume)|]] as well).

Voiced by [[Nitta Hiyori]].

A character from [[Fate/Zero]].

He has [[short hair|short]] [[black hair]] with an [[ahoge]], but after being infected with the Matou crest worms, his hair changes to [[white hair|white]]. He wears a blue [[hoodie]] and a black [[turtleneck sweater]].

Kariya is the white sheep of the Matou family and the first in many generations to have any real talent for magecraft. However, due to his disgust with his family he severed ties with them ten years prior, earning him the ire of family head [[Matou Zouken|Zouken Matou]]. Kariya has loved [[Tohsaka Aoi|Aoi Tohsaka]] since they were childhood friends, so upon seeing [[Tohsaka Tokiomi|Tokiomi Tohsaka]] apparently abandoning [[Matou Sakura|one of the girls]] he views almost as his own daughters he vows to protect her. While Kariya has no interest in the Grail, he made a deal with Zouken that should he win the Grail for him, Sakura will be taken from the horrible abuse Zouken intends for her and released back to the Tohsaka family. 

However, despite his noble intentions, Kariya simply lacks the training to participate as an equal and is inflicted with parasitic worms that will boost his abilities in exchange for rapidly degrading his health. Making matters worse, Zouken forces him to summon [[Berserker (Fate/Zero)|a Berserker class Servant]], all previously summoned examples of which have killed their Masters either directly or through the staggering power they consume in battle. Berserker and Kariya cannot interact directly due to Berserker's madness, but Kariya can issue orders, and sometimes glimpses Berserker's thoughts while sleeping, though these only disturb him.

payload.body:
[[Fate (series)|]] series character and one of the main characters in [[Fate/Stay Night]].

She has [[purple eyes]], [[long hair|long]] [[purple hair]], and a [[red ribbon|red]] [[hair ribbon]]. At school she wears the standard [[Homurabara Academy School Uniform]], while her casual clothes are a [[pink shirt]] and a [[yellow skirt|yellow]] [[long skirt]].

In [[Fate/Zero]], Sakura is [[Tohsaka Rin]]'s sister and the younger daughter of [[Tohsaka Tokiomi|Tokiomi]] and [[Tohsaka Aoi|Aoi]]. She was given away to the Matou family because the laws of the mage world prevented Tokiomi from training more than one of his daughters to carry on his family's tradition, and Tokiomi didn't want Sakura's potential to go to waste. However, [[Matou Zouken|Zouken]] is not really training her as a mage but instead putting her through hell. [[Matou Kariya]] made a deal with Zouken to win the Holy Grail in exchange for Sakura's freedom to return to the Tohsaka family, which he fails to do at the end of the series.

In [[Fate/Stay Night]], Sakura is [[Emiya Shirou|Shirou]]'s timid underclassman and [[Matou Shinji|Shinji]]'s adopted sister. She has been friends with Shirou since the previous summer when he was injured in an accident and she began visiting him with the excuse of taking care of him while he couldn't care for himself. Despite coming from the Matou family, Shinji claims she has been kept in the dark regarding magic as in a traditional magus household only the successor will be taught any magecraft (even though it's later revealed it's a lie and she's [[Medusa (rider) (fate)|Medusa Rider]]'s true master). Though she is respectful of her brother and defends his misconduct, he is in turn an abusive jerk towards her. Further, despite her upbeat attitude with Shirou, she is actually nearly silent and much gloomier when away from the Emiya household or Taiga and has no real friends apart from those two.

In [[Heaven's Feel]], Sakura becomes the love interest of the story and secrets about her life and the Matou family are slowly revealed.

In the [[Fate/Extra]] series, she is [[matou sakura (fate/extra)|reimagined as a new character]]. In [[Fate/Extra CCC]], she created the AI named [[BB (Fate)|BB]], who took her likeness and were assigned to monitor the moon. BB in turn created five Alter Ego servants collectively known as "Sakura Five", which were also modelled after Sakura.

In subsequent installments since [[Fate/Grand Order]], a number of servants (primarily those from the [[Hindu mythology]]) were manifested using Sakura's body as a vessel, therefore sharing her appearance. These servants along with BB and the Sakura Five were later collectively known as "Sakurafaces" by fanbase.

He is the third born son of the Matsuno [[sextuplets]]. Though selfish and a braggart, he is one of the more clever brothers. He is close with his elder brother [[matsuno_osomatsu|Osomatsu]], and often accompanies him on adventures.

In [i][[Osomatsu-san]][/i], he is characterized by his [[tsukkomi]] nature, flippant attitude, and green color. Unlike his brothers, he lacks an [[ahoge]] and also tends to wear [[glasses]]. He is voiced by [[Kamiya Hiroshi]].

payload.body:
[quote]
For a type of [[tree]] called todo-matsu (椴松) in Japanese, use [[sakhalin fir]].
[/quote]

A character from [i][[Osomatsu-kun]][/i] and its spin-offs. His name is a wordplay for the Japanese term of "'in the end'":[http://tangorin.com/general/todonotsumari] and "[[sakhalin fir]]". 

He is the youngest of the Matsuno [[sextuplets]], characterized by his easygoing and carefree attitude. In [i][[Osomatsu-san]][/i], he retains this personality trait, but becomes the socializer of the brothers and gains some feminine characteristics. As a side effect, he has the most luck in talking to women. He tends to be secretive about his life outside the house, and has the most scheming personality out of his siblings due to wanting to elevate his social status.

He is characterized with his large eyes and [[:3]] expression in [i]Osomatsu-san[/i]. He is associated with the color pink.

She is named after "Matua":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Matua_(island)] ([i]Matsuwa[/i] in Japanese), one of the Kuril Islands spread between [[Hokkaido]] and Russia's Kamchatka Peninsula.

[b]May[/b], known as [b]Haruka[/b] in Japan, is the female player character in [i][[pokemon|Pokémon]] [[pokemon ruby/sapphire/emerald|Ruby, Sapphire,]] and [[Pokemon Emerald|Emerald]][/i].

[quote]
May is a cheerful girl and the daughter of Professor Birch from the Hoenn region. She's great at taking care of others and loves cute Pokémon and conducting fieldwork.
[/quote]

In her [[pokemon omega ruby and alpha sapphire|ORAS]] outfit, she has [[grey eyes]] and [[medium hair|medium-length]] [[brown hair]]. She wears an [[orange hairband|orange]] [[bow hairband|hairband]], a [[sleeveless shirt|sleeveless]] [[orange shirt|shirt]], a [[bracelet]], [[bike shorts]] [[bike shorts under shorts|under]] [[white shorts|white]] [[short shorts|shorts]], [[yellow shoes|yellow]] [[shoes]], and a [[green bag|green]] [[fanny pack|belt bag]].

Her [[Pokemon Adventures|Pokémon Adventures]] counterpart is [b]Sapphire[/b] who has [[fangs]], [[sharp fingernails]], [[sharp toenails]] and sports on occasion a [[leaf bikini]] and [[grass skirt]], but mostly during fieldwork and other special occasions. If she doesn't wear a bandana, she sports an [[topknot]], which strongly resembles a [[chasenmage]]. Her hair in general is slightly more desaturated and darker. During the Emerald Arc, she wears a blue variant of the official clothing set for Pokemon Emerald, of which she also wears during the late chapters of the RubySapphire Arc. Starting from the ORAS Arc, her hair has darkened down considerably as seen on the cover of Volume 63 of Pokemon Adventures and sports now a [[short ponytail]].

[[Umamusume]] character. 

A little maverick of a throughbred, Mayano Top Gun is a young-looking [[horse girl]] who is named as well as having part of her personality based around the movie [[Top Gun]]. When she isn't spouting aeronautical references, she is trying (too hard) to be [[age_conscious|treated as an adult]], yet despite of this she is notably capable of learning quick and is able to grasp the situation such as answering a math question. This is reflected in-game where she is capable of running in different strategies.

Her racing outfit was influenced by the movie [[Top Gun]] (her jacket is nearly identical to that worn by [[Pete "Maverick" Mitchell]]). When it came to promote [[Top Gun: Maverick]] (or, rather, due to her very presence), she was the natural choice to "advertise the movie":[/posts/5348482].

Voiced by [[Hoshitani Mio]] (replacing [[Imamura Ayaka]]).

payload.body:
[b]The Medieval period[/b] (also known as [b]the Middle Ages[/b]) was a time period in Europe that lasted for 1000 years, from the end of classical antiquity (conventionally dated to the fall of the Western Roman Empire in 476) until the early modern period around 1500 (roughly coinciding with the widespread use of the printing press and the discovery of the New World). Today, the Middle Ages are synonymous with [[knight]]s and high [[fantasy]] aesthetics.

At Danbooru, this tag should be used for fashion that the typical Western audience would consider to pertain to this era, such as knight's armor, gowns with long sleeves, laced sandals, boots, and even cloaks. It also covers pre-modern European architecture such as castles.

This should not be confused with the [[Renaissance]] period, which came after/during the Late Middle Ages and marked the onset of early modern era.

h4. See also
* [[Holy Roman Empire]]

The [[fate (series)|Fate series']] depiction of the obscure Egyptian god Medjed, summoned by [[Nitocris (fate)|]] in [[Fate/Grand Order]].

Medjed appears in the Book of the Dead, wearing what appears to be a [[ghost costume]] with only his eyes and feet visible. His comical appearance became a [[meme]] on Japanese social media after the Book of the Dead papyrus was exhibited in Tokyo in 2012. [[Fate/Grand Order]]'s Medjed is a reference to this meme.

[[nitocris (fate)|Nitocris]] uses Medjed as one of her summons. She dresses like Medjed in her First Ascension as a [[nitocris (swimsuit assassin) (fate)|Swimsuit Assassin]].

Character in [[Xenoblade Chronicles 1]], her name is [b]Melia Ancient[/b] in Japanese.

The fifth permanent party member, she joins [[Shulk (xenoblade)|]]'s party in Makna Forest in order to slay a dangerous [[Telethia (xenoblade)|]]. She is later revealed to be the heir to the Imperial throne. In battle, she uses a [[staff]] to cast [[magic]], especially by summoning and discharging elementals.

As a High Entia, she has [[head wings]] and [[grey hair]] with [[curled ends]]. Her default attire is a [[short dress]], [[thighhighs]], [[cape]], and [[hat]]. 

In [[Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected]], she wears a different outfit with [[o-ring]]s in the top and [[juliet sleeves]] and has her hair with a [[crown braid]].

Appears in [[Xenoblade Chronicles 3]] as the [b]Queen of Keves.[/b] [spoilers]She is recruitable as a Hero in the postgame.[/spoiler]

She resembles [[Matou Sakura]], with [[long hair|long]] [[purple hair]], [[blue eyes]], and a [[flat chest]]. She wears a large black cloak, with [[long sleeves]] that [[sleeves past fingers|cover her hands]], and a metal [[crotch plate]]. Her floral namesakes are the [[Amaryllis (flower)|]] and the [[Lily (flower)|]]. Her component spirits are [[Artemis (fate)|]], [[Leviathan (mythology)|]], and [[Saraswati (mythology)|]].

payload.body:
A character from [[Fire Emblem: Three Houses]] and a member of the [[Blue Lions (fire emblem)|]].

She has [[long_hair|long]] [[blonde hair]] (though she cuts it [[short_hair|short]] after the in-game timeskip), [[blue eyes]], and [[large breasts]].

A motherly and religious woman, Mercedes can't ignore people in need, being always prone to help her friends if there's a problem. She tends to let people tell her what to do, rationalizing this to be the will of the Goddess. She is good friends with [[annette_fantine_dominic|Annette]].

In-game, Mercedes is one of the best healers available to the player, being one of only two characters with access to the Fortify spell (the other being [[flayn_(fire_emblem)|Flayn]]). She also does reasonably well with offensive magic, but she has terrible physical stats.

[spoilers]Mercedes's [[half-siblings|half-brother]] is [[Jeritza von Hrym]], who was once known as Emile von Bartels. The two were separated when Emile's father, Baron Bartels, attempted to dispose of his wife, Mercedes and Jeritza's mother, and force his step-daughter to bear him a child with the power of a Crest. However, his plan was stopped by Jeritza, who killed his father before running away.[/spoilers]

payload.body:
Meta Knight is a character in the [[Kirby  (series)|Kirby series]] and is the second of [[Kirby]]'s rivals, the first being [[King Dedede]]. He follows a code of honor, often providing Kirby with a sword to battle with (only breaking that code when he's not in control of himself, or when the situation is dire), and fights using a golden spiked sword called [[Galaxia (sword)|]]. Meta Knight is also shown to help Kirby sometimes.
 
In the [[kirby: right back at ya!|anime]], he's definitely on Kirby's side, helping him fight against the evil Demon Beasts created by the Holy [[Nightmare (kirby)|]] Company that Dedede buys from them. He shows some relationships with one of Kirby's friends, [[Fumu (kirby)|]], seeing her as a rare source of intelligence. He's also a Star Warrior, having been one before Kirby and having been one of the few survivors of the war between the Galaxy Soldier Army and the Holy Nightmare Company. 

He is also playable in the [i][[Super Smash Bros.]][/i] games, starting with [i]Brawl[/i]. In [i]Brawl[/i] specifically, he is notorious for being a "god tier" character, which was addressed in the later [i]Smash[/i] games.

The [b]MG42[/b] ([i]Maschinengewehr 42[/i]) is a German [[World War II]]-era open-bolt [[machine gun]] that fires the 7.92×57mm Mauser round. It supplanted the earlier [[MG34]] in 1942 due to lower manufacturing cost thanks to dominant stamped metal parts. Due to its highest cyclic rate of fire that measures up to 1200 RPM, the [[weapon]] gained the nickname [i]Hitler's Buzzsaw[/i].

The MG42 is recognizable by its [[barrel shroud]] with squared-off profile and larger perforations. It is [[ammunition belt|belt-fed]] and also accepts [[dual drum magazine]]s.

For the post-WWII counterpart with some modernized features and synthetic furniture instead of a wooden buttstock, use [[MG3]].

[b]Micaiah[/b] is one of the main protagonists of [[Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn]]. She is a light magician from Daein, a fortune teller, and a member of the Dawn Brigade (alongside [[Sothe (fire emblem)|]], [[Edward (fire emblem)|]], [[Leonardo (fire emblem)|]] and [[Nolan (fire emblem)|]]).

She is a patriot and loves her people. She will do anything that she can to help others: this, alongside her unusual abilities, made her something of a savior for Daein and earned her the titles "Silver-Haired Maiden" and "Priestess of Dawn". Usually seen alongside her bird companion [[Yune (fire emblem)|]].

She has [[long hair|long]] [[grey hair]] and [[yellow eyes]]. On the back of her right hand, she has a [[birthmark]] that vaguely resembles a bird. This mark is known as a "Brand" in the Tellius Games, usually hidden behind her gloves, and a recurring element in all of her outfits.

Her default Light Mage outfit consists of a [[sleeveless dress]] with [[side slit]]s, [[black leggings]] or [[black pantyhose]], [[black gloves|black]] [[fingerless_gloves|fingerless]] [[elbow gloves]], a [[hair ribbon]], a [[blue scarf]], and [[boots]]. In her second outfit, Light Sage, she trades the scarf for a [[blue cape]], her black gloves for [[purple gloves|purple]] ones with [[long sleeves|long]] [[detached sleeves]], and her red dress becomes [[pink dress|pink]] with a [[turtleneck dress|turtleneck]].

Voiced by [[Kuwatani Natsuko]] in Japanese and [[Veronica Taylor]] in English.

payload.body:
A [i][[Touken Ranbu]][/i] character. Based off of the [[tachi (weapon)|tachi]] [i]Mikazuki[/i] crafted by Sanjou Munechika currently housed in the Tokyo National Museum as a national treasure. One of the "Five Swords Under Heaven", along with [[Juzumaru Tsunetsugu]] and [[Oodenta Mitsuyo]].

In-game, he appears as a [[blue_hair|blue-haired]] young man with [[blue eyes]]. He wears a black [[hairband]] with golden [[tassel]]s, [[black gloves]] and a [[hakama skirt]] underneath a [[sayagata]] patterned [[kariginu]]. The crescent moon imagery invoked in his name (三日月 = Crescent Moon) is seen in his casual wear [[bandana]] and on the sides of his standard clothing.

Tends to be characterized as an "old man" in fanworks, since he introduces himself as an old man due to being "born" near the end of the 11th century. This either manifests in a wise, ancient personality or that of a doddering old fool in comedic works. For the most part he also tends to be characterized as a rather teasing person based on a few of his lines. Knows a thing or two about [[Honebami Toushirou]]'s past, but refuses to tell him anything about it.

He shares the same name as [[mikazuki (kancolle)|Mikazuki]]  from [i][[Kantai Collection]][/i] due to the historical ship being named after the sword, and as a result is often paired with her in various [[crossover]] fanart. Their grouping is tagged "三日月爺孫":http://dic.pixiv.net/a/%E4%B8%89%E6%97%A5%E6%9C%88%E7%88%BA%E5%AD%AB ("Mikazuki Grandfather-Daughter") in pixiv, as Mikazuki the sword spirit is a self-proclaimed old man (and thus the grandfather), while his ship-girl counterpart is a very young girl (hence the grand-daughter).

Because of his status as one of the hardest to obtain swords in the game, he's become rather infamous, and has appeared in multiple media as a borderline mascot for the franchise.

Voiced by Toriumi Kosuke. Character designer is [[sata (ipev)|]].

Her worldview is challenged however after she's thrust into the world of magical girls, first by encountering [[Tomoe Mami]], and later by contracting with [[Kyubey]], which causes her to get into trouble with [[Akemi Homura]] and [[Sakura Kyoko]], although she starts developing a complicated relationship with the latter.

She has [[short_hair|short]] [[blue hair]], [[blue eyes]], and wears a [[fortissimo]] [[musical note hair ornament|ornament]] [[hairclip]]. Her main attire is the [[mitakihara school uniform]] with [[black socks]].

In [[Mahou Shoujo Madoka Magica: Walpurgis No Kaiten]], Sayaka receives a [[bandaged head]] that obscures most of her face, save for her left eye. Where and how she received the bandages is currently unknown.

She is voiced by [[Kitamura Eri]] (Japanese) and Sarah Anne Williams (English).

Minna-Dietlinde Wilcke (ミーナ・ディートリンデ・ヴィルケ, Mīna Dītorinde Viruke?) is a Witch of the [[501st Joint Fighter Wing]] attached with the [[Karlsland]] Air Force. She became renowned as the Ace of Spades (スペードのエース, Supēdo no Ēsu), although some also call her by the pet name of Fürstin (フュルスティン, Fyurusutin). Her familiar is the [[wolf]]. 

She is skilled at leading operations and squad management and, rather than pursuing her own individual military gains, she focus on the efficient military performance of the squad as a whole. She also has a tendency to look after her subordinates, which causes some to have a motherly impression about her.

Minna's inherent magic is called Three Dimensional Space Understanding Ability (三次元空間把握能力, Sanjigen Kūkan Haaku Nōryoku). Classified in the perception-lineage, it makes possible to perceive and discern all nearby targets in every direction, sorting out their position, number and classification.

Her ace archetype is "Wolf-Dietrich Wilcke":http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wolf-Dietrich_Wilcke. Similar to Minna, Wolf-Dietrich bore the nickname "Fürst" amongst his friends and squadmates. 

Due to a scene in the second season she is often drawn with a noteworthy [[ass]].

A character from [[Boku no Hero Academia]]. A professional Japanese hero with "rabbit" quirk, granting her various rabbit-like abilities such as immensely strong legs, capable of jumping at a great height, and superhuman hearing ability. Her civilian name is [b]Usagiyama Rumi[/b]. 

She is depicted as a [[dark skin]]ned or [[tan]]ned, [[toned|athletic]] [[rabbit girl]] (although, her fanart frequently depicts her as [[muscular female|muscular]] instead) with [[white hair|white]], [[long hair]]. While under hero duties, she wears a [[white leotard]], which when combined with her organic [[rabbit ears]] and [[rabbit tail|tail]] can make it appears as if she's wearing a [[playboy bunny]] outfit.

Mirko was named after Mirko "Cro Cop" Filipovich, a now retired [[mixed martial arts]] fighter and Kickboxer, best known for competing in [[Pride Fighting Championships]] and the [[Ultimate Fighting Championship]].

Due to a localization error, "Mirko" is sometimes inappropriately spelled as "Miruko". When he was fighting in Japan, "Mirko" had to be translated as "Miruko/ミルコ" as Japanese does not have an independent "R" sound (the hiragana らりるれろ are roughly pronounced ra-ri-ru-re-ro). Western manga translators who did not know the reference unintentionally retranslated the faulty original translation.

Mishaguji are [[snake]]-like gods in Japanese folktales.

In [[Touhou]],  Mishaguji are underlings of [[Moriya Suwako]] and appear as white snakes with red eyes. They can be seen in [[Touhou Hisoutensoku]] during one of her super moves, where she summons them to assault the opponent in a manner similar to the [[Shun Goku Satsu]]. They also betrayed [[Yasaka Kanako]] when she seized Suwako's land in the distant past, blighting the region until Kanako agreed to keep Suwako as a co-deity. They are utterly loyal to Suwako and will answer to no one else, with the possible exception of Suwako's descendant, [[Kochiya Sanae]].

In [[Megami Tensei]], Mishaguji is a god of sexual intercourse and had a phallic shape, possibly similar to an earthworm.

[b]Misty[/b], known as [b]Kasumi[/b] (カスミ) in Japan, is a character introduced in [[pokemon|Pokémon]] [[pokemon red/green/blue/yellow|Red and Green]].

The Cerulean City gym leader, known as the Tomboyish Mermaid, she specializes in Water-types. Her signature Pokémon are [[Starmie]] and [[Articuno]].

Her look varies across the series. In her most iconic outfit from the [[pokemon (classic anime)|classic anime]], she has [[short hair|short]] [[spiked hair|spiky]] [[orange hair]] tied in a [[side ponytail]] and wears a [[yellow tank top|yellow]] [[crop top|cropped]] [[tank top]] and [[short shorts]] with [[suspenders]]. In the games, she usually wears swimwear, such as a [[blue bikini|blue]] [[sports bikini]] in [[Pokemon FireRed and LeafGreen|FireRed and LeafGreen]] and a [[white one-piece swimsuit]] with a [[white jacket]] in [[pokemon heartgold and soulsilver|HeartGold and SoulSilver]]. In her [[Pokemon: Let's Go Pikachu! and Let's Go Eevee!|Let's Go Pikachu! and Let's Go Eevee!]] outfit, she wears an [[orange bandeau|orange]] [[bandeau]], a [[blue shirt|blue]] [[two-tone shirt|and]] [[white shirt]], [[grey shorts|grey]] [[denim shorts]], and [[red shoes|red]], [[blue shoes|blue]] [[multicolored shoes|and]] [[white shoes|white]] [[sneakers]].

Her eye color varies from [[aqua eyes|aqua]] to [[green eyes|green]] or [[blue eyes|blue]].

payload.body:
Miyafuji Yoshika is the main character of [[Strike Witches]]. She has short [[brown hair]] and wears a [[school swimsuit]] under her blue [[school uniform]]. She is a part of the [[501st Joint Fighter Wing]]. Her affiliation however is the 288th Fuso Air Force, along with [[Sakamoto Mio]].

Her first [[Striker Unit]] was a A6M3a type Zero with a single yellow stripe as it's identification stripe. Her second unit was the same type (previously owned by Major Sakamoto Mio until she received a new unit based off of the [i]Kawanishi N1K-J [b]Shiden[/b][/i]) with blue stripes on the vertical stabilizer as well as a blue angled stripe that points downward at the front and upward at the back. 

Her third (and current) striker unit is based on the [i]Kyūshū J7W [b]Shinden[/b][/i]. The [i]Shinden[/i] allows Yoshika to use her magic to her fullest potential, as during episode 8 of the anime (Strike Witches 2) her magic became so strong that the governor installed on Mio's striker unit protected the magic engine from overloading.

Her familiar is the [[shiba inu]].

She has been shown to be [[yuri|attracted to other witches' breasts]], especially [[Lynette Bishop]]'s. Because of that she was given a nickname 淫獣宮藤 (injuu miyafuji, lewd/dirty beast Miyafuji).

h4. Equipment

* [[Type 99 cannon|13mm Type99-2-2 machine gun]]
* M712

payload.body:
The "Loyal Undead". Stage 3 boss of [[Touhou]]'s [[Ten Desires]]. A [[jiangshi]], or Chinese zombie, with the ability to eat anything. Humans bitten by her may turn into a jiangshi temporarily.

Assigned to guard the cemetery adjacent to the [[Myouren Temple]] by [[Kaku Seiga]], she's a tough opponent who takes her duties seriously but is somewhat dumb. Referred to as a "meaningless bodyguard" by [[ZUN]]. She is partially based on Miyako No Yoshika, a real 9th century poet who was rumored to be friends with [[Ibaraki Douji (touhou)|]].

Both her hair and eye color are inconsistently drawn, [[blue eyes|with]] [[black eyes|either]] [[purple eyes|being]] [[blue hair|blue]], [[black hair|black]], or [[purple hair|purple]]. She wears a [[purple hat|purple]] [[newsboy cap]] with a [[star hat ornament|star]], an [[ofuda]] on her forehead, a [[black ribbon|black]] [[neck ribbon]], a [[short sleeves|short-sleeved]] [[red shirt|red]] [[tangzhuang]] with [[lace-trimmed sleeves|a lace trim on the sleeves]], a [[black skirt]] sometimes with a [[floral print|floral]] [[print skirt|print]], and [[black footwear|black]] [[shoes]].
