payload.body:
Saber-class servant in [[Fate/Grand Order]]. She's a genderswap of the famous samurai of the [[Miyamoto Musashi (real life)|same name]] who killed his first man in a duel at age 13,  founded the Niten Ichi-ryū (二天一流) style of swordsmanship and wrote The Book of Five Rings (五輪の書).

She has [[pink hair]] in a [[ponytail]] held by a fan-like [[hair ornament]], [[blue eyes]], and [[large breasts]]. Initially wears a [[blue kimono|blue]] [[sleeveless kimono]] with an [[obi]], black [[detached sleeves]], [[black thighhighs]], and [[sandals]]. Later her kimono becomes more elaborate, gaining a [[navel cutout]], a red cloth with a [[maple leaf print]], and more red details. The chest area is also revealed. Sometimes her sleeves are also [[wide sleeves|widened]]. She has maple [[earrings]] and [[dual wielding|wields two]] [[katana|katanas]] while keeping two more [[sheathed]] at her waist.

A character in [[Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club]] and a second year student at Nijigasaki High School. Despite her gyaru style and flashy, loud appearance, Ai is a kindhearted, reliable girl who loves making puns.

This hairstyle is sometimes called a 'momitail' (もみーテール).

Akari is usually depicted wearing her Aria Company [i]undine[/i] [[aria company uniform|uniform]], which is colored white with blue trim and features a [[bowtie]] and a circle-and-arc [[logo]] in front and black company patches with yellow lettering on the left sleeve and [[hat]]. payload.body:
[b]Mobile Suit[/b], often abbreviated as [b]MS[/b], is the name of the [[mecha]] in the [[Gundam]] series. It basically refers to any (mostly) humanoid giant robot (standing from about 15 to 20+ meters tall) that is piloted by a human soldier (aside from [[G Gundam]], which uses the term [b]Mobile Fighter[/b]).

Most mobile suits are humanoid-shaped, though there are some which are not, such as the [[BuCUE]] and [[LaGOWE]] from [[Gundam SEED]].

This term was first introduced in the first episode of the original Gundam series, [[Mobile Suit Gundam]] from 1979. [[Tomino Yoshiyuki]], creator and writer of the series, explained that the concept of a manned robot was inspired by the [[super robot]] shows of the 1970s that began with the [[Mazinger Z]] anime from 1972. The name is also a tribute to the [[Mobile Infantry]], a fictional military organization of [[space marine]]s that uses [[power armor]] in the novel [[Starship Troopers]] from 1959.

He recently got a small [[robot dog]] pet, which he named [[Laika (touhou)|Laika]].

[[Doujinshi]] sometimes portray him either as a lecherous [[pervert]] running around wearing only a [[fundoshi]] or as an extremely [[muscular male]] with power almost equal to the rest of the cast - dubbed [[MANnosuke]].

payload.body:
An [[idol]] in the [[idolmaster cinderella girls|THE IDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls]] series. As a cowardly girl with no self-esteem, she remains an idol only because she lacks the will to quit. Even so, she often disappears from work to hide in quiet, dark places, like [[under_table|underneath]] the [[producer_(idolmaster)|Producer's]] desk. She considers these places her "Sanctuary".

In most illustrations, Nono is shown avoiding eye contact with the viewer by [[averting eyes|averting her eyes]] to one side. This was also adapted into [[idolmaster cinderella girls starlight stage|Starlight Stage]], where her model has the unique trait of avoiding direct eye contact with the camera (with the exception to this being when she is wearing one of the special costumes provided by her SS Rare cards). This trait is even referenced in her own name, which when written in hiragana (のの) resemble a pair of eyes looking to the side.

After ranking 4th in the "5th Cinderella Girl General Election":[https://www.project-imas.wiki/THE_iDOLM@STER_Cinderella_Girls_General_Election#5th_Cinderella_Girl_General_Election] on May 13th, 2016, she was one four girls selected to receive a voice. Her voice debuted on the web radio program [i]Shiny Numbers[/i] ("video":[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4czi911GBBM]), where her voice actor was revealed to be [[Takahashi Karin]].

She has [[medium hair|medium-length]] [[blonde hair]] with two [[red ribbon|red]] [[hair ribbon]]s and [[yellow eyes]]. Her [[brown hat]] has almost become an entity of its own in fan art, due to the leering eyes on top of it. Her outfit is a [[white shirt]] with a [[turtleneck shirt|turtleneck]] and [[long sleeves]] under a [[purple vest]] with a [[skirt set|matching]] [[purple skirt]] with the occasional [[frog print]]. She is 17 and is notable for being relatively large compared to the other idols, at 182 cm (5'11.5"). She even continues to grow after training. For comparative purposes, the tallest main character in [[Idolmaster_(classic)|classic]] [[Idolmaster_(classic)|iDOLM@STER]] is [[Shijou Takane]] at 169 cm (5'6.5") and the tallest main character in [[idolmaster side-m|iDOLM@STER: SideM]] is [[Kurono Genbu]] at 190 cm (6'3"). 

She loves collecting cute things, and has a fun, excitable personality, which is embodied as Kirarin Power, as well as an always-present [[:3]] visage. Fan art often depicts her as being superhumanly strong and prone to accidental destruction. She usually dresses in [[Fairy Kei]] fashion with some [[Decora]] elements.

As one of the most popular [i]Cinderella Girls[/i] characters, she was selected for the second CINDERELLA MASTER CD series, alongside [[Kanzaki Ranko]], [[Maekawa Miku]], [[Jougasaki Mika]] and [[Shimamura Uzuki]]. Her seiyuu is [[Matsuzaki Rei]].

She is in the unit "Ankira" with [[Futaba Anzu]], as well as "[[Decoration (idolmaster)|Decoration]]" with [[Jougasaki Rika]] and [[Akagi Miria]], and their unit costumes are [[Pikapikapop (idolmaster)|]] in the anime.

payload.body:
[b]Morrigan Aensland[/b] ([b]モリガン・アーンスランド[/b]) is the de facto main character from the [[Darkstalkers]] series of fighting games.

Morrigan is a [[demon girl|succubus]] who is very vain and lives for little more than the excitement of battle. She appears as a beautiful woman with [[long hair|long]], light [[green hair]], [[large breasts]] and [[bat wings|bat-like wings]] on her back and on the [[head wings|sides of her head]], artwork tends to depict her with either [[green eyes|green]] or [[yellow eyes|yellow]] eyes. Morrigan can reshape these wings into spikes and blades when attacking her enemies, as well as using them to shield herself from enemy attacks. She has [[long hair|long]] [[grey hair]] in [[two side up]] style and [[twintails]], [[brown eyes|brown]]/[[red eyes]], [[dark skin]], and [[large breasts]]. At Kai, her rigging adds several [[Type 96 AA gun]]s. 

She has a boastful, battle-hungry personality, contrasting with the more reserved [[Yamato (Kancolle)|]]. Her looks and personality stem from how the actual battleship's sinking involved taking an incredible amount of punishment, although like Yamato, she never actually engaged in surface combat.

payload.body:
Musashi's Kai Ni form portraying her as an A-150 battleship (featuring 6 51cm guns in 3 twin turrets instead of Yamato-class' 9 46cm guns in 3 triple turrets). Outside of rigging major differences between this and Musashi's base and Kai forms is different hairstyle (long twintails vs base forms short hair with long sidelocks) and major increase in amount of clothing worn.

In February of 2018, she obtained her remodel, which is stylistically the polar opposite from her previous half-dressed self. She is wearing in full her double-breasted uniform along with her original skirt, stockings (as revealed in her damaged pose, not pantyhose), thighboots as well as a coat acting as a cape. Another major difference is her hair, which is both longer and fully white instead of being platinum blonde. Replacing her already huge triple 46cm guns is her new humongous experimental twin 51cm guns (in a style similar to {{world_of_warships}}' Shikishima concept; a Yamato-class with 51 cm guns). Upon being damaged, her budget sarashi is revealed from under her tattered uniform.

payload.body:
Yet another version of [[Artoria Pendragon (fate)|]], this time summoned as the Assassin Class. Wears a [[scarf]], [[blue jacket|blue]] [[track jacket]], [[shorts]], and a [[baseball cap]] that somehow [[hair through headwear|fails to conceal]] Artoria's iconic [[ahoge]].

She appears in the Type-Moon [[April Fools]] joke [[Rojiura Satsuki: Chapter Heroine Sanctuary]], [[Fate/Grand Order]] and [[Fate/EXTELLA]].

Her goal is to rid the universe of the ever growing Artorias and their ilk as she considers them a plague upon the universe and once they are gone she shall be the one and only Artoria. Although primarily focused on her mission to exterminate all Artorias, she has opened her heart to [[Saber Lily]].

Consequently, Artoria wears Mysterious Heroine X's outfit as an alternate costume in [[Fate/EXTELLA]].

Wields the mysterious magical sword, the [[Himitsucalibur (fate)|]]. Its capabilities and powers are a secret.

payload.body:
Foreigner-class version of [[Mysterious Heroine X (fate)|]]. She has three distinct designs depending on her Ascension level:

* [[mysterious heroine xx (first ascension) (fate)|First Ascension]] is her wearing a [[full armor]] [[exoskeleton]].
* [[mysterious heroine xx (second ascension) (fate)|Second Ascension]] loses some of the armor to show her face, and she wears a large [[blue scarf]], [[skin tight]] clothes under her armor, and metal gloves and boots.
* Third Ascension loses the armor completely, and she wears a blue [[baseball cap]], a [[white bikini]], [[strappy heels]], and a blue [[shrug (clothing)|]].

Mysterious Heroine XX wields [[Twinmyniad (fate)|]], a double-bladed version of [[Rhongomyniad (fate)|]]. Her breasts get [[medium breasts|slightly]] [[large breasts|larger]] with each Ascension, though never as big as [[Artoria Pendragon (lancer) (fate)|]].

Personality-wise, she's an older, more mature version of Heroine X (and also fills the role of being a swimsuit version of her).  She's nowhere near as obsessed as X is with eliminating all the other Sabers, to the point that she sometimes forgets about it completely, and is more focused on eliminating Foreigners. In-universe, she's a Galactic Police officer, but more or less abandons her post to go to Chaldea after the events of the 2018 summer event (2020 for North America).

While her First and Second Ascensions are given character tags, her Third Ascension bikini and shrug is considered her 'default' costume and thus has not been given a tag.

[b]Character Design:[/b] [[BUNBUN]]
[b]Voice Actress:[/b] [[Kawasumi Ayako]]

payload.body:
The "Night Sparrow." Stage 2 mid-boss and boss of [[Touhou]]'s [[Imperishable Night]] and a playable character in [[Phantasmagoria of Flower View]].

An egocentric night sparrow youkai who can induce confusion and night-blindness with her song. She dislikes [[yakitori]] (grilled chicken) and has set up a grilled lamprey eel stand in protest, convincing blinded travellers that her eels cure blindness (she cures them on the spot). 

She is best known, however, for having been reputedly devoured by [[Saigyouji Yuyuko]] during Imperishable Night, only to reappear in Phantasmagoria of Flower View, landing her a place in [[Team 9 (touhou)|]], a posse of low-tier Touhou characters. Her more recent association with [[Kasodani Kyouko]] as part of [[Choujuu Gigaku]], as well as the increased prominence of her food stand, have loosened her association with Team 9 somewhat.

Contrary to accusations of being illiterate by [[Shameimaru Aya]] in an interview from [[Bohemian Archive in Japanese Red]], she merely has poor eyesight, based an appearance in [[Touhou Sangetsusei]] where she uses a magnifying lens to help her read.

She has [[short hair|short]] [[pink hair]] and [[brown eyes]] with [[bird ears]] and [[purple wings|purple]] [[feathered wings]]. Her outfit is a [[brown hat|brown]] [[winged hat|winged]] [[mob cap]], a [[collared shirt|collared]] [[white shirt]] with [[long sleeves]], a [[brown dress|brown]] [[pinafore dress]], [[brown socks]], and [[black shoes]].

payload.body:
Lead antagonist of [[Pokemon Black And White|Pokémon Black and White]] , and supporting character in [[pokemon black 2 and white 2|Pokémon Black 2 and White 2]].

He is the "King" of [[Team Plasma]]. He regularly challenges the player character, [[Hilbert (pokemon)|]] or [[Hilda (pokemon)|]], in order to confirm his ideas of justice. He calls Pokémon "friends", but he wants to split humans and Pokémon and divide them to create a black and white world, as he wanted to set Pokémon free from people (who he viewed to be their oppressor), and looks for the power to bring his idea to reality. 

He returns in the sequel games to help thwart the schemes of his father, [[Ghetsis (pokemon)|]], who has formed his own Team Plasma with the intent of taking over Unova by force.

Full Name: [b]Natural Harmonia Gropius[/b]

[[Azur Lane]]'s personification of the Japanese battleship [i]Nagato[/i]. Character design by [[Alisa (kuro no sakura)|]], voiced by [[Kuno Misaki]]. 

She is portrayed with [[long hair|long]] [[black hair]] with a [[hime cut]] with bird-like [[hair ornament]]s, [[yellow eyes]], [[small breasts]], and [[fox ears]]. Her default outfit consists of an [[off shoulder]] [[red dress|red]] [[pleated dress|pleated]] [[sleeveless dress]] with [[detached sleeves]]. Her [[rigging]] consists of her real-life bridge holding two large half-circle hull pieces containing her 41 cm twin gun mounts with [[shimenawa]] and [[shide]], plus six 14 cm single guns.

In contrast to her ship class, she is portrayed as a child(-like?) character. Her young appearance may be a reference to how Japanese schoolchildren donated funds for the two battleships, especially [[Mutsu (Azur Lane)|]].

As she looks like - and perhaps [i]is[/i] - a little girl, she is often contrasted with [[Nagato (kancolle)|]] from [[Kantai Collection]], to the point where the latter goes "Nagamon":/pools/8242 after "herself".

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese battleship [i]Nagato[/i]. Character design by [[Shizuma Yoshinori]], voiced by [[Sakura Ayane]].

She has [[long_hair|long]] [[black hair]], [[red eyes]], and [[large breasts]]. Her default outfit consists of a [[Japanese clothes|Japanese-style]] [[white shirt|white]] [[crop top]], [[black corset]] with a [[gold trim]], [[black_gloves|black]] [[fingerless_gloves|fingerless]] [[elbow gloves]], [[white skirt|white]] [[pleated skirt]] with [[black trim]], grey waist piece with a [[kikumon]] (based off her bow), [[red thighhighs]] with [[garter straps]], and [[grey footwear|grey]] [[high heels|high-heeled]] [[rudder footwear]]. 

Her [[rigging]] consists of two connected hull pieces in a half-circle, fastened to her back with a funnel and containing her four 41 cm twin gun mounts and two 14 cm single mounts. 

Often portrayed as cool and professional if a bit prideful, being one (and the first) of the Big 7 battleships legally allowed by the Washington Naval Treaty system to mount 16-inch guns. Secretly likes cute things.

In real life, she was [[Yamamoto Isoroku]]'s flagship in the first months of the war (even gave the signal for the Pearl Harbor attack to commence from her bridge). She served as part of BatDiv1 with [[Yamato (Kancolle)|]] and [[Mutsu (Kancolle)|]] in the [[battle of Midway]]. After the war, she was used along with [[sakawa (kancolle)|Sakawa]], [[prinz eugen (kancolle)|Prinz Eugen]] and [[saratoga (kancolle)|Saratoga]] as a target at Bikini Atoll during [[Operation Crossroads]]. She was sunk after the Baker test from a combination of damage sustained on the attack on Yokosuka and the two nuclear tests.

[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese light cruiser [i]Naka[/i]. Character design by [[Bob (biyonbiyon)|Bob]], voiced by [[Sakura Ayane]].

She has [[medium hair|medium-length]] [[brown hair]] in a [[double bun]] with [[antenna hair]], and [[brown eyes]]. Her default outfit is the class' uniform: an [[orange shirt]] with [[white sailor collar]], [[black neckerchief]], [[black gloves|black]] [[elbow gloves]], [[black skirt|black]] [[pleated skirt]], [[black socks]], and [[black shoes]]. 

Her [[rigging]] consists of her funnels on her ankles, 14 cm gun mounts on both of her elbow gloves (with an additional [[aircraft catapult]] on her right), and two 61 cm quad [[torpedo tubes]] attached to her [[black belt]]. 

Considers herself as being the fleet's [[idol]]. She is a common unwanted drop, leading to the nickname "[[2 Fuel 4 ammo 11 steel|2 Fuel, 4 Ammo, 11 Steel Girl]]" after the amount of resources you get from dismantling her, often representing her as an actual pile of these resources. 

Historically, [i]Naka[/i] was to be the second of the Sendai-class and was actually laid down before [[Jintsuu (Kancolle)|]]. However, the Great Kanto Earthquake of 1923 damaged Naka's original hull so much that she need to be scrapped and be rebuilt from scratch. She was finally completed in 1925, making her the third and last of her class. 

Her [[abyssal ship|abyssal]] form is assumed to be the [[Light Cruiser Oni]] first form.

He has an outgoing, cheerful and somewhat spacey personality. His occasionally odd behavior is most notable in his Internal affairs quote "馬糞は嫌いなやつになげるー" ("I'll throw horse poop at those I hate~"), which naturally results in fanworks giving him a strange fixation on horse poop. He lost some memories due to being burned in a fire during the siege on Osaka Castle, but he claims he doesn't let his memory loss overwhelm him. However, there are indications that it bothers him more than he lets on.  

He has [[long hair|long]] [[black hair]] tied in a [[ponytail]], along with a prominent [[ahoge]], and [[purple eyes]]. His usual outfit is the [[military uniform]] worn by most of the other Awataguchi swords, along with a black [[necktie]] and black [[sode]] on one shoulder. His [[Namazuo Toushirou (Kiwame)|Kiwame]] form gives him [[high heels]] and more elaborate armor, and his hairstyle has changed to a [[high ponytail]].

Often compared to [[Shigure (kancolle)|]], with his [[black hair]] and his prominent [[ahoge]] making him look rather like a male version of her.

[i]Namazuo[/i] (鯰尾) means "[[catfish]] tail", which is reflected in his Kiwame form with the sode on his right arm resembling a catfish.

Her default attire has changed many times throughout the series, her most iconic outfit consists of a [[white shirt|white]] [[striped shirt]] and [[orange skirt|orange]] [[miniskirt]]. In the [i]Long Ring Long Land Arc[/i], she wears a [[crop top|cropped]] [[black tank top]] with "Gold" [[clothes writing|written on it]], [[white pants]], a [[brown belt]], and [[pink sandals]]. During the [i]Water 7 Arc[/i], she wears a [[collared shirt|collared]] [[blue shirt]] with a [[blue necktie]], [[white skirt|white]] miniskirt, and [[blue sandals]]. payload.body:
Character from [[Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair]]. Her title is Ultimate Gamer (超高校級の「ゲーマー」).

She has [[flipped hair|flipped]] pink or light brown [[medium hair]] with a [[Galaga]] [[hairclip]], and pink eyes. She wears a [[pleated skirt|pleated]] [[brown skirt]], [[black thighhighs|black]] [[over-kneehighs]], a [[pink ribbon|pink]] [[neck ribbon]], and a black and white [[dress shirt|dress]] [[collared shirt|shirt]] that is [[shirt tucked in|tucked]] in her skirt. She has a [[hooded jacket]] that's shaped like a [[cat hood]] and she carries a pink [[backpack]], that's shaped like a [[cat bag]]. 

As the Ultimate Gamer, she loves video games of all kinds, and playing so many games has given her a wide range of general knowledge. Because of this you mostly see her [[holding handheld game console|holding and playing on a handheld game console]]. She's playing [[Galaga|Galaga Omega]] for the most time of the day and wears a hair ornament dedicated to the game. When she's not with [[Hinata Hajime|Hinata]] or [[Komaeda Nagito|Nagito]], she's sometimes seen with [[Monomi (Danganronpa)|]] by her side.

[spoiler]In Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair she is actually an artificial intelligence. Her creator and "father" was [[Fujisaki Chihiro]], the Ultimate Programmer from [[Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc]] who programmed her A.I. for the Neo World Program.

[[Danganronpa 3 (anime)|]] reveals her to be based off of an actual Nanami Chiaki, who was part of Class 77-B and was executed by [[Enoshima Junko]] to push the rest of the class into despair. In this show she's wearing the [[Hope's Peak Academy School Uniform]]. She also wears [[loafers]] instead of [[mary janes]].[/spoiler]

Like other Danganronpa Girls, she has an official [[Playboy bunny]] outfit. She wears a [[two-tone leotard|two-tone]] [[white leotard|white]] and [[black leotard]], [[fishnet thighhighs]] and a [[rabbit hood|bunny hood]] with [[fake animal ears|fake]] [[rabbit ears|bunny ears]].

payload.body:
Archer-class Servant first debuted in [[Fate/Grand Order]] during the Lostbelt arc. The depiction of the [[napoleon bonaparte|famous military leader]] of the same name.

Napoleon's appearance is different from his self in history. His third ascension outfit seems to be based on the romantic oil painting [[napoleon_crossing_the_alps|Napoléon Crossing the Alps]] done by Jacques-Louis David in 1801. It is stated that if he was summoned as a Rider, his height would decrease.

A tall, muscular man with [[brown hair]], [[blue eyes]], and facial hair in the style of [[goatee]] and [[long sideburns]]. Usually depicted in [[bara]] style with an [[open jacket|open]] [[leather jacket]] and [[epaulettes]] (with [[fringe trim]] and [[long sleeves]]) on top of an [[open shirt]] that shows off his [[pectorals]] and [[cross scar|cross scarred]] [[scar on chest| chest]]. When his jacket is not [[partially unbuttoned]] he usually wears his [[military uniform]] with a [[shoulder sash]], [[medal]], [[ascot]], [[belt]], [[tight clothes]] [[white pants]], and [[leather boots|leather]] [[knee boots]]).

He wields a [[huge weapon|huge]] [[cannon]] that shoots [[rainbow]]. According to in-game lines, the cannon was designed by [[Charles Babbage (fate)|]], despite the UK and France considered each other enemies during their lifetime.

A legend says that during his campaign in [[Egypt]], he spent a night inside the [[great pyramid of giza|Great Pyramid]] and had a vision of his most admired hero, Alexander the Great ([[Iskandar (fate)|]]). This fact is included in one of Napoleon's in-game lines and has inspired fans to depict them as a [[bara]] [[couple]], especially since both were known as charismatic military leader and historical connections.

[b]Character Design:[/b] [[Ryota-H]]
[b]Voice Actor:[/b] [[Hino Satoshi]]

Playable dark-type character in [i][[Granblue Fantasy]][/i]. Makes an appearance in the fighting game spin-off, [[Granblue Fantasy Versus]]; the fighting game's sequel, [[Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising]]; and the action-RPG spin off, [[Granblue Fantasy: Relink]].

A  [[katana]]-wielding [[draph]] girl with [[blue eyes]] and [[long hair|long]], [[purple hair]] adorned with hair ornaments that's fashioned with two [[low-tied long hair|low-tied]] frontal locks, a [[single braid|single left-sided braid]], and [[hair over one eye|bangs draped over her left eye]]. Has horns are black and curve towards the front. Like most draph characters, she also has [[large breasts]].

Wears a [[sleeveless]] coat that is closed at the top. Underneath is a black vest-like garment with various belts with what seems to be [[bottomless|no bottom]]. Her legwear consists of a [[single thighhigh|single]] [[black thighhighs|black]] thighhigh on her left leg and a [[black boots|black boot]] on her right along with a [[thigh strap]] (both footwear having [[high heels]]). Lastly, she has [[black gloves|black]] [[uneven gloves|uneven]] [[elbow gloves]].

Narmaya has a overall airy and aloof demeanor. She is rather obsessive over the [[gran (granblue fantasy)|main]] [[djeeta (granblue fantasy)|character]], constantly babying and worrying about him/her whilst wanting to be seen as a big sister.

Due to her popularity, she has been given a number of alternate versions: an SSR Water Summer version in 2016, an SSR Earth Holiday version in 2019 and a Grand version in 2021.

Voiced by [[Ichimichi Mao]]

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the battleship HMS [i]Nelson[/i] (pennant no. 28). Character design by [[Konishi (koconatu)|]], voiced by [[Nomizu Iori]]. 

She has [[long hair|long]] [[blonde hair]], [[blue eyes]], and [[large breasts]]. Her default outfit consists of a [[grey jacket|grey]] [[long sleeves|long-sleeved]] closed [[cropped jacket]], short [[red necktie]] with a [[red rose]], [[black dress]], [[black thighhighs]], [[thigh strap]]s, and [[grey shoes|grey]] [[rudder footwear]]. Her strictly military appearance contrasts greatly with Warspite's regal one due to their respective classes' namesakes being of admiralty and of royalty respectively. 

Her [[rigging]] consists of three hull pieces, one to her back and two to her sides, with the armament arranged asymmetrically (15.2 cm twin gun mounts on her left, [[anti-aircraft gun]]s plus her funnel and mast to her back, and her three 406 mm triple gun mounts to her right) and controlled by a [[joystick]]. She also has her real-life fire directors as [[headgear]]. 

At Kai, Nelson's jacket gains darker sleeves, and her rigging obtains a camouflage pattern. 

In the game, she is capable of a special cut-in sequence: the "Nelson Touch". It is also a "historical term":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Nelson_Touch], referring either to Vice Admiral Nelson's naval strategy that he used to great success or the broader sense of naval superiority the Royal Navy enjoyed during the 1800s after the British victory in the Battle of Trafalgar despite Vice Admiral Nelson's death during that time.

payload.body:
Umbrella tag for the members of the Nemo Series from [[Fate/Grand Order]]. [[Captain Nemo (fate)|]] is the leader of the series and the first one to appear in the [[S I N (fate/grand order)|]] chapter as [[Sion Eltnam Sokaris]]' servant, with [[Marine Nemo (fate)|Marine]] only briefly appearing. The rest of the series only manifest after he declares his true name in the [[Yugakshetra (fate/grand order)|]] chapter and manifests the [[Nautilus (fate)|]]. The series is a result of Memory Partition he learned from his master, allowing Nemo to divide his skills up into [[multiple persona|multiple selves]] to manage all the operations of his submarine.

Although the Nemo Series' genders were initially left ambiguous, the male-to-female ratio was eventually confirmed to be 3:3 by Fate/Grand Order material XI. In-game details, such as the annual Valentine's Day event, have shed light on the genders of each Nemo: the confirmed men are Captain and the Marines, the confirmed women are Engineer and Baker, and Professor and Nurse's genders are still unknown, though Professor is implied to be female.

This is changed in the global release where only Captain is male and the rest are female.

[b]Character Design:[/b] [[astg]]
[b]Voice Actress:[/b] [[Hanamori Yumiri]]

Her [[rigging]] consists of her real-life bridge to her back, 61 cm triple [[torpedo tubes]] on joints attached to the bridge, [[dual arm cannons|12.7 single and twin handgun mounts]], and floating [[headgear]]. 

A very energetic girl, she tends to use her name in a joke. In fact, it's her single gag, characteristic catchphrase and verbal tic in one ("What day is today? Nenohi/New Year's Day!").

payload.body:
The CPU Candidate of Planeptune and sister to [[neptune (neptunia)|Neptune]]. Despite being 'born' later than Neptune, both her appearance and attitude are more mature (leading to some confusion at times). While she admires her sister and tends to spoil her, she also tries to be strict with her at times (especially when Neptune slacking off, unless she joins her in doing so).

She is friends with the other CPU Candidates [[uni (neptunia)|Uni]] (but Uni is a [[tsundere]] so she wouldn't admit that), [[rom (neptunia)|Rom]] and [[ram (neptunia)|Ram]].

In [[Choujigen Game Neptune MK2]] she had the role of the main character, but by [[Kami Jigen Game Neptune V]] she got degraded to a side character and comic relief (which she laments a few times during the course of the story, frequently breaking the 4th wall in doing so). While she frets that she lacks any defining features or traits, she eventually begins to display a talent in electronics and robotics.

Voiced by: [[Horie Yui]] (Japanese), [[Christine Marie Cabanos]] (English)

h4. See also

* [[Purple Sister]], Nepgear's HDD (Hard Drive Divinity) form.
* [[purple_sister_(chaos_form)|Purple Sister (Chaos Form)]], it's a corrupted form of Nepgear's HDD form.
* [spoiler][[purple_sister_v|Purple Sister V]], it's a corrupted form of the Nepgear from [[conquest_end|Conquest's End]].[/spoiler]

payload.body:
The main character of [[Choujigen Game Neptune]], and of most games thereafter in the [[neptune (series)|Neptunia series]].

While depicted as a preteen girl without a single care in the world, Neptune is actually one of the four goddesses of Gamindustri, presiding over the Land of Purple Progress, Planeptune. After losing a fight with the other three goddesses in the world of Celestia, she is banished to the earth below, driving into the ground headfirst and losing her memories.

Her regular appearance consists of a [[hoodie]]/[[hooded jacket]] with [[drawstring]]s that resemble [[usb]] controller plugs, blue-and-white [[striped thighhighs]], and [[D-pad hair ornament]]s. Both her [[purple_eyes|eyes]] and [[short_hair|short]], rather messy [[purple_hair|hair]] are purple.

While many of the characters of the franchise tend to break the [[fourth wall]] on occasion, Neptune is the one who does so most frequently.

Choujigen Game Neptune's characters are mainly personifications of game companies or game consoles, Neptune represents the long-canceled [[Sega]] Neptune.

Voiced by: [[Tanaka Rie]] (Japanese), [[Melissa Fahn]] (English)

payload.body:
[[Azur Lane]]'s personification of the [i]Iowa[/i]-class battleship USS [i]New Jersey[/i] (BB-62). Character design by [[yyy (zelda10010)|yyy]], voiced by [[Tomita Miyu]].

She is the second natural UR ship in the game. She has [[long hair|long]] [[blue hair]], wears a black [[bodystocking]] with a futuristic style over[[coat]] on her shoulders, [[white gloves|white]] [[elbow gloves]], white [[miniskirt]], bluish-chrome [[high heels]], and a headpiece with her hull number (BB-62) inscribed on it. She has an upbeat and flashy personality, rarely seen without a smile on her face.

Her [[rigging]] consists of her three 406 mm triple Mk7 mounts and four of her ten historical 127 mm twin mounts in an equally-futuristic rig with an electrically-charged glowing ring to her back.

She was launched on December 7th 1942, exactly one year after the Pearl Harbor attack. She took part in numerous actions from World War II to Vietnam and earned 19 battle stars in her long service before being decommissioned for the last time on February 8th 1991. Her historic counterpart is currently a museum ship located in Camden, New Jersey.

payload.body:
Character from [[Chuunibyou Demo Koi ga Shitai!]]




[[Nibutani Shinka]] is a beautiful girl who has [[long hair|long]] [[brown hair]] tied into a [[side ponytail|ponytail]] along with a pink [[hairclip]]. She also has [[orange eyes]] and is a tall girl.

During the start of the first episode of Ren she dyes her hair [[black hair|black]] which lacks a ponytail and a hairclip along with wearing a much [[long skirt|longer]] [[skirt]] in order to keep her identity a secret, but fails at the end of the first episode as she changes back into her old appearance, but during the finale she briefly wears her hair in [[twin braids]], round [[glasses]] and [[white socks]].

She's a Class Representative (and originally a [[cheerleader]], but later joins the drama club as of Ren) from [[Togashi Yuuta]]'s class who, like him, used to be diagnosed with a chuunibyou in which she labeled herself as "[[Mori Summer]]", but then moved to Icho Private Highschool in order to escape her horribly embarrassing past. She often tends to fight with [[Dekomori Sanae]] because of it in achieving the goal of erasing the traces of her own past as Mori Summer for good.

Shinka is generally described as a gorgeous and friendly girl in the anime, and is popular among her peers due to her good looks. However, she shows her blunt and edgy side when she's alone [[takanashi rikka|Rikka]], [[Togashi Yuuta|Yuuta]] and others, particularly whenever it comes to dealing with [[Dekomori Sanae]], who doesn't know is the real [[Mori Summer]]. She usually takes her frustration out on her whenever she says "fake Mori Summer" and feeding her milk, which Sanae deems poisonous, but it's later revealed that they actually care for each other and vice-versa. 

Despite her flaws, she's a genuinely kindhearted girl who cares deeply about her friends/clubmates, and doesn't hesitate to help them whenever they need it. In Episode 7, it is revealed that she's enthusiastic when it comes to romance, but in Episode 9 Shinka makes it fairly clear that Rikka and Yuuta must be together, and often tends to help them on their relationship.

Nikka Edvardine Katajainen (ニッカ・エドワーディン・カタヤイネン ?) is a witch of the [[502nd Joint Fighter Wing]], originating from [[Suomus]]. She is referred to as "Nipa" by her friends. Her familiar is an ermine.

Nikka is affiliated with No.24 Squadron, an elite unit of the Suomus Air Force. As [[Eila Ilmatar Juutilainen]] is also a member of this squadron, the two are fellow squadron members.

Nikka is something of a tomboy, bearing a boyish appearance and often unladylike manner. She was once something of a delinquent, which has since eased somewhat with the influence of her close friends such as Eila and [[Hanna Wind]]. She possesses a very exacting personality which usually splits any situation into right or wrong. While not stupid, she is relatively guileless and often distracted, making her a popular subject for Eila's pranks.

Nikka is based on the Finnish flying ace Nils Katajainen (http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nils_Katajainen ). Like Nikka, Nils had a reputation for frequently crashing his craft, often surviving with only minor injuries. Her nickname, "Nipa," was also Nils' nickname during the war.

An [[iDOLMASTER Cinderella Girls|iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls]] character in the Cool category.

She enjoys hair dyeing and buckle fashion. Asuka is intense and brooding, and trying to find her identity like many other 14-year-olds. She can be summed up as a [[chuunibyou]], but unlike [[Kanzaki Ranko|Ranko]] (who she is often associated with by fans), Asuka is decidedly more of the cool or subcultural type. Asuka is very self-aware, and asks the Producer to cut her some slack if she's unpleasant at times because she's dealing with puberty. While she is initially an enemy to the Cinderella Girls cast, she later joins them and is available to produce.

In the tie in Cinderella Girls Theater skits, Asuka is introduced by [[Makihara Shiho]]. She believes love and peace to be the same in principle, as only those who believe in them have them. Her views of mystical or paranormal objects are that she doesn’t think that they can exist outside of a person’s imagination. She does not like black coffee and thinks that the aura of the office roof is heartwarming.

Due to her popularity, she was selected for the 9th set of CINDERELLA MASTER CD series, alongside [[Igarashi Kyoko]], [[Ohtsuki Yui]], [[Nakano Yuka]], and [[Aiba Yumi]]. She is voiced by [[Aoki Shiki]].

Along with [[teireida mai|Mai]], she is based after Matarajin's two servants, Nishida and Teireida respectively. Like her mythological counterpart, she is depicted holding a [[myouga (plant)|myouga plant]] in her character portrait.

Satono and Mai are [[matara okina|Okina's]] loyal servants. They used to be human children, but Okina's magic made them less human. They dance for Okina's sake and are essentially an extension of Okina's power. Satono is depicted as discreet but overconfident. h6. Das Finale

Overall commander for the Ooarai Girls tankery team, and boards the Panzer IV Ausf.H (originally Ausf.D) as the tank commander.  Second daughter of the Nishizumi family which heads the Nishizumi-style of tankery.  Following the 63rd National Tankery Tournament, she led the team to victory against the Selection University team and secured the existence of the school.  Has a warm personality, but when faced with a problem, is able to put together flexible tactics that go beyond the limits of the Nishizumi-style.

[tn]Source: "[3]":[#dtext-external-links][/tn]

h6. Operation More Love Love

A girl transferring from Kuromorimine Girls Academy, her family is of the Nishizumi Style, a prestigious school of tankery. As commander of Team Anglerfish, she helped contribute to the victory of Ooarai Girls in the national tournament. Although she is a calm girl who is considerate of those around her, she also has a strong core. This can be seen from the fact that she loves the bear mascot "Boko", even though those around her do not understand.

[tn]Source: "[4]":[#dtext-external-links][/tn]

[[Genshin Impact]] character. Voiced by [[Takao Kanon]] in Japanese. 

She is portrayed with [[short hair|short]] [[grey hair]] with a [[crown braid]], [[green eyes]], and [[medium breasts]]. Her default outfit, fitting of her role as a knight-in-training/maid, consists of a [[white hat]] with [[red rose]]s, [[black dress|black]]-and-[[red dress|red]] [[armored dress]] (complete with a [[boobplate]]), [[red ascot]], [[white apron]], [[shoulder armor]], [[gauntlets]], and [[white boots|white]] [[armored boots]]. 

Like most of Mondstadt's young people, Noelle always dreamed of being a knight of Favonius when she grew up. She may not have what it takes to be a knight just yet, but she is learning. Working as a [[maid]] at the Knights' headquarters, she is constantly taking notes on what constitutes knightly speech, knightly conduct, and knightly customs. payload.body:
One of four goddesses of Gamindustri, Noire presides over the Land of Black Regality, Lastation. Noire is seen as an ideal goddess, working independently on her own time, though this often gets her sick or wears her out. She is generally very menseful towards everyone, but also comes off as stubborn since she prefers to work alone.

Noire is usually wearing a fancy dress colored dark blue, red, and white with gold buttons and lining here and there. She also sports a blue bow on her back as well as a smaller one around her neck that's attached to a monochrome collar and is adorned with a piece of gold in the center. Noire's hair is tied into two very long pigtails that reach her hips, her bangs being nice and neat, and her eyes are as red as rubies.

The ideal goddess Noire is the personification of the Sony PlayStation 3.

Voiced by: [[Imai Asami]] (Japanese), [[Erin Fitzgerald]] (English, 2011-2016), [[Erica Mendez]] (English, 2017-)

payload.body:
Japanese name: (Romaji [i]Hoppou Seiki[/i], literally "northern-dwelling princess")

E2 Stage boss of [[Kantai Collection]]'s Aleutian Islands / Midway Islands Summer 2014 Event. Also known as "Northern Princess", and based off "Dutch Harbor":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_Dutch_Harbor].

The youngest by appearance of the [[Abyssal ship|Abyssal]] "Princesses", she is often depicted as the child character of said fleet. Due to similar appearances, [[Seaport Princess]] is often seen as the parent-like figure, and [[Airfield Princess]] as her elder sister. She is also shown together with [[Midway Princess]] and [[Aircraft Carrier Princess]], whose first appearances are in the same Summer Event. She is also associated with [[Ryuujou (kancolle)|]], as the Akutan Zero (see below) originally belonged to her.

The nickname ほっぽちゃん ("Hoppo-chan") comes from the first two kanji of her name (pronounced "Hoppo"). あくたん ("Akutan") comes from the "Akutan Zero":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Akutan_Zero], a Mitsubishi [[A6M Zero]] fighter plane which crashed on "Akutan Island":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Akutan_Island] but was recovered largely intact by the US following the Dutch Harbor campaign.

Her sudden overwhelming popularity led the developers to turn her into a mainstay for 3-5. Because of this, she also has numerous seasonal CG:

* Christmas 2014 (and onwards): Based on her "yelling" portrait, she wears an "abysallized" santa hat while carrying a present box (with an abyssal mouth, of course). Part of her [[rigging]] has turned into a christmas tree and her airplanes have been turned into ornaments.
* Rainy Season 2015 (and onwards): Based on her "running" portrait, she replaces her Zero plane with an abyssalized teruterubouzu and umbrella. She also appears to be looking at her umbrella instead of looking "at the viewer".
* Fall 2015 (and onwards): Based on her yelling portrait, she makes sign that there's no [[saury]] where she is (and indeed, you cannot gather saury from her) instead of yelling.
* New Year 2016: She happily holds some kagami mochi.
* Valentines 2016: She blushingly holds some fine chocolates in a box (with a mouth, of course).
* Sukiya Promotion: She is happily eating a serving of Sukiya's gyuudon while her hungry aircraft pleads for her to share some of her food.
* New Year 2017: She wears a furisode and haori set while her machinery has been replaced by abysallized versions of New Year paraphernalia.

Her catchphrase [i]kaere![/i] (カエレ！) is "officially translated":http://www.cospa.com/detail/id/00000065534 as "[[Go back!]]", but a popular alternate translation has it as "Go home!".

Voiced by [[Kanemoto Hisako]].

h4. Appearance

* !post #1783024

h4. See also

* [[Muppo]]

payload.body:
The practice of [[nude|wearing little to no clothing]] to be "closer to [[nature]]," treating nudity as natural and nothing to be ashamed of.

This tag overlaps with (but not necessarily relates to) [[exhibitionism]] and [[zenra]], as nudists can be naked [[indoors]] (such as the privacy of their home), as opposed to the aforementioned fetishes that emphasize [[public nudity]] and exposure to others. Nudism is usually treated as a matter of personal preference rather than deliberate titillation.

Do not apply this tag simply because the character is naked. Other evidences in the image such as the character performing various mundane task naked, treat their nakedness as an ordinary matter, or is not involved in a sexual situation is required to identify this tag.

h6. As a rule of thumb:
* If the person in nude is aware of their nudity and is not in the act that requires them to be in nude (such as [[bathing]]) but does not attempt to cover it and acts as normal, then the tag "nudist" is applicable.
* If the person in nude is in public place, being in presence with other people, or is overtly showing their state of nudity to others, then the tag "[[exhibitionism]]" is applicable.
* If the setting of the image treats the state of nudity or sexual act as a normal activity, then the tag "[[zenra]]" is applicable.


h4. See also

* [[exhibitionism]]
* [[nude beach]]
* [[zenra]]

h4. External links

* "Wikipedia: Naturism":http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Naturism

[b]Obijime[/b] is a small decorative string tied around the [[obi]], used only in women's [[kimono]].

It's about 150 cm (4.9 ft) long and is tied around the obi and through the knot, and which doubles as decoration. It can be a woven [[string]], or be constructed as a narrow sewn tube of fabric. Heroic spirit appearing in the [[Fate (series)|]], being a [[genderswap (mtf)|]]ped version of [[Oda Nobunaga (real life)|]]. She comes from a parallel timeline, with the version from proper human history being a male. She first appeared as the Demon Archer of [[Saber (fate)|Artoria]] in [[Koha-Ace]] as the second new servant after the [[Okita Souji (koha-ace)|Sakura Saber]]. She was introduced into [[Fate/Grand Order]] with the [[GUDAGUDA Honnouji]] event, and appears as the servant of [[Asama Kaname]] in [[Fate/type Redline]].

Nobunaga is often depicted in [[naked cape]] as a result of a running gag in Koha-Ace about how she would occasionally "feel hot", referencing the real life counterpart's death during the Honnouji temple incident. This was later elaborated upon in a more symbolic meaning in [[Fate/Grand Order]] (where this specific "outfit" is available as her final ascension art) as being her "accepting" her death and giving up on her honor and power that she can't take to the afterlife.

payload.body:
An [[Idolmaster Cinderella Girls]] character in the Passion (Yellow Sun) category.

Yui is a playful, laid back and informal 17-year-old girl who marches to the beat of her own drum. Initially her love of candy was played up as her primary quirk; it faded into a minor trait as her character developed. She became best friends with [[Aikawa Chinatsu]] after befriending her at the game's first New Year's event. In fact, one of her stages of evolution leading up to a swimsuit S Rare features her wearing Chinatsu's glasses.

She has been known to tease the Producer about indirect kisses when she offered him a lick of her lollipop, which is her favorite food. She refers to the Producer with the “-chan” honorific.

In the tie in Cinderella Girls Theater skits, Yui is a fun loving and excitable teen. She loves the freedom some roles give her, particularly that of a pirate. She tries to be mature by bringing her version of a hot drink to an onsen, but finds the cola to be disgusting due to it having gone flat. She is friends with Chinatsu and [[Mary Cochran]]. She wanted to walk with the Producer under an umbrella together and tried to get a taste of [[Mochizuki Hijiri]]’s cake until Hijiri began to cry in worry for a sugar figurine’s life. Yui is quick to point out that [[Ohta Yuu]]’s chocolate figure is suspicious and hopes Akky isn’t in any danger.

Due to her popularity, she was selected for the 9th set of CINDERELLA MASTER CD series, alongside [[Igarashi Kyoko]], [[Ninomiya Asuka]], [[Nakano Yuka]], and [[Aiba Yumi]]. She is voiced by [[Yamashita Nanami]].

payload.body:
Okazaki Yumemi (岡崎夢美) is the canonical final boss of the third [[Touhou]] game 東方夢時空 〜 The Phantasmagoria of Dim.Dream ("canonical" because it's a dueling shooter, so everyone fights everyone anyway). 

An eighteen-year-old university probability physics professor from the future who got shunned by society for believing in magic, she comes to Gensokyo to capture its specimens and prove her theory is right. A genius even by the future's high standards, she's the creator of the [[Probability Space Hypervessel]] - something not only capable of travel between time and space, but also of ripping through the Great Hakurei Barrier.

Yumemi's outfit and appearance is primarily red: her [[red_eyes|eyes]], [[red_hair|hair]], [[red_vest|vest]], [[red_skirt|skirt]], [i]and[/i] her [[red_cape|cape]] are all red.  Even the [[bowtie|bow on her white blouse]] is [[red_bowtie|red]].  Commonly, she will be represented by a red cross motif in reference to her in-game attacks; or strawberries, in reference to her theme music, [i]Strawberry Crisis!![/i]

A character from [[Koha-Ace]], an alter version of [[Okita Souji (fate)|]]. Originally known as "Majin Saber" during the manga's [i]XP[/i] run, she was a Saber-class gag character lampooning the concept of powerful fusions and [[dark persona]] (Alter forms in Fate universe), being a fusion of [[Oda Nobunaga (koha-ace)|]] and [[Okita Souji (koha-ace)|]]. She appears as a young woman with [[long hair|long]] [[white hair]], tied with a [[hair bow]] and decorated with [[tassel hair ornament]]s. The second kanji in her name as "Majin Saber" doesn't actually exist, with "jin" (asset #39621318) consisting of the character for god (神) above the character for person (人).

Her swimsuit variant is [[Okita Souji Alter (Swimsuit Saber) (fate)|]].

payload.body:
Random fortunes written on strips of paper at [[Shinto]] [[shrine]]s in Japan. Tying these strips of paper to trees or wires is a common custom, especially when receiving a negative fortune.

The fortune received is determined by shaking an [[omikuji-bako]], a cylindrical box containing several small sticks. After shaking the box until one of the sticks falls out, the stick will be matched to a specific drawer containing that person's fortune.

h4. Examples
* !post #8722659
* !post #8649254

h4. Fortunes
The short messages that may be found on them follow below, ordered tentatively from worst to best:

* 大凶 (dai-kyou), Great Curse
* 末凶 (sue-kyou), Future Curse
* 半凶 (han-kyou), Half-Curse
* 小凶 (shou-kyou), Small Curse
* 凶 (kyou), Curse
* 末小吉 (sue-shou-kichi), Future small Blessing
* 末吉 (sue-kichi), Future Blessing
* 半吉 (han-kichi), Half-Blessing
* 吉 (kichi), Blessing
* 小吉 (shou-kichi), Small Blessing
* 中吉 (chuu-kichi), Middle Blessing
* 大吉 (dai-kichi), Great Blessing

The temples and shrines across Japan do not have a unified system for their omikuji. Some places do not offer the full range of fortunes, and a few offer an additional fortune rank:
* 平 (hira), Neutral

How the unmodified "Blessing" ranks compare to Small and Middle blessings also varies.

h4. See also

* [[chinese fortune sticks]]
* [[omikuji-bako]]
* [[tied omikuji]]

payload.body:
The [b]Late Night Serious 60-Minute Drawing Game[/b] (深夜の真剣お絵描き60分一本勝負, Shin'ya no Shinken Oekaki 60-bu Ipponshōbu), or [b]1draw[/b] (ワンドロ, Wandoro), is a self-explanatory Twitter hashtag where artists are given a prompt and have an hour to exercise their skills.

The prompt is usually composed of three characters from a set copyright. Each copyright gets their own tag.

The challenge was originally started on May 13, 2013, by twitter user [[monyomoke]], establishing a prompt where participants were to draw [[Touhou]] characters [[komeiji_koishi|Koishi]], [[Nazrin]], and/or [[ibaraki_Kasen|Kasen]]. After a couple months, however, the organizer decided to quit, since he was tired. The role of organizer has since been passed over a couple of times.

The Touhou prompt is currently being hosted by "@1draw_night":[https://twitter.com/1draw_night]. They also have "a website":[http://1draw.aqn.jp] which hosts the artworks posted at the hashtag, with the artists' permission.

Other accounts dealing with different copyrights have been appearing. Some tags may be defunct.

h4. External links

* "Nameless Rumia's Wiki: 1draw":[https://namelessrumia.heliohost.org/w/doku.php?id=1draw]

payload.body:
One of the most recognizable [[Transformers]] that first appeared in the original [[Transformers: Generation 1]] TV cartoon from 1984. The heroic, wise and powerful Optimus Prime leads the [[Autobot]]s against [[Megatron]], the evil leader of the [[Decepticon]]s.

In the first series his alternate mode is a red, silver and blue Kenworth K100 cab over [[truck]]. But since his [[transformers (live action)|appearance in the the live action movie]], he is also frequently depicted as a red and blue [[Peterbilt 379]] [[semi truck]] with distinctive flame paintjob.

Before becoming leader of the Autobots, Optimus [spoiler]used to be a smaller robot called [[Orion Pax]]. He was mortally damaged by Megatron, but Alpha Trion reconstructed him into the ultimate powerful form of Optimus Prime.[/spoiler]

In [[Japan]] (except for the Japanese dubs of the live-action films and of [[Transformers: Animated]]), Optimus Prime is known as [b]Convoy[/b].
 
His quote in the G1 series, "”I've got an idea.”":[http://dic.pixiv.net/a/%E7%A7%81%E3%81%AB%E3%81%84%E3%81%84%E8%80%83%E3%81%88%E3%81%8C%E3%81%82%E3%82%8B] is regarded as a type of [[meme]] among Japanese Transformers fandom due to its low success rate.

Optimus Prime's original G1 design was created by [[mecha]] designers Obara Hiroyuki, [[Kawamori Shouji]] (famous for his work in [[Macross]]) and Ohno Kouhjin for the [[Diaclone]] Japanese transforming robot toy series in the early 1980s.

[quote]Motto: [i]"Freedom is the right of all sentient beings...".[/i][/quote]

h4. See also

* [[Omega Prime]]
* [[Elita One]]
* [[Orion Pax]]
* [[Convoy (armada)|]] 
* [[Optimus Prime (Transformers Prime)]]

The [b]Orca[/b] ([i]Orcinus orca[/i]) is a black and white carnivorous marine mammal. Commonly known as the [b]killer whale[/b] and also known as [b]orca whale[/b]. The orca is the largest species of dolphin, being part of the family Delphinidae. (Delphinidae is within the Odontoceti or toothed whales, which is within the Cetacea or whales, so orcas are whales in the sense that all dolphins are whales.)

Despite this, works portraying an Orca [b]ought not[/b] be tagged as [[whale]].

Usually growing around 5-8 meters long, orcas are known to be apex predators of the sea, as they have no natural predators.

payload.body:
A character design element of [[Arknights]], which manifests as chips of jagged, black, crystalline [[material growth|material growing]] out of the body.

They are symptoms of Oripathy, a disease in the world of Arknights caused by exposure to the mineral [[originium (arknights)|]]. Characters who become "infected" have originium begin to fuse with their cells; this causes tiny seed crystals of originium to form and subsequently grow, eventually resulting in lesions as the crystals damage surrounding tissue. Oripathy lesions appear on a number of characters but not all, since not every character is necessarily infected (or does not yet have external lesions).

It is also a feature that many fan artists, particularly ones not familiar with the property, often miss. Characters that should have oripathy lesions are often missing them in fan art and even official art can be a little inconsistent.

An Assassin-class servant from [[Fate/Grand Order]] first appearing in the [[Halloween Strike!]] event. Osakabe-Hime is a youkai that haunts the walls of Himeji Castle, and a friend of [[Tamamo no Mae (Fate)|]] and [[Kiyohime (fate)|]]. While she uses a [[bat (animal)|]] motif, Osakabe is actually a kitsune that attained human form (and also notes that it would be confusing if there were two kitsune Servants in the game). She is also a massive [[hikikomori]], and has the ability to control the [[origami]] animals she creates.

Appearance-wise, Osakabe has [[very long hair|very long]] [[black hair]] [[gradient hair|fading into]] [[brown hair|brown]] tips that she wears in [[twintails]], [[purple eyes]], and wears [[glasses]]. Her standard outfit is a kimono-themed [[hoodie]] and a [[purple skirt]]. Due to her dialogue in her swimsuit variants, she is also often depicted with a [[plump]] body.

She has a [[osakabehime (swimsuit archer) (fate)|swimsuit version]] for the summer 2019 event.

Otomachi Una is a Japanese [[VOCALOID]] developed and distributed by Internet Co., Ltd. in collaboration with MTK Inc., and was released for the VOCALOID4 engine.

She is a young girl with [[long hair|long]] [[blue hair]] in [[low-tied long hair|low-tied]] [[low twintails|twintails]] with [[low-braided long hair|braids on the ends]], long [[bangs]] and an [[ahoge]]. She has [[blue eyes]] and a [[fang|fanged]] smile.

With the release of this character came three designs, two for the VOCALOID voicebank "[[otomachi una (sugar)|SUGAR]]" and "[[otomachi una (spicy)|SPICY]]", and [[otomachi una (talkex)|another]] for [[TalkEX]] (a text-to-speech program):

* [[otomachi una (sugar)|SUGAR]] features Una in a [[band uniform]] with a [[sailor collar]] and [[red necktie]] and a [[white skirt|white]] [[pleated skirt]]. She wears [[white socks]] and [[blue shoes]]. Around her left thigh is a gold [[thighlet]]; this matches her gold [[bracer]].
* [[otomachi una (spicy)|SPICY]] is altered to be more [[punk]] in theme. Consisting of a black [[jacket]], red tie, and white shirt that shows her navel. She also wears [[belt]]s, a [[single fishnet legwear|single]] [[fishnet thighhighs|fishnet thighhigh]] attached to a [[single legwear garter]] [[mismatched legwear|paired]] with a [[purple thighhighs|purple thighhigh]] with [[piano print]] and [[black shoes]] .
* The [[otomachi una (talkex)|TalkEX]] design features Una in a [[sailor dress]], [[plaid pantyhose|plaid]] [[black pantyhose]] and [[white shoes|white]] [[sneakers]]. Her accessories are [[red-framed eyewear]] and a [[wristwatch]]. This design was also reused for her later [[VOICEROID]] voicebank.

All three looks have her wearing a puffy [[eel]] [[hat]].

payload.body:
An NPC and the deuteragonist of [[Genshin Impact]].

Paimon is a fairy-like being who accompanies the Traveler ([[Aether (genshin impact)|]]/[[Lumine (genshin impact)|]]) throughout their adventure in [[Teyvat]] as their guide. She met them after they fished her out of the sea, saving her life. Her past before the events of the game and meeting the Traveler is quite an enigma, with even Paimon herself unable to remember it's details. She serves as the mascot of Genshin Impact and is used as the icon for the app, official websites, and social media accounts.

She is very bubbly, outgoing and caring with a love for food and [[mora (genshin impact)|]] but can also be rude and blunt, giving people she doesn't like "ugly nicknames". She has a multitude of nicknames herself, including "Emergency Food" from the Traveler (which became a popular recurring gag) and "Flying Lavender Melon" from [[Arataki Itto]]. Her birthday is on June 1st (shared with [[Arataki Itto]]) which is International [[Children's Day]].

Paimon is very [[petite]], giving her a fairy-like appearance. She [[medium hair|medium]]-length [[white hair]] with a [[star hair ornament]], [[black eyes]] with [[white pupils]] and a [[halo]] above her head. She wears a [[white romper]] with rose-[[gold trim]] and a [[triquetra]] symbol on it, a [[black cape]] with a [[constellation print|constellation]] design, a [[single thighhigh|single]] [[white thighhighs|white thighhigh]] and a pair of [[white boots]].

Voiced by Penelope Rawlins in English (replacing [[Corina Boettger (voice actor)|]] (v1.0-v5.7)), [[Koga Aoi]] in Japanese and [[Duoduo Poi]] in Chinese.

The [b]Panzerkampfwagen IV[/b] (Pz.Kpfw. IV), commonly known as the [b]Panzer IV[/b], was a medium [[tank]] developed in [[Nazi]] Germany in the late 1930s and used extensively during [[World War II]]. Its ordnance inventory designation was Sd.Kfz. 161.

Designed as an infantry-support tank, the Panzer IV was not originally intended to engage enemy armor—that function was performed by the lighter [[Panzer III]]. However, with the flaws of pre-war doctrine becoming apparent and in the face of [[Soviet]] [[T-34]] tanks, the Panzer IV soon assumed the tank-fighting role of its increasingly obsolete cousin. The most widely manufactured and deployed German tank of the Second World War, the Panzer IV was used as the base for many other fighting vehicles, including the [[Sturmgeschutz IV]] assault gun, [[Jagdpanzer IV]] tank destroyer, the Wirbelwind self-propelled anti-aircraft weapon, and the Brummbär self-propelled gun.

h4. See also

She has mastery over the seven elements corresponding to Japanese weekday names - Sun, Moon, Fire, Metal, Wood, Water and Earth - earning her the nickname "One-Week Wizard", but her reclusive lifestyle (she's apparently not left her library in 100 years, which is interpreted in some doujins as signs of [[hikikomori]] behavior) has taken a toll on her health, limiting her powers by way of asthma and anemia. She wears a [[pink hat|pink]] or [[white hat|white]] [[mob cap]] with a [[crescent hat ornament|crescent ornament]] on it, as well as a [[hat ribbon|ribbon]], and single or [[double bun]] [[bun cover|covers]]. payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s depiction of HMAS Perth (D29), drawn by [[Kusada Souta]]. HMAS Perth was one of three modified Leander-class light cruisers used by the Royal Australian Navy during the early part of [[World War II]]. She was originally called HMS Amphion before being renamed after "the capital city of the state of Western Australia":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Perth]. She is the game's first Australian shipgirl.

Visually, Perth has [[purple eyes]] and [[long hair|long]] [[blonde hair]] tied in a [[braided bun]] with a [[braid]] across the front. She wears a [[school uniform]] consisting of a [[short sleeves|short-sleeved]] [[white shirt|white]] [[dress shirt]] underneath a [[green vest]] with a [[blue necktie]], a [[blue skirt|blue]] [[pleated skirt|pleated]] [[plaid skirt]], a pair of [[green thighhighs]], and [[brown footwear|brown]] [[loafers]]. Her [[rigging]] includes a pair of [[adapted turret]]s and a [[searchlight]]. She also has a [[green cape]] draped over her left shoulder, fastened by a large [[badge]] that strangely resembles the [[Icelandic flag]] and six seven-pointed stars which resemble those found on the Australian flag.

Because she is originally British, she does not exhibit the stereotypical mannerisms and preferences associated with Australians. She does make a reference to "Vegemite":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vegemite], a popular Australian sandwich spread, and is often accompanied by a [[koala]] in fan art (due to one clinging to a fairy version of her, the 6-inch Twin Rapid Fire Gun Mount Mk.XXI fairy).

She was originally commissioned for the [[Royal Navy]] on 15 June 1936 and was sold to the Royal Australian Navy in June 1939. She was sunk during the Battle of Sunda Strait on 1 March 1942.

payload.body:
The titular plant-like organisms from the [[Pikmin (Series)|]] series. They come in multiple varieties and have three distinct developmental stages (leaf, bud and flower).

h5. Introduced in [[Pikmin 1]]

* [[Red Pikmin]]: The only Pikmin with noses, they are red in color and have immunity to fire.
* [[Yellow Pikmin]]: The only Pikmin with ears, they are yellow in color and are the lightest of the Pikmin. They can use small [[bomb rock]]s and have immunity to electricity. 
* [[Blue Pikmin]]: These Pikmin have mouth-like gills and are the only Pikmin who can survive being underwater. They are blue in color.

h5. Introduced in [[Pikmin 2]]

* [[White Pikmin]]: The smallest of the Pikmin, they are the fastest and have immunity to poison as well as being toxic themselves. They have large red eyes and are white in color, similar to an [[albino]].
* [[Purple Pikmin]]: The only Pikmin with hair, they are the strongest but slowest of the Pikmin with a single Purple Pikmin having the strength of ten non-purple Pikmin. They are the bulkiest of the Pikmin and are purple in color. 

h5. Introduced in [[Pikmin 3]]

* [[Rock Pikmin]]: These Pikmin are grey in color and look like rocks. They are very hard, which allows them to destroy objects and are immune to being crushed or stabbed.
* [[Winged Pikmin]]: The only Pikmin with wings, they are pink in color and have blue eyes. They can carry objects to take shortcuts and avoid enemies, but are the weakest type of Pikmin for attacking.

h5. Introduced in [[Pikmin 4]]

* [[Ice Pikmin]]: These Pikmin are made out of ice and look similar to the Rock Pikmin. They can be used to freeze enemies or water to travel across.
* [[Glow Pikmin]]: These Pikmin are bioluminescent and have a bright green ghost-like body. They are nocturnal and can be used to form energy  orbs to hit enemies.

h4. External links

* "Pikmin Wiki: Pikmin family":https://www.pikminwiki.com/Pikmin_family

The line of [[game controller]]s used by the PlayStation series of [[game console]]s beginning with the [[Playstation 1]] in 1994.

Like the [[Super Famicom]]/[[Super Nintendo]]'s controller, which it was based on, the face of the controller features a [[D-pad]] on the left, four action buttons on the right, and initially two buttons in the middle (originally a Start and  Select button). It also features two sets of shoulder buttons, unlike the SNES controller's single set, and improved the ability to use those buttons by adding hand grips.

Starting in 1997, the design incorporated a pair of analog sticks toward the center of the controller and vibration functionality, both of which have remained a common feature in later iterations of the design.

payload.body:
[[Penguin]]-like dolls from the [[Disgaea]] video game series, and other titles by [[Nippon Ichi]].  They are mascot minions.  Prinnies explode on impact when thrown, dood.  Prinnies contain the souls of humans or demons who lead a criminal life or committed a grave sin, and have to work in Celestia (Heaven) or the Netherworld (Hell) to pay off their debts and reincarnate as something else. It's stated somewhere that you also become a Prinny if you lead a meaningless life.

Prinnies slur the words at the end of their sentences as "~ッス", or in English localizations, say "dood" at the end of sentence, dood.

[[Kazamatsuri Fuuka]] is a notable "prinny" from Disgaea 4 who wasn't fully converted into a prinny, and instead looks and acts as a girl with a prinny hat on and doesn't explode, in spite of her technical prinny status.  Other characters who die in Disgaea frequently reappear as prinnies, including some bad endings, but they are [[spoilers]]. 

There are some Prinnies who break the usual standards of being one, though those instances tend to be rare. [[Big Sis Prinny (disgaea)|]] is the first to break tradition by having a woman's voice. Another is the giant yellow Prinny that [[Usalia (disgaea)|]] rides around on during battles, which doesn’t have a name and never speaks. Another is [[Pii-chan (disgaea)|]], a bright yellow cat-themed Prinny who serves as [[Pirilika (disgaea)|]]’s secretary and speaks like a normal person.

Voiced by [[Majima Junji]].

A repeating [[gun]] action that is operated by manually pumping a sliding handguard on the gun's forestock. When shooting, the sliding forend is pulled rearward to eject the expended [[shell casing]] and typically to cock the hammer/striker, and then pushed forward to load a new [[ammunition|cartridge]] into the chamber.

Most pump-action firearms use an integral tubular [[magazine (weapon)|]], although some do use detachable box magazines. 

Pump-action is typically associated with [[shotgun]]s. The [[Remington 870]] and [[Mossberg 590]] are common examples of pump action firearms.

Quanxi, also known as ‘The First Devil Hunter’, is a hybrid of the [[Crossbow Devil (Chainsaw Man)|]], former Japanese Devil Hunter, and infamous assassin from China.

Quanxi worked as a Devil Hunter in Japan and became known as the 'First Devil Hunter'. While working as a Devil Hunter, Quanxi was partnered with [[Kishibe (Chainsaw Man)|]] while he was a young and new Devil Hunter. Upon their first meeting, [[Kishibe (Chainsaw Man)|]] flirted with and asked her to become his woman. This was followed by her immediately slapping him across the face and soundly rejecting him. This same cycle would repeat over the next 9 years, until she realized she was interested in girls to which [[Kishibe (Chainsaw man)|]] admitted to having already known.

At some point in time after this, she left Japan and moved to China to begin work as an assassin for the Chinese government. She formed a harem of 4 female Fiends ([[Quanxi's Group (Chainsaw Man)|]]) either before or after moving to China.

She is able to transform into a hybrid of the [[Crossbow Devil (Chainsaw Man)|]], triggered by pulling a crossbow bolt out of her right eye.

payload.body:
An alternate version of [[Hatsune Miku]] that serves as the mascot for [[GoodSmile Racing]].

[[Hatsune Miku]] receives a new design in a [[race queen]] theme for each racing season since 2009. The designs are officially acknowledged as "Racing Miku" (レーシングミク). The real life race queens for GoodSmile are known as the "Racing Miku Supporters" and wear outfits based on the Racing Miku design of the year.

The 2009 derivative is the only version of the Racing Miku derivatives which did not have an official illustration as per her release, though it was featured in merchandise for that season and new official arts have been given later on. The unveiling of the Racing Miku derivatives only became a feature from the 2010 season onwards. All merchandise related to Good Smile Racing featuring Miku prior to the 2010 season, with the exception of the 2009 Racing Miku figurine, features Miku in her normal attire.

payload.body:
A playable character in [[Genshin Impact]], the Electro Archon who governs Inazuma. Notable for her [[human scabbard|peculiar sword drawing technique]], in which she manifests the [[tachi (weapon)|]] [[Musou Isshin (Genshin Impact)|]] from her [[cleavage]]. Also known as Baal or "the Shogun". 

During the story, it is revealed her name is [spoiler]Ei, and her Archon name is Beelzebul[/spoiler]. The name Baal [spoiler]was a title that actually belonged to her twin sister[/spoiler]. 

Raiden Shogun has [[purple hair]] and [[purple eyes]], the former which is tied in a [[very long braid]] and is adorned with a [[hair ornament]]. She wears a [[purple kimono]] worn [[off shoulder|hanging off her arms]], tied with a [[red sash|red]] [[obi]] and adorned with a [[shoulder armor]]. She wears [[black thighhighs]] and [[high heels|high-heeled]] [[sandals]]. Typically wields a [[katana]] called [[Musou Isshin (Genshin Impact)|]].

Her signature weapon is [[Engulfing Lightning (Genshin Impact)|Engulfing Lightning]].

She is related to [spoiler][[makoto (genshin impact)|Raiden Makoto]][/spoiler], who is her [spoiler]twin sister[/spoiler].

payload.body:
[b]"Rainbow" Mika Nanakawa[/b], or [b]"Rainbow" Mika[/b] ([b]レインボー・ミカ[/b]) or [b]R. Mika[/b] for short, is a video game character from the [[Street Fighter]] fighting game series. Her first appearance is in [[street_fighter_zero_(series)|Street Fighter Zero 3]], later re-appearing in [[Street Fighter V]].

Mika is a Japanese [[wrestling|professional wrestler]] trained by the big, domineering, shinai-sporting, golf cart-riding [[Harmageddon Yoko]]. One of her favorite attacks (outside of grappling) is a flying [[hip attack]]. She is usually seen with her tag-team partner [[Yamato Nadeshiko (Street Fighter)|]]. She is considered the forefront representative of "joshipuro" (Japanese women's pro wrestling) in fighting games. [[Zangief]], a fellow pro wrestler, is her hero.

Mika is most commonly seen wearing a white and sky blue [[wrestling outfit]] of some design, complete with a [[blue mask|blue]] [[domino mask]] serving as a [[wrestling mask]] around her [[blue eyes]] and her [[long hair|long]], [[blonde hair]] done up as [[twintails]]. In [[Street Fighter Zero (Series)]], her wrestling outfit consists of a [[blue leotard]] with [[clothing cutout|cutouts]] on her [[back cutout|back]] (in the shape of a [[heart cutout|heart]]), [[shoulder cutout|shoulders]], and [[elbow cutout|elbows]]. She also has frills on her [[frilled sleeves|sleeves]] and [[frilled collar|collar]], a [[white bustier]] with [[heart print|hearts]] on each breast, and [[white boots|white]] [[wrestling boots]].

Mika's goal is to be "Star of the Ring." To try to accomplish this, Mika decided she would travel abroad and battle famous street fighters even before she made her official debut. During that time, she met Zangief, a wrestler she is a huge fan of. Zangief inspired her as a pro wrestler to train hard for the next time they meet.

h4. Official art

* !post #9505643

payload.body:
[b]Ranni the Witch[/b] is a character in [[Elden Ring]]. She is a mysterious figure who first introduces herself as Renna. Upon meeting her again, she reveals her true name and recruits the [[Tarnished (elden ring)|]] in servitude, setting them off in search of a hidden treasure. Her other servants are [[Blaidd the Half-Wolf]], [[War Counselor Iji]], [[Preceptor Seluvis]], and [[Glintstone Dragon Adula]]. She is the [[family|daughter]] of [[rennala queen of the full moon|Rennala]] and [[radagon of the golden order|Radagon]].

Ranni wears a [[large hat|large]] [[witch hat]] with wiry, silver [[hat ornament|ornamentation]] resembling a [[wreath]], and a [[fur cloak]] or [[fur cape|cape]] over what appears to be a pale [[robe]] or [[dress]]. She has [[extra arms|four arms]] and her limbs are [[doll joints|visibly jointed]]. She has [[cracked_skin|cracks]] on the left side of her face. She also has a second, translucent [[extra faces|face]] (called her "spirit face") which is displaced to one side, such that its left eye overlaps with her physical face's right eye. It is rather subtle and many players and artists don't notice it at first.

She normally wears a plain, silver [[ring]] on the ring finger of one of her right hands.

h4. See also

* [[Miniature Ranni]]
* [spoilers][[Lunar Princess Ranni]][/spoilers]

A playable character from [[Genshin Impact]]. He lives with a [[wolf]] pack in [[Wolvendom]] after being abandoned by his parents at a young age. The whereabouts of his [[Razor's Mother (genshin impact)|mother]] and [[Razor's Father (genshin impact)|father]] are currently unknown.

A good-natured and honest person, Razor loves his wolf pack as a family and refers to them as "Lupical". He has very keen senses and is highly agile, though he finds speaking troublesome and only speaks in short phrases and words. As Razor was abandoned by his parents when he was young, he was raised by Wolf of the North [[Andrius (genshin impact)|Boreas]] and his wolf pack in Wolvendom. At some point, he met Grand Master [[Varka (genshin impact)|]], who would give him his name and also taught him how to wield a claymore. Varka later brought Razor to [[Mondstadt City|Mondstadt]] which allowed him to slowly integrate with humans again through the help of his teacher [[Lisa (genshin impact)|]], who also taught him how to harness his elemental energy. Razor is good friends with [[Bennett (genshin impact)|]] and also [[Klee (genshin impact)|]], as he always manages to fix her disasters.

Razor has [[very long hair|very long]] [[grey hair]] with bangs hanging [[hair between eyes|between his eyes]], [[antenna hair]], [[red eyes]] and has [[scar]]s on his [[scar on cheek|cheek]] and [[scar on arm|arms]]. He wears a [[brown shirt]] with [[short sleeves]] and [[tassel]]s, a [[brown coat|brown]] [[hooded coat|hooded]] [[sleeveless coat]] with his [[hood up]], [[brown gloves|brown]] [[partially fingerless gloves]], [[green pants]], a [[brown belt]] and a pair of [[black boots]]. He has a [[bone necklace]] around his neck, an [[arm strap]] on his right arm and [[bandages]] on his [[bandaged arm|left arm]]. His [[vision (genshin impact)|]] is worn on his back. Razor's vision element is Electro and he wields a [[greatsword|claymore]] in battle.

Voiced by Todd Haberkorn (EN), [[Uchiyama Kouki]] (JP) and Zhou Shuai (CN).

One of the last [[abyssal ship]]s in the original Iroha order (not -hime or -oni moniker) in [[Kantai Collection]]. An insanely powerful Aviation Battleship.

Characterized by her cute yet psychotic [[grin]] and signature salute, petite appearance, and monster [[tail]] that her battleship parts are mounted on, she has [[short hair|short]] [[white hair|white]]/[[grey hair]] and [[glowing eyes|glowing]] [[purple eyes]] (or [[red eyes]] in her Elite form). She wears a black [[hoodie]] complete with [[scarf|muffler]] which is zippered down far enough to reveal her upper body and [[o-ring top]]. Also comes equipped with a small white [[backpack]]. Catchphrase is "Re!".

Holds a ridiculous amount of aircraft in-game (180) and is one of the very few ships that can participate in every stage of combat. Notorious for her elite form being as strong as most of the early event bosses from 2013-2014 and being far stronger than the other normal enemy ships.

payload.body:
[b]Rei no pool[/b] (例のプール, lit. "the usual pool"), officially called the[b] Hanazono Room[/b], is that indoor swimming [[pool]] with angled solarium windows which can be seen in just about every pool-related Japanese adult video ever.

It is located on the top floor of a building in [[Shinjuku (tokyo)|]], and was formerly part of a private penthouse apartment during the area's economic boom. It's now owned by a company that rents locations for video shoots. Surprisingly for a studio frequently used to film porn, it overlooks an elementary school.

The pool virtually ceased being available for JAV shoots in 2020 due to the rising cost of facility maintenance expenses to clean up afterwards. The pool remains open for non-AV shoots such as gravure and non-pornographic shoots.

Despite its reputation as a common location for JAVs, the pool has recently been featured in a handful of mainstream productions as well, including an episode of [[Kamen Rider Fourze (Series)|]].

h4. Examples

Reinforce II (リインフォースII or リインⅡ) is a [[minigirl|smaller version]] of [[Reinforce]] that has been accepted as a member of [[Yagami Hayate|Hayate's]] task force in the Time-Space Administration Bureau; she even wears the uniform. She can be summoned as a hologram from the [[Schwertkreuz]], and promotional pictures for [i][[Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha StrikerS|StrikerS]][/i] show a very solid Reinforce II accompanying Hayate as well. Her seiyuu is [[Yukana]].

Reinforce II (pronounced "Zwei") is apparently solid, and needs to eat and sleep daily; she has a "room" of sorts in Hayate's bag. She holds the rank of Sergeant Major and serves as Hayate's SNCO/ Chief of Staff in Lost Property Management Division 6. In [i][[Mahou Senki Lyrical Nanoha Force|Force]][/i], it is shown that she can also take a full-sized human form, though she's still noticeably shorter and younger-looking than the original Reinforce.

[[Agito (nanoha)|]] is her rival for some unknown reason.

Named after [[Reisen Udongein Inaba]]. Sometimes referred to by fans as "Reisen II" (レイセン2号) to distinguish her from the original, but English-speaking fans also use the unofficial romanization "Rei’sen" with the an added apostrophe or alternatively the anglicized phonetic spelling "Reysen".

h4. External links

* "Touhou Wiki: Reisen":http://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Reisen_(Bougetsushou)
