payload.body:
The "Lunatic [[Moon Rabbit]]". Stage 5 boss of [[Touhou]]'s [[Imperishable Night]] and later a recurring playable character in games.

Pet lunar [[rabbit girl|rabbit]] of [[Houraisan Kaguya]], apprentice to [[Yagokoro Eirin]], and caretaker of earth-born rabbit youkai [[Inaba Tewi]]. Her power is to cause lunacy with her stare, as well as control all kinds of wavelengths. Ironically, Reisen is also depicted as one of the more level-headed characters of the series. Doujins make fun of her [[danmaku]], which vaguely resemble [[suppository|suppositories]], as well as her rabbit ears, which look as though they were buttoned onto her head.

She has [[red eyes]], [[rabbit ears]] and a [[rabbit tail]], and [[very long hair|very long]] [[purple hair]]. She is one of the few Touhou characters with a "normal" outfit, with a [[black jacket|black]] [[blazer]] over a [[long sleeves|long-sleeved]] [[white shirt]] [[collared shirt|with]] a [[red necktie]], a [[pleated skirt|pleated]] [[pink skirt]], [[white socks]], and [[brown shoes|brown]] [[loafers]]. There might be a [[crescent pin]] or a [[carrot pin]] somewhere on her clothing.

In [[Urban Legend in Limbo]], her urban legend was the [[Kune-kune]], and she wields a [[megaphone]]-like weapon called the [[Lunatic Gun]].

payload.body:
The "Scorching, Troublesome Divine Flame". Final boss of [[Touhou]]'s [i][[Subterranean Animism]][/i] and later a playable character in [i][[touhou_hisoutensoku|Hisoutensoku]][/i]. A hell raven who absorbed the powers of a [[yatagarasu]], giving her the power to manipulate nuclear fusion which she then used to try to conquer the surface. Her nickname is "Okuu" (おくう), which is based on an alternate reading of the kanji in her name. Both Reiuji and [[Kaenbyou Rin]] are pets of [[Komeiji Satori]] and live in [[Chireiden]]. 

Her (fan-given) catchprase is '[[Unyu]]'; she is also known as [[circled 6|⑥]] because, like [[Cirno]] (whose nickname is [[circled 9|⑨]]), she is rather dumb and the strongest of the Former Hell, only difference is, she actually [i]is[/i] strong.  "⑥" also reflects her status as a Stage 6 boss, and the notion of her heat-based powers being the inverse of Cirno and her ice abilities.

Her spellcards are announced with a highly visible [[radiation symbol]] and while [[pointing up]] towards the [[black sun]], often while holding her [[arm cannon]] based on a [[control rod (touhou)|]].

She has [[long hair|long]] [[black hair|black]] or [[brown hair]] tied with a [[green bow|green]] [[hair bow]] and [[red eyes]], including her [[third eye]] on her chest. Her outfit is a [[collared shirt|collared]] [[white shirt]] with [[puffy short sleeves]] and sometimes [[frilled shirt|frills on the bottom]] and the [[frilled shirt collar|collar]], a [[frilled skirt|frilled]] [[green skirt]], a [[white cape]] with a [[starry sky print|starry]] [[print cape|print]] on the [[two-sided cape|reverse side]] over her [[black wings|black]] [[feathered wings|wings]], [[black socks]], and [[brown shoes|brown]] [[loafers]].

A character from the series [[Girls und Panzer]],  she's the driver of "Ooarai Girls Academy":[#dtext-see-also]'s Team Anglerfish's [[Panzer IV]].

Voiced by [[Iguchi Yuka]].

h4. Appearance

* !post #1283975: Profile

[expand=Official Character Bio]

h5. Ooarai Girls Academy / Team Anglerfish

h6. Original Anime

Is a genius at the top of her class.  But, due to her habitual tardiness in the morning she has insufficient credits, and so she is pursuing Tankery in exchange for credits.

[tn]Source: "[1]":[#dtext-external-links] (post #1283975)[/tn]

h6. Das Finale

Belongs to the Ooarai Girls tankery team.  Team Anglerfish's driver. Has excellent grades, but due to low blood pressure is weak in the mornings. With her genius she was able to master the controls with high degree of maneuverability just by reading the manual, and manipulates the Panzer IV freely according to Miho's intent. A childhood friend of Saori, she loves eating desserts and going to bed.

[tn]Source: "[2]":[#dtext-external-links][/tn]

h6. Operation More Love Love

Driver for Team Anglerfish. A gifted girl with top marks in her grade, and her memory and reading comprehension are unmatched. Has a great weakness for heights and getting up early, her best friend is the night when everyone else is asleep. That's why, no matter how scorching the temperature is, when the sun is out her eyelids naturally close...zzz.

The "Scarlet Devil". Final boss of [[Touhou]]'s [[Embodiment of Scarlet Devil]] and later a recurring playable character.

[[vampire|Vampiric]] mistress of the [[Scarlet Devil Mansion]] of at least 500 years of age despite her childish appearance, whose title comes from the bloodstains on her clothes and her fearsome ability to manipulate fate. Nevertheless, she is refined and friendly, if somewhat bratty. Besides her younger sister [[flandre_scarlet|Flandre]] and the rest of her household - head maid and personal attendant [[Izayoi Sakuya]], gatekeeper [[Hong Meiling]], and librarian [[Patchouli Knowledge]] and the little devil [[Koakuma]], among others - she is also good friends with her one-time nemesis, [[Hakurei Reimu]]. Atypical of vampires, Remilia has a low appetite for blood.

Sometimes drawn with her weapon, [[Spear the Gungnir]].

Nicknamed おぜうさま ([i]ozeu-sama[/i]) in Japanese, to differentiate her from countless other [i]ojou-sama[/i] characters.

[b]Revy[/b] is the female lead of [[Black Lagoon]] and the Lagoon Company's primary muscle. She has [[brown eyes]] and [[brown hair]] tied into a [[ponytail]]. She wears a [[crop top|cropped]] [[black tank top]], [[black gloves|black]] [[fingerless gloves]] with a hole cut out in the back, [[denim shorts|denim]] [[micro shorts]] that are held up with a [[green belt]], and [[green boots|green]] [[lace-up boots]].

Known as "Two Hand" because of her penchant for [[dual wielding]] guns, she is the member of the company most likely to use violence to deal with problems and is very nihilistic and cynical, which often puts her at odds with the more idealistic [[Okajima Rokuro]]. Revy enjoys a good gunfight, and works with [[Dutch (black_lagoon)|]] because she gets to shoot people and get paid, though her violent tendencies often border on the psychotic at times. Her full name is Rebecca Lee.

He reappears in [i][[Xenoblade Chronicles 3: Future Redeemed]][/i], being not only significantly older but outright bigger than his previous appearance as well as missing an eye.
In the context of [i][[Xenoblade Chronicles 3]][/i]'s main game, this hints him as [spoilers]the mentor of Founder [[Linka (Xenoblade)|Cassini]] of the City.[/spoilers]
He also has a cameo [spoilers]in the ending in a photo with him and the rest of the main XC2 cast surrounding Pyra, Mythra and Nia with newborns.[/spoilers]

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the lead ship of the French [i]Richelieu[/i]-class battleships. Character design by [[Akira (kadokawa)|]], voiced by [[Tanibe Yumi]].

She has light [[blue eyes]] and [[long hair|long]] [[blonde hair]] with a long lock [[long_hair_between_eyes|between her eyes]]. She has a [[mole under eye|mole under her left eye]] and another [[mole under mouth| below her mouth]].

Her outfit consists of a [[white beret]] with a red [[pom pom (clothes)|]] at the top, a [[two-tone dress|two-tone]] black-white-grey [[strapless dress]] with a [[belt]] under the breasts, a grey-black-red [[scarf]], black and white [[two-tone gloves]], a tricolore scarf tied on her left arm, black and white [[two-tone thighhighs]], and [[rudder footwear|rudder]]-styled [[loafers]].

The historical [i]Richelieu[/i] was laid down in 1935, launched in 1939 and still not fully complete at the start of [[World War II]]. She served both sides during the war. She began the war under [[Vichy]] France, notably helping fend off an Allied attack on Dakar. She joined the Allies in November 1942, and after a refit in New York was mostly employed in the Indian Ocean. After the war she served as a training ship and was eventually scrapped in 1968.

She is named after the "Red Eminence" [[Cardinal Richelieu]], a French clergyman and statesman.

[b]Rika[/b], known as [b]Chili[/b] (チリ) in Japan, is a member of Elite Four of the Paldea region in [[Pokemon Scarlet and Violet|Pokémon Scarlet and Violet]]. She also serves as the receptionist for the Pokémon League, interviewing the player during the first part of the Champion Assessment. She specializes in Ground-type Pokémon, her ace being [[Clodsire]].

She has a laidback and easygoing personality. In the original Japanese she speaks in the [[kansaiben|Kansai dialect]], though she will temporarily drop it when conducting the interview. She refers to the player as "kiddo" and has a distinct "nahaha" laugh.

Owing to her Japanese name, she is popularly represented by the 🌶️ (chili pepper) emoji among Japanese fanartists.

payload.body:
The [[flag]] of the former [[Imperial Japanese Army]] and [[Imperial Japanese Navy|Navy]] and the current naval ensign of [[Japan]], still used in the [[Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force]]. It has a red sun with sixteen rays on a white field, with the sun being off-center to the left in the naval ensign version.

Mostly confused as the Empire of Japan's state flag during the [[Meiji]]-era until end of World War II (Empire of Japan at the time use the same flag as today's Japan). Commonly viewed in other Asian countries (especially [[China]] and [[Korea]]) as a symbol of Japanese aggression and colonialism. Many Japanese, however, disagree with this view.

payload.body:
The ancient Roman way of writing numbers. Likely because of the elegant style, it is still usually recognized and understood by everyday people (at least from 1 to 10), and is frequently used on clocks.

* 1 = I
* 2 = II
* 3 = III
* 4 = IV (one below 5)
* 5 = V
* 6 = VI (one above 5)
* 7 = VII (two above 5)
* 8 = VIII
* 9 = IX
* 10 = X (can be remembered by how 2 V's form an X; 5*2=10)
* 11 = XI
* 12 = XII
* 50 = L
* 100 = C
* 500 = D
* 1000 = M

payload.body:
[[Azur Lane]]'s personification of the German heavy cruiser [i]Roon[/i], as part of a collaboration with [[World of Warships]]. Character design by [[Terras]], voiced by [[Satou Satomi]].

She has [[blonde hair]] and [[brown eyes]], with [[large breasts]]. Her default outfit consists of an [[open jacket|open]] [[black jacket]], [[black shirt|black]] [[double-breasted]] [[collared shirt]] with an [[Iron Cross]] medal, [[black skirt|black]] [[pleated skirt]], and black [[knee boots]]. 

Her [[rigging]] is emblazoned with some white [[Iron Cross]]es and a black-white stripe pattern. It consists of animalistic hull pieces holding her two triple and two twin 203 mm mounts, her intended armament, plus various 105 mm [[anti-aircraft gun]]s and [[searchlight]]s.

Her looks hide a highly-sinister personality. Similar to [[Graf Zeppelin (Azur Lane)|]], Roon is sadistic, relishing in bloodshed against her enemies, and even expresses willingness to attack her own allies. She becomes rather [[yandere]] for the [[Commander (Azur Lane)|]] with enough affection, and will eagerly kill anyone who attempts to come between the two. 

Roon has the "Expert Loader" skill, based on the [[World of Warships]] skill of the same name. It allows her to change shell types between high explosive and armor-piercing on the fly.

The historical Roon never saw much in the way of development, and no ship of her class was even considered, ordered, or laid down. The concept was largely based on a triple 8" turret designed by Krupp.

The female protagonist of [[pokemon black 2 and white 2|Pokemon Black 2 and White 2]]. Sometimes nicknamed "Donut-ko". Her male counterpart is [[Nate (pokemon)|]].

[quote]
This high-spirited young lady likes to stand out and has a strong sense of justice. Her dream is to have many battles with Trainers all over the world.
[/quote]

Known as [b]Mei[/b] in Japanese versions. Their Japanese names come from [i]kyoumei[/i] (共鳴), meaning "resonance". In English, this association is also kept, with "resonate" turning into "Rosa" and "Nate". 

She has [[blue eyes]] and [[very long hair|very long]] [[brown hair]] worn in [[twintails]] with [[double bun|double]] [[donut hair bun]]s. She wears a [[visor cap]], a shirt with [[raglan sleeves]] and a [[pink bow]], [[yellow shorts|yellow]] [[short shorts]] [[pantyhose under shorts|worn over]] [[black pantyhose]], [[sneakers]], and she carries a [[handbag]].

Already a popular player character in her own right, Rosa enjoyed a resurgence in popularity after being revealed as an early-game free character in the story of [[Pokemon Masters EX]]. In this game, Rosa's partner is [[Snivy]], and became known for her upbeat attitude and [[stroking own chin|multitude]] of [[+_+|expressions]].

Her [[Pokemon Adventures]] counterpart is [b]Whitley[/b] (ファイツ [i]Whi-Two[/i] in Japanese).

payload.body:
A playable character from [[Genshin Impact]]. She is a [[nun]] in Mondstadt's Church of Favonius.

Rosaria comes off as rather cold and intimidating, unlike the other sisters and hates working overtime. Despite Rosaria's position as a sister in the church, she is not devout, preferring to skip all church activities and when she does appear, can be found [[smoking]] in the pews. Notably, due to her lack of devotion, she never remembers [[Barbatos (genshin impact)|]]' name, frequently mispronouncing it in prayer. Secretly, Rosaria acts as a purveyor of justice in the shadows, investigating and eliminating potential threats to Mondstadt, much like [[Diluc (genshin impact)|]]. She is rather skilled in killing, due to her being raised by the same [[bandit]] group that slaughtered her family as a child. At some point, said bandit group was ultimately wiped out by the Knights of Favonius. She was then brought to [[Mondstadt City|Mondstadt]] by [[Varka (genshin impact)|]] for a chance of redemption.

Rosaria has [[pale skin|pale]] [[grey skin]], [[short hair|short]] [[purple hair]] with [[short hair with long locks|long locks]], a [[single hair streak|single]] [[red streaks|red streak]] and bangs hanging [[hair between eyes|between her eyes]], [[purple eyes]] and [[large breasts]]. She wears a [[black veil|black]] and [[red veil|red]] [[nun headdress|nun veil]] with a [[silver tiara]], a [[white shirt|white]] [[sleeveless shirt|sleeveless]] [[turtleneck]] top, [[white gloves|white]] [[elbow gloves]], a [[long skirt|long]] [[black skirt|black]] and [[red skirt]] with [[side slit]]s, a [[purple pantyhose|purple]] [[fishnet pantyhose]] and a pair of [[black boots|black]] [[high heel boots]]. She has a [[red gem]] on her chest, a [[black belt|black]] [[thigh belt]] on her left leg, multiple silver [[claw ring]]s on each hand and a silver [[incense burner|censer]] tied to her right wrist. She wears her [[vision (genshin impact)|]] on the back of her skirt by her lower back. Rosaria's [[vision (genshin impact)|]] element is Cryo and she wields a [[polearm]] in combat.

Voiced by [[Elizabeth Maxwell]] (EN), [[Kakuma Ai]] (JP) and Zhang Anqi (CN).

payload.body:
Ruby Rose is the protagonist of [[RWBY]], a 3DCG series produced by [[Rooster Teeth]]. 

Ruby is the "R" in RWBY, and is associated with the color red. Her character design is inspired by [[Little Red Riding Hood (fairy tale character)|]]. [[Yang Xiao Long]] is her [[half-siblings|half-sister]]. She likes cookies, drinks milk, and has a cheerful disposition.

h4. Abilities 

She wields a large [[scythe]]/[[gun]] hybrid weapon named [[Crescent Rose]], a "High-Caliber Sniper-Scythe" (HCSS). Her symbol is a [[rose]], and red [[rose petals]] appear when she uses her speed semblance (special ability).  

When in the presence of [[grimm (rwby)|]], her eyes are able to glow brightly with a silvery light. When this ability is used, any [[grimm (rwby)|]] in front of this light will be turned to dust or petrified, depending on how large the grimm is; very strong ones may be able to partially resist the effect.

h4. Physical characteristics 

Ruby has [[grey eyes]] and [[short hair|short]] [[two-tone hair|two-toned]] [[gradient hair|gradient]] [[red hair]]/[[black hair]], or black with red streaks. 

In earlier volumes of the series, she stood 5'2" tall (including boots). As of Volume 7, she is 5'4" tall.

h4. Attire 

She is usually seen in a [[red cape|red]] [[cape]] or [[hooded cloak]] secured with [[cross]]-shaped pins. Her default outfit includes a [[long sleeves|long sleeved]] [[black dress]] (with red [[frilled dress|frills]]) tied with a [[corset]], [[black pantyhose]], and [[black footwear|black]] [[knee boots]] with red [[lace-up boots|laces]]. Her [[belt]] is a [[bandolier]] with large [[bullet]] [[cartridge|cartridges]].  Most of her oufits include a [[rose]]-shaped badge somewhere on them.

Her Beacon [[school uniform]] consists of a [[white shirt|white]] [[blouse]] with [[neck ribbon]], brown [[blazer]], and [[plaid skirt]], plus her customary red cape.

h4. Appearance

* !post #2051267

She dislikes sunlight, concealing herself in darkness to protect herself, but ends up impairing her own vision, leading her to be portrayed as a member of [[Team 9 (touhou)|]], a posse of childish low-tier Touhou characters.

She is best known for her catchphrase "[[Is that so]]~?" (そーなのかー?, "So-nanoka~?"). She is often drawn with her [[spread arms|arms spread]] in a "crucifixion" pose.

A playable summoner in [i][[Final Fantasy IV]][/i]. Found by [[Cecil Harvey]] in the ruins of her hometown, the hero takes it upon himself to take her to the nearest inn. Rydia is initally distrusting of Cecil, but eventually warms up to him as he goes on a quest to cure his beloved [[Rosa Farrell|Rosa]] of a fatal fever.

[spoiler]After being knocked off a ship by Leviathan, Rydia is taken to the Feymarch, the Land of Summons, and discovers her full potential as a summoner. The warped time flow of the Feymarch causes Rydia to reach adulthood by the time she reunites with Cecil.[/spoiler]

payload.body:
One of the main protagonists of the [[Kara no Kyoukai]] novels. She is a teenage girl who possesses the [[Mystic Eyes of Death Perception]], a supernatural ability that allows the user to see the inherent mortality of everything (both living and non-living) in the form of lines.

She has short [[brown hair]] and [[brown eyes]]. She is usually seen wearing a [[red jacket|red]] [[leather jacket]] over a [[blue kimono]]. When she uses her powers, her eyes [[glowing eyes|glow]] an iridescent [[blue eyes|blue]] (though she is sometimes illustrated with blue eyes while [i]not[/i] using her powers [[artistic error|by mistake]]).

During the [[Fate/Grand Order]] collaboration event with Kara no Kyoukai, she can be acquired as an Assassin-class Servant. She can also be summoned as a Saber-class servant known as [[Void Shiki]] using the Kanesasa Kuji, where she appears in a more formal kimono. She gained a swimsuit version in the 2026 [[Chaldea U-Summer Island]] event.

A cursed spirit known as the [b]King of Curses[/b]. Incarnated into [[Itadori Yuji]] due to the latter eating one of his [[ryoumen sukuna's fingers|cursed fingers]], which contain his fragmented power.

He serves as one of the primary antagonists of the [[Jujutsu Kaisen]] series. 

See [[Ryoumen Sukuna (True Form) (Jujutsu Kaisen)]]  for depictions of his original form, and [[Ryoumen Sukuna (Second Possession) (Jujutsu Kaisen)]] for a form taken later in the series (beware of [[spoilers]]).

payload.body:
[i]You must defeat Sheng Long to stand a chance.[/i]
--Ryu, American version of [[Street Fighter II (series)|Street Fighter II]]
[tn]Mistranslation of the win quote, 昇龍拳を破らぬ限り、お前に勝ち目はない! ([i]lit.[/i] "If you cannot overcome the Shouryuuken, you don't stand a chance!) 
[/tn]

[b]Ryu[/b] is the main character and protagonist of the [[Street Fighter]] series. Ryu has made an appearance in every Street Fighter game, as well as in every crossover game with Capcom characters in it. Ryu has become a very famous character in the fighting genre, and is the star of the original Street Fighter.

As a very young child, Ryu was orphaned and left with no memories about his parents, and whether they were still alive. He was found and adopted by a man named [[Gouken]] who raised Ryu in his secluded dojo and trained Ryu in the ways of his martial arts. Shortly afterwards, Gouken would later train his best friend's spoiled son, [[Ken Masters]]. Ken served not only as a sparring partner, but also gave Ryu a friend in the form of a boy his own age.

Ryu looked up to Gouken as a father figure, and regards Ken as his best friend and surrogate brother, a relationship which remains to this day. When Ryu was 23 years old, Gouken believed that Ryu was ready to travel the world in order to test and hone his martial skills against the best fighters from around the world. With this, Ryu left Gouken's dojo, and headed to fight in the World Warrior tournament.

In most of his appearances, Ryu has [[short hair|short]] dark [[brown hair]] (sometimes depicted as [[black hair|black]] instead) tied with a [[red headband]]. He wears a white [[dougi]] with [[torn sleeves]] and red [[fingerless gloves]], and is usually [[barefoot]]. In his appearance in [i][[Street Fighter 6]][/i], he has grown a [[beard]] and forgone the upper portion of his dougi for a reddish-brown [[sash]].

A character in [[Higurashi no Naku Koro Ni]]. She is voiced by [[Nakahara Mai]].

She has a hobby for collecting and obsessing over cute things, as well as treasure hunting. Her catchphrase "I want to [[take it home]] with me!" referes to her tendency to collect anything she deems cute.

Although gentle and friendly, she suffered from a mental disease after her mother has left her. This led into her often underwent a stage of [[crazy|psychopath]]ic rampage against everyone.

She has [[blue eyes]] and [[short hair|short]] [[orange hair]] with [[bangs]]. Her school attire consists of a [[serafuku]] with a [[white shirt|white]] [[blouse]], [[blue sailor collar]], [[yellow neckerchief]], and a [[blue skirt|blue]] [[pleated skirt]]. Her casual attire consists of a [[white dress]], [[purple bow]], [[black thighhighs]], and a [[white headwear|white]] [[hat]]. She also often wields a distinctive [[machete]] during rampage.

[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese light carrier [i]Ryuujou[/i]. Character designed by [[Kuuro Kuro]], voiced by [[Hidaka Rina]].

She has [[long hair|long]] [[brown hair]] tied into [[twintails]], [[brown eyes]], and a [[flat chest]]. Her default outfit consists of a maroon/dark red [[kariginu]]-like vest over a [[white shirt]], [[black skirt|black]] [[pleated skirt]], a [[magatama]] necklace, [[visor cap]] patterned off her real-life bow, [[thigh strap]]s holding [[anti-aircraft gun]]s, [[white socks]], and [[platform footwear]]. She emits blue flames with text reading "Imperial Edict" which is how she launches aircraft from her [[flight deck]] [[scroll]]. 

She talks in [[kansaiben|Kansai-ben]]. She is often nicknamed "RJ" and, with her cap, somewhat resembles a [[McDonald's]] worker. Near-constant victim of [[flat chest joke]]s in fanworks. Ironically, in game she is proud of her "distinctive silhouette" and never seems [[breast envy|envious]] of other girls' bosoms.

A character from [[Fate/stay night]], [[Fate/hollow ataraxia]], [[Fate/Zero]], and [[Fate/Extella]]. Saber is the female lead character of [[Fate/stay night]].

A young girl with [[blonde hair]] tied up in a [[single hair bun]] with a [[bun with braided base|braid]], [[green eyes]] and a distinctive [[ahoge]]. Often seen wielding a [[sword]] and wearing [[armored dress]], or a white [[blouse]] and a blue [[skirt]]. The Fate/Zero version is often drawn wearing a black [[business suit]] and hair tied in a [[ponytail]]. In [[Fate/stay night]], her chronological age is approximately in the late twenties, but she appears to be around fifteen, as her physical aging was stopped by magic in the "Sword in the Stone" event until her death in her original timeline.

[spoiler]True Name: [[Artoria Pendragon (fate)|]], a [[genderswap]]ped version of [[King Arthur (mythology)|King Arthur]].[/spoiler]

payload.body:
A non-canonical alternate costume of [[Saber (fate)|]] playable in the [[Fate/Unlimited Codes]] fighting game for the PS2 based on [[Fate/stay night]]. She also appeared in the Type-Moon OVA [[Carnival Phantasm]], along with [[Phantas-Moon]], [[Magical Amber]], and [[Kaleido Ruby]]. 

She is basically [[Saber (fate)|]] as a [[magical girl]] with a strong [[lily (flower)|lily]] motif, though not in a literal sense.

As of the release of [[Fate/Grand Order]], she has gotten an official story, where she is Saber during her earlier days, still wielding [[Caliburn (fate)|]] and just beginning to walk the path of a king. She was still an inexperienced knight, looked  like an adorable lily, and her eyes brimmed with shining hope. To experience many things, she traveled the land and engaged in many adventures. The people she saved in his time came to call her in past of the Knight Princess, for her brilliance and beauty.

Saber Lily is treated as a separate character from Saber, so do not add the [[Saber (fate)|]] tag if she is by herself. It's only applicable if both characters are together in the image.

[b]Sabrina[/b], known as [b]Natsume[/b] in Japan, is a character introduced in [[pokemon red/green/blue/yellow|Pokémon Red and Green]].

She is the Gym Leader of [[Saffron City]]'s Gym, and she hands out the [[Marsh Badge]] to trainers who defeat her. She possesses psychic abilities and specializes in Psychic-type Pokémon. Her signature Pokémon is [[Alakazam]].

In her [[pokemon firered and leafgreen|FireRed and LeafGreen]] outfit, she has [[red eyes]] and [[long hair|long]] [[straight hair|straight]] [[black hair]] with [[blunt bangs]]. She wears a [[bodysuit]], a [[cropped jacket|cropped]] [[red jacket|red]] [[turtleneck jacket|turtleneck]] [[long sleeves|long-sleeve]] jacket, [[white gloves|gloves]], a [[red skirt|red]] [[side slit]] [[pencil skirt|pencil]] [[miniskirt]], [[yellow thighhighs|yellow]] [[over-kneehighs]], and [[red boots]]. In her [[pokemon heartgold and soulsilver|HeartGold and SoulSilver]] outfit, she has red eyes, [[medium hair|medium]] [[flipped hair]], a [[crop top|cropped]] [[pink camisole]] that exposes [[midriff]], large [[bracelet]]s, [[white pants]], and [[pink slippers]].

Voiced by [[Tanaka Rie]] and [[Araki Kae]] (anime).

payload.body:
A Character from [[little_busters!|Little Busters!]]. Haruka is a schoolmate of Riki's from a different class, but despite this, always seems to find time to hang around in Riki's classroom. She is a problem child and will start an uproar for her own personal enjoyment, which causes her twin sister, the public morals chairman Kanata Futaki, to often chase after her. She use marbles as a weapon to distract the public morals committee from chasing her, and when Riki is with her, she will drag Riki away, explaining that being captured by the public morals committee means big trouble for her. [spoiler]The truth is, she was abused by her family (not her parents, who were kept away from her and Kanata), while Kanata was seemingly treated very well, though truthfully she was not. She thus starts trouble to bother her sister and shame her family name.[/spoiler] She works part-time in the school's cafeteria to get permission to use the oven to bake muffins and cakes. 

Looks the same as [[Futaki Kanata]]. Tell them apart by:

Kanata: usually no thighhighs, golden eyes
Haruka: often black/white striped thighhighs, blue eyes

Despite her tragic history, she often acts as a rather ditzy airhead, seemingly thinking of nothing but anticipating her meals, sleeping, and teasing her straight-laced bodyguard and gardener, [[Konpaku Youmu]]. All these facets, however, conceal an incredibly sharp mind to rival that of her closest friend, [[Yakumo Yukari]].

Depictions might show her with the cherry tree her body was buried under, the [[Saigyou Ayakashi]].

Non-ghost depictions of her can be found under [[Saigyouji Yuyuko (living)]].

Her second unit is based off of the [i]Kawanishi N1K-J [b]Shiden[/b] (Violet Lightning)[/i]) with a single white angled identification stripe after she started becoming unable to raise proper shields once she reached the age of 20. She also forged a new [[katana]] that she calls Reppumaru, that has the ability to redirect [[Neuroi]] energy beams back to the enemy.

Mio is based on Japanese flying ace [[Sakai Saburou]].

She has [[short_hair|short]] [[purple hair]] with [[antenna hair]], and light [[purple eyes]]. Her default outfit is the class' uniform: a white [[serafuku]] that exposes her [[midriff]] with a red [[pleated skirt]], [[blue necktie]], [[white gloves]], [[belt]], [[grey footwear|grey]] [[rudder footwear]], and has [[uneven legwear]] where the left leg is a [[single thighhigh]] with a [[garter_straps|garter strap]].

Her [[rigging]] consists of her real-life bridge, funnel, and mast (with [[radar]]) worn in a backpack-like arrangement, her three 15.2 cm twin gun mounts controlled by [[joystick]]s, an 8 cm twin [[anti-aircraft gun]] mount on her right ankle, and a [[flight deck]] and 61 cm quad [[torpedo tubes]] on her left leg. 

Sakawa is visibly shorter, thinner and has [[small breasts]]: the result of having never participated in combat because the IJN was short of fuel (in fact, this was what prevented her and the other surviving [i]Akizuki[/i]-class destroyers under her DesRon from joining her sister Yahagi in Operation Ten-Go).

A character from [[Mahou Shoujo Madoka Magica]].

A girl from Kazamino City who showed up in Mitakihara at the end of episode 4. Originally self-centered, easily angered and confrontational, she eventually starts to warm up after gradually bonding with [[Miki Sayaka]]. She also greatly enjoys eating, being infuriated at the sight of food being wasted, and is highly skilled at [[Bemani]] games such as [[Dance Dance Revolution]].

She has [[long_hair|long]] [[red hair]] in a [[ponytail]] held by a [[black bow]] and [[red eyes]], and her regular clothes is a [[casual]] outfit consisting of an [[aqua hoodie]] jacket, a [[black shirt]] with [[midriff peek]], [[denim shorts]] with [[fur trim]], and [[brown boots]]. Usually seen [[mouth hold]]ing a [[pocky]], or eating [[taiyaki]] or [[apple]].

Her [[magical girl]] clothes resembles a crimson cassock and has [[detached sleeves]] that show [[bare shoulders]]; she also wears [[black thighhighs]] and [[boots]]. Her weapon is a [[spear]] that can detach into several pieces connected by chains.

In [[Mahou Shoujo Madoka Magica: Walpurgis No Kaiten]], Kyoko's hair becomes [[braid|braided]] on the sides, and her ponytail is a bit messier.

[spoiler] As shown in the PSP game, her witch form is [[Ophelia (madoka magica)|]].[/spoiler]

payload.body:
An [[iDOLMASTER Cinderella Girls]] character in the Cute (Pink Flower) category. She appeared in the Idolm@ster Cinderella Girls anime.

Momoka is a very elegant young 12 y.o. lady with a princess-like disposition, who acts very mature for her age. Her clothes tend to be very frilly and covered in flower motifs. She's from a wealthy upbringing.

In the tie in Cinderella Girls Theater skits, Momoka is a mature girl who appears to have a lady-like aura about her. While she often tries to act older than she is, Momoka still is a young girl at heart and is susceptible to things girls her age enjoy. She was scouted by considering herself the prize in the Production Match Festival. She regularly holds tea parties with the younger idols, and takes them very seriously. Her favorite tea seems to be “Rose Hip Tea”, although she can occasionally be distracted from it via the antics of her guests.

Momoka found a friend in [[Umeki Otoha]], as they both shared a similar demeanor. She appears to enjoy teasing [[Kamiya Nao]], as she notes Nao chooses her clothes and costumes with the Producer in mind. Momoka also really likes the glasses [[Kamijo Haruna]] gave her, and enjoys selecting kimonos with friends. She holds the Producer in very high regard and shows that she will put herself on the line in order to show him that she cares about him.

Due to her popularity, she was selected for the 8th CINDERELLA MASTER CD series, alongside [[Tachibana Arisu]], [[Ichinose Shiki]], [[Katagiri Sanae]], and [[Shiomi Syuko]].

Voiced by [[Terui Haruka]].

The sakuramon (桜紋) is a stylized depiction of a five-petaled [[cherry_blossoms|cherry blossom]]. The tips of the petals often feature an indent.

It is notably used on rank and cap badges of the [[Imperial Japanese Navy]] and all branches of the Japan Self-Defense Forces. It frequently shows up in copyrights with a naval theme. In [[Azur Lane]] it's used as the emblem of the Sakura Empire and appears on many of that nation's characters. It's also seen on several [[Kantai Collection]] characters, where it is often mistaken for a [[kikumon]].

payload.body:
The personification of the American [i]John C. Butler[/i]-class destroyer escort as depicted in [i][[Kantai Collection]][/i].

As a destroyer escort, she is of a small frame comparable to an elementary schooler. Her [[short hair]] is a dull light [[blue hair|blue]] done up in [[double bun]]s while her eyes are a highly light, dull [[yellow eyes|yellow]].

She wears a [[sleeve cuffs|cuffed]] [[long sleeves|long-sleeved]] [[white shirt|white]] [[serafuku]] with a [[blue sailor collar]] (oversized to fit her collar rigging) and [[aqua neckerchief]], a [[pleated skirt|pleated]] [[aqua skirt|aqua]] [[miniskirt]], a [[white headwear|white]] [[dixie cup hat]] with a [[black ribbon|black]] [[hat ribbon|ribbon]] and star ornament (representing the Battle Star she earned for Samar) attached to it, [[high heels|high-heeled]] [[red footwear|red shoes]] with [[rudder footwear|attached rudders]] and screws, and a [[thigh strap]] on her left leg. The [[signal flag]]s on the ends of her hat ribbon spell out her radio callsign, NTIK. 

In her right hand, she is holding one of her 5-inch gun turrets in an [[adapted turret|adapted]] assembly that resembles a [[FN P90]] [[submachine gun]]. The assembly has a length of armor plating attached to the side, which holds at least 2 spare magazines.

The [[Navy Cross]] hanging from her left shoulder references both the one awarded posthumously to her namesake, "Coxswain Samuel Booker Roberts Jr.":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Samuel_B._Roberts], and the one awarded to her skipper, "Lieutenant Commander Robert W. Copeland":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robert_W._Copeland], for the action off Samar.

She is accompanied by a [[Little Blue Whale (kancolle)|]]. This references another incident of the historical [i]Samuel B. Roberts[/i]: on her first day of active service, she struck a large whale with her starboard propeller shaft off the coast of Maine, and had to return to Norfolk for repairs.

[[Zeco]] once remarked that shipgirl Samuel [[no panties|doesn't wear panties]] underneath her clothes. It is not known whether it was just a joke as it has never been apparent on official art. Nonetheless, fans took this as semi-fact to the point of being a running gag used by some fan artists.

payload.body:
The main protagonist of the [[Metroid]] series. A Bounty Hunter that has averted countless crises that have threatened the galaxy, such as those involving the [[Metroid (creature)|]]s, [[Phazon]] and the [[X Parasite]]s.

Adopted by the [[Chozo]] after being orphaned by a [[Space Pirate (metroid)|]] raid, she was infused with their [[alien]] DNA and raised as a warrior. She later served under Commanding Officer [[Adam Malkovich]] within the Galactic Federation Army, but after a traumatic incident she left to become an independent Bounty Hunter.

She is armed with a Chozo [[power armor|cybernetic exoskeleton]] equipped with an [[Arm Cannon]] and a [[assault visor|visor]] known as the [[Power Suit (metroid)|]] that protects her and greatly enhances her abilities. This suit also has the means to assimilate other technology within itself to [[power-up|upgrade]] it's capabilities and gain greater power. She wears the [[Zero Suit]], a [[skin tight]] [[blue bodysuit]], under her power suit in case of a malfunction which offers far less protection and only has her armed with the [[Paralyzer]]. She wears more casual clothing in various endings, her most popularized being a [[crop top]] and [[short shorts]] in either orange or blue. [spoiler]A special ending to the first Metroid will show her in a [[bikini]][/spoiler].

According to the [[metroid 2: return of samus|Metroid II]] manual and concept art for [[Super Metroid]] within her power suit she is 6'3" (1.90 m) [tn]"[1]":[http://metroid.retropixel.net/gallery.php?gallery_id=m2_manual&image_id=8][/tn][tn]"[2]":[https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/metroid/images/c/c1/M3_Kraid_design.png/][/tn].

[b]"Black Leg" Vinsmoke Sanji[/b] is one of the main characters of the manga and anime [[One Piece]]. He is a member of the [[Straw Hat Pirates]], serving as cook and fighter. Sanji's life goal is finding the All Blue, a legendary sea where all oceans of the One Piece world meet, giving a cook the opportunity to make a truly global and unique meal.

He is the master of the "Black Leg Style", a martial art consisting of coordinated kicks he developed to avoid damaging his hands so that his fighting wouldn't interfere with his profession as a cook. One of his quirks is having [[aroused nosebleed|absurdly exaggerated nosebleeds as a reaction to beautiful women]], and his most recognizable facial feature are his [[curly eyebrows]], which he has in common with his siblings. Third son of [[Vinsmoke Judge]].

He is the main character of the spin-off culinary manga [[Shokugeki no Sanji]].

payload.body:
[[Strike Witches]] character.

Aleksandra "Sanya" Vladimirovna Litvyak is a Night Witch of the [[501st Joint Fighter Wing]], originating from Orussia and affiliated with her home unit: the Imperial Army of Orussia’s 586th Fighter regiment. Her familiar is the domestic cat. Her mild personality and nocturnal lifestyle give her a "ghost like" impression. 

Her Magic Antenna (魔導針, Madō Shin, lit. "Magic Needles") allow her to interact with radio waves. It is a type of non-visual perception that can detect objects at extreme ranges. Also can use a spell to provide guidance cues to other witches and aircraft and is able to tune in and rebroadcast radio transmissions.

Sanya based on Russian flying ace Lydia V. Litvyak, one of only two female aces of [[World War II]] and the only female pilot out of the pilots the witches are based on. Both share the name "White Lily of Stalingrad"; a nickname that may have been influential on the color choice of Sanya's hair.

h4. Appearance

* !post #9921951

h4. External Links

* "Wikipedia: Lydia V. Litvyak":http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lydia_Litvyak

Title character of [[Ranma 1/2]]. He's an expert martial artist who was born male, but a curse from falling into a magic spring made him turn into a girl. Whenever he gets soaked with cold water he transforms into his [[Saotome Ranma (Female)|female form]] and he changes back to his [[Saotome Ranma (Male)|male form]] when he gets soaked from hot water. He also has an aversion to cats as a result of training in "Cat Fu".

Thanks to his father, he has two fiancés: [[Tendou Akane]] and [[Kuonji Ukyou]]. Is also loved by [[Shampoo (Ranma 1/2)|]] and [[Kunou Kodachi]]. Seen as rival in love by [[Hibiki Ryouga]], [[Mousse (ranma 1/2)|]] and [[Kunou Tatewaki]].

payload.body:
A [[Persona 4]] character.

An upbeat girl with [[short hair|short]] [[brown hair]] who usually wears a [[green jacket|green]] [[track jacket|athletic jacket]] decorated with buttons. Her weapon is a pair of greaves. She has an obsession with Kung fu, and even uses them in battle, similar to Lisa Silverman of Persona 2. Most of the time, she is friendly, cheerful, and energetic, but she has a short temper, especially with Yousuke. Chie, Yukiko, and Rise are unskilled at cooking, often providing the main cast with unpalatable to terribly awful dishes through the course of the story. Yousuke refers to their horrible cooking as "Mystery Food X."

Her Persona is [[Tomoe (Persona 4)|]] of The Chariot Arcanum, a muscular female figure wearing a yellow outfit reminiscent of Bruce Lee's famous tracksuit, wielding a double bladed naginata. Tomoe is shown to use both physical and low-level ice spells. Tomoe evolves into [[Suzuka Gongen (Persona 4)|]] after maxing out her Social Link, the one for The Chariot Arcana.

She is also one of the female characters whom the protagonist can have a romantic relationship with.

Voiced by: [[Horie Yui]] (Japanese), [[Tracey Rooney]] (English, PS2 release), [[Erin Fitzgerald]] (English, [[Persona 4 The Golden|Golden]] onward).

payload.body:
A sauna is a small room or house designed as a place to experience dry or wet heat sessions, or an establishment with one or more of these and auxiliary facilities.

A sauna session can be a social affair in which the participants disrobe and sit or recline in temperatures typically between 70°C (158 °F) and 100°C (212 °F). This induces relaxation and promotes sweating.

Saunas can be divided into two basic styles: conventional saunas that warm the air or infrared saunas that warm objects. Infrared saunas may use various materials in their heating area such as charcoal, active carbon fibers, and other materials.

payload.body:
A playable character from [[Genshin Impact]], she is a [[ninja]] of the Shuumatsuban in Inazuma. She is capable of summoning or transforming into [[Muji-Muji Daruma (genshin impact)|]].

Despite being a particularly skilled and capable [[ninja]], Sayu mainly uses her ninjutsu to hide from her work and avoid a certain [[Kano Nana|shrine maiden]], allowing her to spend as much time [[sleeping]] as possible. While she is renowned for her laziness, other Shuumatsuban members know that she is still very loyal to their cause. Her short height is something Sayu is very unsatisfied with, believing that sleeping will help her grow taller and will not allow people to [[headpat]] her as she believes it will impede her growth.

Sayu has [[short hair|short]] [[green hair]] with [[blunt bangs]], [[purple eyes]] and has [[fake animal ears|fake]] [[raccoon ears]] on her [[raccoon hood|hood]] and a [[fake tail|fake]] [[raccoon tail]]. She wears a [[brown kimono|brown]] [[short kimono]] with a [[single sleeve|single]] [[short sleeves|short sleeve]], a [[gradient clothes|gradient]] [[jacket]] with its [[hood up]], a [[black scarf]] around her neck, a [[black sash|black]] [[obi]] with an [[orange bow]], [[uneven gloves|uneven]] [[black gloves|black]] [[fingerless gloves]] with [[arm guards]], [[black shorts|black]] [[bike shorts|bike]] [[short shorts]] and a pair of [[black sandals]]. She has a [[leaf]] [[leaf on head|on her head]] resting between her ears, [[red rope]] and a [[shuriken]] adorning her scarf, a [[fishnets|fishnet]] [[thigh strap]] on her left leg and carries a [[brown bag|brown]] [[kinchaku]] on her left hip. She wears her [[vision (genshin impact)|]] on the thigh strap on her left leg. Sayu's [[vision (genshin impact)|]] element is Anemo and she wields a [[greatsword|claymore]] in combat.

Voiced by [[Lilypichu]] (EN), [[Suzaki Aya]] (JP) and Sakula小舞 (CN).

Caster-class Servant in [[Fate/Grand Order]] who debuted in the [[Agartha (fate/grand order)|]] singularity as the [b]Caster of Nightless City[/b]. Has [[long hair|long]] [[black hair]], [[dark-skinned female|dark skin]] and a [[curvy]] design featuring lots of [[skindentation]]. She is a character from the Middle Eastern story [i]One Thousand and One Nights[/i], where she dated a king who killed every woman he courted with so they wouldn't be unfaithful to him. Scheherazade avoided death by reading fascinating stories to the king every night, stopping the tale at dawn each time so she could keep his interest. After 1,001 nights together, the king spared her life and married her.

She first appeared in [[promotional art]] for Epic of Remnant (post #2635525). She's usually grouped together with [[Nitocris (fate)|]] and [[Queen of Sheba (fate)|]] in both official and fan works due to their common traits as middle eastern queens.

[[Matoi Ryuuko]]'s primary weapon in [[Kill la Kill]]. She wields one half of a red pair of scissors capable of cutting apart Goku Uniforms. The Scissor Blade can shrink into a regular-sized scissor half, or morph itself via mechanical joints into a much larger version that Ryuuko uses to fight, which she calls Decapitation Mode.

The other half is with the person responsible for murdering Ryuuko's father. She battles [[Kiryuuin Satsuki]] and her minions to find out who owns the missing Scissor Blade.

[spoiler]In episode 12, [[Harime Nui]] reveals that she owns the other half of the Scissor Blade and that she murdered Ryuuko's father on [[Kiryuuin Ragyou]]'s orders. For some reason, Nui's half is colored purple until Ryuuko recovers it and reattaches it to her own half.[/spoiler]

A large, fish-eating mammal that has a round body, sleek fur, and lives near the sea, usually in cold climates.

Not to be confused with the [[sea lion]]. A seal is big and round with high body fat, holes for ears (excepting the "fur seal":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fur_seal]), and often squishes its head inward inside of its own body fat. A [[sea lion]] has a thinner body, visible ear flaps, more defined and protruding head shape, can stand "upright" on its flippers which it uses to walk, and makes loud barking sounds.

An Archer-class servant introduced in [[Fate/Grand Order]]'s [[Imijikarishi Valentine]] event.

An author, poet and court lady to Empress Fujiwara no Teishi. Shounagon authored "The Pillow Book":https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pillow_Book, a book of observations and personal musings she had during her service to the Empress.

Initially introduced herself as Kirakira no Archer, "The Sparkling Archer". She later refers to herself with her informal name Nagiko. She is a contemporary and rival of [[Murasaki Shikibu (fate)|]].

A notable [[otaku]] who tried to be as youthful and "in-touch" with modern culture as possible. Which were shown by her Noble Phantasm [[Emotional Engine - Full Drive]], which features a [[double v]], as well as her (in)famous [[dab (dance)|dabbing]] attack pose.

[b]Character Design:[/b] [[Mika Pikazo]]

Shadow has a distant, at times borderline edgy personality due to his past, but has gained independence from it and will not tolerate wrongdoings against those he cares for. He is [[voice actor|voiced]] by [[Yusa Kouji]] in the Japanese version, and David Humphrey, Jason Griffith, and Kirk Thornton in English titles. In the live action [[Sonic The Hedgehog 3 (movie)|]] movie, Shadow is voiced by [[Keanu Reeves]].

payload.body:
The "Traditional Reporter of Fantasy". First appeared as an opponent (and later, playable character) in the ninth [[Touhou]] game, [i][[Phantasmagoria of Flower View]][/i]. She has since reappeared in other games as a playable character, and often appears in the various print works.

Aya is a crow tengu, and has the ability to manipulate the wind in addition to the exceptional sight and long-range hearing possessed by most tengu. She is also absurdly fast, perhaps even the fastest in Gensokyo. She runs, reports, and photographs for her own newspaper, the [i][[Bunbunmaru]] Shinbun[/i]. However, the publication is notorious for being filled with rumors, gossip, and personal opinion. 

She is the rival of fellow journalist [[Himekaidou Hatate]], who runs the [i]Kakashi Nenpo[/i] ("Kakashi Spirit Times"). She was (and still is) also often depicted in fanworks as a friend to (or the superior of) the white wolf tengu [[Inubashiri Momiji]], one of the guardians of Youkai Mountain. However, it was revealed in [[Double Spoiler]] that the two actually dislike one another. 

Her catchphrase is "[[ayaya~]]".

Aya has [[red eyes]] and [[black hair]] of varying lengths. Her outfits have changed somewhat throughout her various appearances, but by far her most common outfit is a small [[red hat|red]] [[tokin hat]] with two strings of [[pom_pom_(clothes)|pom poms]] attached, a [[white shirt|white]] [[collared shirt]] with a [[black ribbon]] tied around the collar, [[frilled skirt|frilled]] [[black skirt]], [[black socks|black]] [[kneehighs|knee-high socks]], and [[red footwear|red]] [[tengu-geta]]. She often carries around an old [[camera]], a [[notebook]] and [[calligraphy brush]], and a [[hauchiwa]] (a leaf-shaped fan).

Due to variations in depiction, she may also have [[pointy ears]] or long, [[black wings|black]] [[bird wings|feathered wings]]. Her outfit may also sport an [[armband]] or a tan, [[leaf print|leaf-patterned stripe]] motif. Other times, she may be shown wearing a completely different outfit, such as the [[Kourindou Tengu costume]] from [[Curiosities of Lotus Asia|CoLA]] or her combination of a [[newsboy cap]], [[necktie|tie]], and [[suit jacket]] from [[Forbidden Scrollery]] which should be tagged as [[Shameimaru Aya (newsboy)]].

Shana is the main heroine of the [[Shakugan no Shana]] media franchise.

She is the Flame Haze bound as contractor to the Crimson God [[Alastor (Shakugan no Shana)|Alastor]]; their job is to stop other Crimson Denizens from running amok. The series begins when she gets involved with [[Sakai Yuuji]], an ordinary high schooler who's been imbued with a powerful artifact that can't fall into the wrong hands. Shana becomes his protector, and gradually more like a partner as he learns to fight; in turn, sharing daily life with Yuuji gradually brings Shana out of her shell (she's always lived in the world of Flame Haze, to the point of not even bothering with a [i]name[/i] till Yuuji gives her one).

Shana is often seen wearing a [[pendant]], the vessel of Alastor, and wielding the [[sword]] she's named after, the Nietono no Shana. She sports [[long hair]] ([[black hair|black]] normally, [[red hair|red]] with a flame effect when she's fighting), an [[ahoge]], and [[zettai ryouiki]]. Her closest connections are with Alastor (partner and advisor), Yuuji (love interest), [[Yoshida Kazumi]] (friend/love rival), and [[Wilhelmina Carmel]] (mother figure). Her love for [[melon bread]] is the stuff of legend.

While not the first [[tsundere]] character, Shana is rivalled only by [[Tohsaka Rin]] for most famous one.

payload.body:
[[Touhou]] character. The physical component for [[Alice Margatroid]]'s spellcard "Eerily Luminous Shanghai Doll" in [[Perfect Cherry Blossom]] / [[Immaterial and Missing Power]], as well as her familiar in [[Imperishable Night]].

Shanghai is a very popular supporting character (or artifact) in [[Touhou]] fan art depicting Alice.

Some comic artists give the [[doll]] a personality and feelings of its own, making it a "master doll" that helps control the lesser dolls. Others show it as Alice's primary magically-controlled "puppet". These points of view can be mixed, possibly to give an impression of Alice "debating with herself" through doll use, reminiscent of the way ventriloquists use puppets. Sometimes she/it is even depicted as lacking "doll" traits entirely, resembling a [[minigirl]].

Another view is that Shanghai is a type or class of magical dolls rather than an individual doll. This is based on the fact that several Shanghai dolls are seen simultaneously in [[Perfect Cherry Blossom]].

Canonically, Shanghai, like all the rest of Alice's dolls, is a mindless drone that requires direct supervision for all but the most basic of autonomous action, despite Alice's ongoing efforts to create a truly sapient construct. When a fanwork depicts Alice finally succeeding, Shanghai is usually the subject.

payload.body:
[[Azur Lane]]'s personification of the cruiser HMS [i]Sheffield[/i] (C24).

She has [[blonde_hair|blonde]] [[hair rings]] framing dull [[yellow eyes]] and pale skin. Like many other Royal Navy light cruisers, she is a [[maid]]. Her outfit is much more modest, revealing no cleavage like many other Royal maids, with a [[cross]] hanging from her neck. Her breasts are usually portrayed as smaller than her counterparts, though she bears no envy over it.

Unlike the other maids, Sheffield is much more serious about her duties and is very sharp-tongued and caustic towards the [[Commander_(azur_lane)|]]. She refuses to give into the lewd antics that the others (such as [[Sirius_(azur_lane)|]]) finds themselves involved in. She also specializes in espionage and special operations duties, emphasized in the anime, which also reveals her somewhat ironic status as a [[no_panties|different breed of commando]].

Character design by [[Maya G]], voiced by [[Kohara Konomi]].

h4. History

In real life, [i]Sheffield[/i] was the third of the [[Southampton (Azur Lane)|]]-class light cruisers, the first group of the Town-class. She earned the nickname "Shiny Sheff" on account of the fact that her interior fittings were done in stainless steel instead of brass, rare in the [[Royal Navy]].

She took part in the sinking of [[Bismarck (Azur Lane)|]], Arctic convoys, the battles of the Barents Sea and North Cape, the Salerno landings, and [[Victorious (Azur Lane)|]]' attempts to sink [[Tirpitz (Azur Lane)|]]. Consequently, she attained 12 battle honours.

Post-war, consideration was given to turn her to a museum ship as she largely remained unchanged from her war years but she had deteriorated in reserve so [[Belfast (Azur Lane)|]] was selected instead. She was scrapped in 1967.

The second remodel of [[Shigure_(kancolle)|]].

In her second remodeling, [[hair flaps]] have formed in her hair, and she gains a hair decoration (either salvaged from or based on one of [[Fusou (kancolle)|]]'s or [[Yamashiro (Kancolle)|]]'s) and she wears the same uniform as [[Yuudachi (Kancolle)|]] but with a straight [[necktie]].

Her hair flaps and neck piece are near duplicates of those on [[Yuudachi (Kancolle)|]] (and would become a hallmark for all subsequent Shiratsuyu-class remodels), and because of this the two girls are frequently portrayed together, despite the fact that the real ships shared no common operations. The hair flaps also look much like a dog's floppy ears, and because of this she is (and Yuudachi too) often given doggish mannerisms, despite her in-game personality having no doggish mannerisms.

A "yama":http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yama responsible for judging the souls of the dead, having the ability to identify good and evil. She is best known, however, for being quite moralistic and calling out other characters on their faults - more so (sometimes with physical punishment) upon her errant shinigami, [[Onozuka Komachi]]. Based on her illustration from "The Grimoire of Marisa", fanworks often comically depict her as rather petite and [[flat chest|flat-chested]] compared to her imposing, busty employee - something which angers Eiki - though a full-figured woman with long legs and [[zettai ryouiki]] is another depiction often used in fanart. Canon is inconsistent on which form is true, with some speculation that the child depiction is used as an alternate form for reasons unknown.

Yamaxanadu (ヤマザナドゥ) is her title (meaning "Yama of Paradise"), but has led fans to erroneously read her name as "Shikieiki Yamaxanadu". In actuality, her given name is Eiki and her surname is Shiki.

She has [[short hair|short]] [[green hair]] often cut [[asymmetrical hair|asymmetrically]] and either [[blue eyes|blue]] or [[green eyes]]. Her outfit is a [[frilled hat|frilled]] [[blue hat]], a [[blue vest]] with [[buttons]] and a [[ribbon-trimmed vest|ribbon trim]] and [[epaulettes]], a [[white shirt]] with [[red bow|red]] and [[white bow]]s [[sleeve bow|on]] its [[long sleeves|sleeves]], a [[black skirt]] also with a [[ribbon-trimmed skirt|ribbon trim]], [[white socks]], and [[black shoes|black]] [[mary janes]]. She is often seen [[holding]] her [[rod of remorse]] or a red [[spider lily]].

[b]Shimakaze[/b] (島風, lit. "Island Wind") is the personification of the Japanese destroyer [i]Shimakaze[/i] in [[Kantai Collection]]. 

Shimakaze has [[long_hair|long]] [[blonde hair]] and [[grey eyes]]. She wears a [[crop top|cropped]] [[serafuku]], [[striped thighhighs]], [[white_gloves|white]] [[elbow gloves]], a short [[miniskirt]] with [[black_panties|black]] [[highleg panties]] which show off her [[ass]], and a [[black hairband]] with long floppy "ears". She has small robot familiars called [[Rensouhou-chan]]s which represent her three twin "12.7 cm/50 naval gun":https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/12.7_cm/50_Type_3_naval_gun turrets.

The popularity of her distinctive and revealing outfit has spawned many [[cosplay]] posts. She is also frequently portrayed as a [[trap]] ([[Shimakaze-kun]]) or as an unrelated boy [[crossdressing]] as her.

Her fan nickname is [i]Zekamashi[/i], Shimakaze spelled backwards due to pre-1946 Japanese orthography reading horizontal writing right-to-left, after it was written on an [[innertube]] on a Rensouhou-chan.

Character design by [[Shizuma Yoshinori]], voiced by [[Sakura Ayane]].

[[Azur Lane]]'s personification of the Imperial Japanese Navy aircraft carrier [i]Shinano[/i].  Character design by [[Soaryuna]], voiced by [[Noto Mamiko]].

She has [[very long hair|very long]] [[white hair]] with fox features ([[fox ears|ears]] and [[multiple tails|multiple]] [[fox tail|tails]]), and [[purple eyes]]. Her outfit is a traditional blue-white [[kimono]] with a [[white skirt]] and white [[thighhighs]].

Her [[rigging]] consists of her real-life [[flight deck]] with several 25 mm triple AA mounts and 12 cm 28-tube rocket launchers on each side, while she has three [[katana]] on a hull accessory to her back. She also has [[moon phases]] floating around her as a reference to her in-lore ability to [spoilers]see across multiple timelines[/spoilers] and the fact that she was historically sunk at night/early morning.

She was introduced as the first UR (Ultra-Rare) ship of the roster, by way of the [i]Dreamwaker's Butterfly[/i] event on September 17, 2020.

The demonic god-queen of [[Makai (Touhou)|Makai]] and the last boss of the fifth [[Touhou (PC-98)|Touhou PC-98]] game, [[Mystic Square]]. She created Makai and everything in it. She is thus considered to be the mother or foster-mother of [[Alice Margatroid (PC-98)|]], the stage 3 boss of Mystic Square and also the Extra stage boss.

She is sometimes depicted as being friends with [[Undefined Fantastic Object]]'s last boss, [[Hijiri Byakuren]], since one of her attacks, "Devil's Recitation", is a spellcard version of Shinki's final bullet pattern from Mystic Square. Since Byakuren was sealed in a portion of Makai, this effectively made Shinki her jailer, granting them an opportunity to interact.

She has [[blue_eyes|light-blue eyes]] with [[long_hair|long]] [[white hair]] and wears red robes. She's able to summon six white wings, which can turn purple with red markings.

She is a multi-talented genius who can do anything if she sets her mind to it, however, due to growing up sheltered, it resulted in her lacking in several pieces of what might be considered common sense. Her main objective is to make [[Shirogane Miyuki]] fall in love and confess to her.

She has [[red eyes|red]] [[tareme|tareme eyes]], [[small breasts]], and [[short hair|short]] [[black hair]] stylized in a [[folded ponytail]] with [[parted bangs]] & [[sidelocks]]. She usually wears the [[Shuuchiin Academy school uniform]] with a [[red ribbon|red]] [[hair ribbon]].

In her cold-hearted "Ice" form, she lets her [[hair down]] [[long hair|long]] and her eyes become [[tsurime]].

She is based on [[Kaguya Hime]], the main character of the Japanese legend [[Taketori Monogatari]] ([i]The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter[/i]).

payload.body:
A [[Kantai Collection]] character based on the Japanese Imperial Army amphibious assault ship [i]Shinshuu Maru[/i].
Character design by [[Parsley-F]].

h4. Appearance
Shinshuu Maru has [[long_hair|long]] [[brown hair]] tied into [[twin_braids|a pair of braids]] and [[large breasts]]. She wears a [[black capelet|black]] [[hooded capelet]] worn over a [[black dress]] and [[black footwear|black]] [[boots]]. She is typically depicted with the [[hood up]]. Her [[rigging]] consists of a crane and a large ship deck with several smaller ships attached.

Her hooded appearance has led to some similarities with the later-released [[Sakamata Chloe]], as both were drawn by the same artist.

h4. Personality and history
While coming off as somewhat laid back, she does seem to bear a grudge against [[Mogami (kancolle)|]], whose torpedoes accidentally struck Shinshuu Maru during the "Battle of Sunda Strait":https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_Sunda_Strait while engaging [[Houston (Kancolle)|]] and [[Perth (Kancolle)|]], sinking Shinshuu Maru in the process (she was later salvaged and brought back into service). For decades, [[Fubuki (Kancolle)|]] was mistakenly blamed for the act before new research pointed to Mogami instead.

h4. History
The historical ship was commissioned on 15 November 1934 and sunk (for the second and final time) on 3 January 1945 by air attack.

payload.body:
A Japanese fire-wielding [[ninja]] from [[SNK]]'s [[Fatal Fury]] and later [[The King of Fighters]]. She debuted in [[Fatal Fury 2]].

Her trademarks are her [[folding fan]], and her [[revealing clothes|revealing]] [[sleeveless kimono]] that shows off her [[large breasts]], legs, and overall physique. She has [[brown eyes]] and most commonly wears her [[long hair|long]], [[brown hair]] in a [[ponytail]] tied up with an ornamental hairpin, usually referred to as a [[motoyui]].

Mai is the last native heir to Shiranui-ryuu Ninjutsu, with a particular skill in fire ninja magic. She has a loving infatuation with - and at least as of [[Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves]], is engaged to - fellow Shiranui-ryuu practitioner [[Andy Bogard]], whom she trained with at a relatively young age and she came to see as a good man (though she tended to move the relationship a little too quickly for Andy's liking). As of [[Garou: Mark of the Wolves]], she and Andy both train a young Shiranui-ryuu disciple named [[Hokutomaru]]. She is good friends with most of the rest of the Fatal Fury roster, not least of which includes Andy's brother [[Terry Bogard|Terry]] and best friend [[Joe Higashi]]. In The King of Fighters, she is a founding member of the Women Fighters Team alongside [[King (SNK)|]] and [[Yuri Sakazaki]].

Mai is one of SNK's most popular characters, appearing in numerous cross-overs and promotions. Her oldest and arguably greatest cross-company [[rivalry|rival]] is [[Capcom]]'s [[Street Fighter]]'s [[Chun-Li]]. She notably appears as a guest character in both [[Dead or Alive]] ([i]DOA 5 Last Round[/i] and [i]DOA 6[/i]) and [[Street Fighter 6]], being the second ever guest character (after [[Terry Bogard]]) to appear in a mainline Street Fighter title. She also makes a cameo in [[Queen's Gate Spiral Chaos]].

She received a new outfit in [[Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves]], consisting of a [[cropped jacket|cropped]] [[black jacket]], [[black gloves]], [[black pants]], and [[black boots|black]] [[high heel boots]]. The [[tank top]] and [[short shorts]]/[[dolphin shorts]] casualwear/nightwear she wore in her [[SNK Heroines: Tag Team Frenzy]] ending, previously referenced in her and Andy's Real Bout Fatal Fury 2 endings, makes a cameo appearance as part of her character select animation in [[Street Fighter 6]].

Due to her revealing attire, she was allegedly denied a cameo in [[Super Smash Bros.|Super Smash Bros. Ultimate]], since she would be challenging the game's [[CERO]] rating of A; the way Sakurai put it in the announcement ("[[Smash is for good boys and girls]]") was turned into a meme.

A character from [[Blue Archive]]. Similar in appearance to [[Shiroko (blue archive)|]]. Also goes by the name of "Anubis".

[spoiler]A version of Shiroko who remains the sole survivor of Abydos High School, exposed to Chroma by the Nameless Priests, which also altered her physical appearance. Shiroko would go on to serve the Nameless Priests directly under the protection of [[Phrenapates (blue archive)|]], until the main timeline's Sensei infiltrated the Ark of Atrahasis, leading to its subsequent destruction. In Volume 1 Chapter 3, Shiroko was summoned by [[Plana (blue archive)|]] to assist in subduing [[Hoshino Terror (blue archive)|Hoshino Terror]], whose mental state began to spiral similarly to hers.

As of the end of Volume 1 Chapter 3, Shiroko has now been appointed as a member of the Abydos Student Council, and her Halo has slowly begun to heal, now that she's since let go of the guilt of losing her friends.[/spoiler]

She uses a [[SIG SG550]] [[assault rifle]] with a [[SIG P220/P226]] [[handgun]] as a sidearm. [spoiler]She additionally wielded the weapons of the deceased [[Foreclosure Task Force (blue archive)|Foreclosure Task Force]], but has since discarded them as a sign that she's begun to move on.[/spoiler]

Being a grown-up version of Shiroko, Shiroko*Terror has [[very long hair|longer and messier]] [[grey hair]] that's brighter than Shiroko. Her body is also more developed, being slightly taller and having [[large breasts|larger breasts]] and [[thick thighs|fuller thighs]]. Shiroko*Terror wears a pitch [[black dress]] with [[wide sleeves]] that shows her [[cleavage]] and legs, [[black choker]], and a [[thigh holster]] that [[skindentation|worn tightly around her left leg]].

payload.body:
A [i][[Touken Ranbu]][/i] character.

A [[tachi (weapon)|Tachi]]. His name literally means "Candlestick-cutter Mitsutada", referring to an incident where his namesake was used to kill someone and happened to cut through a bronze candlestick as well. He is obsessed with being cool, even saying it would have been cooler if he had cut through a candlestick made from a sturdier material. He is noted to [[look-alike|resemble]] [[Kantai Collection]]'s [[tenryuu (kancolle)|Tenryuu]] with his [[eyepatch]], general appearance and mannerisms. His black clothes reference the fact that his sword's current appearance is burnt to the hilt.

His original sword is one of  [[Date Masamune (real life)|]]'s blades, along with [[Ookurikara]], [[Tsurumaru Kuninaga]], and [[Taikogane Sadamune]].  Mitsutada seems to hold the latter in fond regards, since he calls him "Sada-chan" and specifically asked around for him in his citadel quote, leading artists to portray the two in a pseudo-familial relationship. He has nicknames for the rest of Masamune's blades, calling Tsurumaru "Tsuru-san" and Ookurikara "Kara-chan".

He has a generally friendly personality, and is seen as the heart of the Masamune group due to his compassion. When he interacts with [[Sayo Samonji]] or [[Taikogane Sadamune]], he takes on a more brotherly or [[fatherly]] disposition. He also seems to enjoy cooking (a reference to his former master Date Masamune, who also liked to cook), since he's able to actively help out his new masters.  For this reason, some artists portray him as a secondary butler like [[Heshikiri Hasebe]].


Fans have given him the nickname "Candle-Cutter [[Pikachu]]" (CCP), based on an alternate reading of the kanji for Mitsutada.

payload.body:
A [i][[Kemono Friends]][/i] character. She is one of many "Friends" in Japari Park, being part of the Snowy Mountain Region in the anime.

A "Silver Fox" simply refers to a melanistic (black colored) red fox with mostly black and gray fur along with a near complete lack of brown. This color morph is typical of American Red Foxes but it has spread through the fur trade. For the record, she was simply listed in the original game as an unspecified red fox ([i]Vulpes vulpes[/i]) and in the anime as an American red fox ([i]Vulpes vulpes fulvus[/i]).

Her outfit consists of what appears to be an marine blue [[blazer]] uniform with fur lined sleeves and a very short black pleated skirt worn over [[black leggings]], black gloves as well as a scarf tied into a bow. She has long dark gray hair with black-tipped bangs along with the requisite fox ears and tail. She can be distinguished from a simple palette swap of Ezo Red Fox with her long [[sidelocks]]. Her eyes are also a deeper amber color than her fellow fox.

She is sometimes depicted wearing [[glasses]] while carrying a [[flask]] due to her depiction in the original game.

She is often seen with [[ezo_red_fox_(kemono_friends)|Ezo Red Fox]], a fellow fox Friend. Compare as well with [[red_fox_(kemono_friends)|Red Fox]], their nominate species Friend.

payload.body:
The "Departed Spirit of the Children of the Gods".

Stage 5 midboss of [[Touhou]]'s [[Ten Desires]].

She is a very practical woman who can use coarse language. She also appears to be a foil to Futo's air-headed, jovial nature. In spite of the language she uses, she's actually kind, though short-tempered. Her friendship/rivalry with [[Mononobe no Futo]] led her to be unable to reincarnate like Futo and [[Toyosatomimi no Miko]]. Soga instead came back as a ghost with two [[ghost tail]]s in the place of legs. Exactly where her body transitions from human-like to ghost-like is unclear, due to the [[long dress|long]] [[green dress]] that she wears. She has [[short hair|]] [[green hair]] and [[green eyes]] and also wears a [[black hat|black]] [[tate eboshi]] like Futo. 

Her name came from "Tojiko no Iratsume":[https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/刀自古郎女], a daughter of [[Soga no Umako]] and consort of [[Shoutoku Taishi]]. Since her name comes from the consort of the character on whom [[Toyosatomimi no Miko]] was based, the two are often depicted by fans as a [[couple]].

payload.body:
The main protagonist of the [[Dragon Ball]] series. He is married to [[Chi-Chi (dragon ball)|]] and has two sons named [[Son Gohan]] and [[Son Goten]].

Goku is a [[Saiyan]] born on planet Vegeta and raised on Earth. Capable of several different transformations including [[Kaiouken]], [[Super Saiyan]] [[Super Saiyan 1|1]], [[Super Saiyan 2|2]], [[Super Saiyan 3|3]], [[Super Saiyan 4|4]], [[Super Saiyan God]], [[Super Saiyan Blue]] and, ultimately, [[Ultra Instinct]].

His Saiyan name is "Kakarot", which is how [[Vegeta]] addresses him throughout the anime and manga. Some of his signature techniques are the [[Kamehameha (dragon ball)|]] and the [[Genki Dama]].

He is loosely based on [[Sun Wukong]] of the classical Chinese novel [i][[Journey to the West]][/i], whose name is translated as Son Goku in Japanese.

Goku's Japanese seiyuu is [[Nozawa Masako]], and the current English dub voice actor is [[Sean Schemmel]] (though the character has gone through many different dub voice changes in the past). In other languages, Mario Castañeda voices him in the Latin American dub, and in the Tagalog dub, he was voiced by Nesty Ramirez until his retirement from the role in the early 2000s, and the late Jefferson Utanes. 

In the early series, he possesses the [[ruyi jingu bang|Power Pole]] and the [[Flying Nimbus]].

payload.body:
The main hero of the [[Sonic (series)|]] franchise. [b]Sonic the Hedgehog[/b] is a blue-colored hedgehog who can run at extremely fast speeds, and who has a upbeat personality with a smarty-pants attitude while always looking forward to adventures. His long-time nemesis is [[Dr. Eggman]], but they seem to uphold their rivalry on decent terms. 

Sonic can change his form by collecting all seven of the [[Chaos Emerald]]s and harnessing their positive energy to transform into [[Super Sonic]], which bears a striking resemblance to a [[Super Saiyan]] from the [[Dragon Ball Z]] universe. This in turn grants him exponential speed and power increases, while also making him immune to most attacks. 

Sonic was designed and created by Japanese artist and game designer "Oshima Naoto":http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Naoto_%C5%8Cshima. He was initially codenamed "Mr. Needlemouse" during development as Sega's new mascot and was originally colored teal. His trademark blue pigmentation was chosen later to match Sega's cobalt blue logo. [[Uekawa Yuji]] provided the revamp of Sonic's art style during the shift to the 3D era with the release of the [[Sonic Adventure]] games around 1998.

Voiced by Kanemaru Jun'ichi in Japanese, and Jaleel White, Martin Burke, Ryan Drummond, Jason Griffith, and [[Roger Craig Smith]] in English.

There is an electrical switch on the left side of her gear, which can be observed more clearly on her damaged art. In her kai art, a yellow warning stripe is taped over the switch, referring to her infamous short circuit incident during the battle.

[b]Spider-Man[/b] is a [[Marvel]] superhero and star of the [[Spider-Man (series)|]] franchise. The character was created by writer-editor [[Stan Lee]] and writer-artist Steve Ditko. He first appeared in [i]Amazing Fantasy[/i] #15 (Aug. 1962).

Spider-Man is the secret identity of [[Peter Parker]], who was raised by his [[Uncle Ben]] and [[May Parker|Aunt May]] after the death of his parents. In his origin story, he gains superhuman powers after being bitten by a radioactive spider. These include superhuman strength, agility, and the ability to shoot webs and cling to walls.

Peter isn't the only one to bare the Spider-Man moniker. In the 1970s, Spider-Man was given his own [[tokusatsu]] [[spider-man (toei)|series]] in Japan where the mask was worn by [[Yamashiro Takuya]] and he had a [[mecha]] named [[Leopardon]]. In the 2010s, as part of the Ultimate Marvel (Earth-1610) continuity, Peter would be succeeded as Spider-Man by [[Miles Morales]].

[i]Not to be confused with [[Saint-Louis_(azur_lane)|Saint-Louis]], a personification of the French heavy cruiser featured in the same game[/i].

Personification of the United States Navy light cruiser [i]USS St. Louis (CL-49)[/i] in [[Azur Lane]]. Character design by [[Yunsang]], voiced by [[Hikasa Youko]].

She has [[long hair|long]] [[blue hair]] tied in a [[high_ponytail|high]] [[side ponytail]] with [[sidelocks]], and reddish-[[purple eyes]]. Her outfit is similar to her (half)-sister [[honolulu_(azur_lane)|Honolulu]], wearing a [[double-breasted]] [[white_dress|white]] and [[blue_dress|blue]] [[two-tone dress|two-tone]] [[side-tie dress|side-tie]] [[micro dress]], [[white thighhighs]], [[high heels]], and [[white gloves|white]] [[elbow gloves]]. Her [[rigging]] consists of all five of her real-life 15.2 cm triple mounts, two to her left and three to her right.

Historically, she and her sister [[helena_(azur_lane)|Helena]] differed from the first seven [i]Brooklyn[/i]-class light cruisers in having four 127 mm twin turreted mounts instead of eight 127 mm single open pedestal mounts and having their engines and boilers arranged alternately for increased survival. She served from Pearl Harbor to Okinawa before she was sold off to Brazil in 1951 and renamed [i]Almirante Tamandaré[/i], seeing further service until 1976.

A [b]stiletto[/b] is a kind of [[dagger]], optimized to function as a stabbing [[weapon]] exclusively. Generally it has little to no cutting edges, being essentially a long, thin spike with a needle-like point mounted to a handle.

The stiletto originated in late 15th century Italy.  As a result of its abilities to penetrate thick clothing and even mail, and to inflict lethal wounds with comparatively less external bleeding, as well as being easy to conceal, it became the favored weapon of the medieval assassin.

Notably used by [[Yor Briar]].

A [[shirt]] that doesn't have any straps, neck, or sleeves. The shoulders and upper chest area are left [[bare shoulders|bare]].

A strapless shirt is similar to a [[tube top]], but not exactly the same. A tube top is generally shorter and has a tighter fit, while a strapless shirt is usually longer and looser. A tube top usually wraps tight around the breasts and doesn't cover the [[midriff]], while a strapless shirt usually covers the stomach and doesn't conform as tightly to the breasts.

This tag may be used for strapless shirts with [[detached sleeves]], but not for [[sleeveless shirt|sleeveless]] or [[off-shoulder shirt]]s. A [[sleeveless shirt]] has a neck but no sleeves; an [[off-shoulder shirt]] has sleeves but no neck; a strapless shirt has neither.

payload.body:
A form of [[Super Saiyan]] that originally appeared in the anime-only [[Dragon Ball GT]]. Born from gaining control over the [[Golden Oozaru]] form, its main features are red fur covering the torso, longer hair, red lining around the eyes, and the addition of a [[monkey tail]] even if the user already had them cut beforehand.

[[Son Goku]] is the first to achieve this form, followed by [[Vegeta]] and their fusion, [[Gogeta]] (whose Super Saiyan 4 form is different from his fusees, since his hair turns [[red hair|red]] and his body gains brown fur instead). It can be upgraded into [[Super Full Power Saiyan 4]].

[[Dragon Ball Heroes]] would later introduce a further evolution to this form, with the long name of [[Super Full Power Saiyan 4 Limit Breaker]].

The form would be canonized with its appearance in [[Dragon Ball DAIMA]], though appearance-wise it would see some changes, such as rendering the hair in the same color as the fur, and the arms and hands getting proportionally larger per GT's original concepts.

Due to some odd events (such as streaming ten hours of [[Ring Fit Adventure]] [i] immediately after[/i] streaming ten hours of [[Dark Souls I]]), Lulu gained a reputation for behaving like some sort of inhuman creature, a notion further developed by her habit of staring directly at the viewer when something doesn't go as it should and her weird remarks like implying her eyeballs can regenerate after being crushed, while claiming to be nothing but a normal college student.

She is part of the [[Saine Sisters]] trio along with [[Kamishiro Kurea]] and [[Sephira Su]], as the three virtual youtubers were designed by [[Saine]] and consider themselves sisters, sometimes appearing in each other channels.

Unexpectedly announced she would be graduating and ceasing activities on June 30, 2021. Her return was "suddenly announced":[https://twitter.com/nijisanji_app/status/2000853410099364013] (asset #39539878) on December 16, 2025.

Upon remodel her [[hachimaki]] becomes white, the writing changes from "61st Destroyer Division" to "41st Destroyer Division", and her Chou-10cm-hou-chan gains a set of 25mm triple [[anti-aircraft gun]] mounts.
