[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese heavy cruiser [i]Suzuya[/i]. Designed by [[Konishi (koconatu)]], voiced by [[Bridcutt Sarah Emi]].

She has [[long hair|long]] [[aqua hair]] with a [[hairclip]] and [[aqua eyes]]. She wears a brown [[school uniform]] with an orange [[ascot]], brown [[jacket]] and [[pleated skirt]], [[brown thighhighs]], and black [[loafers]] that have high heels. Her [[rigging]] includes multiple [[ship turret]]s with twin-[[cannon]] arrangements strapped two to her forearms, one on each thigh, and a larger one carried by a strap like a purse. She carries a mast like a backpack.

She has an energetic and informal personality, behaving like a typical high-school girl, with little sense of personal space and a frisky attitude. She's also frequently shown as being rather close to her sister-ship, [[Kumano (kancolle)|]].

payload.body:
Sweet Lolita or "Amaloli" ( アマーロリ ) is a substyle of [[Lolita fashion]] heavily influenced by Rococo styles as well as Victorian and Edwardian children's clothing. Focusing on the child and fantasy aspects of Lolita, the Sweet Lolita style adopts the basic Lolita format and uses lighter colors.

It has all the traditional Lolita elements but with a wider choice of colors, like light pinks, baby blues, whites, and even sometimes colors like lavender, canary yellow and mint green. This is also where you'll find the most fluff and [[frills]].

A female character from the novel, manga and anime series [[Mushoku Tensei]] . She was introduced as a beloved childhood friend of [[Rudeus Greyrat]], and became a bodyguard for [[Ariel Anemoi Asura]] alongside [[Luke Notos Greyrat]] following the Teleport Catastrophe. During this time, she operated under the cover identity Fitz/Fitts at the Ranoa magic academy before eventually becoming Rudeus's [[polygamy|first]] wife. She is also the granddaughter of [[Elinalise Dragonroad]] .

She is of mixed heritage (having [[elf|elven]], human and beast race ancestors), inheriting [[pointy ears]] from the former. Her hair was initially [[green_hair|green]], but due to the ordeal following the teleportation incident, it became [[white_hair|white]] (she also let her hair grow longer). She is the mother of [[Lucy Greyrat]] and [spoiler][[Sieghart Saladin Greyrat]] [/spoiler].

[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese submarine tender [i]Taigei[/i]. Upon remodel her name changes to [[Ryuuhou (Kancolle)|]]. Character design by [[Kujou Ichiso]], voiced by [[Ogura Yui]].

She has [[long hair|long]] [[purple hair]] with [[low twintails]], feathered [[hair flaps]] and an [[ahoge]], as well as [[red eyes]]. Her default outfit consists of a [[white shirt|white]] [[long sleeves|long-sleeved]] [[sailor shirt]] with a [[blue sailor collar]], [[white apron]], [[blue skirt|blue]] [[pleated skirt]], [[black pantyhose]], and [[rudder footwear|rudder-themed]] [[grey sandals]]. 

Her [[rigging]] consists of her funnel and crane to her back, and her real-life bow as a [[single knee pad]] on her right.

Attempts to obtain her are unsurprisingly called "Whaling" on account of her name's meaning (lit. "Great Whale"). She was originally built as part of a project to build auxiliary support ships that could be converted to carriers quickly should the need arise. However, she suffered from faulty hull welding, unreliable diesel engine propulsion, and very questionable seakeeping (a flaw common to other treaty-skirting warships of her time). In late 1941, she finally received approval for carrier conversion and was renamed [[Ryuuhou (kancolle)|]].

She wears a [[serafuku]] consisting of a [[blue sailor collar]], [[red neckerchief]], [[long sleeves|long sleeved]] [[white shirt]], [[blue skirt|blue]] [[pleated skirt]], [[blue shorts|blue]] [[short shorts|shorts]] under the skirt, and [[black socks|black]] [[kneehighs]].

[spoilers]In [i][[Karakai Jouzu no (moto) Takagi-san]][/i] she is married to Nishikata and they have a child, [[nishikata chii|Chii]].[/spoilers]

She is voiced by [[Takahashi Rie]] in Japanese, and Sarah Wiedenheft (Seasons 1-3) and Kayli Mills (Season 2) in English.

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese destroyer [i]Takanami[/i]. Character design by [[Fujikawa]], voiced by [[Kuno Misaki]].

She has [[short_hair|short]] [[green hair]] in a [[bob cut]] with notable long [[sidelocks]], and [[brown eyes]]. She wears the standard [i]Yuugumo[/i]-class uniform: a purple [[halterneck]] [[pleated dress]] over a [[white shirt]], [[blue bowtie]], and [[grey pantyhose]] with a pair of [[lace-up boots]], with a [[yellow sports bra]] underneath her shirt. 

Her [[rigging]] is the same as the rest of the class: her funnel and foremast to her back with a 25 mm [[anti-aircraft gun]] mount, a 12.7 cm twin [[handgun]] mount, and two 61 cm quad [[torpedo tubes]] on [[thigh strap]]s. 

She has a personality that is lacking in confidence. Her verbal tic is "かも" or "kamo", which usually means "maybe". The homophone "kamo" (written "鴨") can also mean [[duck]], so she is sometimes seen with ducks for this reason. This verbal tic is shared with [[Akitsushima (Kancolle)|]], who was introduced at the same time.

h5. Ooarai Girls Academy / Team Anglerfish

h6. Original Anime

She idolizes the concept of romance and connects everything in the world to it in her mind. She thought she would be popular if she took tankery, however ...

[tn]Source: "[2]":[#dtext-external-links] (post #1283979)[/tn]

Belongs to the Ooarai Girls tankery team.  Team Anglerfish's radio operator.  The new Student Council Public Relations officer.  Has dreams of yearning for love, however she adores the underclassmen and takes care of them with good cooking.  Contributes to the team through high communication skills such as being good at fast texting and also by acquiring an amateur radio license.

Radio Operator for Team Anglerfish. She is interested in romance, so much so that she chose tankery as she believed the words, "if you study tankery, you'll be popular with the boys". Having won the national tournament, she is looking forward to the day when she receives a flood of fan mail.

She is very soft spoken and is usually depicted as rather laid back. True to her cat-like nature, she is often portrayed sleeping or lounging, especially under a [[kotatsu]]. She is most frequently paired with her sisters, especially [[Kuma (Kancolle)|]].

She fights using a [[crossbow]].

Fans of the character use the term "Eroha" to refer to erotic fanarts of her.

[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese destroyer [i]Tanikaze[/i], the fourteenth ship of the Kagerou-class destroyers.

She has [[short_hair|short]] [[black hair]] with a [[white hairband|white]] [[hairband]]. Like her division mates from the 17th Destroyer Division, she wears a [[short_sleeves|short-sleeved]] [[white shirt|white]] and blue button-up [[serafuku]] with a yellow scarf (similar to [[Yukikaze (kancolle)|]]) on top of a Kagerou-class standard [[pleated skirt]] along with [[white thighhighs]]. On her back is her [[rigging]], with an attached [[depth charge]]. Like most of the Kagerou-class, she wears [[white gloves]]. She [[dual wielding|dual wields]] two [[handgun]]s, one resembling the standard 12.7 cm twin gun, the other resembling an anti-air gun.

She speaks like a stereotypical [[Edoben|Edokko]] despite being built in Osaka. Thus, she is the opposite of [[Ryuujou (kancolle)|]] (who speaks in [[Kansaiben]] but was built in Yokohama, just nearby Tokyo). Also, because of her accent, she has a good relationship with [[Suzukaze (kancolle)|]] who shares the same accent, and is sometimes shown sprouting [[Buront]]isms.

She is a frequent victim of [[breast envy]] due the fact that she is only one in 17th Destroyers Division who has a [[flat chest]] and is often compared with her sisters and division mates [[Urakaze (kancolle)|]] and [[Hamakaze (kancolle)|]] who have [[large breasts]].

payload.body:
A character from [[Kantai Collection]], introduced in the 2018 Winter Event. Based on the Soviet destroyer leader Tashkent.

h4. Appearance

She has wide [[brown eyes]], [[long hair|long]] [[brown hair]] tied off into [[low twintails|low]] [[twintails]] with [[black bow|black]] [[hair bow|hair bows]], wears a [[black headwear|black]] [[papakha]] with three [[star (symbol)|]]s on it, a [[torn scarf|tattered]] [[white scarf|white]] [[scarf]] and a [[ribbon trim|ribbon-trimmed]] [[blue shawl|blue]] [[shawl]] over a [[white jacket|white]] [[jacket]] and an [[anchor necklace]]. She also wears [[black gloves|black]] [[fingerless gloves]], a [[black skirt|black]] [[skirt]], a couple of [[black belt|black]] [[belt]]s, an [[untucked shirt|untucked]] [[red shirt]], [[brown pantyhose]], and [[black footwear|black]] [[thigh boots]].

Her rigging includes a pair of [[ship turret|turrets]] and a pair of triple-tube [[torpedo tubes|torpedo launchers]].

In her appearance in the 2019 calendar (post #3431552), she is portrayed as significantly taller than [[hibiki (kancolle)|Hibiki]].

h4. Personality

In-game, she has a generically friendly and reliable personality. She consistently refers to the admiral and other shipgirls as "Comrades", conforming to the communist model. In fan-art, the fact that she was built in Italy is rarely shown unless this is directly referred to, often making her the zealous, "more communist than thou" character compared to newcomer [[hibiki (kancolle)|Hibiki]]/[[verniy (kancolle)|Verniy]] and imperial-era old guard [[Gangut (kancolle)|]]. On the opposite end, you can have "the sweetest Tashkent around":[/pools/14819].

h4. History

The Tashkent class of ships consisted of a single destroyer leader, built in Italy for the Soviet navy just before World War II. Three other ships were ordered but canceled before construction. The class is named after Tashkent, "the capital city":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tashkent] of the Uzbek Soviet Socialist Republic (now Uzbekistan).

h4. Trivia

The real life destroyer Tashkent had a top speed of 43 knots, technically making her faster than [[Shimakaze (destroyer)|]] but slower than the French destroyer [[Le Terrible (destroyer)|Le Terrible]]. With that in mind, she is currently the fastest destroyer implemented in game.

h4. See also

* "Kancolle Wikia: Tashkent":[http://kancolle.wikia.com/wiki/Tashkent]

Mai is depicted as scatterbrained and quick to take action. Her abilities allow her to draw out one's vitality by dancing behind them.

Notably, she's the only girl in the series to use the masculine "Boku" as her first-person pronoun of choice. Do not confuse her with [[mai (touhou)|Mai]] from [[Mystic Square]].

payload.body:
[b]Tiki[/b] (Chiki) is a playable character in several games of the [[Fire Emblem]] series of strategy RPGs. She is the Princess of the Divine Dragon tribe, and therefore much older than she appears to be. She first appears as a 500-year-old child in [[Fire Emblem: Shadow Dragon and the Blade of Light]] and [[Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem]], and reappears [[aged up|as an adult]] 2,000 years later in [[Fire Emblem Awakening]].

She has [[long hair|long]] [[green hair]] in a [[ponytail]], [[green eyes]] and [[pointy ears]]. [[Tiki_(young)_(fire_emblem)|As a child]], she wears a [[short dress|short]] [[pink dress|pink]] [[dress]], while [[Tiki_(adult)_(fire_emblem)|as an adult]] she wears a short [[red dress|red]] [[strapless dress]] with [[side slit]]s, a pink [[cape]], red [[thigh boots]] over pink [[thighhighs]] with [[garter straps]] and red [[gloves]]. As both a child and an adult she has a [[hair ornament]] above her forehead.

In-game, her class is Manakete, which gives her the power to change into [[dragon]] form in combat via use of a dragonstone.

Remarkably, her Awakening incarnation ended in the Top 1 of the 2022's Edition of "Choose Your Legends":[https://vote6.campaigns.fire-emblem-heroes.com/en-US/result] (women's side).

The protagonist of [[Tsukihime]], its sequel [[Kagetsu Tooya]], its spinoff [[Melty Blood]], and its [[Tsukihime (Remake)|Remake]], created by [[Type-Moon]].

She has [[orange eyes]] with [[slit pupils]]. Tohru always possess [[dragon horns]]. While at home she features a large green [[dragon tail]], but while out in society it is usually magically hidden. While in dragon girl form she very occasionally displays a pair of [[dragon wings]]. Tohru is most often depicted wearing a cosplay-style [[maid|maid uniform]] featuring a [[black dress|black]] [[pinafore dress]] over a [[white shirt]] with [[puffy short sleeves]], a red [[ascot]], [[white_gloves|white]] [[elbow gloves]] and a [[maid headdress]].

A character from [[Date A Live]]. She is voiced by [[Sanada Asami]].

Kurumi is one of the spirits appearing in our world from another realm. Unlike most spirits who are shy and/or bashful, she is openly easy going and very pro-active towards sex. She has [[long hair|long]] [[black hair]] and possesses [[heterochromia]], with one [[red eyes|red eye]] and one [[yellow eyes|yellow]] [[clock eyes|clock eye]].

She wears a [[sleeveless dress|sleeveless]] [[red dress|red]]/[[orange dress|orange]] [[lolita fashion|lolita dress]], along with a [[lolita hairband]], [[frilled choker|frilled]] [[black choker]], [[detached sleeves]], [[red ribbon]]s, [[thighhighs]], and [[black footwear|black]] [[boots]]. She also has [[uneven twintails]] and wields two [[flintlock]] pistols of differing length.

When not in her Astral Dress, she can be seen with [[low twintails]] and [[hair over one eye|hair covering her left eye]]. She also wears the [[Raizen High School uniform]] when attending said school.

She makes her playable debut in [[Shimousa (fate/grand order)|]] as [b]Archer of Inferno[/b]. Despite her steadfast nature and her fiery and graceful style of combat (she wields a [[sword]], a [[naginata]], and a [[bow (weapon)|]] with great proficiency), she has a more playful side (shown in My Room where she expresses great interest in playing video games).

Has [[black horns]], due to having some oni ancestry. These only become visible starting with her second ascension. The horns are initially [[black horns|black]] but turn [[red horns|red]] for her third ascension. She also has [[very long hair|very long]] [[aqua hair|aqua]], [[light blue hair|light blue]], or [[grey hair]] (sometimes in a [[ponytail]], or with a white [[headband]] and a [[red bow]]) and [[red eyes]]. Usually wears a [[short kimono|short]] [[white kimono]] with an [[obi]] and [[detached sleeves]], and [[hakama pants]] with [[side slit|side slits]]. Sometimes she also has [[kote]] and [[kusazuri]]. Her later outfit looks like a [[sleeveless turtleneck]] showing some [[sideboob]]. Her kote and kusazuri looks more colorful.

[b]Character Design[/b]: [[Shirabi]]
[b]Voice Actress[/b]: [[Kanemoto Hisako]]

She has [[blonde hair|blonde]] [[drill hair]]/[[twin drills]] with flower-themed [[hairpin]] and [[yellow eyes]]; normally wears a [[school uniform]] with [[black pantyhose]]. She has one of the [[large breasts|largest busts]] of the cast, and this trait tends to be [[huge breasts|exaggerated]] in her art.

Her [[magical girl]] attire includes a [[beret]], a [[white shirt|white blouse]] with [[puffy sleeves]] at the shoulders, a pair of [[detached sleeves]], [[fingerless gloves]], [[pleated skirt]], [[corset]], [[brown thighhighs|brown]] [[vertical-striped thighhighs]], and [[boots]]. She uses a [[magical musket (madoka magica)|]] as a weapon.

In [[Mahou Shoujo Madoka Magica: Walpurgis No Kaiten]], her legwear is changed to [[white socks|white]] [[loose socks]], making her somewhat resemble a [[gyaru]].

She has [[short hair|short]] [[blonde hair|blonde]] and [[black hair|black]] [[two-tone hair]]. As a hat she has a [[lotus hair ornament]]. payload.body: [b] Undefeated Matriarch of the Gouyoku Alliance [/b] Toutetsu Yuuma is the main antagonist and final boss of [[Touhou]] 17.5, [[sunken fossil world|Gouyoku Ibun ~ Suibotsushita Chinshuu Jigoku (Strange Tale of Avarice ~ Submerged Hell of Sunken Sorrow)]], first mentioned in Wily Beast and Weakest Creature. In [[Unfinished Dream of All Living Ghost]], she is revealed to have once been friends with [[Yakumo Ran|Ran]]. As her title suggests, she's the boss of the [[Eagle Spirit (touhou)|]]s. She has large [[red horns|red]], [[sheep horns]], with a [[horn ribbon]] on both horns. She has [[curly hair|curly]], [[white hair]], [[red eyes]] with [[horizontal pupils|horizontal]], [[rectangular pupils]], and is often depicted with [[sharp teeth]]. She wears [[hoop earrings]] on her [[pointy ears]]. She wears a [[blue dress]] with [[detached_sleeves|detached]], [[red sleeves]]. Her clothing has a [[meandros]] [[patterned clothing|pattern]] with [[eye print]]s. Some artists may depict her wearing a [[blue vest]] and [[blue skirt]] instead. She often goes [[barefoot]] and [[holding spork|carries around]] an [[oversized object|oversized]] [[spork]] which may be filled with [[motor oil]] or [[blood]]. Her spork may be depicted as a [[spoon]] by some artists, either deliberately or as a mistake. Her ability allows her to devour and absorb almost absolutely anything, turning it into her power. Unlike her fellow Animal Realm matriarchs, she and her organization prefer to avoid pointless conflict, and would rather recruit or forge a mutually-beneficial relationship with their enemies, with an all-out war being a last resort for them. Taking advantage of the events in Wily Beast and Weakest Creature, she went to the Former Hell of Blood Pools in order to monopolize the [[petroleum]] deposits there, containing the desires of long dead organic beings. Note: If you can't concretely identify the utensil she is wielding (even with the tags/title/commentary/parent-child posts/pools), just tag [[utensil]] instead. h4. Appearance * !post #6516433 h4. An offense-class character in [[Overwatch]]. Lena Oxton (call sign: "Tracer") was handpicked to test the prototype of a teleporting fighter, the Slipstream. During its flight, the aircraft malfunctioned and disappeared. Lena was presumed dead. Months later she reappeared, but her molecules had desynchronized from the flow of time and she would disappear from the present on occasion. A scientist by the name of [[winston_(overwatch)|Winston]] developed a [[chronal accelerator (overwatch)|]] for her to anchor herself to the present, and control her flow of time at will.

In "Reflections", Tracer was shown together with her [[yuri|girlfriend]] [[emily (overwatch)|Emily]].

payload.body:
A traditional [[nun]]'s habit, specifically a traditional Christian style (Catholic, Orthodox, etc), as opposed to the fetishized, non-traditional nun habits typically seen in anime and fanart.

It consists at most of a [[long dress|long dress]] (that's black) with [[long sleeves]] and a [[guimpe]] (that's white), and typically stars the distinctive [[nun headdress]] (consisting of a [[wimple]]/[[coif]] [that's white], headwear bandeau [that's white], and [[veil]] [that's black], though it has become increasingly optional for some since the 20th century), and may also include a [[tabard]], underdress, and so on. The habit is typically white-on-black, with black the predominant color, but they can also be wholly white, or white-on-blue. Color can depend on the religious order which the nun is a part of (ex. Carmelites being white-on-brown). They can also be wholly black, which is the common choice for Orthodox nuns.

The traditional habit can be accentuated with minor additions, but not so much that it detracts from the basics (ex. [[Sister Claire]] and [[Double (skullgirls)|]] as opposed to [[Specter (arknights)|]] and [[Index (toaru majutsu no index)|]]), and some degree of modesty must be adhered to (ex. not too tight-fitting, no shortened dresses, no cutouts, no openings where they wouldn't normally be ala the chest area, no side slits which reveal skin or undergarment, no overtly sexual depictions of certain undergarments, etc).

h4. Examples

* !post #6716988: Wholly traditional
* !post #3752558: Without headdress
* !post #3432046: Minor flourishes

h4. See also

* [[nun]]

h4. External links

payload.body:
[[One Piece]] character. One of the [[Eleven Supernova]] and captain and doctor of the Heart Pirates. He became one of the [[Shichibukai]], but his position was revoked for allying with [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]].

Occasionally seen with close friend and crewmate [[Bepo (one piece)|]], though it is unknown exactly if Bepo is his first mate or not.

Having consumed the Ope Ope no Mi [[Devil Fruit]], he can create a "room" where he can separate and spatially displace anything and everything within it. This includes the ability to [[body switch|switching the body]] of his victim by exchanging their soul or detach/attach their limbs at his wish. Due to this ability, he is nicknamed "Surgeon of Death" for his combination of medical and combat skills.

Sometimes drawn alongside the [[Straw Hat Pirates]]' doctor [[Tony Tony Chopper]]. He is also often [[genderswap (mtf)|genderswapped]] as [[Law-chan]] due to an episode where Law and his crews were infected by a "feminization virus" which caused them to be temporarily transformed into women, which was perpetrated by [[Doc Q]].

It was later revealed that Trafalgar Law's [spoiler]full name[/spoiler] is [spoiler]Trafalgar D. Water Law[/spoiler], making him [spoiler]one of the carriers of the legendary "Will of the D."[/spoiler]

payload.body:
A [[Touken Ranbu]] character.

A [[tachi (weapon)|tachi]] forged by Gojou Kuninaga. He had gone through several owners (one of them being Oda Nobunaga, so he is often depicted in fanworks alongside other swords owned by him), and was stolen from his owners twice; once from the grave of Sadayasu of the Adachi clan, and also from a shrine by Koudeki of the Honami Clan. He is currently part of the Imperial Collection alongside [[Ichigo Hitofuri]], [[Uguisumaru]] and [[Hirano Toushirou]].

Because of how he tended to be stolen from his resting place, and because of his long life in general, Tsurumaru has a love of surprises and likes to sneak up on people to surprise them. This has naturally earned him a reputation of being a troll in fanworks who plays pranks on the other characters for his own amusement. 

He has [[white hair]] and [[yellow eyes]], and wears [[Japanese clothes]] with a [[hood]] and [[pom_pom_(clothes)|pom pom]]s. He has [[black gloves]] that are [[partially fingerless gloves|partly fingerless]] and [[Japanese armor]] at his waist.

His name is written with the kanji for "[[crane_(animal)|crane]]", and he often references how he resembles one due to his white clothing. Ironically, despite cranes representing longevity and good fortune in Japanese culture, most of his masters did not live long.

h4. See also

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese escort ship [i]Tsushima[/i]. Character design by [[Akasaka Yuzu]], voiced by [[Imamura Ayaka]] (initial) and [[Seto Asami]] (after Imamura's retirement). 

She has [[long_hair|long]] [[purple hair]] with [[pink hair|pink]] [[gradient_hair|gradient]], and [[two-tone eyes|two-tone]] [[purple eyes|purple]]-[[yellow eyes]]. Her default outfit is the [i]Etorofu[/i]-class uniform: a [[white shirt]] with [[puffy short sleeves]] and a [[blue sailor collar]], [[aqua neckerchief]], [[white hat|white]] [[beret]], [[white gloves]], [[blue skirt|blue]] [[pleated skirt]], [[black thighhighs]], and [[grey footwear|grey]] [[loafers]]. 

Her [[rigging]] is shared with the rest of the class: her funnel and masts to her back, a 12 cm [[handgun]] mount, 25 mm [[anti-aircraft gun]] and [[depth charge]]s on [[thigh strap]]s, additional depth charges slung to her side, and a [[blue ribbon|blue]] ankle ribbon.

As a coastal defense ship, her class is even smaller than destroyers, and as such, she is portrayed as an "elementary school student" character, even younger than the generally "middle school" appearances of the destroyers. She comes off as having a cool personality.

The seventh member of the class, she was transferred to Taiwan post-war as ROCS [i]Lin An[/i], serving until 1963. She is named after "Tsushima Island":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tsushima_Island]  at the Korea Strait between South Korea and Japan. The island is also known as Daemado (대마도) as Changwon City, South Korea "lays claim to the island":[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Korean_claim_to_Tsushima_Island], but not South Korea itself.

This expression is sometimes accompanied by the [[head down|head tilted downward]], sometimes with face facing forward but [[looking up]], often occurs alongside [[raised eyebrows]]. This is similar to [[sanpaku]] in that the white sclera of their eyes might be visible to three of four sides of their irises, but in this tag refers to a soft, gentle expression, whereas [[sanpaku]] refers to a shocked, angry, detatched, or unhinged expression.

payload.body: [[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese destroyer [i]Ushio[/i]. Character design by [[Drew (drew213g)|]], voiced by [[Hayasaka Kozue]]. She has [[long hair|long]] [[black hair]] with an [[ahoge]], and [[brown eyes]]. Her default outfit is the Special Type's [[serafuku]] and [[black_socks|black]] [[kneehighs]]. Her [[cannon|12.7 cm twin gun mount]] is colored pink, and which has a [[:3]] face upon its top so that looking down at it, the cannon barrels look like ears on a bunny. She normally hugs her cannon tightly to her chest (to hide her chest, presumably). She has [[long_hair|long]] [[black hair]] with a notable [[ahoge]]. The [[torpedo tubes]] strapped to her thighs have puppy, kitty, bunny, and other cartoon animal [[sticker]]s on them. Her damaged CG reveals that she's hiding surprisingly [[large breasts]] for a destroyer/young girl. The reason for this may be that "Ushi" is the word for "cow", so she has "Ushi Oppai", or "cow tits", which is how some Japanese mock women with larger-than-normal cup sizes. Historically, the real-life [i]Ushio[/i] took part in many of the IJN's operations and was one of the extremely few surviving Japanese destroyers of [[World War II]], alongside only [[Yukikaze (kancolle)|]] and [[Hibiki (kancolle)|]] of the ships in the game. Also famous for being a "lucky" ship, she is unlike [[Yukikaze (Kancolle)|]] and [[Shigure (Kancolle)|]] in the sense that she protected her companions instead of jinxing them. h4. A utility pole is a column or post, frequently made of wood, used to support overhead [[power lines]] and various other public utilities, such as electrical cable, fiber optic cable, and related equipment such as [[transformer|transformers]] and street lights. 

Depending on the application they may be referred by various names, such as transmission pole, telephone pole, telecommunication pole, power pole, telegraph pole, and telegraph post.

Should not be confused with a [[transmission tower]], which are large towers, frequently made of a steel lattice, used to carry high voltage electrical lines.

payload.body:
A [b]V[/b] or [b]U[/b]-shaped head attachment commonly found on Gundams and similar [[mobile suit]]s, where they function as potent [[radio antenna]]s or other sensory and detection equipment. They may be a single piece, such as on the [[RX-78-2 Gundam]], have protrusions like on the [[Strike Freedom Gundam|Strike Freedom]], be comprised of detached segments like [[Gundam Harute|Harute]]'s v-fin, or be made of energy or flames like on the [[Beginning Gundam]] and [[Phantom Gundam|Phantom]].

Please note that this tag does not necessarily implicate [[Gundam]] or a parody of the franchise, as mecha from other series may have the same design element.  Examples of this include [[Prowl (transformers)|]] and [[Strongarm_(transformers)|]] from [[Transformers]] and the [[Huckebein]] series from [[Super Robot Wars]].

Similarly, not every Gundam features a v-fin, such as the [[Turn A Gundam (mobile suit)|Turn A]], which has a [[mustache]], [[G-Self]], which has [[horns]], and [[Gundam Ez8|Ez-8]], which has an [[radio antenna|antenna]].

In real life the V-fins were inspired by the crests found on ancient [[Japan]]ese [[kabuto (helmet)|]] helmets.

payload.body:
Foreigner-class Servant seen in [[Fate/Grand Order]], introduced during the [[Imaginary Scramble]] event. She is a [[genderswap (mtf)|]]ped version of [[Vincent Van Gogh (person)|]], a Dutch post-impressionist painter who is among the most famous and influential figures in the history of Western art, though he was considered a failure and a madman during his lifetime. His most famous paintings include [i]The Starry Night[/i], [i]Cafe Terrace at Night[/i], and the [i]Sunflowers[/i] series.

It is revealed later that the named servant is not in anyway related to Van Gogh but instead is "Clytie":https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clytie_(Oceanid), a water nymph and daughter of Oceanus and Tethys from Greek Mythology, and her existence is more in line with the [[passionlip (fate)|Alter]] [[meltryllis (fate)|Egos]] where they are [[kingprotea (fate)|goddesses]] and [[sitonai (fate)|deities]] forced into a mixed existence of human form. 

[[Vincent Van Gogh (person)|]] in [[Fate (series)|]] has the ability to transform Servants into Gods through his artwork, thus he was targeted by the Outer Gods who desired him for their plans. However, rather than submitting to their wills, he killed himself in an act of defiance that carried over with him even as a Heroic Spirit. This forced the Outer Gods to instead create another "Van Gogh" using his powers and memories and mixing his "Spirit Origin/Saint Graph":https://typemoon.fandom.com/wiki/Saint_Graph with that of Clytie's, creating a cruel combination of Clytie (her body), "Vincent" (his abilities) and with power of that of an "Outer God/Foreigners'":https://typemoon.fandom.com/wiki/Foreigner.

Their existence as a Servant thus becomes an endless struggle of conflicting existence, where Vincent will constantly try to kill himself by various curses (as seen from their first ability; Void Space Fine Arts), and Clytie, who is determined to stay alive, will defy his attempts (reviving herself with the "Guts" skill).

[b]Character Design:[/b] [[Kibadori Rue]]
[b]Voice Actress:[/b] [[Takahashi Karin]]

payload.body:
The main protagonist of [[Trigun]] manga and anime series. Nicknamed [i]"The Humanoid Typhoon"[/i].

A tall, blond-haired man who seems to have disaster follow him wherever he goes. He is feared by the people of Gunsmoke as a ruthless, destructive killer. Supposedly responsible for the annihilation of July City, Vash has quite the bounty placed on his head – 60 billion double-dollars, dead or alive! Constantly hounded by often entire towns of people wanting to claim the reward for his capture, Vash is always wandering, never staying in one place for too long (and leaving behind a lot of property damage). In reality, Vash is not a homicidal maniac, but a complete and utter goofball who actually refuses to kill anyone, despite the huge pistol he keeps with him at all times, a prosthetic arm that can switch into a machine gun, and a switchblade in his boot. He has an extreme fondness for donuts (and sometimes alcohol). He claims to be a "hunter of LOVE AND PEACE, searching for the mayfly known as Love".

A major character in the [[Dragon Ball]] franchise, first introduced in [[Dragon Ball Z]]. Vegeta made his appearance in chapter #204 "Sayonara, Son Goku", published in Weekly Shounen Jump magazine on January 7, 1989, seeking the wish-granting Dragon Balls to achieve immortality.

Prince of the Saiyan race, and the main villain of the Saiyan arc before becoming a reluctant ally of the heroes during the Frieza arc. His family and home world was destroyed by [[Frieza]], and was forced to serve under his wing, until he met and fought against [[Son Goku]].

He always refers to Goku by his Saiyan name "Kakarot", who he regarded as his rival. He later becomes a full ally of the Dragon Team after the [[Cell (Dragon Ball)|]] arc, marries [[Bulma]] and together they had two children, [[Trunks (dragon ball)|]] and [[Bra (dragon ball)|]]. Some of his most famous techniques are [[Big Bang Attack]], [[Final Flash]] and [[Galick Gun]].

Voiced by [[Horikawa Ryou]] in the Japanese version, Christopher Sabat in the Funimation English dub, and René García in the Latin American Spanish dub.

The remodeled form of [[Hibiki (kancolle)|]] in [[Kantai Collection]]. Character design by [[Yadokari (Migihashi)|]], voiced by [[Suzaki Aya]].

She replaces the sailor shirt shared with the rest of the Akatsuki class with a [[belt]]ed button-up [[sailor shirt]] and her hat is now white with red trimmings, with a [[hammer and sickle]] and [[star (symbol)|]] pin on it. As for her [[torpedo tubes]], she replaces her Japanese 61 cm triple mounts with Soviet 53.3 cm quad mounts on either side. Curiously, she retains her 12.7 twin gun mount Type B to her right.

Often nicknamed "Bep" (as if the Cyrillic letters "Вер" were read as Latin letters), "Beppu" ("別府", same thing but as a pun to the city of the same name) or "Nuinui" ("ヌイヌイ", like [[Shiranui (kancolle)|]], so it's not uncommon to see the two being paired together) as her name might be difficult to pronounce for the Japanese (and most non-Russian speakers alike).

In-game, she is characterized with a lack of stock equipment (she predates [[Gangut (kancolle)|]]'s appearance by 3.5 years and [[Tashkent (kancolle)|]]'s - who actually used some of the equipment that Verniy would be equipped with - by 4.5 years, and thus such equipment were unavailable in-game when Verniy came out), a relatively low luck for her sheer longevity (she was only lucky in the way she avoided combat by being in repairs), and her high resilience compared to destroyers of her size (only [[Suzutsuki (Kancolle)|]] and [[Tashkent (Kancolle)|]] exceeds her in health, both are also significantly larger than Verniy, only [[Shimakaze (Kancolle)|]], [[Yukikaze (Kancolle)|]], and [[Amatsukaze (Kancolle)|]] exceeds her armor but none of them can equip bulges, which Verniy can).

payload.body:
One of four goddesses of Gamindustri, Vert presides over the Land of Green Pastures, Leanbox. She is as she appears: mature, calm, and friendly to all. However, Vert is also a gaming fanatic and will put her wants before her needs. This often leads her to being tired out since she's playing video games almost all the time rather than working. She likes [[yaoi|BL-stuff]], which she keeps as a secret from her friends.

Vert wears a dress that is primarily green with gold markings along with a pink bow that adorns the top of her skirt, as well as green and white gloves. At the collar of her dress is a gold piece with a blue gem in the center along with a maroon and gold ribbon. Vert has [[blonde hair]] [[long hair|that reaches her waist]], along with [[blue eyes]] that aren't always fully open, which may attest to her constant gaming. She has the [[large breasts|second-largest breast size]] of the entire extended cast. Initially the largest, she was dethroned by [[CFW Magic]] in the sequel [[Choujigen Game Neptune Mk2]], who sports an H cup.

Vert is the only CPU who doesn't get a 'sister'. This leads to her being very friendly, almost obsessively so, with the other nations' CPU candidates, particularly [[Nepgear]]. In Re;Birth 1, she also shows a fondness for [[IF (neptunia)|]].

Vert is the personification of the Xbox 360.

Voiced by: [[Satou Rina]] (Japanese), [[Tara Platt]] (English, 2011-2015), [[Carrie Keranen]] (English, 2016-)

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the battleship HMS [i]Warspite[/i] (03). Character design by [[Konishi (koconatu)|]], voiced by [[Uchida Shuu]].

She has [[long hair|long]] [[blonde hair]] styled in a [[half up braid]] and [[blue eyes]]. Her outfit consists of a [[long sleeves|long sleeved]] [[corset]]ed [[white dress|white]] [[off-shoulder dress]] with a [[red ribbon]] in front. She also wears a [[black hairband]] with a [[mini crown]], [[white thighhighs]] held up by [[garter straps]], [[high heels|high heeled]] [[black shoes|black]] [[mary janes]], and a silver [[necklace]]. 

Her [[rigging]] is in the shape of a [[throne]] which she sits on, and contains her real-life crane and two 38 cm twin gun mounts, her real-life mainmast as a [[scepter]], and a [[globus cruciger]]. 

She is often considered the first foreign shipgirl to actually be able to speak her native language properly by fans, unlike those before her (the German and Italian shipgirls, [[Iowa (kancolle)|]], [[Kongou (kancolle)|]] and [[Verniy (kancolle)|]] to an extent) that have been notorious for their [[ranguage]]. She even goes so far as to speak her English lines in a native-sounding, vaguely British accent (largely thanks to her voice actress being born in Australia). Although Warspite speaks with a Western-sounding accent, actual sentences, such as "Sally go!" demonstrate grammar a native speaker would not use.

Warspite behaves in the manner of a sedate, high-class British lady. She is often depicted in fanart alongside fellow English-speakers [[Iowa (kancolle)|]] and [[Kongou (Kancolle)|]]. She has hourly lines talking about Italian ships [[Littorio (kancolle)|]] and [[Roma (kancolle)|]], who she unsuccessfully tried to escort out of Italy following the Italian surrender, and [[Zara (kancolle)|]] and [[Pola (kancolle)|]], who she sank.

The historic HMS [i]Warspite[/i] was the Royal Navy's most decorated battleship, serving in both World War I and II. After a long career, she was scrapped after the end of World War II.

[b]The Moon Princess Connecting Sea and Mountain[/b]
[b][spoiler]The Sage Who Links the Triangular Mountain and the Sea   (Fossilized Wonders)[/spoiler][/b]

A [[Touhou]] character introduced in the manga [[Silent Sinner in Blue]]. Lunarian princess and older sister of [[Watatsuki no Yorihime]]. She has the ability to manipulate boundaries, similar to [[Yakumo Yukari]], but her power is limited to boundaries involving the moon. She has a [[folding_fan|fan]] capable of mass destruction (said to be big enough to wipe out the Bamboo Forest completely).

Toyohime has [[blonde hair]] with [[yellow eyes]]. Her [[hat]] has a [[purple bow]], and her [[purple dress]] has a [[single strap]].

[spoiler]She makes her first appearance in a mainline game as the Stage 5 Boss of [[Fossilized Wonders]], where she received a slight redesign: Her hat is now a [[mob cap]] with a [[purple ribbon]], her fan and her eyes are now [[red_eyes|red]]. [/spoiler]

[spoiler]In FW, Toyohime is revealed to be the administrator of the Asama Impurity-Cleansing Mountain, a Lunarian facility in Gensokyo. In order to prevent the influx of impurity from destroying the Lunar Capital, she unsealed Ariya and rebooted Yuiman to resolve the incident on the Lunar Capital, leading to time being frozen in Gensokyo and creating a new incident.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]Similar to Sagume, Toyohime is one of the few non final boss characters in the series to not have a "defeated" portrait.[/spoiler]

A former [[Virtual Youtuber|VTuber]], and member of [[hololive English]]'s 1st generation, [[holoMyth]]. Designed by [[Nabi (UZ02)|]].

A [[detective]] time traveler with a [[Sherlock Holmes]] motif. Refers to herself as "Amelia Watson" to make her name sound more natural for English-speaking viewers. Also known as "Ame" for short.

She has [[medium hair|medium]] [[blonde hair]] and [[blue eyes]], hiding [[large breasts|a sizable bust]] under the layers of clothing. Her default hairstyle is a [[bob cut]] with a monocle [[hair ornament]].

Despite being called "the most normal-looking" and "oddball" out of the other [[HoloMyth]] debut (due to her not being a monster girl), she is actually the most chaotic of the bunch. She also likes to make jokes and banter, giving rise to her connection with the [[ground pound]] meme.

Her mascot and pet dog [[Bubba (watson amelia)|]] can occasionally be heard during her streams. She also has a pet cat named [[Wellington (watson amelia)|]].

Due to their frequent collaborations and chemistry both in videos and on Twitter, it is common to see her coupled with [[Gawr Gura]], a ship known as "AmeSame". Fans were quick to also compare her to [[Akai Haato]] due to their similar chaotic nature, which extends to collabs.

She reached one million subscribers on February 11 (JST) / 10 (PST) 2021.

Her general activities ended on September 30th, 2024, but she did not fully "graduate" and is still affiliated with Cover Corp, participating in future projects.

She is often pictured wielding an [[L-STAR]], as the weapon was added to the game at the same time as her, and her heirloom weapon is the [[Energy Reader (apex legends)|]]. She has a pet [[cat]] named [[Nikola (apex legends)|]], and is notably fond of [[Nessie (respawn)|]] - to the point that she's credited as the person responsible for the plushies hidden around the various maps.

payload.body:
Weiss Schnee is one of the main characters of [[RWBY]], a 3DCG series produced by Rooster Teeth. 

Weiss is the "W" in RWBY, and is associated with the color white. Her character design is inspired by [[Snow White (fairy tale character)|]].
[[Winter Schnee]] is her sister. As heiress to the Schnee Dust Company, her life has been marked by pressure. Her arrogant and prickly exterior hides a softer heart. 

h4. Abilities 
She wields a sword/revolver hybrid weapon named [[Myrtenaster]], a "Multi-Action Dust [[Rapier]]" (MADR). Her symbol is a snowflake, and [[magic circle|magic circles]] ("glyphs") appear when she uses her semblance (special ability).  

h4. Physical characteristics 
Weiss has [[blue eyes]] and [[long hair|long]] [[white hair]] tied into a [[ponytail]] off to one [[side_ponytail|side]]. She has a [[scar]] [[scar_across_eye|over]] her left eye.  

She stands 5' 3" tall (including [[high heels]]). 

h4. Attire

She usually wears a [[tiara]] in her hair, around her ponytail, and often wears a bit of jewelry: [[earrings]] and a [[necklace]] with [[pendant]]. Her default outfit includes a white [[cropped jacket]] with a [[high collar]] (revealing the red interior lining) and [[long sleeves|long]] [[wide sleeves]], a blueish-[[white dress|white]] [[strapless dress]] with [[lace-trimmed skirt]] over a [[petticoat]], and blueish-[[white boots]] with [[high heel boots|high heels]]. Her [[belt]] is a [[ribbon]] tied with a [[bow]] in front, holding a [[belt pouch]] with Dust supplies on her back.  

Her Beacon [[school uniform]] consists of a [[white shirt|white]] [[blouse]] with [[neck ribbon]], brown [[blazer]], and [[plaid skirt]].

h4. Appearance

* !post #2051268

h4. External links

* "RWBY Wikia: Weiss Schnee":https://rwby.wikia.com/wiki/Weiss_Schnee

payload.body:
The "Bug of Light Wriggling in the Dark". Stage 1 boss of [[Touhou]]'s [i][[Imperishable Night]][/i].
A youkai insect (in her case, based on a [[firefly]]) with the ability to manipulate insects. She is best known, however, for the confusion surrounding her gender (due to her [[androgynous]] appearance) prior to the full release of IN. Doujins portray her as a member of [[Team 9 (touhou)|]], a posse of low-tier Touhou characters alongside [[Cirno]], [[Mystia Lorelei]] and [[Rumia]]. Also humorously called "G" (short for "gokiburi", Japanese for "cockroach"), due to the antennae on her head. She is also frequently associated with [[Kazami Yuuka]], because they have similar hairstyles and because bugs pollinate flowers.

She has [[short hair|short]] [[green hair]] and [[green eyes]] with thin [[antennae]] on her head. Her outfit is a [[collared shirt|collared]] [[white shirt]] with [[long sleeves]], a [[two-sided cape|two-sided]] [[black cape|black]] and [[red cape]], [[blue shorts|blue]] or [[black shorts]], [[white socks]], and either [[red shoes|red]] [[mary janes]] or [[brown shoes|brown]] [[loafers]]. 

In [i]Imperishable Night[/i], when the player character moves to the top of the screen to obtain an item, they bump into Wriggle, who descends from above. This appears to be a flying kick from Wriggle, and the meme "[b]Wriggle Kick[/b]" named after this is fairly well-known in Touhou fan fiction.

payload.body:
[[Genshin Impact]] character.

The second son of the Feiyun Commerce Guild, Xingqiu has had a reputation for being studious and polite ever since he was a young child.
But there is another side to the mild-mannered Xingqiu everyone knows. A daring, adventurous, and much more mischievous side...

His name is pronounced [b]Yukuaki[/b] in the Japanese version of the game.

Xingqiu has dark, navy [[blue hair]] with [[asymmetrical bangs]] and [[yellow_eyes|golden amber eyes]]. He has a slight frame and a light skin tone. He typically wears a blue [[earrings|earring]] with a gold [[tassel_earrings|tassel]] on his right ear. He is the only character who wears a [[single_earring|single right earring]]. Other characters either have two earrings, no earrings, or a single left earring. His [[vision_(genshin_impact)|vision]] is pinned to the bottom of the left side of his coat on top of a span of frilled, white fabric. A tassel made of amber which matches his eyes hangs from the vision.

His attire consists of a [[long_coat|long coat]] of silk which gradients from black at the collar, to shades of navy blue as the material descends. The coat's underneath is colored a contrasting yellow and a faint, wavy pattern which alludes to his hydro vision is situated all over the fabric. His [[frilled_shirt_collar|collar]] and shoulder plates are rimmed with a gold, metallic material and to the right side of his chest sits a large and circular [[brooch|brooch]]. It's embedded with a blue jewel, alike the center of his collar, coat buttons and sleeve cuffs (front and side). Underneath, Xingqiu wears a white [[long_sleeves|long-sleeved]] [[shirt|shirt]] with a frilled seam to the right, revealed by the slit of his coat behind two overlapping ribbon-like buttons. He additionally wields distinct, [[frilled_sleeves|frilled sleeves]] which extend from his coat's baggy, gold pair. A clover-like [[ribbon|ribbon]] of white, black and yellow is pinned to the right side of his [[belt|belt]]. Beneath this hangs a pair of rectangular ribbons, one in white covering a notably longer, black ribbon. Both of them wield gold decals at their ends. He also wears a pair of navy-[[blue_shorts|blue shorts]] with ends of black that are mostly concealed by the length of his coat. On his right leg, Xingqiu wears a [[frilled thigh strap|garter]] with a blue tassel, just below the knee. His footwear consists of a pair of white high-calf [[boots|boots]], black at the [[high_heels|heels]] and soles with gold motifs.

payload.body:
A [[Touken Ranbu]] character. A [[tantou]] crafted by Awataguchi, and thus one of the many Toushirou brothers. 

In 1493, [[Hatakeyama Masanaga]] tried to commit hara-kiri using this dagger, but he couldn't cut deep into his flesh. He got angry and threw the dagger, and then the dagger pierced directly through a yagen (a stone mill for medicinal herbs). The dagger gained the reputation for never damaging its master but sharp. That's responsible for its name. He was also owned by [[Oda Nobunaga (real life)|]] at one point. It's said that Yagen was burned down at the Honnō-ji Incident with Nobunaga.

He has [[short hair|short]] [[black hair]] and [[purple eyes]]. His standard outfit is a [[military uniform]], a [[necktie]] and [[black gloves]]. For his Internal Affairs outfit, he wears [[glasses]], a [[lab coat]] and [[suspenders]]. For both outfits he wears [[shorts]] and [[black socks|black]] [[kneehighs]].

Known for being very mature and reliable, and having a very deep voice despite his youthful appearance. Of course, artists tend to portray him as a precocious kid. Either that, or he's presented as a reliable big brother for the other Awataguchi school tantous when [[ichigo hitofuri|Ichigo]] is away, as he's the only one of them in-game that's been used in combat prior to personification. For this reason he's known as "Aniki" outside of game.

payload.body:
The "Brain of the Moon". Secondary final boss of [[Touhou]]'s [[Imperishable Night]].

Lunarian pharmaceutical genius responsible for creating the Hourai Elixir that gave her good friend [[Houraisan Kaguya]] - and later Kaguya's bitter nemesis, [[Fujiwara no Mokou]] - immortality. She has since been Kaguya's bodyguard and caretaker in their mansion, Eientei. She is also the mentor of Kaguya's pet lunar rabbit, [[Reisen Udongein Inaba]], and by extension Reisen's charge, earth-born rabbit youkai [[Inaba Tewi]]. Owing to her expertise, she became [[Gensokyo]]'s chief pharmacist.

Due to her estimated age (well over 1000 years old and possibly one of the original Lunarians) and her relatively mature demeanor (compared to her charge), she is often included in the "Old Maids Alliance" with [[Yakumo Yukari]] and [[Yasaka Kanako]].

Most famous for the fans' rallying cry "Eirin! Eirin! [[Tasukete Eirin]]!" which, in fact, originated from Houraisan Kaguya.

On her hat is typically the [[red cross]] symbol. At the bottom of her dress are [[trigram|trigrams]] composing the [[bagua]]. She is frequently depicted with [[constellation|constellations]] sewn into her dress.

Her surname invokes the name of the Shinto god of intellect and wisdom, Yagokoro-no-Omoikane. This, combined with ZUN's comment about her being in "the higher order of gods", gave rise to the belief that she may in fact be Omoikane.

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese light cruiser [i]Yahagi[/i]. Character design by [[Konishi (koconatu)|]], voiced by [[Yamada Yuuki (voice actor)|]].

She has [[long_hair|long]] [[black hair]] tied into a [[ponytail]] with a red [[scrunchie]] and has notable [[sidelocks]] and [[red eyes]]. Her default outfit is her class' uniform: a [[sleeveless]] [[serafuku]] that exposes her [[midriff]], [[red skirt|red]] [[pleated skirt]], dark [[blue necktie]], [[white gloves]], [[black belt]], [[rudder footwear]], and [[asymmetrical legwear]] where the left leg has a [[single thighhigh]] stocking on a [[garter_straps|garter strap]]. 

Her [[rigging]] consists of her real-life bridge and foremast to her back, two hull pieces containing her three real-life 15.2 twin gun mounts with a [[joystick]] control, an 8 cm twin [[anti-aircraft gun]] mount on her right [[rudder footwear|rudder boot]], and her [[flight deck]] on the left boot. 

She speaks in a serious tone, with militaristic terminology. She has a line about enjoying [[Sasebo]] burgers (named after her hometown) as an uncharacteristic soft side to her. While she acts mature around her sisters, she tends to play an awed junior to (or romantic interest to) [[Yamato (Kancolle)|]].

The historical [i]Yahagi[/i] was sunk a couple months before the end of the war in the ill-fated [[Operation Ten-gou]], a suicide mission which sank [[Yamato (Kancolle)|]] and virtually everyone else involved. Because of this, she almost always appears either with Yamato, her sister ships, or guarding destroyers.

[[Yakumo Yukari]]'s 800+-year-old [[kyuubi]] [[kitsune]] shikigami who specializes in black magic and mathematics. She is also powerful enough to have her own shikigami, a [[cat girl|nekomata]] named [[Chen]], to whom she is portrayed to act motherly towards prominently in fanworks. Yukari treats Ran as closer to a tool that follows orders, sometimes to such an extent that Yukari wishes she had more free will. In subsequent games and manga, it has been revealed that Ran is actually parasitically taking host of a nine-tailed fox youkai who was once an inhabitant of the Animal Realm, and was friends with [[Toutetsu Yuuma]].

She is notorious in many fanworks as a streaker, earning her the nickname "Suppa Tenko":/pools/1733 ("Naked Heavenly Fox"), and for bursting into an [[excessive nosebleed]] if Chen does anything exceptionally cute.

She is a [[fox girl]] with has [[short hair|short]] [[blonde hair]] and [[yellow eyes]], but she usually has her [[fox ears|ears]] covered by her [[white hat|white]] [[mob cap]] and her [[multiple tails|multiple]] [[fox tail|tails]] under her dress. Her outfit is a [[long dress|long]][[white dress]] with [[long sleeves]] and a [[blue tabard]].

payload.body:
The "Youkai of Boundaries". Phantasm Stage boss of [[Touhou]]'s [[Perfect Cherry Blossom]] and later a recurring playable character.

A powerful youkai of at least 1200 years of age, reputedly older than [[Gensokyo]] itself. Nominally responsible for guarding the border between Gensokyo and the outside world using her power of manipulating boundaries and her [[gap (touhou)|]]s, but is frequently sleeping or slacking around, leaving her work to her [[shikigami]] [[Yakumo Ran]] and Ran's own shikigami [[Chen]]. In [[Silent Sinner in Blue]] she has two pet [[crow]]s - [[Zenki (touhou)|]] and [[Goki (touhou)|]].

She has [[long hair|long]] [[blonde hair]] with [[multiple hair bows|multiple]] [[red bow]]s, and either [[yellow eyes|yellow]] or [[purple eyes]]. Her outfit is a [[white hat|white]] [[mob cap]] with a [[red ribbon|red]] [[hat ribbon]], and then either a [[frilled dress|frilled]] [[white dress]] with [[juliet sleeves]] and a [[purple tabard]] or a [[purple dress]] with [[puffy short sleeves]] and [[white gloves|white]] [[elbow gloves]]. She usually [[holding umbrella|carries]] her [[pink umbrella|pink]] [[parasol]] or a [[folding fan]].

Besides her servants, she is friends with [[Ibuki Suika]], [[Saigyouji Yuyuko]] (whom she knew from as early as the latter's days as a human) and [[Hakurei Reimu]] (the other barrier guardian, whom she sometimes pesters). Also hinted to be [[Morichika Rinnosuke]]'s business partner and supplier of items from the outside world. Yukari has an as-yet undefined connection to [[Maribel Hearn]].

The iconic antagonist of the Japanese horror movie [[The Ring]]. A [[ghost]] girl who haunts a cursed video tape by emerging [[through screen|through the screen]] of anyone who watches it.

Due to her corpse having spent too long at the bottom of a well, she has [[pale skin]], [[long hair|long]], [[black hair|black stringy hair]] [[hair over eyes|covering both of her eyes]], and her fingernails rotted away. She wears a [[white robe]], which is sometimes depicted as a [[white dress]] instead.

She has enjoyed long-lasting popularity in the Japanese - and later worldwide - anime community due to a trend of "moe-ifying" into a ghost girl with [[large breasts]] who will become shy when her eyes are exposed or when her would-be victim pointed out her breasts. This characterization has later become the archetypical depiction of various "ghost girls" in various anime media.

payload.body:
A [[Touken Ranbu]] character. Official art by [[kumita_(sumica)|Kumita]]. Voiced by [[Ichiki Mitsuhiro]].

Both he and [[Kashuu Kiyomitsu]] are personifications of swords owned by [[Okita Souji]]. Unlike Kiyomitsu, who resents Okita for abandoning him, Yasusada is very fond of Okita and hasn't gotten over his former master's death, to the point of dressing and occasionally acting like him. 

He has [[black hair]] worn in a [[high ponytail]], [[blue eyes]], and a [[mole under eye|mole under his left eye]]. His standard outfit is a [[white scarf]], a [[Shinsengumi]] [[haori]], [[black gloves|black]] "[[bridal gauntlets|bridal gauntlet]]"-type gloves, a dark blue [[hakama]], black [[tabi]] and [[zouri]] with blue straps.

Normally, he has a carefree personality with his comrades, but is ruthless and sadistic in battles. Of course, artists tend to portray him as someone who's completely obsessed with Okita (to the point of being dismissive with the Saniwa) and who gets violent for no reason. Either that, or he's presented as a foil to Kiyomitsu.

There is also [[yamato-no-kami yasusada (ootachi)|another sword called Yamato-no-Kami Yasusada]], which is not currently a character in Touken Ranbu.

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese battleship [i]Yamato[/i]. Character design by [[Shizuma Yoshinori]], voiced by [[Taketatsu Ayana]].

She has [[long hair|long]] [[brown hair]] tied to a [[ponytail]], multiple [[cherry blossoms]] in her hair, and [[large breasts]]. 

Her default outfit consists of a [[white shirt]] with [[shoulder cutout]]s and a [[red sailor collar]], [[yellow neckerchief]], grey [[collar]] with a [[kikumon]], a "Z" [[signal flag]] [[armband]], [[red skirt|red]] [[pleated skirt]] with [[hip vent]]s, [[mismatched legwear|mismatched]] [[black socks]] (knee-length on her right, [[black thighhighs|thighhigh]] on her left), AP shells on her [[thigh strap]]s, and [[grey footwear|grey]] [[high heels|high-heeled]] [[rudder footwear]]. She also uses Type 91 AP shell caps as [[breast padding|breast pads]] as shown in her damaged arts. 

Her [[rigging]] consists a headpiece containing her two Type 21 [[radar]]s, and two large hull pieces in a half-circle and held by a funnel to her back, containing all three of her 46 cm triple gun mounts and either four triple 155 mm triple gun mounts (base) or two triple 155 and six 127 mm twin [[anti-aircraft gun]]s (kai). She also uses a [[red umbrella|red]] [[oil-paper umbrella]] patterned off her real-life tripod mast. 

Because the historical [i]Yamato[/i] had a career mostly based around impressing people, Yamato is often depicted as a shy and soft-spoken housewife. Yamato was historically referred to as the [[Hotel Yamato]], due to her relatively luxurious quarters and the fact that she was never used in combat until late in the war, when defeat was certain.

Yamato only fired her massive 460 mm guns in battle once during the Battle of Samar to finish off [[Gambier Bay (kancolle)|]]. This is the only confirmed kill of Yamato during her entire career. She was sunk on 7 April 1945 during [[Operation Ten-gou]], in which she was bombarded with dozens of bombs and torpedoes before being sunk off southern Kyushu.

One of the main characters of [[RWBY]]. Yang is the "Y" in RWBY, and is associated with the color yellow. Her character design is inspired by [[Goldilocks]].

Her Beacon [[school uniform]] consists of a [[white shirt|white]] [[blouse]] with [[neck ribbon]], brown [[blazer]], and [[plaid skirt]]. 

[[Ruby Rose]] is her [[half-siblings|half-sister]]. She loves her family, her hair, her [[motorcycle]], and fights. Guilty of bad puns. 

[spoiler]At the end of Season 3 of RWBY, Yang has her right arm severed at the elbow by [[Adam Taurus]], and in Season 4 receives a [[prosthetic_arm|prosthetic replacement]].[/spoiler]

payload.body:
An [[iDOLMASTER Cinderella Girls|iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls]] character in the Passion (Yellow Sun) category. She is a mysterious girl who goes out of her way to help strangers, speaking and acting as if she's more than just an ordinary person. Her manner of speech, in addition to being very slow and soft, is highly elaborate and old-fashioned, making her sound more like a historical priestess than a modern-day girl: in particular she is known for ending her sentences with でして (deshite), which is regarded as a formal or old-fashioned form of です (desu).

Yoshino has an interest in shrines and temples, which suggests that before becoming an idol she was a miko - however it is heavily implied (due to her ability to resolve people's wishes and find lost items) that she is some form of supernatural entity, possibly the goddess Benzaiten (one of the Seven Lucky Gods or shichifukuji), as several of Yoshino's illustrations show her having a connection to water; in addition to fortune, music and words, Benzaiten is the goddess of water. If that is the case, then the Producer successfully talked a goddess into becoming an idol - although it's possible that she does it just because she enjoys being worshipped.

She is voiced by [[Takada Yuuki]].

payload.body:
[b]Yowane Haku[/b] is an [[original]] [[Vocaloid]] character originated from a [[2channel]] thread where a user commented: [i]"I bought [[Hatsune Miku]] for her cute looks but no matter how hard I try, I can't get anything better than mechanical sounding songs out of her."[/i]

An artist ([[Caffein]]) took this idea and ran with it to create Yowane Haku, an alter ego of all unskilled users of Hatsune Miku. Haku is a sad Vocaloid who just can't sing as well as Miku. She is always crying because of this and vents her frustration by drinking. Her image colors are silver and purple. Her character item is a sake bottle. She's also noted for her [[large breasts|curvier figure]] compared to Miku and has a decent following. Haku's name means "speaking weak words" ('speaking' here has connotation of a pent-up sigh or muttering.)

This created a trend of users labeling badly-made Vocaloid songs with voyakiloid, or "shouting vocaloid." It is implied that it was Haku who sung those songs, and not Miku. Later on, she received several fan-made [[mikumikudance|MMD]] models and being treated as a "genuine" character rather than a byword for bad Vocaloid songs.

She has [[long hair|long]] [[grey hair]] (sometimes depicted as [[white hair|white]]) tied in a [[ponytail]], and [[sidelocks]]. Her usual attire consists of a [[crop top|cropped]] [[sleeveless shirt|sleeveless]] [[collared shirt|collared]] [[grey shirt|grey]] [[cropped shirt|shirt]] with a [[purple necktie]], [[black sleeves|black]] [[detached sleeves]] with [[purple trim]]s, [[black pants]] held up with a [[purple belt]], [[white boots]] with a [[colored shoe soles|purple soles]], and a [[striped bow|striped]] [[hair bow]].

Since 2012, there is a yearly contest to decide which fan-submitted design will be used as the official Yuki Miku of that year, the winner of which also gets their design turned into a Petite [[Nendoroid]] by [[Goodsmile Company]].

h4. Appearance

* !post #11096693: Successive Yuki Miku as of 2025; from left-to-right, top-to-bottom.

h4. Versions

* [[yuki miku (2010)|2010]] - Hatsune Miku's usual outfit colored to blue, white, and silver. 
* [[yuki miku (2011)|2011]] - Same outfit as the 2010 version, but given [[earmuffs]], a white [[scarf]], and white [[mittens]]. Now used as the default Yuki Miku.
* [[yuki miku (2012)|2012]] - "Fluffy Coat version" (ふわふわコートVer.): Wears a blue ribbon [[hairband]] and a coat with white [[fur trim]]. Has [[fur-trimmed boots]] to match.
* [[yuki miku (2013)|2013]] - "Strawberry White Dress version" (いちご白無垢Ver.): Wears a white kimono and [[uchikake]].
* [[yuki miku (2014)|2014]] - "Magical Snow version": Wears a [[witch hat]], a blue [[cape]], and wields a [[staff]].
* [[yuki miku (2015)|2015]] - "Snow Bell version": has a plant motif, wears a white [[bubble skirt]] and [[capelet]].
* [[yuki miku (2016)|2016]] - "Snow Owl version": Wears an owl-shaped [[hat]] and sports gear.
* [[yuki miku (2017)|2017]] - "Twinkle Snow version": Wields a [[wand]] and wears a sleeveless blue [[dress]].
* [[yuki miku (2018)|2018]] - "Crane Priestess version" (タンチョウ巫女Ver.): Has a crane-themed [[miko]] outfit with [[striped_legwear|striped]] [[thighhighs]].
* [[yuki miku (2019)|2019]] - "Princess version": Wields a [[scepter]] and wears a green and white [[frilled dress]], with a crystal [[tiara]], [[detached collar]], and equally as [[detached sleeves|detached]] [[juliet sleeves]].
* [[yuki miku (2020)|2020]] - "Snow Parade version": A [[band uniform]] motif with a [[french horn]], [[epaulettes]] that have a [[fringe trim]], and [[hat feather]].
* [[yuki miku (2021)|2021]] - "Glowing Snow version": A choir outfit with a clock motif featuring a [[clock print]] [[beret]] and [[white dress]].
* [[yuki miku (2022)|2022]] - "Grand Voyage version": A naval captain outfit with a crab motif featuring red [[hair ribbon]] that resemble crab claws and a [[fur-trimmed coat]].
* [[yuki miku (2023)|2023]] - "Serene Winter version": A pink and blue pastel palette [[kimono]] with a daybreak motif. She wields a [[giant brush]].
* [[yuki miku (2024)|2024]] - "Winter Feast version": A traditional [[Japanese clothes|Japanese outfit]] with a [[soup curry]] motif.
* [[yuki miku (2025)|2025]] - "Crystal Snow version": Carries an [[icicle]] [[wand]] and wears various winter-themed accessories, including [[icicle]], [[snowball]], and [[crystal|ice crystal]] [[hair ornament]]s.
* [[yuki miku (2026)|2026]] - "Sweet Snow version": Western-style dress with apron. Her hair is adorned with [[musical_note-themed_food|musical note-themed sweets]] and she wears a beret with a [[strawberry swiss roll]].

Main supporting character in [[Senran Kagura]]. A Third-Year student and leader at the Gessen Academy.

Yumi has dark-grey [[medium hair|medium length hair]], pale white skin, and icy [[blue eyes]], wearing a white and blue [[striped bow]] on the back of her head. When she transforms she wears a solid white [[furisode]] [[kimono]] with a blue double-lined trim and blue [[obi]] on the back, while the top part [[bare shoulders|exposes her shoulders]] and most of her [[cleavage]]. Yumi wields [[hand fan|fans]] and her Ice Sword during her Ice Queen transformation. She wears white [[socks]] and lavender flip flops on her feet. Her Ice Queen Mode loses her hair tie and allows her hair to grow and becoming white icy blue in color, while her eyes become [[red eyes|red]]. 

Yumi is a calm and very serious girl, giving nothing but everything she has when achieving a personal goal she has set for herself. She has also developed a good friendship with [[Asuka_(senran_kagura)|]], as her late grandfather Kurokage was once a friend and rival to Asuka’s grandfather Hanzou. Her hobby is calligraphy, and her favorite food is shaved ice with red bean on top.

When her clothes are ripped off, she is revealed to be wearing [[plaid]] [[lingerie]].

Her seiyuu is [[Hara Yumi]].

Yunyun usually wears a [[black cape|black]] [[hooded cape]], similar in design to Megumin's. She wields a silver [[wand]] and wears a [[dagger]] on her hip. She wears a red [[headband]] and a training outfit - typically the upper half of a [[white dougi|white]] [[sleeveless]] [[dougi]], with a [[blue sports bra]] (or sometimes a [[crop top|cropped]] [[blue shirt|blue]] [[cropped shirt|shirt]]) worn underneath, [[blue gloves|blue]] [[fingerless gloves]], [[blue leggings]], and [[red shoes|red]] [[sneakers]]. 

She is the second child and only daughter of Kyokugen-ryuu [[Karate]] founder [[Takuma Sakazaki]]. She has an older brother named [[Ryou Sakazaki]]. She is the love interest of fellow Kyokugen disciple and friend of the family [[Robert Garcia]].

She practices the Swallow discipline of Kyokugen-ryuu Karate, having learned the family style within a year (against her father's wishes, initially). She is also the first female to be able to perform the [[Haou Shoukou Ken]]. She is often described as a genius, able to learn moves very quickly. For this reason, Yuri has a habit of parodying moves from other characters, most infamously [[Ryu (Street Fighter)|]] and [[Akuma (Street Fighter)|]] from [[Street Fighter]] (a way for [[SNK]] to lightly poke fun back at [[Capcom]] after the latter made [[Hibiki Dan]]).

She first appeared as a damsel in distress, kidnapped by [[Mr Big (SNK)|]] in Art of Fighting 1 and rescued by Ryo and Robert. She made her playable debut in Art of Fighting 2.

Her original fighting stage was a fitness gym, and her signature theme song is named "Diet". As of [[Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves]], which takes place long after the events of Art of Fighting, Yuri owns her own gym.

In the King of Fighters continuity, Yuri is a founding member of the Women Fighters Team alongside [[Shiranui Mai]] and [[King (SNK)|]].

She has a voluntary verbal tic of adding "-cchi" to the end of her sentences, allegedly for the sole purpose of sounding cuter. For example, "余裕!"/"Yoyuu!" ("Easy!") becomes "余裕っち~!"/"Yoyuu-cchi~!" ("Easy peasy~!")

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese light cruiser [i]Yuubari[/i]. Character design by [[Konishi (koconatu)|]], voiced by [[Bridcutt Sarah Emi]].

She has [[medium hair|medium-length]] dull [[green hair]] in a [[ponytail]] secured with a teal [[hair bow]], and [[brown eyes]]. She wears a dark [[blue shirt|blue]] [[sailor shirt]] with a light [[green sailor collar]], [[orange neckerchief]], [[green skirt|green]] [[pleated skirt]], [[black pantyhose]], and [[grey footwear|grey]] [[rudder footwear]]. In the [[Kantai Collection (anime)|Kantai Collection anime]] she also serves as the fleet's [[mechanic]] (due to the absence of [[Akashi (kancolle)|]]) and wears an alternate outfit consisting of an [[orange jumpsuit]] over a [[tank top]]. 

Her [[rigging]] at base form consists of two hull pieces held by the funnel-and-bridge to her back, with all four of her 14 cm twin/single mounts controlled by [[joystick]]s, and two 61 cm twin [[torpedo tubes]] on her ankles. 

As the real life [i]Yuubari[/i] was small in size and displacement (being slightly larger than the [i][[Akizuki (kancolle)|]][/i]-class destroyer), she is depicted with a petite body and costume akin to that of the other destroyer in-game. She is heavily associated with [[melon]]s (more specifically, [[cantaloupe]]s), due to her namesake city in Hokkaido being famous for cantaloupes.

Because the historical [i]Yuubari[/i] was built as an experimental ship to test new designs and configuration, Yuubari is very often portrayed tinkering with or designing new equipment, frequently together with [[Akashi (kancolle)|]]. Historically, [i]Yuubari[/i]'s survivors were rescued by [[Samidare (kancolle)|]], so the two are commonly depicted together, often in a big sister/little sister or romantic relationship.

Personification of the fourth ship of the [i]Shiratsuyu[/i]-class destroyers, [i]Yuudachi[/i] (夕立), in [[Azur Lane]].

Introducing herself as the "Mad Dog of Solomon", her personality takes the dog-like mannerisms that fans gave her [[yuudachi (kancolle)|Kantai Collection counterpart]] and dials them up even further. Yuudachi is highly aggressive, often growling and even outright howling. Like many dogs, she is also food-motivated, and often cannot stop thinking about the consumption of freshly-cooked meat.

Character design by [[Saru]], voiced by [[Takamori Natsumi]].

Yuudachi has [[long hair|long]] [[grey hair]] tied into a [[one side up]] on her right and a [[braid]] from her left sidelock. She has [[red eyes]], [[wolf ears]] with metal plates over the outside, and a [[wolf tail]]. Like Shigure, her outfit consists of a modified [[serafuku]], with a white [[crop top]], [[puffy short sleeves]], a [[black sailor collar]], and a [[red ribbon]]. Below the waist, she wears a [[black skirt|black]] [[pleated skirt|pleated]] [[miniskirt]], [[white socks|white]] [[loose socks]] and [[red shoes|red]] [[rudder footwear|rudder]] [[high heels]]. Additionally, she has [[fingerless gloves]] with red and white leather [[cuffs]], [[stuffed wolf]] toy near her hip, and a rose [[tattoo]] on her right hip. She has [[medium breasts]] despite her small frame and most of her outfits feature [[underboob]].

Her [[rigging]] has a single twin [[ship turret|turret]] on her right, a quad [[torpedo tubes|torpedo tube]] on her right, and a [[smokestack]] on her back. These are all in solid black and white paint-scheme.

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese destroyer [i]Yuudachi[/i]. Character design by [[Kujou Ichiso]], voiced by [[Tanibe Yumi]].

She has [[long hair|long]] [[blonde hair]] and [[green eyes]]. In her [[Yuudachi Kai Ni (Kancolle)|Kai Ni]] form she has [[red eyes]] and dog-ear-like [[hair flaps]]. Her default outfit is the [i]Shiratsuyu[/i]-class' [[school uniform]]: a [[black_serafuku|black]] [[serafuku]], [[black socks]], and brown [[loafers]].

Her [[rigging]] at base form consists of her funnel to her back, a 12.7 cm twin gun mount slung to the side, and two 61 cm quad [[torpedo tubes]] on [[thigh strap]]s. 

She has a carefree, pugnacious yet unsure and worrisome personality. Her catchphrase is "-[[poi (phrase)|]]" (-ぽい), meaning "maybe?". Her "dogness" upon remodel seems to have inspired personifications of the destroyer in other franchises. The [[Yuudachi_(warship_girls_r)|]] in [[Warship Girls R]] has fake dog ears and a [[doge]]-like expression, while the [[Yuudachi (azur lane)|]] in [[Azur Lane]] is a dog girl outright along with the rest of the Shiratsuyu-class.

Her remodel's change in appearance and personality alludes to her alleged performance in the Naval Battle of Guadalcanal and her nickname, "Nightmare of Solomon". Her artist tweeted that her hair flaps were to reflect her "ferocious hound"-like history during her final battle. While the historical Yuudachi was indeed present during the battle, the name "Nightmare of Solomon" was the name US Marines stationed on Guadalcanal christened a night bombardment - a night bombardment that Yuudachi did not participate in.

payload.body:
The second remodel of [[yuudachi (kancolle)|Yuudachi]] from [[Kantai Collection]].

Easily identifiable with hair flaps, different hair ornaments, and (most tellingly) a white sail on her rigging (a reference to how her crew rigged a white sail for emergency propulsion after being severely damaged in the Naval Battle of Guadalcanal). Personality-wise, slightly more aggressive and itching for a battle than her base form.

Her remodel greatly changes her appearance. Her hair becomes messier, with dog-like hair flaps and a red gradient, and she now wears a hairclip alongside with her ribbon. Her eyes are now red and her clothes become more ornate. It's implied she matures physically as well (this is partially confirmed in the anime), so many fan-artists draw her with far more notable breasts. Furthermore, her firepower's potential is practically on par with some of the heavy cruisers, making her very popular.

A martial artist who has mastered the Fiery Spear Hand. He is a Transient who specializes in torture and can inflict internal burns on a victim. Furthermore, he is a tool of the heavens who prioritizes divine law above his Summoner's orders and his own will. He deals with everyone politely and even sinners are no exception. [spoilers]And in the [i][[Final Fantasy VII Remake|FFVII Remake]] trilogy[/i] too.[/spoilers]

[b]Zero[/b] ([b]ゼロ[/b]) is one of the three main characters of the [[Mega Man X (series)|]] series, as well as the protagonist of the [[Mega Man Zero (series)|]] series. He is voiced by [[Okiayu Ryoutarou]][tn](Jp)[/tn].

A high ranking Maverick Hunter in the X series and a legendary freedom fighter in the [[Mega Man Zero (series)|Zero series]], he's a die hard warrior who doesn't hesitate to take action. However, behind his cold and emotionless attitude lies a wounded soul.

He was created by [[Dr. Wily (mega man)|Dr. Albert W. Wily]] during the [[Mega Man (classic)|classic Mega Man]] series. As such, his designation is DWN-∞ (Infinity). [spoiler]He had the Maverick Virus contained inside the gem in his head. When [[Sigma (mega man)|]] smashed the gem, he was infected by the Maverick Virus. Subsequently, Zero no longer showed any signs of Maverick behavior while Sigma became a Maverick.[/spoiler]

Wields the [[Z Saber]].

payload.body:
The [b]zodiac[/b] is the "band" of the night sky roughly corresponding to the solar system's ecliptic plane. Western astrologers divide it into twelve signs, named for the constellation that is nearest the position of the Sun for one-twelfth of the year.  (These periods do not quite line up with the calendar months, so that the sign of the zodiac changes around the twentieth or twenty-first of the month.)

Not to be confused with the popular brand of semi-rigid inflatable boats, the serial killer, the former-Soviet rock band, or the town of Zodiac, Missouri.

h4. The Twelve Signs of the Zodiac

Note: Please don't make these tags into character tags, as they do not refer to specific characters.

* ♈ [[Aries (zodiac)|]]: The Ram, "The Agrarian Worker".
* ♉ [[Taurus (zodiac)|]]: The Bull, "The Steer of Heaven".
* ♊ [[Gemini (zodiac)|]]: The Twins, "The Great Twins".
* ♋ [[Cancer (zodiac)|]]: The Crab, "The Crayfish".
* ♌ [[Leo (zodiac)|]]: The Lio, "The Lion".
* ♍ [[Virgo (zodiac)|]]: The Maiden, "The Furrow"; "The Furrow, the goddess Shala's ear of corn".
* ♎ [[Libra (zodiac)|]]: The Scales, "The Scales".
* ♏ [[Scorpio (zodiac)|]]: The Scorpion, "The Scorpion".
* ♐ [[Sagittarius (zodiac)|]]: Centaur The Archer, "soldier".
* ♑ [[Capricorn (zodiac)|]]: "Goat-horned", "The Goat-Fish".
* ♒ [[Aquarius (zodiac)|]]: The Water Bearer, "The Great One", later "pitcher".
* ♓ [[Pisces (zodiac)|]]: The Fish, "The Tail of the Swallow", later "fish-cord".

Originally a summon. She was later on made into a raid boss, and afterwards into a playable character.

A [[dark skin|dark-skinned]] young woman with  long, [[ahoge|tufted]] blonde-tinted [[white hair]]. Her eye color in official art seems to fluctuate between [[red eyes|red]] and [[orange eyes|orange]]. She wears a [[blue dress|blue]] [[armored dress]] and [[black thighhighs|black]] armored [[thighhighs]]. She wields a shield and an intensely blue sword.

She was given a limited summer version in 2016 despite not ever making it in the top ten female characters in popularity polls prior. This was probably to give players an easier alternative to get her, as her regular version requires one to purchase the official Granblue Fantasy visa card.

Gives herself the name [b]Zooey[/b] in her introduction fate episode, since her full name was hard to pronounce.

h4.Official alternate costumes
[[zooey (summer) (granblue fantasy)|Zooey Summer]]
other_names: ジ・オーダー・グランデ

payload.body:
A race of fish humanoids in the [i][[the legend of zelda|Legend of Zelda]][/i] franchise. They first appear in [i][[The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time]][/i].

They generally live in areas with large amounts of water. Usually a people with a prominent royal line, long lived, and technologically advanced.

In [i][[the legend of zelda: the wind waker|The Wind Waker]][/i], they are a distant relative of the [[Rito]]. May or may not be related to the [[Parella]] of [i][[the legend of zelda: skyward sword|Skyward Sword]][/i].

[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese light aircraft carrier [i]Zuihou[/i]. Character design by [[Konishi (koconatu)|]].

She has [[long_hair|long]], [[grey_hair|grey]] or [[brown_hair|brown hair]] with a [[high_ponytail|high ponytail]]. Her default outfit at base form is a [[nontraditional miko]] set of a [[white kimono]] top with sleeves visibly attached over a red one, lattice trimming on the sleeve ends, [[red shorts]], [[muneate]], red and white-striped [[hachimaki]], and uses a [[bow_(weapon)|bow]] and arrow set.

She has a [[flat chest]]. However, she doesn't have the same amount of [[breast envy]] as [[Ryuujou (kancolle)|]]. If she cooks, it will usually be [[tamagoyaki]]. Sometimes nicknamed "Dzuho", like the characters on her shorts (which were actually on her flight deck, see [[chitose (kancolle)|"Chito"]] and [[chiyoda (kancolle)|"Chiyo"]]).
