payload.body:
[[Azur Lane]]'s personification of the Japanese aircraft carrier [i]Zuikaku[/i]. Character design by [[Enka (bcat)]], voiced by [[Taneda Risa]].

She has [[very long hair|very long]] [[brown hair]] tied into a [[high ponytail]], [[yellow eyes]], and [[large breasts]]. She wears a [[white kimono]] similar to her sister, with [[wide sleeves]] ending in black tips that look like wings of a swan or crane. Her kimono has an attached [[hood]]. She wears a [[red skirt|red]], [[pleated skirt|pleated]] [[miniskirt]] and [[black socks|black]] [[kneehighs]]. Unlike [[Zuikaku (Kancolle)|]] from [[Kantai Collection]], she has [[large breasts]], which often leads to [[breast envy]] moments in certain fanarts.

Her [[rigging]] is composed of a [[flight deck]] at her right hip as well as a [[katana]] and [[sheath]] that she wields.

She's an energetic, driven girl. She views herself as a rival to [[Enterprise (Azur Lane)|]], pestering her for matches in her lines. She's also very fond of her sister, [[Shoukaku (Azur Lane)|]], mentioning her often in her lines.

payload.body:
[[Kantai Collection]]'s personification of the Japanese aircraft carrier [i]Zuikaku[/i]. Character design by [[Konishi (koconatu)|]], voiced by [[Nomizu Iori]].

She has [[long_hair|long]] dark [[green hair]] in [[twintails]], [[yellow_eyes|yellow]]/[[green eyes]], and [[small breasts]]/[[flat chest]]. Her default outfit is a [[nontraditional miko]] set comprising a [[white kimono]] top, [[red skirt|red]] [[hakama short skirt]], [[black thighhighs|black]] [[thigh boots]] with [[rudder footwear|rudder and propeller]] parts, [[brown gloves|brown]] [[yugake]], and a black [[muneate]] with her identifier "Zu" marked on it. 

Her [[rigging]] consists of her [[flight deck]] on her left arm, her real-life hull to her back and used as a [[quiver]], and multiple [[anti-aircraft gun]] placements on her waist and thigh boots. 

In contrast with her sister ship [[Shoukaku (kancolle)|]], Zuikaku is depicted as a brash, hot-headed, reckless, and somewhat [[tomboy]]ish girl, in reference with her turbulent wartime career, in which she was credited for damaging and sinking several ships, but usually at a cost of large numbers of airmen.

She is frequently portrayed as a [[turkey]] and her in-game line "don't call me a turkey" is widely used as a joke on [[4chan]] and [[2channel]]. This stems from the IJN's notoriously poor performance in the battle of the Philippine Sea, where well-trained USN aviators referred to fighting inexperienced IJN pilots as a "turkey shoot". 

Her abyssal form is assumed to be the [[Abyssal Crane Princess]].

payload.body:
[b]Zundamon[/b] is a character who was originally created as [[VOICEROID]] [[Touhoku Zunko]]'s pet since 2017, but received an official [[personification]] and later a text-to-speech voicebank under the [[VOICEVOX]] software in August 2021. She later received a singing voicebank under [[NEUTRINO (software)|]] on July 31, 2022. She is a [[Zundamon (UTAU)|zunda mochi fairy]], and can transform into Zunko's bow called "Zunda Arrow". Its projectized arrow is used by Zunko in order to change a normal [[mochi]] into zunda mochi.

After the release of her text-to-speech voicebank, Zundamon became immensely popular within Japan and later abroad, to the point that she has completely overshadowed her original master Zunko.

Her gender was unknown until her human form's profile was released, describing her as a [[tomboy]]ish girl. Nevertheless, as [[VOICEROID]] characters are predominantly female, she is a popular target for [[genderswap]]s.

Her human form has [[long hair|long]] [[green hair]] tied in a [[low ponytail]] with two [[pea pod]]s on her head, and [[yellow eyes]]. Her outfit is a [[puffy short sleeves|puffy short-sleeved]] [[white shirt]], [[green shorts]] held with [[suspenders]], and [[green boots]].

If Zundamon is only depicted in her [[Zundamon (UTAU)|UTAU]] (mascot / zunda mochi fairy) form, do not tag with [[VOICEVOX]].
